paras.zh: ”我连这山都没下过。“”我知道，“芙蕾雅若有所思。

paras.en: She looked at Anna’s mother. “It would be wonderful if you could finally visit Arendelle.” Anna dropped her spoon into the icing with a loud thud. “Could I?
paras.zh: 她看安娜母亲。”若你终能去阿伦黛尔，该多好。“安娜把勺咚一声掉进糖霜。”我可以吗？

paras.en: I’d bring cookies.
paras.zh: “我会带饼干。

paras.en: Which are your daughter’s favorites?
paras.zh: ”你女儿最爱哪种？

paras.en: The snowmen?
paras.zh: “雪人？

paras.en: Your husband likes the spice cake, I know.…” Her mother jumped in. “Anna, slow down.” Freya was quiet for a moment, lost in her own thoughts. “If I could finally find a way for you to visit, would you like to come stay with me?” Freya asked, her voice cracking. “ Like to come?
paras.zh: ”你丈夫爱香料蛋糕，我知道……“母亲插话。”安娜，慢点。“芙蕾雅静了一瞬，陷入思绪。”若我终于能想法让你来，你愿来陪我住吗？“芙蕾雅声音发颤。”愿来？

paras.en: Of course I’d like to come!” Anna squealed in delight.
paras.zh: “我当然愿来！”安娜开心地尖叫。

paras.en: Her mother smiled sadly at Freya. “Anna’s always wanted to visit Arendelle.
paras.zh: 母亲对芙蕾雅苦涩一笑。“安娜一直想去阿伦黛尔。

paras.en: Do you think there is any way to make that sort of trip possible?” “We don’t know unless we ask,” Freya said to Anna’s mother.
paras.zh: ”你觉得有什么法子成行吗？“”不试怎知，“芙蕾雅对安娜母亲说。

paras.en: Then she looked at Anna. “You’ve waited long enough.” It was like they were speaking in code.
paras.zh: 随后她看安娜。”你等得够久了。“她们像在说暗语。

paras.en: They weren’t making sense to her.
paras.zh: 安娜听不懂。

paras.en: It was just a trip to the kingdom.
paras.zh: 不过去趟王国。

paras.en: Why were they so hesitant?
paras.zh: 她们为何如此犹豫？

paras.en: Anna wanted to ice the cookies fast so she could focus on the conversation.
paras.zh: 安娜想快点给饼干上霜，好专心听对话。

paras.en: Quickly, she tested the icing on the first snowman, letting it drip from her spoon onto the cookie, then watched it spread out and drip over the sides, covering the snowman in white.
paras.zh: 她快速给第一个雪人试霜，让糖霜从勺上滴落饼干，看它蔓延淌过边缘，把雪人覆成白色。

paras.en: She did several more snowmen, then put down the icing and spoke up. “I want to visit Aunt Freya in Arendelle so badly,” Anna said.
paras.zh: 她又做了几个雪人，放下糖霜开口。”我好想去阿伦黛尔看芙蕾雅姑姨，“安娜说。

paras.en: She didn’t want to hurt her parents, but she knew staying in Harmon wasn’t her future. “Can I go?
paras.zh: 她不想伤父母心，却知留在哈蒙不是她的未来。”我能去吗？

paras.en: Please, Ma?” Her mother sighed and looked at Freya. “We’re so busy with the bakery we couldn’t afford to have you gone for long.” She paused. “But I’ll talk to your father.
paras.zh: “求你了，妈？”母亲叹息看芙蕾雅。“烘焙坊太忙，我们经不起你离开太久。”她顿了顿。“但我会和你父亲商量。

paras.en: It’s not a guarantee,” she stressed, “but I’ll ask.
paras.zh: ”这不敢保证，“她强调，”但我会问。

paras.en: You are bound to wind up there eventually.” “I’ve always wanted to meet your daughter,” Anna said to Freya. “It would be nice to bake with someone my own age.
paras.zh: “你终究会去成。”“我一直想见你女儿，”安娜对芙蕾雅说，“和同龄人一起烘焙真好。

paras.en: No offense.” Freya and Anna’s mom laughed. “Someday soon you two will be together,” Freya said. “Your meeting is long overdue.” Arendelle.
paras.zh: ”别见怪。“芙蕾雅与安娜妈妈笑。”不久你们俩会相聚，“芙蕾雅说，”你们早该相见了。“阿伦黛尔。

paras.en: Anna could almost imagine the kingdom she’d spent so many years looking at from a distance.
paras.zh: 安娜几乎能想象那个她遥望多年的王国。

paras.en: She’d see more than the tops of the turrets.
paras.zh: 她会看到比塔尖更多的东西。

paras.en: She’d be right there in the middle of everything, with Freya, who knew the place so well. “Do you think Papa will say yes?” Anna asked her mother. “Perhaps,” Ma replied.
paras.zh: 她会身处一切中心，与熟稔此地的芙蕾雅一起。”你觉得爸爸会答应吗？“安娜问母亲。”也许，“妈答。

paras.en: Freya smiled and took Anna’s hand.
paras.zh: 芙蕾雅微笑，握住安娜的手。

paras.en: She seemed hopeful. “When I get back from my trip, we will find a way to bring you to Arendelle.”
paras.zh: 她满怀希望。”等我这趟回来，我们定会想出法子带你去阿伦黛尔。“

paras.en: I might die of boredom.
paras.zh: 我大概会无聊到死。

paras.en: Elsa would never say those words out loud, of course.
paras.zh: 当然，艾莎绝不会把这句话说出口。

paras.en: But as she sat in the portrait hall in a large velvet chair and stared up at the ceiling, she couldn’t help thinking them.
paras.zh: 可当她坐在大厅那张天鹅绒大椅上、仰头盯着天花板时，脑子里却不由自主地冒出这些念头。

paras.en: Her parents had been gone only a week, but already she was feeling the weight of their absence.
paras.zh: 父母离开才不过一星期，她却已经感受到他们不在身边时的那份沉重。

paras.en: She’d done all her studies for the next three days, sat in on the visits her father had outlined for her, walked around the courtyard daily, and visited with Olina in the kitchen.
paras.zh: 接下来三天的功课她都做完了，父亲给她安排好的接见她也都参加了，每天绕着庭院散步，还去厨房陪奥丽娜说话。

paras.en: The castle’s chef was the closest thing she had to a real friend, if she was being honest.
paras.zh: 说实话，城堡里的厨师是她最像真正的朋友的人。

paras.en: Miss Olina—who insisted Elsa call her Olina now that she was practically an adult—didn’t care that she was the future queen of Arendelle.
paras.zh: 奥丽娜小姐——既然艾莎都快成年了，她坚持要艾莎直接叫她奥丽娜——根本不在乎她是将来的阿伦黛尔女王。

paras.en: She gave it to Elsa straight. “You need friends—or better yet, a suitor,” she had told Elsa that morning.
paras.zh: 她对艾莎说话从不拐弯抹角。“你需要朋友——最好还是个追求者，”那天早上她这么对艾莎说。

paras.en: Elsa was sitting in the kitchen with her, eating eggs for breakfast.
paras.zh: 当时艾莎正和她一起坐在厨房里，吃着鸡蛋当早餐。

paras.en: Elsa groaned. “Now you sound like the Duke of Weselton.” She knew where the conversation was headed: she was about to get a lecture. “Would it be so wrong for you to find someone who is your equal?” Olina asked.
paras.zh: 艾莎叹了口气。“你现在听起来跟威斯顿公爵一个样了。”她知道话题要往哪儿走了：马上就要开始说教了。“你找个门当户对的人，有那么糟吗？”奥丽娜问。

paras.en: Elsa sighed deeply. “You listen, my darling girl.” Olina waved a wooden spoon, the pink in her cheeks from the heat of the stove growing deeper as she got wound up. “You spend too much time alone.” “But—” Elsa said, but Olina cut her off. “I know you’re learning how to follow in your father’s footsteps, and that’s good, but when was the last time you went outside the castle walls?
paras.zh: 艾莎重重地叹了口气。“你听我说，好孩子。”奥丽娜挥着手里的木勺，炉火烤得她脸颊越来越红。她越说越激动。“你独处的时间太多了。”“可是——”艾莎刚开口，就被奥丽娜打断。“我知道你在学着接父亲的班，这很好，可你上一次走出城堡城墙是什么时候？

paras.en: With someone other than this staff?
paras.zh: 是和除了仆人以外的人一起？

paras.en: A good queen knows herself inside and out, and you are too inside your head.
paras.zh: 一位好女王要对自己了如指掌，可你全憋在自己脑子里了。

paras.en: The only way you can understand the people you serve is to get to know them.
paras.zh: 你要想理解你统治的子民，唯一的办法就是去了解他们。

paras.en: Enjoy their company.
paras.zh: 去享受他们的陪伴。

paras.en: Hear their stories.
paras.zh: 听听他们的故事。

paras.en: In the process you might figure out what you enjoy, as well, when you’re not focused on your studies and your future.” Olina made a good point.
paras.zh: 在这个过程中，你也许还会发现自己在功课和未来之外真正喜欢的事。”奥丽娜说得有道理。

paras.en: What did Elsa enjoy doing other than spending time with her parents and learning how to be a wise ruler?
paras.zh: 除了陪父母、学怎么做一位贤明的统治者，艾莎还喜欢做什么呢？

paras.en: Olina was right.
paras.zh: 奥丽娜说得没错。

paras.en: She needed friends.
paras.zh: 她需要朋友。

paras.en: She needed a hobby.
paras.zh: 她需要个爱好。

paras.en: She needed something to do.
paras.zh: 她需要找点事做。

paras.en: But what? “Oh my goodness!” Olina said, spying Kai coming through the door with a large box.
paras.zh: 可做什么好呢？“哎呀天哪！”奥丽娜看见凯搬着个大箱子从门口进来，叫出声来。

paras.en: Various scrolls and hats were falling out of it.
paras.zh: 各种各样的卷轴和帽子正从箱子里掉出来。

paras.en: Olina ran over to help him place the box on the floor. “Let me help you with that.” “Thanks,” Kai said. “That was heavier than I anticipated.” He noticed Elsa. “Hello, Princess.” “Hello.” Elsa nodded. “Who told you to carry it all the way from the attic by yourself?” Olina scolded him, stepping back to the stove and stirring the contents of a large pot.
paras.zh: 奥丽娜跑过去帮他把箱子放到地上。“我来帮你抬。”“谢了，”凯说，“比我想的要沉多了。”他看到了艾莎。“您好，公主殿下。”“你好。”艾莎点点头。“谁让你一个人从阁楼一路搬下来的？”奥丽娜责备他道，一边退回炉子旁搅拌起大锅里的内容。

paras.en: Whatever she was cooking smelled wonderful. “How is it going in the attic?” “Good.
paras.zh: 她煮的东西香气扑鼻。“阁楼上怎么样了？”“挺好。

paras.en: We cleared out several boxes.
paras.zh: 我们清了好几个箱子。

paras.en: You can see the floor again now.” “You didn’t throw out anything the king or queen would want, did you?” Olina asked, placing her hands on her hips. “No, no, just these random old hats and broken things.” Kai held up a Viking hat with one horn and a chipped blue vase. “Thought you might like this.” He pulled out a large pot.
paras.zh: 现在又能看见地板了。”“你没把国王和王后会想要的东西扔掉吧？”奥丽娜双手叉腰问道。“没有没有，就这些乱七八糟的旧帽子和破玩意儿。”凯举起一顶独角的维京帽和一只磕掉口的蓝花瓶。“想着你也许会喜欢这个。”他又拽出一个大锅。

paras.en: Olina’s eyes lit up. “Look at that!
paras.zh: 奥丽娜眼睛一亮。“看看这个！

paras.en: I could put this to good use.” “I’ll go up to the attic again tomorrow when it isn’t so hot and see what else there is.
paras.zh: 这个我能派上用场。”明天没那么热了，我再上阁楼一趟，看看还有什么。

paras.en: I’ll bring you back anything special.
paras.zh: 有什么好东西我给你带回来。

paras.en: Good afternoon, Princess Elsa.” Kai lifted the box again and walked out. “Good afternoon,” Elsa said.
paras.zh: 下午好，艾莎公主。“凯重新提起箱子走了出去。”下午好。“艾莎说。

paras.en: She’d never realized there were things stored in the attic.
paras.zh: 她从没想过阁楼里还存着东西。

paras.en: She’d never even been up there.
paras.zh: 她甚至从来没上去过。

paras.en: She had a whole afternoon ahead of her.
paras.zh: 她整个下午都空着。

paras.en: Maybe it wouldn’t hurt to have a peek at what was stored right above her bedroom.
paras.zh: 去瞧瞧卧室正上方存着些什么，也许并无大碍。

paras.en: It wasn’t a hobby, but it was a start.
paras.zh: 这算不上什么爱好，但总算是个开始。

paras.en: After saying goodbye to Olina, Elsa decided to stop in her room to grab a lantern.
paras.zh: 和奥丽娜道别后，艾莎决定先回房间拿一盏提灯。

paras.en: With her parents away and no engagements being held at the castle until their return, it seemed like everyone was trying to catch up on long-overdue chores.
paras.zh: 父母不在，城堡里在他们回来之前也没什么待客安排，似乎人人都在补做那些拖了很久的杂活。

paras.en: She passed workers cleaning brass fixtures in the hallway and someone delicately brushing dust off their family portrait, painted when Elsa was eight.
paras.zh: 她路过正在擦走廊里铜饰的工人，还有人正小心翼翼地拂去家族画像上的灰尘——那幅画像画的是艾莎八岁时的样子。

paras.en: Finally, Elsa began to ascend the attic stairs, the heat rising as she climbed.
paras.zh: 终于，艾莎开始登上阁楼的楼梯，越往上爬越觉得闷热。

paras.en: The lantern washed over the dark, cramped space.
paras.zh: 提灯的光扫过那片黑暗而狭窄的空间。

paras.en: The room was musty, as if it hadn’t been visited in centuries, even though Kai had just been there.
paras.zh: 屋子里一股霉味，仿佛几个世纪没人来过，尽管凯刚刚还在那儿。

paras.en: Elsa could make out dust marks on the floor from the boxes Kai had taken downstairs.
paras.zh: 艾莎能辨认出地板上凯搬下楼的箱子留下的灰尘印子。

paras.en: The space needed a good cleaning.
paras.zh: 这地方真该好好打扫一番了。

paras.en: Furniture was piled in one corner, a sled hung from another, and the tight quarters were crammed with massive trunks with chipped paint and faded rosemaling.
paras.zh: 家具堆在一个角落，另一角挂着一架雪橇，这逼仄的空间里塞满了掉漆、玫瑰彩绘也褪了色的大箱子。

paras.en: Elsa made her way to the closest trunk to have a peek.
paras.zh: 艾莎走向最近的箱子想看个究竟。

paras.en: It was locked.
paras.zh: 它锁着。

paras.en: The next one contained nothing but quilts.
paras.zh: 下一个里面只有几床被子。

paras.en: The third was full of old hats and a few capes.
paras.zh: 第三个装满旧帽子和几件斗篷。

paras.en: The fourth one was also locked, but the mechanism was loose, so Elsa gave it a hard pull, and it came right off.
paras.zh: 第四个也锁着，不过锁扣松了，于是艾莎用力一拽，锁就直接脱落了。

paras.en: The trunk was full of boring ice axes, fur-trimmed gloves, and snow boots that looked like they had been used to climb the North Mountain.
paras.zh: 箱子里全是些乏味的冰镐、毛皮镶边的手套，还有看起来像爬北山时用过的雪地靴。

paras.en: She could see why Kai was emptying out the place.
paras.zh: 她明白凯为什么要清空这个地方了。

paras.en: The excursion had been a waste of her time.
paras.zh: 这趟阁楼之行算是白费了她的时间。

paras.en: There was nothing to see up there.
paras.zh: 上面实在没什么可看的。

paras.en: Or was there?
paras.zh: 还是说，有？

paras.en: Her father had lived in the castle since he was a boy, and she’d hate to see his childhood things tossed out by accident.
paras.zh: 父亲从小就在城堡里长大，她可不愿意看到他的童年旧物被无意中当作垃圾丢掉了。

paras.en: After all, this was their history.
paras.zh: 毕竟，这是他们家的历史。

paras.en: She needed to protect it.
paras.zh: 她得保护它。

paras.en: Elsa stepped around one of the trunks, and she waved the lantern into the dark recesses.
paras.zh: 艾莎绕过一只箱子，把提灯照向幽暗的深处。

paras.en: The light caught on a broken frame with a yellowed map of the kingdom.
paras.zh: 灯光落在一个破相框上，里面是一张泛黄的王国地图。

paras.en: Her father might like to see that.
paras.zh: 父亲也许想看看这个。

paras.en: She stepped close, her eyes lingering on handwritten markings, and lifted the frame up to the dim light.
paras.zh: 她走近去，目光停留在手写的标记上，把相框举到昏暗的灯光下。

paras.en: That was when she noticed there was a trunk behind the frame.
paras.zh: 就在这时，她注意到相框后面还藏着一只箱子。

paras.en: This one was different from the others.
paras.zh: 这只和别的都不一样。

paras.en: It was painted white, with brightly colored flowers on the front of it.
paras.zh: 它漆成白色，正面画着鲜艳的花朵。

paras.en: Elsa realized immediately why it seemed familiar: it looked exactly like her hope chest.
paras.zh: 艾莎立刻明白它为何眼熟了：它和她装嫁妆的箱子一模一样。

paras.en: Could it have been her mother’s, before she married?
paras.zh: 难道是母亲出嫁前的箱子？

paras.en: Elsa ran her hand along the top of the trunk, removing a thick layer of dust.
paras.zh: 艾莎用手拂过箱盖，抹去厚厚一层灰。

paras.en: The painted markings on it were identical to the ones on her own, but instead of an E painted on top, the tracings of a different letter were buried under all that dust.
paras.zh: 上面的彩绘纹样和她自己那只一模一样，只是顶上没有漆着”E“，而是另一个字母的痕迹被埋在灰尘底下。

paras.en: She rubbed hard at the spot, wiping the dust away until the letter became clear.
paras.zh: 她使劲擦那块地方，抹去灰尘，直到字母变得清晰。

paras.en: It was an A .
paras.zh: 是个”A“。

paras.en: A?
paras.zh: A？

paras.en: Her mother’s name was Iduna.
paras.zh: 母亲的名字是伊杜娜。

paras.en: Her father was Agnarr, but this clearly wasn’t his.
paras.zh: 父亲是安格瑞，但这显然不是他的。

paras.en: Who was A?
paras.zh: A会是谁？

paras.en: Elsa racked her brain, trying to think of who the trunk could belong to.
paras.zh: 艾莎绞尽脑汁，想这只箱子会属于谁。

paras.en: A name was rolling around in her head, but it wouldn’t come forward.
paras.zh: 一个名字在她脑海里打转，却怎么也想不起来。

paras.en: A…A…A …She willed her mind to figure it out, but it was stuck.
paras.zh: A……A……A……她拼命想让脑子想出来，却卡住了。

paras.en: Instead, she thought again about that argument she had overheard between her parents.
paras.zh: 她反倒又想起之前偷听到的父母那场争执。

paras.en: They had referred to a “she.” Her mother had seemed insistent on seeing the person, while her father kept stressing how risky it was to visit.
paras.zh: 他们提到了一个”她“。母亲似乎执意要见那个人，而父亲则一直强调去见面的风险有多大。

paras.en: She’d never heard them that upset with each other before.
paras.zh: 她从没听过他们彼此那样激动地争吵。

paras.en: Now she wondered: could “she” and “A” be the same person? “Princess Elsa!” She stepped away from the trunk as if she had been caught snooping. “Princess Elsa!” She quickly put the frame back where she had found it, hiding the chest from sight, and headed down the stairs.
paras.zh: 此刻她不禁想：”她“和”A“会不会是同一个人？”艾莎公主！“她像被人撞见偷看似的，从箱子旁退开。”艾莎公主！“她赶紧把相框放回原处，把箱子藏出视线，然后朝楼下走去。

paras.en: There was a commotion of some sort.
paras.zh: 外面不知发生了什么骚动。

paras.en: She could hear people crying and others calling her name. “I’m here,” Elsa called, instantly feeling guilty for making anyone worry about where she was.
paras.zh: 她能听见有人在哭，还有人在喊她的名字。”我在这儿，“艾莎应道，立刻为让别人担心她的去向而心生愧疚。

paras.en: She rounded the corner and found members of the castle staff gathered together.
paras.zh: 她转过拐角，发现城堡的仆人聚在一起。

paras.en: Gerda was inconsolable.
paras.zh: 格达哭得无法自抑。

paras.en: Olina was crying into a handkerchief.
paras.zh: 奥丽娜正拿手帕捂着脸哭。

paras.en: Several people were embracing and in tears. “Princess Elsa!” Kai clutched his chest. “You’re all right.” His face was blotchy, as if he’d been crying, too. “We thought…” “Thought what?” Elsa felt her heart speed up.
paras.zh: 好几个人相拥而泣。”艾莎公主！“凯紧捂着胸口。”您没事就好。“他脸上斑斑点点，像是也哭过。”我们以为……“”以为什么？“艾莎感到心跳加速。

paras.en: A lump rose in her throat as she watched Olina blot her eyes.
paras.zh: 看着奥丽娜拭泪，她喉咙里一阵发紧。

paras.en: Everyone was looking at her.
paras.zh: 所有人都看着她。

paras.en: Something was terribly wrong. “What is it?” Lord Peterssen appeared from the middle of the crowd.
paras.zh: 一定出了什么大事。”怎么了？“彼得森勋爵从人群中间走出来。

paras.en: His face was somber and his eyes were bloodshot. “Elsa,” he whispered, her name sounding broken on his tongue, “could we speak in private, please?” The minute she locked eyes with him, she knew. “No.” She started to back up.
paras.zh: 他脸色阴沉，双眼布满血丝。”艾莎，“他低声唤道，名字在他舌尖仿佛碎了，”我们能私下说句话吗？“她一对上他的眼睛，就明白了。”不。“她开始往后退。

paras.en: She didn’t want to hear what he had to say.
paras.zh: 她不想听他要说什么。

paras.en: The walls seemed like they were closing in on her.
paras.zh: 墙壁仿佛在向她逼近。

paras.en: The crying and the sobbing grew louder.
paras.zh: 哭泣和抽噎声越来越大。

paras.en: She felt her heart racing.
paras.zh: 她感到心怦怦直跳。

paras.en: Her mouth was dry and there was a ringing in her ears.
paras.zh: 她口干舌燥，耳边嗡嗡作响。

paras.en: She knew what he would tell her would change her life forever, and for just a moment, she wanted to stall him. “I don’t want to speak in private.
paras.zh: 她知道他要说的话将永远改变她的人生，有那么一瞬，她想拖住他。”我不想私下说。

paras.en: I want to stay here with everyone.” Gerda put her arm around Elsa, steadying her.
paras.zh: 我想和大家待在一起。“格达搂住艾莎，扶稳她。

paras.en: Lord Peterssen looked around, his eyes wet. “All right.
paras.zh: 彼得森勋爵环顾四周，眼圈湿润。”好吧。

paras.en: Elsa, there is no easy way to say this.” She inhaled sharply.
paras.zh: 艾莎，这话怎么开口都很难。“她猛地吸了口气。

paras.en: Then don’t, she wanted to shout. “Your parents’ ship didn’t make it to the port.” His voice faltered. “Maybe it’s gone off course.” Elsa felt her fingertips starting to tingle.
paras.zh: 那就别说了，她想大喊。”你父母的船没能抵达港口。“他的声音发颤。”也许是偏离了航线。“艾莎感到指尖开始发麻。

paras.en: It was a strange sensation.
paras.zh: 这是一种奇怪的感觉。

paras.en: She pulled away from Gerda and shook them out. “Send a ship to find them.” He shook his head. “We already have.
paras.zh: 她从格达身边挣开，甩了甩手。”派船去找他们。“他摇摇头。”我们已经派了。

paras.en: We sought word from every nearby port, every kingdom.
paras.zh: 我们向每一个附近的港口、每一个王国都去信问讯了。

paras.en: Now we have received responses from them all: the ship never arrived.
paras.zh: 现在所有回音都到了：船始终没有到。

paras.en: Moreover, the Southern Seas can be treacherous, and there have been many storms lately.” He paused. “There is only one conclusion left to draw.” “No.” Elsa’s voice was rougher now.
paras.zh: 何况南海向来凶险，近来又连发多场风暴。“他停顿了一下。”剩下的结论只有一个了。“”不。“艾莎的声音现在更沙哑了。

paras.en: Gerda immediately burst into tears again. “That can’t be!” Lord Peterssen swallowed hard, and she watched his Adam’s apple move up and down.
paras.zh: 格达立刻又哭了出来。”这不可能！“彼得森勋爵使劲咽了口唾沫，她看着他的喉结上下滚动。

paras.en: His lip quivered and Olina let out an audible sob.
paras.zh: 他的嘴唇颤抖着，奥丽娜发出一声清晰的呜咽。

paras.en: Several of the others bowed their heads.
paras.zh: 其他几个人都低下了头。

paras.en: She heard Kai praying. “Elsa, King Agnarr and Queen Iduna are gone.” “May their souls rest in peace,” said Olina, closing her eyes and tilting her face to the heavens.
paras.zh: 她听见凯在祷告。”艾莎，安格瑞国王和伊杜娜王后已经不在了。“”愿他们的灵魂安息，“奥丽娜闭着眼、仰面向天说道。

paras.en: Others did the same. “No,” Elsa repeated.
paras.zh: 其他人也跟着这么做。”不，“艾莎重复道。

paras.en: Her whole body began to shake.
paras.zh: 她的整个身体开始发抖。

paras.en: Her fingers began to tingle again.
paras.zh: 她的指尖又开始发麻。

paras.en: She had the sudden feeling she was about to burst into a million pieces, exploding in fragments of light.
paras.zh: 她突然有种感觉，自己马上要碎成无数片，化作一团光迸裂开来。

paras.en: Lord Peterssen reached for her, but she backed away, trying to disappear.
paras.zh: 彼得森勋爵伸手想去扶她，她却往后退，恨不得自己能消失。

paras.en: Kai held up a thin piece of black silk.
paras.zh: 凯举起一截薄薄的黑绸。

paras.en: He and Gerda hung it over the portrait of her parents in the hallway.
paras.zh: 他和格达把它挂在走廊里父母画像的上方。

paras.en: Her parents couldn’t be…dead.
paras.zh: 她的父母不可能……死了。

paras.en: They were her only family.
paras.zh: 他们是她唯一的亲人。

paras.en: Without them, she truly was alone.
paras.zh: 没有他们，她真的孤身一人了。

paras.en: Her breath became ragged and her heart beat so fast she thought it would leap out of her chest.
paras.zh: 她呼吸变得急促，心跳快得仿佛要从胸腔里蹦出来。

paras.en: Every sound she heard was magnified a thousand times. “No!” Her fingers were burning now. “No!” She turned and ran, not stopping till she reached her room.
paras.zh: 她听到的每个声音都被放大了一千倍。”不！“她的手指此刻灼烧般发烫。”不！“她转身就跑，一路不停，直到冲回自己的房间。

paras.en: Elsa fell through the doors with such force they slammed shut behind her.
paras.zh: 艾莎撞进门里，力道之大，门在身后砰地关上。

paras.en: She landed on the circular rug and didn’t have the strength to move.
paras.zh: 她跌落在圆形地毯上，连动一下的力气都没有。

paras.en: Instead, she curled up into a ball and stared at the pink wallpaper where a portrait of her as a child stared back at her.
paras.zh: 她只是蜷成一团，盯着粉色壁纸上那幅画——画里年幼的她正回望过来。

paras.en: That girl was smiling and happy.
paras.zh: 那个女孩笑着，满心欢喜。

paras.en: She had a family.
paras.zh: 她有家人。

paras.en: Now she had none.
paras.zh: 现在她什么都没有了。

paras.en: The burning sensation in her fingers was growing stronger, her heart pulsing so fast she felt like she could hear it.
paras.zh: 手指的灼烧感越来越强，心跳快得她仿佛都能听见。

paras.en: Tears began to stream down her face, wetting the top of her collar and reaching her hot chest.
paras.zh: 泪水开始顺着脸颊流下，打湿了衣领上沿，一直流到她滚烫的胸口。

paras.en: Shaking, Elsa forced herself to stand up, looking for someone—anyone—to talk to.
paras.zh: 艾莎抖着身子，强迫自己站起来，想找个人——随便谁——说说话。

paras.en: No one was there.
paras.zh: 可一个人也没有。

paras.en: She had closed herself off once again.
paras.zh: 她又一次把自己封闭了起来。

paras.en: Elsa went to her hope chest.
paras.zh: 艾莎走到自己的嫁妆箱前。

paras.en: Her hand shook as she brushed the green wooden lockbox under the quilt.
paras.zh: 她手在发抖，拂开被子下那只绿色木锁盒。

paras.en: She rummaged around until she found what she was looking for: the small one-eyed handmade penguin she had confided in as a girl—Sir JorgenBjorgen.
paras.zh: 她翻找着，终于找到要找的东西：小时候向它倾诉心事的独眼手作企鹅——约根·比约根爵士。

paras.en: She held the penguin with shaking hands, but couldn’t put her thoughts into words.
paras.zh: 她用发抖的双手捧着企鹅，却说不出心里的想法。

paras.en: Mama and Papa were gone.
paras.zh: 妈妈和爸爸都不在了。

paras.en: I might die of boredom.
paras.zh: 我大概会无聊到死。

paras.en: Wasn’t that what she’d thought earlier that day?
paras.zh: 那天早些时候，她想的难道不是这个吗？

paras.en: How could she have been so selfish?
paras.zh: 她怎么会这么自私？

paras.en: She clutched Sir JorgenBjorgen so tightly she felt like he might disintegrate in her burning hands.
paras.zh: 她把约根·比约根爵士攥得死紧，仿佛他在她灼热的掌心里要碎掉了。

paras.en: They started to shake so badly she couldn’t hang on to him.
paras.zh: 她的手抖得太厉害，抓不住他了。

paras.en: She threw the doll across the room and he landed on her bed.
paras.zh: 她把玩偶朝房间那头一甩，他落在了床上。

paras.en: Alone.
paras.zh: 孤单。

paras.en: Alone.
paras.zh: 孤单。

paras.en: Alone.
paras.zh: 孤单。

paras.en: Dead.
paras.zh: 死了。

paras.en: Dead.
paras.zh: 死了。

paras.en: Dead.
paras.zh: 死了。

paras.en: Gone.
paras.zh: 不在了。

paras.en: Gone.
paras.zh: 不在了。

paras.en: Gone.
paras.zh: 不在了。

paras.en: She closed her eyes.
paras.zh: 她闭上眼睛。

paras.en: She felt a scream rising inside her.
paras.zh: 她感到一声尖叫从体内涌起。

paras.en: It was so primal she knew it would rattle the whole castle, but she didn’t care.
paras.zh: 那尖叫如此原始，她知道会震得整座城堡发抖，可她不在乎。

paras.en: It gurgled to the top of her throat, threatening to overtake her, until it finally did, and Elsa screamed so hard she thought she might never stop.
paras.zh: 它咕噜着涌到喉咙口，眼看就要压过她，终于还是冲了出来——艾莎尖叫得那么用力，觉得自己可能永远也停不下来。

paras.en: Her hands went from hot to burning cold as they flew out in front of her.
paras.zh: 她的双手从滚烫变得冰冷刺骨，猛地向前挥出。

paras.en: Something inside her opened, like a chasm that could never be closed again.
paras.zh: 她体内有什么东西打开了，像一道再也合不上的深渊。

paras.en: Opening her eyes, she saw it, unbelievably, form in the air in front of her fingers.
paras.zh: 睁开眼，她难以置信地看见它，竟在指尖前的空气中成形。

paras.en: Ice.
paras.zh: 冰。

paras.en: It shot clear across the room, hitting the opposite wall and crawling up to the ceiling.
paras.zh: 冰射穿整个房间，撞上对面的墙，又爬到了天花板上。

paras.en: Terrified and still sobbing, Elsa jumped back in fear as the ice continued to grow.
paras.zh: 艾莎又怕又哭，冰还在蔓延，她吓得直往后跳。

paras.en: It crackled as it moved under her feet, spreading along the floor till it climbed up the other walls, too.
paras.zh: 冰在她脚下发出噼啪声蔓延，顺着地板铺开，直到也爬上了另外几面墙。

paras.en: What was happening?
paras.zh: 这是怎么回事？

paras.en: The ice was coming from inside her.
paras.zh: 冰是从她体内冒出来的。

paras.en: It didn’t make sense, yet she knew it was true.
paras.zh: 这说不通，可她知道这是真的。

paras.en: She’d caused this to happen.
paras.zh: 是她造成了这一切。

paras.en: What was happening?
paras.zh: 这是怎么回事？

paras.en: Magic.
paras.zh: 魔法。

paras.en: She’d heard Papa use that word when he and Mama had been arguing.
paras.zh: 爸爸和妈妈争执时，她听过爸爸用这个词。

paras.en: Had they been talking about her?
paras.zh: 他们说的会是她吗？

paras.en: Elsa sank down along the nearest wall, collapsing in grief.
paras.zh: 艾莎顺着最近的墙滑坐下去，在悲伤中垮掉。

paras.en: Alone.
paras.zh: 孤单。

paras.en: Alone.
paras.zh: 孤单。

paras.en: Alone.
paras.zh: 孤单。

paras.en: Gone.
paras.zh: 不在了。

paras.en: Gone.
paras.zh: 不在了。

paras.en: Gone.
paras.zh: 不在了。

paras.en: More and more ice shot out as she choked back sobs.
paras.zh: 她强忍着抽泣，越来越多的冰喷涌而出。

paras.en: Was her heartbreak causing this?
paras.zh: 是她的心碎造成了这一切吗？

paras.en: Had her parents known she was capable of such strange magic?
paras.zh: 父母可曾知道她拥有这种奇怪的魔法？

paras.en: Or was this something she had been born with and didn’t know she possessed?
paras.zh: 还是说，这是她与生俱来、自己却不知道的能力？

paras.en: She’d never been more frightened in her entire life.
paras.zh: 她这辈子从没这么害怕过。

paras.en: Without her parents, there was no one she trusted enough even to ask.
paras.zh: 没了父母，她连个足以信任到去询问的人都没有。

paras.en: She needed them now more than ever before.
paras.zh: 此刻她比以往任何时候都更需要他们。

paras.en: She banged her head on the wall and closed her eyes.
paras.zh: 她把头抵在墙上，闭上了眼睛。

paras.en: Her voice was barely a whisper. “Papa, Mama, please don’t leave me here alone.”
paras.zh: 她的声音细若游丝：”爸爸，妈妈，求你们别把我一个人留在这。“

paras.en: Anna couldn’t remember the last time she’d crawled back into her bed when the sun was still shining.
paras.zh: 安娜记不得上一次太阳还亮着就爬回床上睡觉是什么时候了。

paras.en: Papa and Ma had insisted she retire for a spell.
paras.zh: 爸爸和妈妈非让她歇一阵子不可。

paras.en: She’d been up late the night before, assembling a traditional Arendelle wedding cake the Larsen family had paid her handsomely for.
paras.zh: 前一晚她熬到很晚，在组装拉森家高价请她做的传统阿伦黛尔婚礼蛋糕。

paras.en: She rarely made that particular type of cake because it was so time-consuming—between the icing and all the layers that needed to be baked, it took hours—but the end result was worth it.
paras.zh: 这种特定款式的蛋糕她很少做，因为太费时间——光是糖霜和一层层需要烘烤的蛋糕胚，就要花好几个小时——但成品值得。

paras.en: Anna knew that the Larsens’ daughter, who was getting married later today, was going to love it.
paras.zh: 安娜知道，今天晚些时候出嫁的拉森家的女儿一定会喜欢它。

paras.en: So it was with a grateful, sleepy sigh that she pulled up her quilt, fluffed her pillow, and closed her eyes.
paras.zh: 于是她带着满足又困倦的叹息，拉起被子、拍松枕头，闭上了眼睛。

paras.en: She couldn’t fall asleep right away.
paras.zh: 她没能马上睡着。

paras.en: Her mind wandered back to the cake.
paras.zh: 她的思绪飘回了那个蛋糕上。

paras.en: She pictured the Larsens raving about it to their guests.
paras.zh: 她想象拉森家对客人们赞不绝口的样子。

paras.en: Guests who had traveled from Arendelle and would go back to the kingdom talking about Anna’s work.
paras.zh: 客人们从阿伦黛尔远道而来，回去后会在王国里谈论安娜的手艺。

paras.en: Soon the king and queen would hear of her baking.
paras.zh: 很快，国王和王后就会听说她的烘焙。

paras.en: Maybe they’d request she bake for them at the castle.
paras.zh: 说不定他们会请她去城堡为他们烘焙。

paras.en: Wouldn’t her parents and Freya be proud?
paras.zh: 她的父母和芙蕾雅该多骄傲啊？

paras.en: There was no way they’d hold her back from moving to Arendelle if they knew the king and queen were requesting her work.
paras.zh: 如果他们知道国王王后在请她做事，绝不会拦着她搬去阿伦黛尔。

paras.en: She could just see herself making snowman cookies for the royal family.
paras.zh: 她仿佛已经看见自己为王室做雪人饼干的样子。

paras.en: The cookies immediately made her think of her aunt.
paras.zh: 这些饼干立刻让她想起了姑姑。

paras.en: Anna hoped Freya would be back from her travels soon and that when she returned, she’d convince Ma and Papa to let Anna visit Arendelle.
paras.zh: 安娜希望芙蕾雅早点旅行归来，回来后能说服妈妈和爸爸让安娜去阿伦黛尔看看。

paras.en: Her mother kept stressing that it wasn’t a definite. “Freya works a great deal.
paras.zh: 妈妈总强调这事还没准。“芙蕾雅忙得很。

paras.en: We have to find the right time for you to go, if you can go at all.” Her mother never stopped worrying!
paras.zh: 得挑个合适的时候让你去，能不能去还两说呢。”妈妈真是操心个没完！

paras.en: Neither did Papa.
paras.zh: 爸爸也一样。

paras.en: He talked about driving her down the mountain himself and waiting nearby in case she wanted to leave early.
paras.zh: 他说要亲自驾车送她下山，在附近等着，万一她想早点回来。

paras.en: She couldn’t remember the last time Papa had left Harmon.
paras.zh: 她记不得爸爸上一次离开哈蒙是什么时候了。

paras.en: She tried convincing them that they should close the shop and all go together for a few days, but Papa wouldn’t hear of it. “We don’t even know if you will be able to go,” he’d said.
paras.zh: 她试着劝他们关了店、全家一起去玩几天，可爸爸听都不想听。“我们连你能不能去都还不知道呢，”他这么说。

paras.en: But Anna knew in her heart of hearts that Arendelle was in her future.
paras.zh: 但安娜从心底里知道，阿伦黛尔是她未来的一部分。

paras.en: She could feel it in every inch of her being.
paras.zh: 她的每一寸身心都能感觉到。

paras.en: When Anna finally drifted off, she didn’t dream of snowmen.
paras.zh: 安娜终于迷迷糊糊睡去时，梦见的不是雪人。

paras.en: This dream was unpleasant.
paras.zh: 这个梦很不舒服。

paras.en: Anna felt cold, like she was sitting in a block of ice, and she couldn’t see her hand in front of her face.
paras.zh: 安娜觉得冷，仿佛坐在一块冰里，连眼前自己的手都看不见。

paras.en: Snow was swirling all around as if she were in a blizzard, but the weather didn’t seem like a regular storm.
paras.zh: 雪在四周打着旋，像置身于暴风雪中，可这天气又不像寻常的风暴。

paras.en: It was filled with a darkness that threatened to swallow her whole.
paras.zh: 其中弥漫着一种似乎要把她整个吞没的黑暗。

paras.en: Even worse, she sensed that someone out there desperately needed her to find them.
paras.zh: 更糟的是，她感到外面有个人正拼命需要她去找。

paras.en: Anna tried to fight the weather to get to them, turning into the pelting ice and wind to search, but she couldn’t see the person.
paras.zh: 安娜努力顶着这天气想去找到他们，迎着扑面的冰粒和寒风搜寻，却看不见那个人。

paras.en: She could hear wailing, but it was so far in the distance she didn’t know where it was coming from.
paras.zh: 她能听见哭喊，可那声音太远，她不知从何而来。

paras.en: All she knew was that she needed to find this person before it was too late.
paras.zh: 她只知道，必须在为时已晚之前找到这个人。

paras.en: Something told her if she followed her heart and trusted her instincts, she would. “Is anyone there?” Anna cried over the wind, but no one answered her.
paras.zh: 有种感觉告诉她，只要跟随内心、相信直觉，就找得到。“有人在那儿吗？”安娜逆着风喊，却没人应答。

paras.en: She had never felt more alone.
paras.zh: 她从没觉得这么孤单过。

paras.en: She took a step forward and plunged off the edge of a snowy cliff.
paras.zh: 她向前迈了一步，从覆雪的悬崖边跌了下去。

paras.en: Anna woke up gasping for air. “ Help!
paras.zh: 安娜醒来，大口喘着气。“救命！

paras.en: She needs help!” She clutched her chest as if it hurt. “It was just a dream,” she repeated over and over.
paras.zh: 她需要帮助！”她紧紧抓着胸口，仿佛那里作痛。“只是个梦而已，”她一遍又一遍地重复。

paras.en: But it hadn’t felt like a dream.
paras.zh: 可那感觉不像梦。

paras.en: It felt real.
paras.zh: 感觉是真实的。

paras.en: She needed to get out of that room.
paras.zh: 她得离开那个房间。

paras.en: Anna threw back the covers and slid into her shoes.
paras.zh: 安娜掀开被子，趿上鞋子。

paras.en: The sun was lower in the sky than it had been earlier.
paras.zh: 天上的太阳比之前低了些。

paras.en: Her parents would soon be finishing up for the day.
paras.zh: 她的父母很快就要收工了。

paras.en: Maybe a walk would do her good.
paras.zh: 也许散散步对她有好处。

paras.en: She slipped out the front door without saying goodbye and began to wander the village aimlessly.
paras.zh: 她没道别就溜出前门，漫无目的地在村子里游荡。

paras.en: For once, she didn’t stop and talk to every person she saw.
paras.zh: 这一次，她没有停下来和每个遇见的人说话。

paras.en: Instead, she kept her head down and hugged her arms to her chest, trying to smother the cold that seemed to permeate her body.
paras.zh: 她只是低着头，双臂紧抱在胸前，想压住那股仿佛渗进身体的寒意。

paras.en: It was a dream, yet it had felt so real.
paras.zh: 那只是个梦，可感觉却那么真实。

paras.en: Someone had been in terrible pain, but all wasn’t lost.
paras.zh: 有人正承受着巨大的痛苦，但一切都还有希望。

paras.en: If she trusted her instincts, Anna knew she could help.
paras.zh: 只要相信直觉，安娜知道自己能帮上忙。

paras.en: How strange… She rubbed her arms to keep warm, walking aimlessly.
paras.zh: 真奇怪……她搓着胳膊取暖，漫无目的地走着。

paras.en: Suddenly, a carriage roared down the road, startling her.
paras.zh: 突然，一辆马车沿路疾驰而来，吓了她一跳。

paras.en: Anna watched as it came to a halt in front of the church and a palace guard jumped out.
paras.zh: 安娜看着它在教堂前停下，一名王宫卫兵跳了下来。

paras.en: Anna had never seen an official royal carriage in Harmon before.
paras.zh: 安娜从没在哈蒙见过正式的王室马车。

paras.en: The guard nailed a proclamation to the church door, spoke to the bishop who came out to greet him, then got in the carriage and raced away.
paras.zh: 卫兵把一份告示钉在教堂门上，和出来迎接的主教说了几句，然后跳上马车疾驰而去。

paras.en: The bishop started talking to anyone who approached, and people began to run back to their homes with the news.
paras.zh: 主教开始和每个走近的人说话，人们带着消息往家跑。

paras.en: Others flooded out of their houses, making their way to the proclamation to see what was written.
paras.zh: 其他人纷纷从家里涌出，挤到告示前看写了什么。

paras.en: Anna drifted closer and watched a woman read the news and gasp.
paras.zh: 安娜慢慢走近，看见一个女人读了消息后倒吸一口冷气。

paras.en: Someone next to her burst into tears.
paras.zh: 她旁边有人失声痛哭。

paras.en: There was commotion and wailing.
paras.zh: 现场一片骚动和哀号。

paras.en: Suddenly, the church bells began to toll.
paras.zh: 突然，教堂的钟敲响了。

paras.en: Anna tried to get through the crowd to see what was written, but people were pushing and shoving in an effort to get a closer look.
paras.zh: 安娜想挤过人群看写的是什么，可人们推来搡去，都想凑近些看。

paras.en: Still she hugged her arms to her chest, struggling to get warm.
paras.zh: 她仍抱着双臂，努力想暖和些。

paras.en: It was silly, but she almost felt like she was still dreaming. “Excuse me,” Anna said to a man who had just been standing near the front steps. “Can you tell me what the guard posted on the church?” He wiped his eyes. “The king and queen, rest their souls, have been lost at sea.
paras.zh: 这念头傻乎乎的，可她几乎觉得自己还在梦里。“打扰一下，”安娜对一个刚站在前台阶附近的男人说，“能告诉我卫兵在教堂贴了什么吗？”他擦了擦眼睛。“国王和王后，愿他们安息，已在海上遇难。

paras.en: Their ship never reached its destination.” “What?” Anna clutched her chest. “No!” “Yes,” he said, pushing farther into the crowd. “The proclamation says we are entering a period of mourning.” “And Princess Elsa?” Anna said, afraid to hear his response. “She lives,” he said. “Spread the word and pray for Arendelle and our future queen.
paras.zh: 他们的船始终没能抵达目的地。”“什么？”安娜捂住胸口。“不！”“是的，”他说着往人群里挤得更深了，“告示说我们要进入哀悼期了。”“那艾莎公主呢？”安娜问，害怕听到他的回答。“她还活着，”他说，“把这个消息传开，为阿伦黛尔和我们的未来女王祈祷吧。

paras.en: She is on her own now.” I must tell Ma and Papa, Anna thought.
paras.zh: 她现在只能靠自己了。”我得告诉妈妈和爸爸，安娜想。

paras.en: She ran all the way to the bakery and found Papa sweeping the shop floor.
paras.zh: 她一路跑到面包房，看见爸爸正在扫地。

paras.en: When she flew through the door, slamming it behind her, he looked up, startled. “What’s wrong?” Papa dropped the broom and moved toward her. “Anna Bear, are you all right?
paras.zh: 她冲进门，在身后砰地关上，他抬起头，吓了一跳。“怎么了？”爸爸扔下扫帚朝她走来。“安娜小熊，你没事吧？

paras.en: I heard the carriage.
paras.zh: 我听见马车声了。

paras.en: Someone said it was royal, but I didn’t go out to see.
paras.zh: 有人说那是王室的，可我没出去看。

paras.en: Is something the matter?” Anna nodded, trying hard not to cry. “Where is Ma?” “Here.” Ma came from the entry to their house, wiping her hands on her apron.
paras.zh: 出什么事了吗？”安娜点点头，拼命忍着不哭。“妈妈呢？”“在这儿。”妈妈从通往家里的门口走出来，在围裙上擦着手。

paras.en: She, too, saw Anna’s face, and her own fell. “What’s the matter?” “I think you should both sit down,” Anna said. “Come into the living room.” Her parents followed her inside, but they wouldn’t sit.
paras.zh: 她也看见了安娜的脸色，自己的脸立刻沉了下来。“怎么了？”“我想你们俩都坐下来，”安娜说，“进客厅吧。”父母跟着她进去，却不肯坐下。

paras.en: They were holding hands.
paras.zh: 他们手牵着手。

paras.en: Anna took a deep breath. “There’s been a terrible tragedy.
paras.zh: 安娜深吸一口气。“发生了一场可怕的悲剧。

paras.en: The king and queen have been lost at sea.” She closed her eyes; the news was almost too much even to think about. “No!” her mother wailed so loud Anna began to shake. “That’s impossible!
paras.zh: 国王和王后已在海上遇难。”她闭上眼；这消息几乎让人想都不敢想。“不！”母亲哭喊得那么响，安娜都抖了起来。“这不可能！

paras.en: What happened?” Anna’s lower lip trembled. “The castle just posted a proclamation.
paras.zh: 出什么事了？”安娜的下唇发颤。“城堡刚贴出告示。

paras.en: We are to enter a period of mourning.
paras.zh: 我们要进入哀悼期了。

paras.en: The king and queen’s ship never made it to its destination.” She bowed her head. “King Agnarr and Queen Iduna, may they rest in peace.” It was so tragic she couldn’t bear it, and both her parents were inconsolable.
paras.zh: 国王和王后的船始终没能抵达目的地。”她低下头。“安格瑞国王和伊杜娜王后，愿他们安息。”这太悲惨了，她承受不住，父母两人都悲痛欲绝。

paras.en: Her mother fell into a chair in a heap while her father rocked back and forth. “No, why?
paras.zh: 母亲瘫坐进椅子里，父亲来回摇晃着。“不，为什么？

paras.en: Why ?” he called to the heavens.
paras.zh: 为什么？”他仰天呼唤。

paras.en: Anna tried to comfort her mother. “It’s terrible, I know.
paras.zh: 安娜试着安慰母亲。“是很可怕，我知道。

paras.en: But all is not lost.
paras.zh: 但一切并非无可挽回。

paras.en: The princess is safe.
paras.zh: 公主是安全的。

paras.en: We will have a queen again.” Her mother cried harder.
paras.zh: 我们还会再有女王。”母亲哭得更厉害了。

paras.en: Papa put his arm around Anna. “When she turns twenty-one, she will take her place at the throne.
paras.zh: 爸爸搂住安娜。“等她满二十一岁，就会继位登基。

paras.en: But for now…” “That poor girl,” Anna whispered.
paras.zh: 可现在……”“那个可怜的女孩，”安娜低声说。

paras.en: She imagined her all alone in that big castle.
paras.zh: 她想象着那个女孩独自待在那座大城堡里。

paras.en: She rubbed her chest.
paras.zh: 她揉了揉胸口。

paras.en: She couldn’t get warm. “I can’t believe the princess lost her parents.” There was silence in the room.
paras.zh: 她暖和不起来。“真不敢相信公主失去了父母。”房间里一片沉默。

paras.en: Finally, Papa spoke. “Tomally, we must tell her,” he said.
paras.zh: 终于，爸爸开口了。“托玛丽，我们得告诉她，”他说。

paras.en: Anna looked from her mother to her father. “Tell me what?” “Yes,” her mother agreed, and reached for Anna’s hands. “There is something you don’t know.” She sighed heavily. “Anna Bear, the queen had several ladies of the court with her on the ship.
paras.zh: 安娜看看母亲，又看看父亲。“告诉我什么？”“没错，”母亲应道，伸手握住安娜的手。“有件事你不知道。”她重重地叹了口气。“安娜小熊，王后上船时，身边带着几位宫中女侍。

paras.en: One of those ladies was Freya.” Ma burst into tears again, and Papa put his arm around her shoulders. “Freya?
paras.zh: 其中一位就是芙蕾雅。”妈妈又哭了出来，爸爸搂住她的肩膀。“芙蕾雅？

paras.en: No!
paras.zh: 不！

paras.en: Freya?” Anna immediately started to cry. “Are you sure?
paras.zh: 芙蕾雅？”安娜立刻哭了起来。“你们确定吗？

paras.en: What about her family?
paras.zh: 她的家人呢？

paras.en: Were they with her?” Ma looked at Papa. “Her husband would be lost as well, but Freya told us their daughter was staying home.” “Should we send for her?
paras.zh: 他们和她一起吗？”妈妈看向爸爸。“她丈夫大概也不在了，不过芙蕾雅跟我们说过，她女儿留在家里。”“我们该去接她吗？

paras.en: Does she have other family?” Anna whispered, her grief overwhelming her. “Will she be all right?” “She will be fine,” Ma said, but she couldn’t stop crying. “Papa, this can’t be true, can it?
paras.zh: 她还有别的家人吗？”安娜低声问，悲伤几乎将她淹没。“她会没事的吧？”“她会没事的，”妈妈说，却止不住眼泪。“爸爸，这不是真的，对吧？

paras.en: Are you sure Freya was on that ship?” Anna asked.
paras.zh: 你们确定芙蕾雅在那条船上？”安娜问。

paras.en: Her father hesitated. “Yes.” His jaw shook. “This was the trip Freya spoke of on her last visit.
paras.zh: 父亲犹豫了。“是的。”他的下巴发抖。“这就是芙蕾雅上次来访时说的那趟行程。

paras.en: She didn’t like to boast, but she traveled with the king and queen.” His eyes filled with tears. “Our dear friend is gone.” Yes, Anna was sad the king and queen had perished, but Freya was family.
paras.zh: 她不爱炫耀，可她确实是跟着国王和王后出行的。”他的眼里盈满泪水。“我们亲爱的朋友不在了。”是的，国王王后遇难安娜也难过，可芙蕾雅是亲人啊。

paras.en: Anna felt weak in the knees.
paras.zh: 安娜觉得双腿发软。

paras.en: Her father reached out with his free arm to steady her.
paras.zh: 父亲腾出一只手扶住她。

paras.en: She sank to the floor, reaching for her mother to comfort her. “Not Freya.
paras.zh: 她瘫坐到地上，伸手去够母亲寻求安慰。“别是芙蕾雅。

paras.en: No!” She buried her head in her mother’s chest.
paras.zh: 不要啊！”她把头埋进母亲怀里。

paras.en: Her mother stroked her hair. “Anna Bear, I’m so sorry.
paras.zh: 母亲抚摸着她的头发。“安娜小熊，我太抱歉了。

paras.en: So terribly sorry,” she choked out.
paras.zh: 真的太对不起了，”她哽咽着说。

paras.en: She pulled her daughter away from her so she could look her in the eyes. “There’s something else you should know, too.” “Tomally!” Papa’s voice was sharp. “You made a vow.
paras.zh: 她把女儿从怀里拉开，好看着她的眼睛。“还有一件事你也该知道。”“托玛丽！”爸爸的声音很尖锐。“你发过誓的。

paras.en: You cannot break it now.” Anna winced.
paras.zh: 你现在不能破誓。”安娜畏缩了一下。

paras.en: She’d never heard her father raise his voice to her mother before. “I have to, Johan!
paras.zh: 她从没听父亲对母亲提高过嗓门。“我必须说，约翰！

paras.en: She deserves to know the truth!
paras.zh: 她有权知道真相！

paras.en: If not now, when?” “It’s not your truth to tell!” he argued.
paras.zh: 现在不说，更待何时？”“这真相不该由你来说！”他争辩道。

paras.en: What truth? “I’m fifteen.
paras.zh: 什么真相？“”我十五岁了。

paras.en: If there is more, I want to hear it.” Ma smiled sadly. “Nothing, darling.
paras.zh: 如果还有别的，我想听。“妈妈难过地笑笑。”没什么，亲爱的。

paras.en: I’m sorry.
paras.zh: 抱歉。

paras.en: I’m just terribly upset.
paras.zh: 我只是太难过了。

paras.en: Freya was my oldest and dearest friend.” Anna reached for her mother again, and they clung to each other.
paras.zh: 芙蕾雅是我最久、最亲的朋友。“安娜又伸出手去够母亲，两人紧紧相拥。

paras.en: Papa put an arm around each of them.
paras.zh: 爸爸用一只手搂住她们俩。

paras.en: They were grieving; it made sense their emotions were high.
paras.zh: 他们在哀悼；情绪激动是人之常情。

paras.en: She could feel the tears coming harder now.
paras.zh: 她感到眼泪这时流得更凶了。

paras.en: Freya wasn’t coming back.
paras.zh: 芙蕾雅回不来了。

paras.en: Their king and queen were gone.
paras.zh: 他们的国王和王后也不在了。

paras.en: The walls seemed like they were closing in, but Anna refused to let them.
paras.zh: 墙壁仿佛在逼近，可安娜不肯认输。

paras.en: Her eyes searched for a comforting sight.
paras.zh: 她的眼睛寻找着能带来慰藉的景象。

paras.en: Over her mother’s shoulder, she found the living room window.
paras.zh: 越过母亲的肩膀，她看见了客厅的窗。

paras.en: The image was hard to see with her eyes filled with tears, but Anna knew it was there.
paras.zh: 眼里含泪，那景致看不太清，可安娜知道它在那儿。

paras.en: If she peered out between two rows of houses and looked toward the bottom of the mountain, Arendelle was still there, calling for her.
paras.zh: 只要从两排屋子之间望出去，朝山脚下看，阿伦黛尔还在那儿，向她召唤。

paras.en: She couldn’t help wondering what was happening inside the castle walls at that very moment.
paras.zh: 她忍不住想，此刻城堡的围墙里正发生着什么。

paras.en: Who was comforting Princess Elsa?
paras.zh: 是谁在安慰艾莎公主？

paras.en: Anna clung tighter to her parents.
paras.zh: 安娜把父母抱得更紧了。

paras.en: More than anything, Anna hoped Elsa wasn’t alone.
paras.zh: 安娜最最希望的，就是艾莎不是一个人。

paras.en: Elsa stared up at the ice-covered ceiling while snow fell around her.
paras.zh: 艾莎仰头盯着结满冰的天花板，雪花在四周飘落。

paras.en: It had been three days since she had learned her parents’ ship was lost at sea.
paras.zh: 自从得知父母的船在海上遇难，已经过了三天。

paras.en: She hadn’t left her room.
paras.zh: 她没离开过房间。

paras.en: She didn’t sleep in her bed.
paras.zh: 她没在床上睡。

paras.en: She hardly touched the food left outside her door.
paras.zh: 门口放的食物她几乎没碰。

paras.en: She refused to see anyone, including Lord Peterssen, who was the closest thing she had left to family.
paras.zh: 谁都不见，包括彼得森勋爵——那是她如今最像亲人般的存在。

paras.en: All she wanted was to be left alone.
paras.zh: 她只想一个人待着。

paras.en: Snowflakes fell onto her nose and cheeks as she stared at the icicles hanging from the ceiling.
paras.zh: 雪花落在她鼻尖和脸颊上，她盯着天花板上垂下的冰柱。

paras.en: Icicles she had somehow created.
paras.zh: 这些冰柱，是她不知怎么造出来的。

paras.en: How ironic that she had been given these strange powers at the exact moment she no longer had anyone to share them with.
paras.zh: 真是讽刺，她偏偏在再无人可以分享的这些奇怪力量降临的此刻，得到了它们。

paras.en: She lifted her hand, fingers trembling, and felt the ice slipping loose again.
paras.zh: 她抬起手，手指发颤，感到冰又一次松脱开来。

paras.en: The ice formed a frosty path across the ceiling.
paras.zh: 冰在天花板上铺出一条霜白的小径。

paras.en: Elsa still wasn’t sure how it worked, but at least she could sense when it was about to happen now.
paras.zh: 艾莎仍不确定这是怎么运作的，但至少现在她能预感到它要发生了。

paras.en: She would feel tingling in her fingers and her heart would speed up.
paras.zh: 她会指尖发麻，心跳加速。

paras.en: She noticed it always happened when she was thinking about her parents.
paras.zh: 她注意到，每当想起父母，它就总会发生。

paras.en: Did she even think about anything else now?
paras.zh: 她现在还会想别的事吗？

paras.en: No.
paras.zh: 不会。

paras.en: She was not getting up off the floor anytime soon.
paras.zh: 她短时间内是不会从地上起来的。

paras.en: There was a quiet knock at the door.
paras.zh: 门上传来轻轻的叩响。

paras.en: She knew who it was without asking. “I am leaving soon for the memorial.
paras.zh: 不用问她也知道是谁。“我马上就要去参加追悼会了。

paras.en: Please consider coming with me, Elsa.” It was Lord Peterssen.
paras.zh: 请你考虑跟我一起去吧，艾莎。”是彼得森勋爵。

paras.en: Even though she hadn’t left her room, she knew what he was talking about.
paras.zh: 尽管她没出过房间，也知道他在说什么。

paras.en: Kai, Gerda, Olina, and Lord Peterssen had been talking to her through her closed door for days.
paras.zh: 凯、格达、奥丽娜和彼得森勋爵已经连着好几天隔着关着的门对她说话了。

paras.en: Nothing they could tell her was of importance.
paras.zh: 他们能告诉她的，没有一件要紧。

paras.en: She already knew who would run the kingdom.
paras.zh: 她早已知道谁会执掌王国。

paras.en: Papa had told her before his trip that if anything ever happened to him, Lord Peterssen would handle affairs until Elsa came of age at twenty-one and could be coronated.
paras.zh: 爸爸出远门前告诉过她，万一他有什么不测，彼得森勋爵会处理政务，直到艾莎二十一岁成年、可以加冕。

paras.en: Anything else they had to say didn’t matter.
paras.zh: 他们其他要说的，都无关紧要。

paras.en: It upset her to think she didn’t know her parents as well as she had thought she did.
paras.zh: 想到自己并不像原以为的那样了解父母，她心里很不是滋味。

paras.en: When she considered the argument she had overheard before they left, the trunk in the attic with the mysterious letter A , and her strange powers, she had to wonder.
paras.zh: 当她回想他们离开前偷听到的争执、阁楼上那只带神秘字母“A”的箱子，以及自己奇怪的力量，就忍不住疑惑。

paras.en: There were so many questions she wished she could ask her parents.
paras.zh: 有那么多问题，她多希望可以问问父母。

paras.en: Did you know I was capable of magic?
paras.zh: 你们知道我能施展魔法吗？

paras.en: If you did, why didn’t you tell me?
paras.zh: 如果知道，为什么不告诉我？

paras.en: Were you ashamed I was born with this power?
paras.zh: 你们是否因我生来就有这力量而感到羞耻？

paras.en: Scared?
paras.zh: 害怕？

paras.en: Worried about what our people would think?
paras.zh: 担心我们的子民会怎么想？

paras.en: I’ll never know.
paras.zh: 我永远也不会知道了。

paras.en: You’ve taken your secrets to the grave and left me alone to figure things out. “Elsa, please?
paras.zh: 你们把秘密带进了坟墓，留我一个人去摸索。“艾莎，求你了？

paras.en: Your parents would want you to be there.
paras.zh: 你父母会希望你到场。

paras.en: Open the door.” She closed her eyes tight.
paras.zh: 开开门吧。”她紧紧闭上了眼。

paras.en: The memorial service for her parents was being held high above the fjord.
paras.zh: 为父母举行的追悼仪式在峡湾高处举行。

paras.en: Even though Papa and Mama had perished at sea, markers were being placed up there in their honor.
paras.zh: 尽管爸爸妈妈葬身海中，那里仍立起纪念碑以纪念他们。

paras.en: Hundreds of subjects were expected to turn out.
paras.zh: 预计会有数百名子民到场。

paras.en: They’d want to offer their condolences and sympathy, but she knew she wouldn’t be able to handle the situation.
paras.zh: 他们会来致哀慰问，可她知道自己应付不了那个场面。

paras.en: Ice would shoot out uncontrollably.
paras.zh: 冰会不受控制地射出来。

paras.en: They’d brand her a witch or a monster.
paras.zh: 他们会说她是女巫或怪物。

paras.en: They’d demand she abdicate the throne.
paras.zh: 他们会要求她退位。

paras.en: Her parents’ legacy would be gone in a moment.
paras.zh: 父母的遗志转瞬就会化为乌有。

paras.en: No, she couldn’t go to her parents’ memorial.
paras.zh: 不，她不能去父母的追悼会。

paras.en: She couldn’t go anywhere in public till she got a handle on her magic.
paras.zh: 在她控制住魔法之前，她哪儿都不能公开去。

paras.en: Until then, she would stay locked in her room.
paras.zh: 在那之前，她就把自己锁在房间里。

paras.en: She’d never leave the castle.
paras.zh: 她再也不会离开城堡。

paras.en: She would avoid contact with most of the staff.
paras.zh: 她会避开和大多数仆人接触。

paras.en: Her sole purpose would be to conceal her powers.
paras.zh: 她唯一的目的，就是隐藏自己的力量。

paras.en: Don’t feel it, she reminded herself.
paras.zh: 别去感受它，她提醒自己。

paras.en: Don’t let it show.
paras.zh: 别让它显露。

paras.en: Her parents had loved her so much.
paras.zh: 父母曾那么爱她。

paras.en: She still needed them—she was desperate to tell them what had happened.
paras.zh: 她仍需要他们——她急需把发生的事告诉他们。

paras.en: What if she couldn’t handle the power on her own?
paras.zh: 万一她独自应付不了这力量怎么办？

paras.en: She couldn’t tell Lord Peterssen for fear of frightening him.
paras.zh: 她不能告诉彼得森勋爵，怕吓着他。

paras.en: The throne was at stake.
paras.zh: 王位关系到存亡。

paras.en: She had no choice but to suffer in silence. “Elsa?
paras.zh: 她别无选择，只能默默承受。“艾莎？

paras.en: Can you hear me?” “What is she saying?” said a second voice, much more insistent than the first.
paras.zh: 你听得见我吗？”“她在说什么？”第二个声音响起，比第一个急切得多。

paras.en: Elsa heard Lord Peterssen patiently trying to explain the situation. “I know she’s upset,” said the second voice, “but it won’t look right for the future queen not to be at her parents’ memorial.
paras.zh: 艾莎听见彼得森勋爵耐心地解释着情况。“我知道她很难过，”第二个声音说，“可未来的女王不出席父母的追悼会，说不过去。

paras.en: What will the people think?” It was cleary the Duke of Weselton.
paras.zh: 子民会怎么想？”那分明是威斯顿公爵。

paras.en: He had no say in their kingdom, but he seemed to feel that being a close trade partner allowed him to weigh in on things.
paras.zh: 他在他们的王国本无话语权，却似乎觉得作为亲密的贸易伙伴，自己可以对事情发表意见。

paras.en: He had raced back to Arendelle when news broke of the king’s and queen’s demises.
paras.zh: 国王王后去世的消息一传出，他就赶回了阿伦黛尔。

paras.en: As much as his presence frustrated her, she knew he was right.
paras.zh: 尽管他的出现让她心烦，她却知道他说得对。

paras.en: She should honor her parents and be at the service.
paras.zh: 她应该敬重父母，出席仪式。

paras.en: But that would mean she’d have to pick herself up off the floor and risk everyone’s finding out what she was capable of. “Please leave,” Elsa croaked.
paras.zh: 可那意味着她得从地上爬起来，冒着让所有人发现她能力的危险。“请离开吧，”艾莎沙哑地说。

paras.en: Silence. “She isn’t coming,” Elsa heard Lord Peterssen tell the Duke.
paras.zh: 一片沉默。“她不来了，”艾莎听见彼得森勋爵对公爵说。

paras.en: He didn’t argue.
paras.zh: 他没有争辩。

paras.en: Moments later, she heard them walk away.
paras.zh: 片刻之后，她听见他们走开了。

paras.en: Elsa sat up and looked at Sir JorgenBjorgen lying on her bed.
paras.zh: 艾莎坐起身，看着躺在床上的约根·比约根爵士。

paras.en: He had been there since she’d thrown him days before.
paras.zh: 自从几天前她把他甩过去，他一直就在那儿。

paras.en: Now he was covered in ice.
paras.zh: 现在他覆了一层冰。

paras.en: She suddenly wished she could reach him.
paras.zh: 她突然希望能碰到他。

paras.en: When she was a child, she had truly loved that toy.
paras.zh: 小时候，她是真的爱那个玩具。

paras.en: Not just because the doll had been such a good listener, but because he was her constant companion.
paras.zh: 不只因为玩偶那么善于倾听，更因为他是她形影不离的伙伴。

paras.en: She had liked to imagine that the doll loved her in return.
paras.zh: 她喜欢想象玩偶也爱着她。

paras.en: For a split second, Elsa recalled a new memory of her younger self.
paras.zh: 有那么一瞬，艾莎想起一段关于幼年自己的新记忆。

paras.en: She was building a snowman with another girl.
paras.zh: 她在和另一个女孩堆雪人。

paras.en: They pulled the snowman around the room laughing.
paras.zh: 她们笑着把雪人在屋里拉着转。

paras.en: It was clear they loved each other.
paras.zh: 显然她们彼此相爱。

paras.en: Her hands started to tingle in an unfamiliar way—they were warm—then the sensation was gone and she was left with a sharp headache.
paras.zh: 她的手以一种陌生的方式发麻——是暖的——接着那感觉消失了，只留给她一阵剧烈的头痛。

paras.en: What was that? she wondered.
paras.zh: 那是什么？她纳闷。

paras.en: The girl had to be in her imagination.
paras.zh: 那女孩准是她想象出来的。

paras.en: She had never used magic before that week.
paras.zh: 在那一周之前，她从没用过魔法。

paras.en: Had she?
paras.zh: 真的没用过吗？

paras.en: Elsa stood up, her legs shaking.
paras.zh: 艾莎站起来，双腿发抖。

paras.en: She held on to her bed frame to keep from falling.
paras.zh: 她扶住床架以免摔倒。

paras.en: Heart pounding, fingers aching, she closed her eyes again and tried to remember the love she had just felt coursing through her veins.
paras.zh: 心怦怦跳，手指隐隐作痛，她再次闭上眼，努力回想刚才那股流经血管的爱意。

paras.en: The emotion was stronger than fear.
paras.zh: 那种情感比恐惧更强烈。

paras.en: This feeling had come from building something out of love—a snowman for the two girls to enjoy.
paras.zh: 这感觉源于出于爱去创造什么——为两个女孩堆个能一起玩乐的雪人。

paras.en: If only she could capture that in a bottle and hold it close.
paras.zh: 要是能把它装进瓶子、揣在身边就好了。

paras.en: Especially now, when she was more alone than she ever had been before.
paras.zh: 尤其是现在，她比以往任何时候都更孤单。

paras.en: It couldn’t hurt to try.
paras.zh: 试一试也无妨。

paras.en: Swirling her arms right and left, Elsa allowed the ice and snow to burst forth, but this time, she tried to focus on the love and leave the fear out of it.
paras.zh: 艾莎左右挥动手臂，让冰雪迸发而出，可这一次，她试着专注于爱，把恐惧抛开。

paras.en: She thought again of the vision of her and the girl laughing and building a snowman.
paras.zh: 她再次想起自己和那女孩笑着堆雪人的画面。

paras.en: When she opened her eyes, the snow was swirling like a cyclone in front of her.
paras.zh: 睁开眼时，雪在她面前像旋风般打着转。

paras.en: It funneled up from the ground, creating snowballs that were pulled into the air and formed into a snowman.
paras.zh: 雪从地面卷起，凝成雪球被吸到空中，聚成了一个雪人。

paras.en: He had a wide bottom and two stubby snowball feet, a modest middle section, and an oval head with a large mouth and prominent front teeth.
paras.zh: 他底墩宽大，两只胖乎乎的雪球脚，中段不算粗，椭圆脑袋上一张大嘴和显眼的大门牙。

paras.en: Elsa stumbled back in disbelief at her creation.
paras.zh: 艾莎不敢相信自己的作品，踉跄着后退。

paras.en: Had she really just controlled her powers to build a snowman?
paras.zh: 她真的刚刚控制住力量堆了个雪人？

paras.en: She almost laughed at the absurdity of it.
paras.zh: 这滑稽劲儿让她几乎笑出来。

paras.en: But Elsa pushed forward and focused on the snowman in front of her, grabbing kindling from the fire for his arms and hair, some coal from the ashes for buttons, and a carrot from last night’s dinner plate for his nose.
paras.zh: 但艾莎上前去，专注地看着面前的雪人，从火里抽出引火柴做他的手臂和头发，从灰里捡煤块做纽扣，又拿昨晚餐盘里的胡萝卜做他的鼻子。

paras.en: When she stepped back to admire her work, she noticed something strange.
paras.zh: 她退后欣赏作品时，注意到一件怪事。

paras.en: The snowman suddenly glowed with the same blue haze her powers had.
paras.zh: 雪人忽然泛起和她魔力一样的蓝色光晕。

paras.en: When the glow faded, the snowman blinked his big eyes.
paras.zh: 光晕褪去，雪人眨了眨大眼睛。

paras.en: Elsa jumped back in surprise. “Hi!
paras.zh: 艾莎吃惊地往后一跳。“嗨！

paras.en: I’m Olaf, and I like warm hugs.” Wait, the snowman was alive ?
paras.zh: 我是雪宝，我喜欢温暖的拥抱。”等等，这雪人还活着？

paras.en: Her powers could do more than create snow—they could make a real being?
paras.zh: 她的力量岂止能造雪——还能创造一个真正的生命？

paras.en: Elsa’s breath was shallow as she watched the snowman begin to walk—walk!—around her room.
paras.zh: 看着雪人在房间里——走起来！——踱步，艾莎的呼吸变得急促。

paras.en: She stared at her hands in wonder.
paras.zh: 她惊奇地盯着自己的双手。

paras.en: How was this even possible? “Did you just talk?” Elsa whispered, not believing her eyes or ears. “Yes!
paras.zh: 这怎么可能？“你刚说话了？”艾莎低声问，不敢相信自己的眼睛和耳朵。“是的！

paras.en: I’m Olaf,” the snowman repeated.
paras.zh: 我是雪宝，”雪人重复道。

paras.en: He picked up Sir JorgenBjorgen. “Ooh!
paras.zh: 他拾起约根·比约根爵士。“噢！

paras.en: What’s this?
paras.zh: 这是什么？

paras.en: Hi,” he said to her doll. “I’m Olaf!” “Olaf,” she repeated, trying to calm down.
paras.zh: 嗨，”他对她的玩偶说，“我是雪宝！”“雪宝，”她重复着，努力平复情绪。

paras.en: Why did the snowman’s name sound so familiar? “Elsa, you built me,” the snowman said. “Remember?” “You know who I am?” “Yeah, why?” Olaf toddled away to examine the window seat.
paras.zh: 为什么雪人的名字听起来这么耳熟？“艾莎，你造了我，”雪人说，“记得吗？”“你知道我是谁？”“知道啊，怎么了？”雪宝摇摇摆摆走开，去打量窗边的座榻。

paras.en: Elsa was stunned by what was happening, but what was more, for a split second she’d forgotten her sorrow.
paras.zh: 艾莎被眼前发生的一切惊呆了，但更让她意外的是，有那么一瞬，她竟忘了悲伤。

paras.en: A memory of love had led her to create a walking, talking snowman. “Ooh!
paras.zh: 一段爱的记忆，让她创造出了一个会走会说的雪人。“噢！

paras.en: This room is pretty,” Olaf said. “What’s that?” he asked, moving to the open window and looking out below.
paras.zh: 这房间真漂亮，”雪宝说，“那是什么？”他走到敞开的窗前，朝下面望去。

paras.en: Elsa watched him in awe. “Ooh!
paras.zh: 艾莎敬畏地看着他。“噢！

paras.en: It’s a village.
paras.zh: 是个村庄。

paras.en: I’ve always wanted to see a village with people and animals, and it’s summertime!
paras.zh: 我一直想看看有人和动物的村庄，而且现在还是夏天！

paras.en: I love summer!
paras.zh: 我爱夏天！

paras.en: Watching all the bees buzz around and kids blow dandelion fuzz and—oh.” He turned toward her.
paras.zh: 看蜜蜂嗡嗡飞、孩子们吹蒲公英绒——哦。”他转过身面向她。

paras.en: The right side of his face was beginning to melt. “Small problem.” Elsa swirled her hands around as she had before and thought hard about what she could do to help him stay cool in the heat.
paras.zh: 他右半边脸开始融化了。“小麻烦。”艾莎像之前那样绕着圈挥手，努力想着能怎样帮他在热天里保持凉爽。

paras.en: A small snow cloud appeared above Olaf’s head. “My own personal flurry!” Olaf hugged himself.
paras.zh: 雪宝头顶升起一小片雪云。“我专属的小雪团！”雪宝抱住自己。

paras.en: Then he saw the look on her face. “What’s the matter?” “I’m still trying to understand how you’re here and how I created you.” “Don’t you remember?” Olaf asked. “You made me for Anna!” Elsa’s heart might have stopped for a moment.
paras.zh: 接着他看见了她脸上的神情。“怎么了？”“我还在努力弄明白你怎么会在这里、我又怎么造出了你。”“你忘了吗？”雪宝问，“你为我——为安娜造的我！”艾莎的心仿佛停跳了一瞬。

paras.en: Anna?
paras.zh: 安娜？

paras.en: Could Anna be the A on the chest in the attic?
paras.zh: 安娜会不会就是阁楼上那只箱子上的“A”？

paras.en: Elsa was almost too afraid to ask. “Who’s Anna?” Olaf’s eager smile faded. “I don’t know.
paras.zh: 艾莎几乎不敢问。“谁是安娜？”雪宝热切的笑容消失了。“我不知道。

paras.en: Who’s Anna?” It was okay.
paras.zh: 谁是安娜？”没关系。

paras.en: This was a start.
paras.zh: 这是个开始。

paras.en: She had a name now. “I don’t know, either.” Elsa took Olaf by the twig and led him to her window seat.
paras.zh: 她现在有名字了。“我也不知道。”艾莎牵着雪宝的树枝手臂，带他到窗边座榻。

paras.en: She planned on telling him everything she knew. “But together we’re going to find out.”
paras.zh: 她打算把知道的一切都告诉他。“但我们要一起把它查清楚。”

paras.en: Three Years Later… Elsa looked out her bedroom window and marveled at the scene unfolding in front of her.
paras.zh: 三年后……艾莎望向卧室窗外，惊叹于眼前铺开的景象。

paras.en: The castle gates were open and workers in green uniforms were readying the courtyard and the chapel for her coronation.
paras.zh: 城堡大门敞开着，穿绿制服的工人们正在为她的加冕礼布置庭院和小教堂。

paras.en: Purple and gold banners, some with her silhouette and others with the family crest, were being hung from every flagpole inside and outside the courtyard.
paras.zh: 紫色和金色的旗帜——有的印着她的剪影，有的印着家族纹章——正被挂上庭院内外的每一根旗杆。

paras.en: Her coronation was only days away.
paras.zh: 加冕礼就在几天之后了。

paras.en: Elsa was terrified.
paras.zh: 艾莎害怕极了。

paras.en: She took a deep breath and tried to steady her heartbeat before the blue glow could appear above her hands.
paras.zh: 她深吸一口气，赶在双手上方泛起蓝光之前，努力稳住心跳。

paras.en: Don’t let them see your powers, she reminded herself.
paras.zh: 别让他们看见你的力量，她提醒自己。

paras.en: You need them to think of you as the good ruler your parents raised you to be, not someone who can do magic, or else …She exhaled slowly and thought about the worst-case scenario: One wrong move and everyone will know the truth.
paras.zh: 你得让他们把你看作父母养育出的好君主，而不是会魔法的人，否则……她缓缓吐气，想着最坏的结局：一步走错，所有人都会知道真相。

paras.en: I’m not like everyone else.
paras.zh: 我和别人不一样。

paras.en: There was a knock at her door. “Princess Elsa?
paras.zh: 有人敲门。“艾莎公主？

paras.en: Your presence is requested in the dressing room for a final fitting of your gown.” It was Gerda calling her from the hallway.
paras.zh: 请您到更衣室去，做礼服的最后一次试穿。”是格达在走廊里唤她。

paras.en: Elsa was thankful for her presence, as well as Kai’s and Lord Peterssen’s, the past three years.
paras.zh: 过去三年里，艾莎对格达、凯和彼得森勋爵的陪伴心怀感激。

paras.en: Her room had become her sanctuary after her parents’ deaths, and they had respected that, allowing her to take the time she needed before she was ready to join the world again.
paras.zh: 父母过世后，她的房间成了避难所，他们也尊重这点，给了她需要的时间，直到她准备好重新面对世界。

paras.en: She spent a lot of time in her room and the adjoining one that was her dressing area, but didn’t like to linger in the castle’s other rooms.
paras.zh: 她把很多时间花在房间和相邻的更衣间里，却不爱在城堡别的房间里逗留。

paras.en: She was still haunted by the memories of her parents. “Thank you, Gerda.
paras.zh: 父母的记忆仍缠绕着她。“谢谢你，格达。

paras.en: I’ll meet you in the dressing room,” Elsa called through the door.
paras.zh: 更衣室见，”艾莎隔着门答道。

paras.en: Gerda understood her better than almost anyone, and yet she didn’t know Elsa’s secret.
paras.zh: 格达比几乎任何人都更懂她，却不知道艾莎的秘密。

paras.en: Only one person knew that. “Oooh, look!
paras.zh: 只有一个人知道。“噢，看！

paras.en: You got more flowers!” said Olaf, walking through the door between her room and the dressing area with a large bouquet. “Olaf!” Elsa pulled him through the door before Gerda saw him. “You know you’re not supposed to be in the dressing room.
paras.zh: 你又收到花啦！”雪宝抱着一大束花，从她和更衣间之间的门走进来说。“雪宝！”艾莎在格达看见他之前把他拽进门。“你知道你不该进更衣室的。

paras.en: You can’t leave my room at all without me.
paras.zh: 没我在，你根本不能离开我的房间。

paras.en: Especially this week.
paras.zh: 尤其这星期。

paras.en: There are too many people in the castle.” “Technically, I didn’t leave your room,” Olaf pointed out. “The dressing room is attached.” Elsa took the flowers from Olaf and placed them on her desk. “I know, but you promised me you’d stay in here.” The snowflakes over Olaf’s head fell faster. “But it looks like so much fun out there!
paras.zh: 城堡里人多得不得了。”“严格说，我没离开你的房间，”雪宝指出，“更衣室是连着的。”艾莎从雪宝手里接过花，放到书桌上。“我知道，可你答应过我会待在这儿。”雪宝头顶的雪花落得更快了。“可外面看起来好玩极了！

paras.en: I peeked through the keyhole and saw someone pushing a cart with a chocolate cake.” “I will have some cake sent to the room,” Elsa promised. “I know it’s hard, but we can’t risk anyone finding a talking snowman roaming the halls today.” Olaf frowned. “You say that every day.” She grabbed his twiglike hand. “I know.
paras.zh: 我透过钥匙孔偷看，看见有人推着小车，上面有巧克力蛋糕。”“我会让人送些蛋糕到房间，”艾莎保证，“我知道这很难，可今天绝不能冒险让一个会说话的雪人在走廊游荡。”雪宝皱起眉。“你每天都这么说。”她抓住他树枝般的手。“我知道。

paras.en: I’m sorry.” There were no words for how sorry she was.
paras.zh: 抱歉。”她心里的歉意，无以言表。

paras.en: Olaf was the closest thing she had to family.
paras.zh: 雪宝是她最像家人般的存在。

paras.en: He had been her constant companion the past three years, and she never let him leave the room unless she was absolutely positive they weren’t going to be seen.
paras.zh: 过去三年里他一直陪着她，除非她百分百确定不会被看见，否则从不让他离开房间。

paras.en: Occasionally, the two of them escaped her room.
paras.zh: 偶尔，他们俩会溜出她的房间。

paras.en: A few times she had stuck Olaf underneath a tea cart and wheeled him to the staircase so they could dash up to the attic.
paras.zh: 有几次她把雪宝塞到茶车底下，推着他上楼梯，好让他们冲去阁楼。

paras.en: Repeated trips had turned up nothing on Anna.
paras.zh: 反复上去，却没找到任何关于安娜的线索。

paras.en: The mysterious trunk with the letter A held tiny dresses and bonnets, but there was nothing there that suggested A was for Anna , or that it was a clue to who Anna was.
paras.zh: 那只带字母“A”的神秘箱子装着小裙子和小软帽，却没有任何东西表明A是指安娜，或暗示安娜是谁。

paras.en: Elsa had exhausted herself searching for information on this lost girl Olaf was sure she knew.
paras.zh: 艾莎为寻找这个雪宝确信她认识的失踪女孩，把自己都累垮了。

paras.en: Visits to her parents’ library also turned up nothing, and there was no record in the castle chapel of an Anna being born.
paras.zh: 去父母图书馆翻找也一无所获，城堡小教堂里也没有安娜出生的记录。

paras.en: Once, she’d even mentioned Anna’s name to Lord Peterssen, hoping to get a reaction, but he looked utterly confused.
paras.zh: 有一回，她甚至向彼得森勋爵提起安娜的名字，想看他的反应，可他一脸茫然。

paras.en: The only one who remembered her was Olaf, and he apparently had memory loss. “After the coronation, we will find time to let you poke around the attic again,” Elsa said brightly, and Olaf’s eyes widened. “Not just the attic!” Olaf said. “Once you’re queen you can tell everyone about your wonderful gift.” Gift.
paras.zh: 唯一记得她的只有雪宝，而他也明显记性不好。“加冕之后，我们会抽时间去阁楼让你再翻翻，”艾莎轻快地说，雪宝眼睛一亮。“不光是阁楼！”雪宝说，“等你当了女王，就能把你的奇妙天赋告诉大家了。”天赋。

paras.en: Sometimes the gift felt more like a curse.
paras.zh: 有时这天赋更像是诅咒。

paras.en: She’d learned to control her magic a bit in the past few years, but only when it came to what she could intentionally create.
paras.zh: 这几年她学会了一点控制魔法，但仅限于她能有意创造的东西。

paras.en: Snow mounds, yes.
paras.zh: 雪堆，可以。

paras.en: But if she found herself getting upset or anxious, she couldn’t stop snow from falling, no matter how hard she tried. “I’m not sure that’s wise.” “Why not?
paras.zh: 可一旦她自己变得沮丧或焦虑，无论怎么努力，都拦不住雪落下来。“我不确定那样做明智。”“为什么不？

paras.en: Everyone would love some snow on a day as hot as this.” Olaf walked to the window, his personal flurry cloud following, and looked out. “They’re roasting out there getting everything ready for your coronation.
paras.zh: 这么热的天，大家都会喜欢来点雪的。”雪宝走到窗前，专属的小雪云跟着他，朝外望去。“他们在外面烤得够呛，正为你的加冕礼做准备呢。

paras.en: Oh, look!
paras.zh: 噢，看！

paras.en: They have lots of banners for you.
paras.zh: 他们为你挂了好多旗帜。

paras.en: Hi, people!” Elsa pulled him back from the window. “I am not sure the kingdom will be happy to know they have a queen who can make ice.” “Anna always liked it,” Olaf offered.
paras.zh: 嗨，大家好！”艾莎把他从窗边拉回来。“我不确定王国子民知道有个会造冰的女王会高兴。”“安娜一直喜欢雪，”雪宝插话道。

paras.en: That was what he’d do sometimes.
paras.zh: 他有时会这样。

paras.en: He’d drop Anna’s name into the conversation as if they should both know who he was talking about.
paras.zh: 他会把安娜的名字随口带进对话，仿佛两人都该知道他说的是谁。

paras.en: But the minute she tried to pull at the loose thread, the conversation unraveled. “When did I make snow for Anna, again?” Olaf clapped his hands excitedly. “Ooh…well…” He frowned. “I don’t remember.” Elsa smiled sadly. “It’s all right.
paras.zh: 可她刚想揪住这根松线，话题就散了。“我到底是什么时候为安娜造雪的，再说一遍？”雪宝兴奋地拍手。“噢……这个……”他皱起眉。“我不记得了。”艾莎难过地笑笑。“没关系。

paras.en: One day you will.” Olaf nodded. “Let’s see you practice for your coronation again.” “I’m not sure I’m ready to do that right now.” Elsa hesitated. “Gerda is waiting.” “You can do it this time!” Olaf cheered her on. “I know you can.” “All right.” Elsa walked to her desk and looked down at the small porcelain jar and candlestick.
paras.zh: 总有一天你会想起来的。”雪宝点点头。“再来练一遍加冕礼吧。”“我不确定现在准备好了。”艾莎犹豫了。“格达在等着呢。”“这次你行的！”雪宝给她打气，“我知道你行。”“好吧。”艾莎走到书桌前，低头看着小瓷罐和烛台。

paras.en: She had been using them as stand-ins for the orb and scepter she would have to hold, like her father did during his coronation.
paras.zh: 她一直拿它们当替代品，代替加冕时她必须捧着的宝球和权杖——就像父亲加冕时那样。

paras.en: As she had many times before, Elsa closed her eyes and tried to imagine herself inside the chapel where the ceremony would take place.
paras.zh: 和以往多次一样，艾莎闭上眼，试着想象自己置身仪式将举行的小教堂里。

paras.en: She thought of the choir that would be singing in the balcony, and she could see the pulpit she would be standing at in front of the priest and all her people, as well as nobles and visiting dignitaries.
paras.zh: 她想到楼座里歌唱的唱诗班，能看见自己将站上去的讲坛——在牧师、全体子民，以及贵族和来访使节面前。

paras.en: With no family, she’d be up there alone.
paras.zh: 没有家人，她将独自站在那里。

paras.en: Elsa tried not to think about that as she imagined the priest placing the jeweled tiara on her head.
paras.zh: 艾莎想象牧师把镶宝石的冠冕戴到她头上，尽量不去想这一点。

paras.en: Then he’d hold out the pillow with the orb and scepter for her to take.
paras.zh: 接着他会捧出垫着宝球和权杖的软垫，让她接过。

paras.en: She couldn’t wear her teal gloves during that portion of the ceremony, so she removed them now for practice.
paras.zh: 仪式那一段她不能戴青绿色手套，所以现在她摘下来练习。

paras.en: She wore gloves all the time these days.
paras.zh: 这些天她手套从不离手。

paras.en: Perhaps it was silly, but she thought the gloves helped her conceal her magic.
paras.zh: 也许有点傻，可她觉得手套能帮她藏住魔法。

paras.en: This was her battle cry: Conceal it.
paras.zh: 这是她的战斗口号：藏住它。

paras.en: Don’t feel it.
paras.zh: 别去感受它。

paras.en: Don’t let it show. “You’re almost there,” Olaf said encouragingly.
paras.zh: 别让它显露。“你快做到了，”雪宝鼓励道。

paras.en: This was the hardest part.
paras.zh: 这是最难的部分。

paras.en: Elsa reached down with trembling fingers and lifted the porcelain jar in one hand and the candlestick in the other.
paras.zh: 艾莎用发颤的手指垂下手，一手提起瓷罐，一手提起烛台。

paras.en: She repeated the prayer she knew the priest would say while she held the objects. “ Sem hón heldr inum helgum eignum ok krýnd í þessum helga stað ek té fram fyrir yðr …Queen Elsa of Arendelle.” Then she would need to turn around with the orb and scepter in her hands as the people chanted, “Queen Elsa of Arendelle!” “Queen Elsa of Arendelle!” Olaf shouted.
paras.zh: 她捧着物件，重复着知道牧师会念的祷词：“Sem hón heldr inum helgum eignum ok krýnd í þessum helga stað ek té fram fyrir yðr……阿伦黛尔的艾莎女王。”接着她要手捧宝球和权杖转过身，而众人齐声高呼：“阿伦黛尔的艾莎女王！”“阿伦黛尔的艾莎女王！”雪宝喊道。

paras.en: Elsa held her breath.
paras.zh: 艾莎屏住呼吸。

paras.en: I can do this.
paras.zh: 我能做到。

paras.en: I can do this.
paras.zh: 我能做到。

paras.en: I can do this, she told herself.
paras.zh: 我能做到，她对自己说。

paras.en: Her hands trembled despite her attempts to keep them steady.
paras.zh: 尽管她努力稳住，手还是发抖。

paras.en: Olaf watched her anxiously.
paras.zh: 雪宝焦虑地看着她。

paras.en: I can do this.
paras.zh: 我能做到。

paras.en: The bottom of the porcelain jar began to crackle with ice.
paras.zh: 瓷罐底部开始噼啪结起冰。

paras.en: The candlestick froze in her fingers.
paras.zh: 烛台在她指间冻住了。

paras.en: She quickly put them down and pulled on her gloves. “You almost had it.” Olaf smiled toothily. “We’ll try again later.” She couldn’t tell Olaf it was hopeless.
paras.zh: 她赶紧放下，套上手套。“你差点就成功了。”雪宝咧嘴一笑。“我们待会儿再试。”她没法告诉雪宝，这根本没希望。

paras.en: How would she get through the ceremony without giving herself away?
paras.zh: 她要怎样才能不露破绽地走完仪式？

paras.en: But Olaf had already moved on. “Look at your beautiful flowers!” Olaf said. “Don’t they smell great?” He took a whiff and sneezed all over them. “I wonder who they’re from?” Elsa picked up the card that was tucked inside the bouquet of purple heather. “I have a pretty good idea.” She read the note.
paras.zh: 可雪宝已经转了话题。“看你的漂亮鲜花！”雪宝说，“闻着很香吧？”他凑近一闻，打了个喷嚏喷了花一身。“不知是谁送的？”艾莎拿起插在紫色石楠花束里的小卡片。“我大概猜得到。”她读起便条。

paras.en: I enjoyed spending time with you yesterday.
paras.zh: 昨天和你共度的时光很愉快。

paras.en: Could I entice you with another walk around the garden this afternoon?
paras.zh: 今天下午能否再邀你在花园里散散步？

paras.en: I think it will help put your mind at ease about your big day.
paras.zh: 我想那会帮你为大日子宽宽心。

paras.en: Elsa smiled to herself. “The prince really does like you!” Olaf observed, looking over her shoulder. “I think.” “Perhaps,” she agreed. “He’s asked you for a walk every day since he arrived!” Olaf reminded her. “And he’s sent you chocolates, flowers, and all those books.” “That’s true.” The prince was always talking to her about the books he read—he loved to read as much as she did—and whenever he finished another one, he had it delivered to her room with a single flower pressed inside the pages.
paras.zh: 艾莎抿嘴笑了。“王子是真的喜欢你！”雪宝从她肩后看出去，说。“我想是吧。”“也许，”她答应道，“自从他来后，天天都邀你散步！”雪宝提醒她，“还送你巧克力、鲜花，还有那些书。”“的确。”王子总跟她聊他读的书——他和她一样爱读书——每读完一本，就让人送到她房间，书页里还夹着一朵花。

paras.en: The prince had accompanied the Duke of Weselton on a trip to Arendelle a few months earlier, and she’d been surprised at how well she and he had hit it off.
paras.zh: 几个月前，王子陪着威斯顿公爵一同来到阿伦黛尔，她和王子竟如此投缘，连她自己都意外。

paras.en: Unlike the nosy duke, the prince was polite and seemed to know she needed time to warm up to people.
paras.zh: 和爱打听的威斯顿公爵不同，王子彬彬有礼，似乎知道她需要时间去敞开心扉。

paras.en: He asked thoughtful questions about her studies and training and liked to discuss history and architecture.
paras.zh: 他关切地问起她的学业和训练，也喜欢讨论历史和建筑。

paras.en: They’d spent hours talking about her family’s rule in Arendelle and how it had lasted several decades.
paras.zh: 他们一聊就是几小时，谈她家族在阿伦黛尔的统治，以及它如何延续了几十年。

paras.en: His family was relatively new to the throne in his kingdom, so he constantly wanted to hear her opinions on trade and foreign affairs.
paras.zh: 他的家族在他王国里登基不久，所以总想听她对贸易和外事的看法。

paras.en: They’d become so close, yet there was still so much she couldn’t tell him.
paras.zh: 他们变得那么亲近，可仍有那么多事她不能告诉他。

paras.en: There was another knock on the dressing room door. “Elsa?
paras.zh: 更衣室的门又被敲响。“艾莎？

paras.en: Are you ready?” “Coming!” Elsa called.
paras.zh: 你准备好了吗？”“来了！”艾莎应道。

paras.en: She looked back at Olaf. “I know what to do,” he told her. “Stay here, be quiet, and if anyone appears, hide.
paras.zh: 她回头看雪宝。“我知道该怎么做，”他告诉她，“待在这儿，别出声，要是有人来，就藏起来。

paras.en: Maybe I’ll even do some cleaning.
paras.zh: 说不定我还能打扫一下。

paras.en: This room is rather dusty.” He wasn’t wrong.
paras.zh: 这房间灰可真多。”他说得没错。

paras.en: Since she never let anyone in to clean, it had gotten a bit musty. “Good idea.
paras.zh: 因为她从不让任何人进来打扫，房间都有点发霉味了。“好主意。

paras.en: If you get bored, maybe you can see if there is anything in my hope chest I don’t need anymore,” she said. “I don’t think I’ve looked in there for years.” Olaf nodded. “Ooh!
paras.zh: 要是觉得无聊，就看看我嫁妆箱里有没有不要的东西，”她说，“我大概好几年没打开过了。”雪宝点点头。“噢！

paras.en: I love hope chests.” He headed off to the chest and opened it wide. “Wow!
paras.zh: 我爱嫁妆箱。”他朝箱子走去，把箱盖大敞开。“哇！

paras.en: There’s lots crammed in here.” Elsa left him with his project.
paras.zh: 里面塞得满满的。”艾莎留他忙活自己的事去了。

paras.en: She came through the doorway between her dressing area and her bedroom and found Gerda patiently waiting.
paras.zh: 她从更衣间和卧室之间的门走出来，看见格达正耐心等着。

paras.en: She stood next to a dress form, holding the gown Elsa would wear for her coronation.
paras.zh: 她站在人体模型旁，捧着艾莎加冕时要穿的礼服。

paras.en: Every detail had been carefully planned for her big day.
paras.zh: 她大日子里的每个细节都精心筹划过。

paras.en: Gerda smiled. “This is a gown fit for a queen, is it not?” Elsa returned the smile.
paras.zh: 格达笑着说：“这是配得上女王的礼服，对吧？”艾莎回以微笑。

paras.en: She didn’t have the heart to tell Gerda she found the dress a bit heavy when she walked, and the high neckline was restricting.
paras.zh: 她不忍心告诉格达，她觉得这裙子走起来有点沉，高领口也勒得慌。

paras.en: Every time she put the gown on, she felt claustrophobic. “Everything you bring in is beautiful, Gerda.” This small room was one of her favorites.
paras.zh: 每次穿上礼服，她都觉得透不过气。“你拿来的每样东西都好看，格达。”这小房间是她最爱的之一。

paras.en: She loved the soothing blue hues of the wallpaper and the white wood accents, hand-painted with gold and purple rosemaling that picked up the colors of the rug on the floor.
paras.zh: 她爱那壁纸柔和的蓝色调，还有白色木饰，上面手绘着金紫两色的玫瑰彩绘，正好呼应地上地毯的颜色。

paras.en: Sometimes she still couldn’t believe that she had a whole room just for dressing, but it helped to know she could walk into the adjacent room and not have to hide Olaf away. “Shall we do one last fitting?” Gerda asked.
paras.zh: 有时她仍不敢相信，自己竟有一整间更衣室，但想到能走进隔壁房间、不必把雪宝藏起来，她就安心些。“我们做最后一次试穿？”格达问。

paras.en: Elsa obliged, slipping behind the screen to put on the gown.
paras.zh: 艾莎答应了，闪到屏风后穿上礼服。

paras.en: When she emerged, Gerda had her stand on a wooden box in front of the large trifold mirror so that they could make final alterations.
paras.zh: 她出来时，格达让她站到三面大镜前的一个木箱上，好做最后的修改。

paras.en: There was a knock at the dressing room door. “May I enter?” “Yes,” Gerda and Elsa said at the same time.
paras.zh: 更衣室的门被敲响。“我可以进来吗？”“请进，”格达和艾莎同时说。

paras.en: Lord Peterssen looked as if he might cry when he saw her. “Elsa, you are lovely.
paras.zh: 彼得森勋爵一见她就眼圈泛红。“艾莎，你真美。

paras.en: If your parents could see you today…” She touched his hand. “I know.
paras.zh: 要是你父母今天能看见你……”她碰了碰他的手。“我知道。

paras.en: They’d be proud.” He pulled a handkerchief out of the pocket of his blue jacket. “They truly would be.
paras.zh: 他们会骄傲的。”他从蓝外套口袋抽出手帕。“他们真的会骄傲。

paras.en: As am I,” he said with a smile.
paras.zh: 我也一样，”他微笑着说。

paras.en: The past three years had aged him.
paras.zh: 过去三年让他苍老了许多。

paras.en: His thick black hair had thinned, and the gray was seeping through.
paras.zh: 浓密的黑发变稀了，灰白也悄悄透了出来。

paras.en: He looked tired all the time.
paras.zh: 他看上去总是疲惫。

paras.en: She could relate.
paras.zh: 她感同身受。

paras.en: Her parents’ absence had weighed on them both.
paras.zh: 父母的缺席，压在他们两人心头。

paras.en: But now the day had come when he would step aside from handling the royal affairs, while she would be entering a lifetime of duty.
paras.zh: 可如今这一天来了：他将从政务中退下，而她将步入一生的职责。

paras.en: How was she going to keep her secret safe from the kingdom?
paras.zh: 她要怎样才能保住秘密，不让王国知晓？

paras.en: She felt her fingertips beginning to tingle inside her gloves.
paras.zh: 她感到指尖在手套里开始发麻。

paras.en: She pulled her hand away from Gerda, who was fixing a stitch on the gown’s midsection. “This gown is ready and so are you,” Gerda said reassuringly.
paras.zh: 她把手从格达手里抽回——格达正在礼服中段缝一针。“礼服准备好了，你也准备好了，”格达安慰道。

paras.en: A crash came from the other side of her bedroom wall.
paras.zh: 她卧室墙的另一头传来一声巨响。

paras.en: Then she heard a loud shriek.
paras.zh: 接着她听见一声尖叫。

paras.en: Lord Peterssen appeared baffled. “Is there someone inside your chamber?” Elsa stepped off the box and began backing out of the room. “Please excuse me for one moment.
paras.zh: 彼得森勋爵一脸困惑。“你房间里有人吗？”艾莎从木箱上下来，开始往后退出房间。“请容我失陪片刻。

paras.en: I left my windows open.
paras.zh: 我忘了关窗。

paras.en: A bird must have flown in,” she said.
paras.zh: 一定是鸟飞进来了，”她说。

paras.en: What is Olaf doing? “I’ll take care of it.” “Do you want help?” Gerda asked. “No!” Elsa said, a bit more forcefully than she intended. “I’ll be right back.” Elsa hurried through the door to her bedroom and closed it.
paras.zh: 雪宝在干什么？“我来弄就行。”“要帮忙吗？”格达问。“不用！”艾莎说，比本意用力了些，“我马上回来。”艾莎匆匆穿过门回到卧室，关上门。

paras.en: When she turned around, she saw Olaf had emptied her entire trunk.
paras.zh: 她转过身，看见雪宝把她整个箱子都倒空了。

paras.en: Papers, gowns, trinkets, and mementos were scattered around the floor.
paras.zh: 文件、礼服、小玩意和纪念品散落一地。

paras.en: Olaf was bent over an object she couldn’t see, and he groaned loudly as he tried to lift it. “Olaf!” she whispered. “What are you—oh!” Olaf stood over a green wooden box she had long forgotten about.
paras.zh: 雪宝正弯腰去搬一个她看不见的东西，费力抬起时大声哼哼。“雪宝！”她低声叫，“你在——噢！”雪宝站在一个绿色木盒前，那是她很久没想起的东西。

paras.en: It was the lockbox her father had given her right before his final journey.
paras.zh: 那是父亲在最后一次远行前给她的锁盒。

paras.en: Seeing it again brought tears to her eyes. “I forgot about this,” she said. “Is it a present?” Olaf asked. “It’s so heavy!” “It’s kind of like a present,” Elsa said, her heart warming at the sight of the rosemaling on the lid.
paras.zh: 再见到它，她眼眶湿润了。“我都忘了这个，”她说，“是礼物吗？”雪宝问，“好沉！”“也算是一种礼物吧，”艾莎说，看见盒盖上的玫瑰彩绘，心里一暖。

paras.en: She fingered the raised gold crest on the top. “My father used one of these boxes as king, and he gave me this one to have when I ruled.
paras.zh: 她抚过顶部凸起的金色纹章。“我父亲当国王时用过这样一只盒子，他给了我这只，让我即位时用。

paras.en: I guess that time is now.” “What’s inside?” Olaf asked excitedly.
paras.zh: 我想，此刻就是了。”“里面有什么？”雪宝兴奋地问。

paras.en: It was the first time in years she had opened the box.
paras.zh: 这是多年来她第一次打开这盒子。

paras.en: She lifted the lid and the empty green velvet lining stared back at them. “It’s empty.” Olaf frowned. “Elsa?” she heard from the dressing room. “Coming!” Elsa placed the lockbox on the desk. “Thank you for finding this.
paras.zh: 她掀开盖，空荡荡的绿色天鹅绒衬里朝他们望着。“是空的。”雪宝皱起眉。“艾莎？”她听见更衣室里传来声音。“来了！”艾莎把锁盒放到书桌上。“谢谢你找到这个。

paras.en: I’ll return soon,” Elsa told him before slipping back into the dressing room, where Gerda was waiting patiently. “Bird.
paras.zh: 我很快回来，”艾莎对他说完，溜回更衣室，格达正耐心等着。“鸟。

paras.en: It’s gone now,” she explained. “Why don’t you change and I’ll hang up the gown?” Gerda suggested. “Lord Peterssen had to leave, but you have another visitor waiting outside.” Elsa quickly went behind the screen to change.
paras.zh: 已经飞走了，”她解释道，“你换身衣服吧，我把礼服挂起来？”格达提议，“彼得森勋爵得先走了，不过门外还有位访客在等你。”艾莎赶紧闪到屏风后换衣服。

paras.en: Olaf would be okay in her room for a spell.
paras.zh: 雪宝在房间里待一会儿没事。

paras.en: It was a lovely day, and a walk around the castle grounds could be just what she needed.
paras.zh: 天气真好，绕着城堡庭园散散步，正是她需要的。

paras.en: When she was dressed and ready, Gerda opened the door so Elsa could greet her guest.
paras.zh: 等她穿戴整齐准备好，格达打开门，让艾莎迎接访客。

paras.en: She had a feeling she knew who it was.
paras.zh: 她有种预感，知道来的是谁。

paras.en: He bowed. “Princess Elsa of Arendelle, thank you for seeing me.” He held out his bent elbow. “Shall we take a walk?” She took his arm. “Prince Hans of the Southern Isles, I’d be delighted.”
paras.zh: 他鞠了一躬。“阿伦黛尔的艾莎公主，感谢您接见。”他伸出弯起的臂弯。“我们散个步可好？”她挽住他的手臂。“南境群岛的汉斯王子，我很乐意。”

paras.en: “You do not need to bow every time you see me, Hans,” Elsa said with a laugh.
paras.zh: 汉斯，你不必每次见到我都行礼的。“艾莎笑着说道。

paras.en: He flashed her a charming smile and sighed. “Force of habit.
paras.zh: 他朝她露出迷人的微笑，叹了口气。”这是习惯成自然了。

paras.en: I’ll stop doing that with time.” Over the past few months, he’d given Elsa a lot of time.
paras.zh: 时间长了我会改掉的。“过去的几个月里，他为艾莎花了许多时间。

paras.en: He’d been patient.
paras.zh: 他很有耐心。

paras.en: He’d been a good listener.
paras.zh: 他是个好的倾听者。

paras.en: He moved slowly, each motion or statement he made carefully considered.
paras.zh: 他举止从容，一举一动、一言一语都经过深思熟虑。

paras.en: Hans learned quickly that the princess of Arendelle required a delicate approach.
paras.zh: 汉斯很快就明白，对待阿伦黛尔的公主需要小心翼翼。

paras.en: The poor thing had been so broken when he met her it was obvious that she’d never really recovered from the loss of her parents.
paras.zh: 他初见她时，这可怜的姑娘心都碎了，显然她始终没能从失去双亲的伤痛中真正走出来。

paras.en: And she didn’t have any siblings to lean on.
paras.zh: 而且她也没有兄弟姐妹可以依靠。

paras.en: He couldn’t imagine what her life must have been like after such a tragedy.
paras.zh: 他无法想象，经历这样的悲剧之后，她的生活会是怎样。

paras.en: The large, empty castle must have felt like a tomb.
paras.zh: 那座空旷的大城堡，想必像座坟墓一般。

paras.en: When the Duke of Weselton had visited the Southern Isles the previous fall, he had spoken at length about Arendelle and its orphaned princess and who would take over her kingdom.
