paras.zh: 去年秋天，威斯特顿公爵到访南方群岛时，曾大谈阿伦黛尔和它那位成了孤儿的公主，以及谁会接管她的王国。

paras.en: His twelve older brothers hadn’t paid any attention, but Hans had listened closely.
paras.zh: 他的十二个哥哥都没放在心上，唯独汉斯听得十分认真。

paras.en: Why should they bother?
paras.zh: 他们何必操心呢？

paras.en: Most of them already knew their place in their kingdom; some of them had a chance to rule the islands or had married well and would rule elsewhere.
paras.zh: 他们大多数都已清楚自己在王国中的地位；有些人有机会治理群岛，或是婚姻美满，将来去别处掌权。

paras.en: As thirteenth in line, his chances of ruling were slim.
paras.zh: 作为第十三顺位继承人，他继承王位的机会微乎其微。

paras.en: He was the only one who knew what it was like to have to find a place to fit in the world.
paras.zh: 只有他明白，不得不在这个世界上为自己找个安身之处是什么滋味。

paras.en: He could understand Elsa in a way no one else could.
paras.zh: 他能以一种旁人无法做到的方式理解艾莎。

paras.en: He had decided right then that he would journey to meet her.
paras.zh: 就在那一刻，他下定决心要动身去见她。

paras.en: The Duke of Weselton, a devious fellow who was always looking for a new partnership, had been delighted.
paras.zh: 威斯特顿公爵是个总在寻找新合伙人的狡猾家伙，对此高兴得很。

paras.en: Hans had been residing in Arendelle ever since.
paras.zh: 从那以后，汉斯就一直住在阿伦黛尔。

paras.en: Yes, there were parts of home he missed.
paras.zh: 没错，家乡有些东西他还是怀念的。

paras.en: His brothers (sometimes), his father’s wisdom (all the time), and his islands, which were warmer and lusher than Arendelle.
paras.zh: 他的哥哥们（偶尔会想），父亲的智慧（一直想念），还有他的那些岛屿——那里比阿伦黛尔更温暖、更葱郁。

paras.en: The problem was the Southern Isles never really seemed like they were going to be his kingdom.
paras.zh: 问题是，南方群岛似乎从来都不像是会属于他的王国。

paras.en: Arendelle, on the other hand, just might be.
paras.zh: 而阿伦黛尔，倒说不定会成为他的。

paras.en: Hans stared out one of the windows into the courtyard and watched the castle workers hurrying around, hanging banners and decorations for Elsa’s coronation.
paras.zh: 汉斯从一扇窗户望向庭院，看着城堡的工人们忙前忙后，悬挂横幅和装饰，为艾莎的加冕典礼做准备。

paras.en: After three long years, the kingdom was ready to have a queen.
paras.zh: 漫长的三年过去，王国已经准备好迎接一位女王。

paras.en: What they needed even more was a king .
paras.zh: 而他们更需要的，是一位国王。

paras.en: He and Elsa weren’t officially courting—he didn’t want to scare her off with such a declaration—but it seemed like they were pretty close. “I’m ready,” Elsa said.
paras.zh: 他和艾莎还没有正式确立恋爱关系——他可不想用这种宣告把她吓跑——但看上去他们已经相当亲近了。”我准备好了。“艾莎说。

paras.en: He heard a crash come from her room behind them.
paras.zh: 他听见身后她的房间里传来一声撞击的巨响。

paras.en: The princess winced. “Something must have fallen.
paras.zh: 公主皱了皱眉。”一定是什么东西掉下来了。

paras.en: I’m sure it’s nothing to worry about!” Elsa kept many secrets.
paras.zh: 肯定没什么好担心的！“艾莎藏着许多秘密。

paras.en: He had to admire her for that. “Shall we walk?” She nodded. “Yes.
paras.zh: 对此他不得不佩服她。”我们出去走走？“她点点头。”好啊。

paras.en: I think you were right.
paras.zh: 我想你是对的。

paras.en: Air will do me good.” “It will,” he agreed.
paras.zh: 透透气对我有好处。“”确实。“他附和道。

paras.en: The two stared at each other for a moment.
paras.zh: 两人对视了片刻。

paras.en: Hans hoped she liked what she saw.
paras.zh: 汉斯希望她喜欢自己眼前的这个人。

paras.en: He had reddish-brown hair and muttonchops, which none of his brothers shared and which they constantly teased him about.
paras.zh: 他有一头红棕色的头发，还留着连鬓胡，这是他的哥哥们都没有的，他们也总拿这个取笑他。

paras.en: His mother said they suited him.
paras.zh: 他的母亲说这很衬他。

paras.en: His brothers all had brown eyes, while his were hazel, like his mother’s.
paras.zh: 他的哥哥们都是棕色眼睛，而他的眼睛是淡褐色，像他母亲一样。

paras.en: He was taller than the princess by several inches, and very lanky, which came from running away from twelve older brothers.
paras.zh: 他比公主高出好几英寸，而且十分瘦长——这是躲避十二个哥哥追打练出来的身材。

paras.en: Elsa reminded him of a deer—timid and easily frightened, with large blue eyes that held pools of sadness. “So I was thinking—let’s forget the courtyard.
paras.zh: 艾莎让他想起一头鹿——胆小、容易受惊，一双蓝色的大眼睛里盛满忧伤。”所以我在想——咱们别去庭院了。

paras.en: It’s packed with people.” Hans led her down the long hall. “Let’s go somewhere quieter.
paras.zh: 那里挤满了人。“汉斯领着她沿长廊走去。”我们找个安静点的地方。

paras.en: How about the stables?
paras.zh: 去马厩怎么样？

paras.en: It’s been a while since I’ve been down there to see Sitron.” “The stables,” Elsa said slowly.
paras.zh: 我好一阵子没下去看西特隆了。“”马厩，“艾莎缓缓地说。

paras.en: She definitely seemed to like Hans’s horse, Sitron.
paras.zh: 她显然挺喜欢汉斯的马西特隆。

paras.en: He was so docile. “I think that’s a great idea.” She paused in front of the large portrait of her family that hung in the hall.
paras.zh: 那匹马太温顺了。”我觉得这主意棒极了。“她在大厅里悬挂的那幅全家画像前停下了脚步。

paras.en: Her parents looked down on her from the wall.
paras.zh: 画中她的父母正从墙上俯视着她。

paras.en: In the painting, they each had one hand on their young daughter’s shoulders.
paras.zh: 画里，他们各自将一只手搭在年幼女儿的肩上。

paras.en: She looked like she was around eight. “I used to fantasize about being an only child,” Hans admitted. “What was it really like?
paras.zh: 那时的她看起来大约八岁。”我以前常幻想自己是独生子，“汉斯坦白道。”其实那是什么感觉？

paras.en: Who did you play with on a rainy day?
paras.zh: 下雨天你和谁一起玩？

paras.en: Or cheat from on your schoolwork?
paras.zh: 又是抄谁的作业？

paras.en: Or go sledding with when it snowed?” Elsa thought for a moment. “I was quiet and always handed in my schoolwork early—and did it on my own.” He smirked. “Show-off.
paras.zh: 下雪天又和谁一起去滑雪橇？“艾莎想了想。”我很安静，作业总是早早交上去——而且都是自己做的。“他笑了笑。”显摆鬼。

paras.en: My brothers were always getting me in trouble with our governess, sending papers flying into the back of her head and blaming it on me.
paras.zh: 我那些哥哥总爱惹我们的家庭教师在气头上，把纸团飞到她后脑勺上，再推到我头上。

paras.en: Have I told you how three of them pretended I was invisible?
paras.zh: 我跟你说过吗，有三个哥哥假装我不存在？

paras.en: Literally!
paras.zh: 字面上的那种！

paras.en: For two years!” Elsa’s eyes widened. “That’s horrible!” Hans shrugged. “That’s what brothers do.” “I wouldn’t know,” Elsa said, and looked away.
paras.zh: 整整两年！“艾莎睁大了眼睛。”太可怕了！“汉斯耸耸肩。”当哥哥的就是这样。“”我可不知道，“艾莎说着，把目光移开了。

paras.en: He didn’t skip a beat. “But you must have had friends.” “My parents let me play with the staff’s children, and sometimes they’d invite dukes or nobles to come for a party and I’d play with their kids,” she explained, “but there was no one I was really close with.” She looked at him sidelong. “I have a feeling my childhood was a lot lonelier than yours.” “That very well may be, but at least you weren’t always competing for attention and trying to figure out where you belonged.” Hans paused. “Your childhood may have been lonely, but your future won’t be.
paras.zh: 他毫不迟疑地说：”可你总该有朋友吧。“”我父母让我和仆人的孩子们一起玩，有时候他们也会请公爵或贵族来开派对，我就和他们的孩子玩，“她解释道，”但真正亲近的人一个也没有。“她斜眼看着他。”我总觉得，我的童年比你的要孤独得多。“”很有可能是这样，但至少你不必总是争宠，也不用苦苦寻找自己的归属。“汉斯顿了顿。”你的童年也许孤独，但你的未来不会。

paras.en: I’m sure you’ll have a family of your own someday.” She blushed and looked away again, but he kept going. “And you’ll probably want more than one heir for the kingdom.
paras.zh: 我确信你总有一天会有自己的家庭。“她脸一红，再次把目光移开，但他继续说：”而且你大概会想要不止一个王位继承人。

paras.en: I’m surprised your parents didn’t.” “My mother couldn’t have any more children after me,” Elsa said softly. “But I’ve often wondered…No, it’s ridiculous.” “What?” he asked earnestly.
paras.zh: 我真奇怪你父母怎么没多要几个。“”我母亲生下我之后就再也怀不上孩子了，“艾莎轻声说。”但我常常在想……不，这太荒唐了。“”想什么？“他认真地问。

paras.en: It wasn’t often she opened up, but when she did, he glimpsed the princess she might have been before the tragedy.
paras.zh: 她很少敞开心扉，可一旦吐露，他便仿佛瞥见了悲剧发生前那个本该成为的公主。

paras.en: Elsa looked around sheepishly. “It’s silly.” “I like silly,” he said, and spun her around.
paras.zh: 艾莎难为情地四下看了看。”这很傻。“”我就喜欢傻乎乎的，“他说着，将她转了个圈。

paras.en: She laughed and studied his face for a moment before speaking. “I always wanted a sister,” she blurted out. “I feel bad saying that, but sometimes I’d fantasize about having a little sister.” She blushed. “I told you it was silly.” “Not silly,” he said. “It sounds like you were lonely.” He held her hand, and she looked at him in surprise. “But you don’t have to be anymore.” Elsa squeezed his hand. “I like talking to you.” “I’m glad.” Finally, he was making progress! “I’ve been searching so long for a place of my own, but with you, I think I may have found it.” Elsa opened her mouth to say something.
paras.zh: 她笑了起来，端详了片刻他的脸，才开口：”我一直想要个妹妹，“她脱口而出。”说出来有点不好意思，但有时候我会幻想有个小妹妹。“她红了脸。”我跟你说过这很傻。“”不傻，“他说。”听起来你那时候很孤独。“他握住她的手，她惊讶地望着他。”但你再也不用孤独了。“艾莎握紧了他的手。”我喜欢和你聊天。“”我很高兴。“终于，他有了进展！”我找了那么久，想找个属于自己的地方，但有了你，我想我也许找到了。“艾莎张开嘴，想说些什么。

paras.en: Down the hall, a door slammed, and Lord Peterssen emerged with the Duke of Weselton.
paras.zh: 长廊那头，一扇门砰地关上，彼得森勋爵和威斯特顿公爵一起走了出来。

paras.en: Neither saw them. “Maybe we should call the princess down to go over her coronation speech one more time,” they heard the Duke say. “It needs to be just right.” Elsa tried to back away.
paras.zh: 两人都没看见他们。”也许我们该把公主叫下来，再把加冕演说过一遍，“他们听见公爵说。”必须分毫不差才行。“艾莎想要往后退。

paras.en: He held tight and pulled her through an open door and out of sight.
paras.zh: 他紧紧拉住她，把她拽进一扇敞开的门后，避开了视线。

paras.en: The two of them broke into a run, laughing as they raced through the portrait hall and other rooms, till they made their way outside into the sun and to freedom.
paras.zh: 两人拔腿就跑，一路笑着穿过画像大厅和其他房间，直到跑出室外，奔向阳光与自由。

paras.en: When they finally reached the stables, Elsa stopped to catch her breath. “I can’t remember the last time I ran off like that!” she said, laughing. “Sometimes you need an escape,” Hans said.
paras.zh: 当他们终于跑到马厩时，艾莎停下脚步喘着气。”我都不记得上一次这样跑掉是什么时候了！“她大笑着说。”有时候你就是需要逃开一下，“汉斯说。

paras.en: It was what he had done.
paras.zh: 他就是这样做的。

paras.en: He didn’t add that part.
paras.zh: 不过那部分他没说出来。

paras.en: Elsa spread her arms wide and spun around. “It’s liberating!” He’d never seen her act that free.
paras.zh: 艾莎张开双臂转了个圈。”真自由！“他从未见她这样无拘无束过。

paras.en: He had her exactly where he wanted her.
paras.zh: 她正落在他想要她待的位置上。

paras.en: He walked to the stables and opened some of the upper doors to the barn.
paras.zh: 他走向马厩，打开了几扇畜棚上方的门。

paras.en: Horses immediately poked their heads out.
paras.zh: 马儿立刻探出头来。

paras.en: Sitron appeared, his white-and-black mane blowing softly in the wind.
paras.zh: 西特隆出现了，黑白相间的鬃毛在风中轻轻飘动。

paras.en: Hans petted his mane while Elsa stepped over to rub his dun coat.
paras.zh: 汉斯抚摸着它的鬃毛，艾莎则走上前去，揉搓它那黄褐色的皮毛。

paras.en: The two of them concentrated on the horse instead of each other.
paras.zh: 两人都把注意力放在马身上，而不是彼此。

paras.en: The stables were completely quiet. “You know, it’s crazy,” Hans said, “but I’ve never met someone who thinks so much…” “Like you?” Elsa said, looking as surprised as he was. “Yes.” Hans searched her face. “Maybe you and I were just meant…” “To be,” Elsa said, finishing his sentence for him again.
paras.zh: 马厩里静悄悄的。”你知道吗，说起来真疯狂，“汉斯说，”可我从未遇见过谁像你这样爱思考……“”像你？“艾莎说，神色和他一样惊讶。”对。“汉斯端详着她的脸。”也许你和我注定……“”注定，“艾莎替他把话说完。

paras.en: They both started to laugh.
paras.zh: 两人都笑了起来。

paras.en: Maybe an official courting was even closer than he thought. “The Duke would be thrilled,” Elsa said wryly.
paras.zh: 也许正式的求爱比他想的还要近。”公爵准会乐坏了，“艾莎挖苦地说。

paras.en: She had the man pegged. “So would Lord Peterssen,” Hans said, brushing Sitron’s side with his hand. “I’ve heard them talking.
paras.zh: 她可把那人看透了。”彼得森勋爵也是，“汉斯说着，用手轻轻拂过西特隆的身侧。”我听见他们聊过。

paras.en: They think we’re a strong match.” To lead this kingdom.
paras.zh: 他们认为我们是很般配的一对。“为了治理这个王国。

paras.en: He snuck a glance at her.
paras.zh: 他偷偷瞥了她一眼。

paras.en: Elsa’s face was hard to read. “Do they?” You know they do, he wanted to say, but he stayed patient.
paras.zh: 艾莎的脸叫人捉摸不透。”是吗？“你明明知道他们是这么想的，他本想这样说，但还是耐着性子。

paras.en: He’d gotten that far.
paras.zh: 能走到这一步已经不错了。

paras.en: He was much closer than he had been even a week before. “But it doesn’t matter what they think.
paras.zh: 他比一周前还要接近目标了。”不过他们怎么想并不重要。

paras.en: It matters what we think.” He glanced her way again. “Exactly.
paras.zh: 重要的是我们怎么想。“他又朝她看了一眼。”正是。

paras.en: I like how we are right now at this very moment.” Hans tried not to look disappointed. “Me too.” The Duke wanted a proposal to come before the coronation, but Hans knew that might be tricky.
paras.zh: 我喜欢此刻我们之间的样子。“汉斯努力不让自己显得失望。”我也是。“公爵想在加冕之前就订婚，可汉斯知道那也许有些棘手。

paras.en: An engagement didn’t have to come that day.
paras.zh: 订婚不必非得定在那天。

paras.en: Or the next.
paras.zh: 也不必是第二天。

paras.en: Hans knew in his heart that they were going to rule Arendelle together soon enough.
paras.zh: 汉斯打心底里明白，他们很快就会一起统治阿伦黛尔。

paras.en: If Elsa was smart, she’d let him take the lead.
paras.zh: 如果艾莎聪明，就该让他来掌舵。

paras.en: And if she didn’t…well, accidents happened.
paras.zh: 而要是她不答应……嗯，意外总会发生。

paras.en: All Arendelle would need to survive was their new king.
paras.zh: 阿伦黛尔要活下去，只需要他们的新国王。

paras.en: This was it!
paras.zh: 就是今天了！

paras.en: It was finally the day!
paras.zh: 终于等到这一天了！

paras.en: Anna stared at the big red circle she’d placed on the calendar and tried not to scream with excitement.
paras.zh: 安娜盯着日历上自己画的大红圈，拼命忍着不让自己兴奋地尖叫出来。

paras.en: She grabbed a pillow from her bed and squealed into it quietly instead.
paras.zh: 她从床上抓过一个枕头，把脸埋进去，小声地尖叫。

paras.en: She’d been waiting for this day for three years!
paras.zh: 她等这一天已经等了三年了！

paras.en: Three years of planning, counting down, and dreaming.
paras.zh: 三年里，她一直在计划、倒数、做着美梦。

paras.en: Three years to figure out exactly what she was going to say to her parents.
paras.zh: 三年里，她一直在琢磨到底要对父母说些什么。

paras.en: And in three years, she still hadn’t figured out the right words to tell them her plan.
paras.zh: 可三年过去了，她还是没想好该用什么话告诉他们自己的计划。

paras.en: Ma, Papa, I’m eighteen now, Anna rehearsed for the billionth time in her head.
paras.zh: 妈妈，爸爸，我现在十八岁了——安娜在心里第无数次排练着。

paras.en: I’m all grown up, and it’s time I started my life, which is why I’m…I’m… This was always the part that gave her pause.
paras.zh: 我已经长大了，是时候开启自己的生活了，所以我要……我要……每到这儿，她总是卡住。

paras.en: Every time she thought about telling her parents she was leaving Harmon, she got a massive stomachache.
paras.zh: 每次一想到要告诉父母自己要离开哈蒙，她就胃疼得厉害。

paras.en: These were her parents.
paras.zh: 他们是她的父母。

paras.en: They’d taken her in as a baby, loved her, and cared for her.
paras.zh: 他们把她当婴儿收养，爱她、照顾她。

paras.en: She didn’t want to hurt them.
paras.zh: 她不想伤害他们。

paras.en: I wish Freya were here.
paras.zh: 真希望弗蕾娅在这儿。

paras.en: That thought popped into her head a lot.
paras.zh: 这个念头常常冒进她的脑海。

paras.en: Even though it had been three years since Freya had been lost at sea with the king and queen, Anna still thought about her every day.
paras.zh: 尽管弗蕾娅随国王和王后一起葬身大海已经三年了，安娜仍每天都想起她。

paras.en: If anyone could have convinced Anna’s mother that Arendelle was a wonderful place to start a life, it was her.
paras.zh: 要说有谁能说服安娜的母亲，让她相信阿伦黛尔是个开始生活的好地方，那一定是弗蕾娅。

paras.en: And Anna’s mother would have been relieved to know Anna had people like family watching over her nearby.
paras.zh: 而安娜的母亲若是知道，有亲如家人般的人在附近照看着安娜，也会松一口气。

paras.en: But Freya was gone.
paras.zh: 但弗蕾娅已经不在了。

paras.en: Anna had to do this on her own.
paras.zh: 安娜只能靠自己去做这件事。

paras.en: The pink room she had adored for so long felt like a child’s now, but she still loved every inch of the space, especially her window seat, with its view of life at the bottom of the mountain.
paras.zh: 那间她钟爱了许久的粉色房间，如今感觉像是小孩子住的，但她仍爱这空间的每一寸，尤其是她的窗边座——从那儿能望见山脚下的人间烟火。

paras.en: Arendelle seemed so close and yet so far away.
paras.zh: 阿伦黛尔似乎近在咫尺，却又遥不可及。

paras.en: Anna touched one of the wooden castle spires on the model her father had made her long before.
paras.zh: 安娜摸了摸父亲很久以前为她做的城堡模型上的一座木制尖塔。

paras.en: Tears sprang to her eyes.
paras.zh: 泪水涌上了她的眼眶。

paras.en: Her parents loved her so much.
paras.zh: 她的父母是那么爱她。

paras.en: How would she tell them without breaking their hearts?
paras.zh: 她该怎么告诉他们，才不至于伤透他们的心？

paras.en: With food!
paras.zh: 用吃的！

paras.en: Of course!
paras.zh: 当然啦！

paras.en: She’d bake them the most perfect dessert she could.
paras.zh: 她要给他们烤出自己能做的最完美的甜点。

paras.en: Something they didn’t make in the bakery every day.
paras.zh: 做点他们面包店平时不常做的东西。

paras.en: They’d be so happy with her creation, and their stomachs so satisfied, that they’d have to hear her out about Arendelle.
paras.zh: 他们吃到她的作品准会满心欢喜，肚子也填得舒坦，到时就不得不听她说说阿伦黛尔的事。

paras.en: And she knew just the thing to bake: carrot cake!
paras.zh: 而她知道该烤什么：胡萝卜蛋糕！

paras.en: She’d made carrot cake for Papa once before, and he had loved it so much he had eaten it every day for a week.
paras.zh: 她以前给爸爸做过一次胡萝卜蛋糕，他喜欢极了，整整一个星期每天都吃。

paras.en: Ma had complained he was having too much sugar, and he had said, “I own a bakery!
paras.zh: 妈妈抱怨他糖吃得太多，他却说：“我开面包店的！

paras.en: Of course I eat too much sugar!” And they all laughed and agreed that carrot cake was the best thing Anna had ever made.
paras.zh: 吃多点糖不是理所当然嘛！”大家都笑起来，一致公认胡萝卜蛋糕是安娜做过最好吃的东西。

paras.en: That was the cake she needed to make them agree to her plan.
paras.zh: 要让他们同意她的计划，就得靠这块蛋糕。

paras.en: She looked at the clock.
paras.zh: 她看了看钟。

paras.en: After baking all morning, her parents were likely on their break, relaxing in the parlor.
paras.zh: 烤了一上午的面包后，父母大概正在休息，在客厅里放松。

paras.en: Papa might even be taking a nap.
paras.zh: 爸爸说不定还在打盹。

paras.en: She’d slip out unnoticed and return fast to get to work.
paras.zh: 她要趁人不注意溜出去，再快点回来动手做。

paras.en: The cake would be ready in time for supper.
paras.zh: 蛋糕赶得上晚饭时做好。

paras.en: They could even have cake for supper!
paras.zh: 他们晚饭甚至可以吃蛋糕！

paras.en: She’d always wanted to try that.
paras.zh: 她一直想试试这样呢。

paras.en: Anna headed out the door, the heat of summer blasting her in the face.
paras.zh: 安娜走出门，夏日的闷热扑面而来。

paras.en: What ingredients do I need?
paras.zh: 我需要哪些材料？

paras.en: I have everything but carrots, right?
paras.zh: 除了胡萝卜，别的都有，对吧？

paras.en: We own a bakery, she reminded herself, not watching where she was going.
paras.zh: 我们家开面包店的嘛——她这样提醒自己，压根没看路。

paras.en: What else could I possibly—WHOA!
paras.zh: 我还能缺什么——哇！

paras.en: She ran smack into a young man holding a giant block of ice.
paras.zh: 她一头撞上了一个抱着一大块冰的年轻人。

paras.en: The impact sent the ice flying.
paras.zh: 撞击让那块冰飞了出去。

paras.en: The block smashed to the ground, breaking into a million pieces in front of the market. “Hey!” the stranger barked. “You’re going to need to pay for—” He spun around and looked at her in surprise. “Oh.” His eyes widened, and he stepped back. “It’s you.” “You mean it’s you !” Anna was equally surprised.
paras.zh: 冰块砸在地上，在集市前摔成了无数碎片。“嘿！”陌生人吼道。“你得赔——”他转过身，惊讶地看着她。“哦。”他瞪大了眼睛，后退一步。“是你。”“该说'是你'的是我吧！”安娜同样惊讶。

paras.en: She remembered him from years before.
paras.zh: 她记起了几年前见过的他。

paras.en: She had looked for him several times but had never seen him again. “You’re the boy who talks to his reindeer.” As if on cue, the reindeer walked into view, nudging the stranger in the back. “Not a boy, first of all.
paras.zh: 她找过他好几次，却再没见过他。“你就是那个跟驯鹿说话的男孩。”仿佛听到了暗号，那头驯鹿走进视野，用脑袋顶了顶陌生人的后背。“首先，我不是男孩。

paras.en: And I talk for my reindeer,” he said. “His name is Sven.
paras.zh: 而且我是替我的驯鹿说话，”他说。“他叫斯文。

paras.en: He wanted carrots, but now that you broke my ice delivery, he won’t get any.” The reindeer snorted.
paras.zh: 他本来想要胡萝卜，可你把我送的冰砸了，他现在一根也吃不上了。”驯鹿打了个响鼻。

paras.en: He turned to the animal. “I’m not being rude,” he whispered gruffly. “She broke the ice.
paras.zh: 他转向那头动物。“我不是没礼貌，”他粗声粗气地小声说。“是她把冰砸了。

paras.en: Now we don’t get carrots.” The reindeer snorted louder. “Fine!” He spun around again. “Sven said I’m barking at you.” Kristoff looked at his feet. “So sorry…even though it was your fault.” “It was an accident,” Anna said.
paras.zh: 现在咱们没胡萝卜了。”驯鹿喷得更响。“行吧！”他又转回身。“斯文说我是在冲你发火。”克里斯托夫低头看着自己的脚。“太对不起了……虽然这确实是你的错。”“这是个意外，”安娜说。

paras.en: She couldn’t help noticing the way his shaggy blond hair fell in front of his brown eyes.
paras.zh: 她忍不住注意到，他那乱蓬蓬的金发垂在棕色眼睛前。

paras.en: The two of them stared at each other for a moment.
paras.zh: 两人对视了片刻。

paras.en: Then they both looked away. “I’ll pay you in cookies if you want,” she offered. “I make the best ones in the village.” The reindeer started to prance. “You make the only ones in the village,” the young man deadpanned. “How would you know?” Anna replied. “Did you ask about me?” He pulled his wool cap down on his head. “No.
paras.zh: 然后两人都移开目光。“要是你愿意，我用饼干赔你，”她提议。“我做的饼干是村里最好吃的。”驯鹿开始欢快地蹦跳。“你做的是村里唯一能吃的饼干，”年轻人面无表情地说。“你怎么知道？”安娜回嘴。“你打听过我？”他把羊毛帽往下拉了拉。“没有。

paras.en: Maybe.” She flushed. “I’m Anna.
paras.zh: 也许吧。”她脸一红。“我是安娜。

paras.en: My parents own Tomally’s Baked Goods.
paras.zh: 我父母经营托马利烘焙坊。

paras.en: What’s your name?” “Kristoff,” he said, then turned to his reindeer. “Sven, we need to go get more ice before—” At that moment, Goran emerged from the market, saw the ice on the ground, and placed his hands on his head. “No!
paras.zh: 你叫什么名字？”“克里斯托夫，”他说，随即转向他的驯鹿。“斯文，咱们得去多弄点冰，趁——”就在这时，戈兰从集市里走出来，看见地上的冰，双手抱住了头。“不！

paras.en: I’ve been waiting for this delivery all morning!” Anna winced.
paras.zh: 我整个上午都在等这批货！”安娜缩了缩脖子。

paras.en: Goran had run the market as long as she could remember.
paras.zh: 打她记事起，戈兰就经营着这个集市。

paras.en: Her parents had always been thankful that he was agreeable to bartering goods.
paras.zh: 父母一直很感激他乐意以物易物。

paras.en: A well-timed cinnamon roll had won her favor sometimes when she forgot money for groceries. “I’m sorry.
paras.zh: 有几次她忘带买菜的钱，一块及时送上的肉桂卷就帮她解了围。“对不起。

paras.en: It was out of my control.” Kristoff side-eyed Anna. “I can get you more, but it will take a few hours.” “A few hours?
paras.zh: 这不在我的掌控之中。”克里斯托夫斜眼瞥了安娜一眼。“我可以再去给你弄，但要花几个小时。”“几个小时？

paras.en: I needed this ice now to keep my groceries cool in this heat!” Goran complained. “I can get it to you this afternoon,” Kristoff promised, “but if I could get the supplies I need now, I can get it faster.
paras.zh: 我现在就需要这冰，好让我的货在这大热天里保鲜！”戈兰抱怨道。“今天下午我就能送来，”克里斯托夫保证，“但如果我现在能拿到需要的工具，就能更快。

paras.en: My ice ax is pretty dull.
paras.zh: 我的冰镐够钝的了。

paras.en: And Sven is out of carrots.” The reindeer snorted.
paras.zh: 而且斯文也没有胡萝卜了。”驯鹿打了个响鼻。

paras.en: Goran folded his arms across his chest. “No ice, no trade.” “But you’ve done it before,” Kristoff reminded him, getting annoyed. “Help me out!” “Not today!” Goran folded his arms across his chest. “I needed that ice now.” “Goran, maybe I can help.
paras.zh: 戈兰双臂交叉抱在胸前。“没冰，就不换。”“可你以前就这么做过，”克里斯托夫有点恼火地提醒他。“帮帮我！”“今天不行！”戈兰抱紧双臂。“我现在就要那块冰。”“戈兰，也许我能帮忙。

paras.en: How about some cinnamon—” Anna started, but Kristoff stared her down. “Back up while I deal with this crook here.” Goran narrowed his eyes and stood up straighter.
paras.zh: 来点肉桂卷怎么样——”安娜刚开口，克里斯托夫却瞪着她。“退后，这儿交给我对付这个骗子。”戈兰眯起眼睛，站直了身子。

paras.en: Anna had never noticed how tall he was.
paras.zh: 安娜从没注意过他这么高。

paras.en: He was bigger than Kristoff. “What did you call me?” Kristoff stood nose to nose with him. “I said—” Anna jumped between them. “Okay, I think this is my fault!
paras.zh: 他比克里斯托夫还壮。“你叫我什么？”克里斯托夫和他鼻尖对着鼻尖。“我说——”安娜跳到两人中间。“好了，我想这都怪我！

paras.en: You need ice, he needs an ice ax to get the ice.
paras.zh: 你要冰，他要冰镐才能弄到冰。

paras.en: Can’t we come to some sort of arrangement?” “I don’t need your help,” Kristoff said. “Actually, you do,” Goran growled. “Goran, put the carrots and ice ax on my tab,” Anna insisted. “I’ll be back with some cinnamon rolls to keep you happy, and then Kristoff will return with ice before you know it.” Anna looked from one man to the other. “All right with everyone?” Goran silently handed Anna the carrots, then went inside the market to retrieve the ice ax.
paras.zh: 我们就不能达成什么协议吗？”“我不需要你帮忙，”克里斯托夫说。“其实你需要，”戈兰低吼。“戈兰，把胡萝卜和冰镐记在我账上，”安娜坚持道。“我等会儿就带些肉桂卷来哄你开心，然后克里斯托夫眨眼工夫就能把冰送回来。”安娜看看这个，又看看那个。“大家都没意见吧？”戈兰一言不发地把胡萝卜递给安娜，然后进集市里去取冰镐。

paras.en: Anna smiled at Kristoff, feeling pleased, but he didn’t share her joy. “I don’t do handouts,” he said. “Who said it’s a handout?
paras.zh: 安娜朝克里斯托夫笑了笑，心里挺得意，可他并不领情。“我不接受施舍，”他说。“谁说是施舍了？

paras.en: You’ll pay Goran back, and if you want to pay me in ice, too, now you know where to find me.” She divided the bunch of carrots in half, handed Kristoff some, and patted the reindeer on the head. “Bye, Sven!” Anna practically skipped down the street back home.
paras.zh: 你会还戈兰钱的，要是也想用冰还我，那你现在知道上哪儿找我了。”她把那把胡萝卜分成两半，递给克里斯托夫一些，又拍了拍驯鹿的头。“再见，斯文！”安娜几乎是蹦跳着沿街跑回家的。

paras.en: She had a feeling she’d see Kristoff again.
paras.zh: 她有种预感，还会再见到克里斯托夫。

paras.en: But first she needed to bake.
paras.zh: 但首先她得去烤蛋糕。

paras.en: The quicker it was finished, the quicker she could finally get this conversation over with.
paras.zh: 烤得越快，她就能越早把这场谈话了结。

paras.en: She was ticking off bakery measurements in her head when her parents walked into the room talking. “Nothing has changed, Johan.
paras.zh: 她正心里默数着烘焙的用量，父母一边聊着走进了房间。“什么都没变，约翰。

paras.en: It’s been three years!
paras.zh: 都三年了！

paras.en: Maybe nothing ever will.
paras.zh: 也许永远都不会变。

paras.en: She has the right to know the truth,” Ma was saying. “Who has the right to know the truth?” Anna asked as she gathered several bowls and large spoons. “And you’re supposed to be resting!
paras.zh: 她有权知道真相，”妈妈正在说。“谁有权知道真相？”安娜一边收拾几个碗和大勺子，一边问道。“而且你该在休息的！

paras.en: Now you’ve ruined my surprise!” Anna was trying to be funny, but her parents looked uneasy. “What’s going on?
paras.zh: 现在你把我的惊喜给毁了！”安娜想开个玩笑，可父母神色不安。“怎么回事？

paras.en: Is this about me?” Papa and Ma glanced at each other.
paras.zh: 是关于我的事吗？”爸爸和妈妈对视了一眼。

paras.en: Papa looked uncomfortable. “We don’t really know how to tell you this, Anna Bear, without possibly betraying our closest friend.” Closest friend?
paras.zh: 爸爸显得有些不自在。“安娜宝贝，我们实在不知道该怎么告诉你这件事，又可能不辜负我们最亲密的朋友。”最亲密的朋友？

paras.en: Betrayal? “Is this about Freya?” Anna asked.
paras.zh: 背叛？“这事和弗蕾娅有关？”安娜问。

paras.en: Ma nodded. “She’s my oldest and dearest friend—she always will be.” “Of course she is,” Anna said.
paras.zh: 妈妈点点头。“她是我最久、最亲爱的朋友——永远都是。”“她当然是，”安娜说。

paras.en: Her mother had never really gotten over Freya’s death, and neither had she. “I think about her all the time, too.” “You do?” Papa asked. “Of course.
paras.zh: 母亲始终没能真正从弗蕾娅的死里走出来，她也一样。“我也一直惦记着她。”“是吗？”爸爸问。“当然。

paras.en: It’s kind of why I wanted to make you this carrot cake today.
paras.zh: 这也算我今天想给你们做这块胡萝卜蛋糕的原因之一。

paras.en: I have something to tell you, as well, but now that you’re talking about betrayal I’m getting worried.” Ma reached for her arm. “We don’t mean to alarm you.
paras.zh: 我也有件事要告诉你们，可你们一说背叛，我就开始担心了。”妈妈伸手握住她的胳膊。“我们不是想吓你。

paras.en: Your papa and I have just been discussing something—” “For the past three years,” Papa said under his breath. “And we don’t want to keep you in the dark anymore,” Ma added. “But the situation is complicated.” “We made a promise to Freya,” Papa said. “But we also don’t want you spending your whole life not knowing the truth.” Anna’s eyes widened. “So this is about me…and Freya?” Papa sounded like he was having trouble breathing. “Yes and no.” They were truly scaring her. “What is going on?” “I knew her a lot longer than you did, Johan,” Ma told him. “If this curse never lifts, she—” “Curse?” Anna’s arm slipped and she knocked a bowl off the table.
paras.zh: 你爸爸和我刚在商量一件事——”“商量了整整三年了，”爸爸低声嘟囔。“我们也不想再瞒着你了，”妈妈补充道。“但情况很复杂。”“我们向弗蕾娅许过诺言，”爸爸说。“可我们也不想让你一辈子都不知道真相。”安娜瞪大了眼睛。“所以这事是关于我……和弗蕾娅？”爸爸听起来呼吸都困难了。“是，也不是。”他们真把她吓到了。“到底怎么回事？”“我认识她可比你久多了，约翰，”妈妈对他说。“要是这个诅咒永远解不开，她——”“诅咒？”安娜手臂一滑，把桌上的碗撞了下去。

paras.en: It shattered.
paras.zh: 碗摔碎了。

paras.en: Papa grabbed the broom from the hook on the wall and began sweeping it up. “I’m sorry!
paras.zh: 爸爸从墙上的挂钩取下扫帚，开始清扫。“对不起！

paras.en: I thought there was no such thing as curses…is there?” Ma hesitated and looked at Papa. “I don’t mean curse, exactly.
paras.zh: 我以为这世上没有诅咒这种东西……有吗？”妈妈犹豫了一下，看了看爸爸。“确切地说，我不是指诅咒。

paras.en: It’s just a word.” “A word for something made up,” Anna clarified.
paras.zh: 那只是个词。”“一个用来形容编出来的东西的词，”安娜澄清道。

paras.en: Ma didn’t answer her. “Johan, if things don’t change, she will live her whole life not knowing she has another family out there.” Papa stopped sweeping. “ We’re her family, Tomally,” he said softly. “What good would telling her do?
paras.zh: 妈妈没有回答她。“约翰，要是事情不改变，她这辈子都不会知道自己在外面还有另一个家。”爸爸停下了清扫。“我们就是她的家人，托马利，”他轻声说。“告诉她有什么用？

paras.en: She can’t change things.
paras.zh: 她改变不了什么。

paras.en: Who would even believe her?” Ma’s eyes filled with tears. “You’re right.
paras.zh: 又有谁会相信她呢？”妈妈的眼里盈满泪水。“你说得对。

paras.en: I don’t want to put our daughter in harm’s way, but I also don’t want to carry this secret to my grave.” Their conversation wasn’t making sense to her. “Is this about my birth parents?” The frown lines on her mother’s forehead deepened. “Well, yes…” “Did Freya know them?” Anna asked.
paras.zh: 我不想让女儿身处险境，可我也不想把秘密带进坟墓。”他们的对话让她摸不着头脑。“这是关于我的亲生父母吗？”妈妈额上的皱纹更深了。“嗯，是……”“弗蕾娅认识他们吗？”安娜问。

paras.en: She’d always wondered.
paras.zh: 她一直想知道。

paras.en: Freya had been such a big part of her life since the beginning.
paras.zh: 从一开始，弗蕾娅就在她生命中占了那么重的分量。

paras.en: Maybe Freya had known something Anna didn’t.
paras.zh: 也许弗蕾娅知道一些安娜不知道的事。

paras.en: Silence hung over the room as they stared at one another. “It’s okay,” Anna finally said. “If you know who they are and don’t want to tell me, I’ll understand.
paras.zh: 三人互相望着，屋里一片沉默。“没关系的，”安娜终于开口。“如果你们知道他们是谁却不想告诉我，我能理解。

paras.en: It doesn’t matter anyway.” She reached for their hands. “You’ve been the best parents anyone could ever hope for.” Papa and Ma reached in for a hug at the same time.
paras.zh: 反正也没什么要紧。”她伸手握住他们的手。“你们已经是任何人能盼望的最好父母了。”爸爸和妈妈同时伸出手，给了她一个拥抱。

paras.en: They were a family of huggers and laughers.
paras.zh: 他们一家人就爱拥抱，爱欢笑。

paras.en: Anna clung to them, not wanting to let go.
paras.zh: 安娜紧紧抱着他们，舍不得松手。

paras.en: Papa looked at her with tears in his eyes as well. “Anna Bear, these aren’t our secrets to tell.
paras.zh: 爸爸眼里也含着泪。“安娜宝贝，这些秘密不是我们的，不能由我们来说。

paras.en: We hope you can respect that.” “I can, but I do have a secret of my own that I wanted to share with you.” Her cake wasn’t ready, but since they were sharing, it was the perfect time to tell them. “And it has to do with Freya, too.” Ma looked rattled. “It isn’t…Do you know…” Anna could feel her heart thumping.
paras.zh: 希望你能体谅。”“我能，不过我自己也有个秘密想和你们分享。”蛋糕还没做好，但既然大家在交心，正是告诉他们的最好时机。“而且这也和弗蕾娅有关。”妈妈显得有些慌乱。“你该不会……难道你知道……”安娜能感觉到自己的心怦怦直跳。

paras.en: Her lips were suddenly dry, but she couldn’t stop now.
paras.zh: 她的嘴唇突然发干，可现在她停不下来了。

paras.en: She thought of how Freya had always said Be true to yourself.
paras.zh: 她想起弗蕾娅常说的一句话：做真实的自己。

paras.en: This was her being true. “I want to move to Arendelle.” Her parents stood perfectly still.
paras.zh: 这就是真实的她。“我想搬到阿伦黛尔去。”父母僵立在原地。

paras.en: Anna kept going. “You both know I’ve wanted to live in Arendelle for as long as I can remember.
paras.zh: 安娜继续说。“你们都知道，从我记事起就想住在阿伦黛尔。

paras.en: I love Harmon, but it feels like there is a whole big world out there that I’m missing out on.
paras.zh: 我爱哈蒙，可总觉得外面还有一个大大的世界，而我正在错过它。

paras.en: A world at the bottom of this mountain.” Anna pointed to the window where Arendelle was visible. “I promise I’m not moving there without a plan.
paras.zh: 一个在山脚下的世界。”安娜指向窗外看得见阿伦黛尔的地方。“我保证，不会毫无计划就搬过去。

paras.en: I’m going to open my own bakery when I make enough money, and until I do, I’ll work in a bakery near the castle.
paras.zh: 等我攒够钱，就开一家自己的面包店；在那之前，我会先在城堡附近的面包店工作。

paras.en: Freya always said there were several.
paras.zh: 弗蕾娅总说那儿有好几家。

paras.en: Several!
paras.zh: 好几家呢！

paras.en: Not just one, like we have here.” Her parents still appeared tongue-tied. “I know I’ll be far away, but I’ll visit, and you can visit, too.” They hadn’t interrupted her yet, so she kept going. “I’m eighteen and it’s time I started my own life.
paras.zh: 不像咱们这儿只有一家。”父母还是张口结舌。“我知道我会离得远，但我会回来探望，你们也可以来看我。”他们还没打断她，于是她继续说。“我十八岁了，是时候开启自己的生活了。

paras.en: Freya always talked about how much I’d like Arendelle, and I know she was right.” Her mother nodded knowingly, filling Anna with hope. “I think you are too young,” Papa blurted out. “I’m eighteen,” Anna whispered. “Johan,” her mother started.
paras.zh: 弗蕾娅总说我会多喜欢阿伦黛尔，我知道她没错。”母亲会意地点头，让安娜心中升起希望。“我觉得你还太年轻，”爸爸脱口而出。“我十八了，”安娜小声说。“约翰，”母亲开口了。

paras.en: He shook his head. “Tomally, you know I’m right.
paras.zh: 他摇摇头。“托马利，你明知道我是对的。

paras.en: A woman is of age at twenty-one.
paras.zh: 女子要满二十一岁才算成年。

paras.en: I’m sorry, Anna, but you are not ready.
paras.zh: 对不起，安娜，可你还没准备好。

paras.en: It isn’t…safe.” He looked at Ma. “Arendelle isn’t the right place for you right now.
paras.zh: 这……不安全。”他看着妈妈。“现在阿伦黛尔不是适合你的地方。

paras.en: We need you here.” “Ma?” Anna said, but Ma shook her head. “Papa is right,” Ma said. “We are getting older, Anna Bear, and this bakery is a lot for us to handle.
paras.zh: 我们需要你留在这儿。”“妈妈？”安娜说，可妈妈摇了摇头。“爸爸说得对，”妈妈说。“我们老了，安娜宝贝，这家面包店对我们来说操劳太大。

paras.en: It was always our dream that someday you would run it.” The idea touched Anna greatly.
paras.zh: 我们一直梦想着，有一天由你来经营它。”这个念头深深触动了安娜。

paras.en: She knew her parents were tired of being up before dawn and baking all day.
paras.zh: 她知道父母厌倦了天不亮就起床、整日烘烤。

paras.en: But staying in Harmon forever wasn’t what she wanted.
paras.zh: 但她并不想永远留在哈蒙。

paras.en: She could feel it in her bones and see it in her dreams—dreams full of snow and voices.
paras.zh: 她骨子里能感觉到，也在梦里见过——那些梦满是雪和声音。

paras.en: Sometimes it felt as if someone was looking for her.
paras.zh: 有时感觉仿佛有人在寻找她。

paras.en: But that was silly. “You know I love this shop, and I love being with you, but I’ve always dreamt of living in Arendelle,” Anna told them gently. “I feel like I’m meant for something bigger.
paras.zh: 但那就太傻了。“你知道我爱这家店，也爱跟你们在一起，可我一直梦想着住在阿伦黛尔，”安娜温柔地对他们说。“我觉得自己注定要做些更了不起的事。

paras.en: Life is short.
paras.zh: 生命短暂。

paras.en: Losing Freya taught me that.
paras.zh: 失去弗蕾娅让我明白了这一点。

paras.en: I don’t want to wait another day to start my life.” Ma and Papa kept looking at each other. “She isn’t ready,” Papa said firmly to Ma. “It isn’t safe.…” “I know.” Ma looked at Anna. “We want you to have the life you dream of—a life in Arendelle—and you will have it.
paras.zh: 我不想再多等一天才开启生活。”妈妈和爸爸仍在彼此对望。“她还没准备好，”爸爸对妈妈坚定地说。“这不安全……”“我知道。”妈妈看着安娜。“我们希望你拥有梦想中的生活——一种在阿伦黛尔的生活——而你终会拥有的。

paras.en: I know it in my heart just as you do, Anna Bear.” She squeezed her hand. “It just isn’t your time yet.
paras.zh: 我和你一样，心里清楚这一点，安娜宝贝。”她握紧安娜的手。“只是现在还不是你的时机。

paras.en: Trust us.” “I understand,” Anna said, but she truly didn’t.
paras.zh: 相信我们。”“我明白，”安娜说，可她其实并不明白。

paras.en: She blinked back tears and held her tongue.
paras.zh: 她眨掉眼泪，把话咽了回去。

paras.en: She never disobeyed her parents, and she wasn’t about to now, but three years felt like a long time to wait.
paras.zh: 她从不违抗父母，现在也不打算违抗，可三年，要等这么久啊。

paras.en: I wish I had the power to stop time, Elsa thought as she stood at her bedroom window, watching people flood into the castle courtyard toward her family’s bronze statue.
paras.zh: 要是我有让时间停下的力量就好了——艾莎站在卧室窗前，看着人群涌进城堡庭院，朝她家的青铜雕像走去，心里这样想着。

paras.en: The gates were open and the chapel was prepped.
paras.zh: 大门敞开，小教堂也已布置妥当。

paras.en: The choir she’d heard practicing for days was ready to perform.
paras.zh: 她听了几天的唱诗班已经准备就绪，可以献唱了。

paras.en: But the time for her own rehearsals was over.
paras.zh: 但属于她自己的“彩排”时间已经结束。

paras.en: She should stop worrying, but she knew she couldn’t.
paras.zh: 她该停止担忧，可她知道自己做不到。

paras.en: Time seemed like it was roaring ahead, and Elsa couldn’t slow it down.
paras.zh: 时间仿佛在咆哮着向前奔涌，艾莎无法让它慢下来。

paras.en: She had already gotten dressed with Gerda’s help.
paras.zh: 她已经在格尔达的帮助下穿好了礼服。

paras.en: Her gown was beautiful, but it wasn’t designed for comfort.
paras.zh: 她的礼服很美，却不是为了舒适而设计的。

paras.en: And it wasn’t created with her in mind.
paras.zh: 而且设计时也没考虑她本人。

paras.en: It almost felt as if she were a doll playing dress up, living in someone else’s body.
paras.zh: 她几乎觉得自己像个玩换装游戏的人偶，活在别人的躯壳里。

paras.en: But she kept reminding herself the dress only had to be worn for a few hours.
paras.zh: 但她不断提醒自己，这身礼服只要穿几个小时就好。

paras.en: She could manage until then.
paras.zh: 在那之前她能撑住。

paras.en: There was nothing left to do but wait to be called.
paras.zh: 除了等被人来唤，已无事可做。

paras.en: I wish I could stop time, Elsa wished again, but she knew it wasn’t possible.
paras.zh: 要是我能让时间停下就好了——艾莎再次许愿，可她知道那不可能。

paras.en: Being with Hans the other day had put her mind at ease, but standing in her room again, she couldn’t escape her thoughts.
paras.zh: 前些天和汉斯在一起曾让她安心，可重新站在自己房间里，她又逃不开那些念头。

paras.en: Papa and Mama, I wish you were standing here beside me.
paras.zh: 爸爸、妈妈，真希望你们就站在我身边。

paras.en: I can’t do this alone.
paras.zh: 我一个人做不了这件事。

paras.en: Elsa heard grunting and turned around.
paras.zh: 艾莎听见一阵哼哧声，转过身。

paras.en: Olaf was trying to move her hope chest and failing. “Olaf!” Elsa hurried over. “What are you doing?” “Looking for Anna,” he explained. “She should be here for this.” Elsa leaned down, her sadness almost overwhelming her. “We don’t even know who Anna is.” “I know she’d want to see you, though!” the snowman said brightly. “Maybe she’s in this hope chest.
paras.zh: 雪宝正试着搬动她的珍宝箱，却搬不动。“雪宝！”艾莎急忙过去。“你在干什么？”“找安娜，”他解释说。“这种场合她该在的。”艾莎俯下身，悲伤几乎将她淹没。“我们甚至都不知道安娜是谁。”“可我知道她一定想见你！”雪人欢快地说。“也许她在这只箱子里。

paras.en: She loved to hide in here.” Elsa was about to ask Olaf what he meant when she heard the knock at her door.
paras.zh: 她最爱躲在这儿。”艾莎正要问雪宝这是什么意思，就听见敲门声。

paras.en: The time had come.
paras.zh: 时候到了。

paras.en: Olaf reached out to hug her. “Good luck!” He ran to hide behind her bed. “I’ll be waiting when you get back.” Elsa opened the door.
paras.zh: 雪宝伸出手抱了抱她。“祝你好运！”他跑去向床后躲去。“你回来时我在这儿等你。”艾莎打开门。

paras.en: Hans was waiting in a white dress uniform. “Princess,” he said with a smile, and held out his arm, “are you ready to be escorted to the chapel?” No, she wanted to say, but she was happy to see him standing there.
paras.zh: 汉斯穿着白色礼服制服等在门外。“公主，”他微笑着伸出手臂，“准备好让我护送你去小教堂了吗？”不想去，她本想这样说，可看到他站在那儿，她又很高兴。

paras.en: Hans was so thoughtful.
paras.zh: 汉斯真体贴。

paras.en: He had offered to escort her to the ceremony, and she had agreed, knowing his presence was calming. “Ah, look at this!” said the Duke, appearing out of nowhere. “The very picture of young love.” The Duke, on the other hand, was not calming.
paras.zh: 他主动提出要护送她去典礼，她也答应了，知道有他在能让人安心。“啊，瞧瞧这一幕！”公爵不知从哪儿冒了出来。“真是一幅青春爱恋的画。”而公爵，可一点都让人安心不了。

paras.en: What was he doing there?
paras.zh: 他在这儿干什么？

paras.en: He adjusted his wire-rimmed glasses and looked up at them over the edge of his ample nose.
paras.zh: 他扶了扶金丝眼镜，从那硕大的鼻梁上方抬眼打量他们。

paras.en: He had slicked his white hair back for the occasion and was in full military dress, with a gold sash and medals swinging from his jacket. “What a fine day this will be for the two of you!” Lord Peterssen rushed down the hall toward them. “I believe the future queen decided Prince Hans would be escorting her to the ceremony.” Then he motioned to the Duke. “Why don’t I take you down and help you find a seat near the front?” Thank goodness for Lord Peterssen!
paras.zh: 他为了这场合把白发梳得服帖，一身全套军礼服，金绶带和奖章在胸前晃荡。“对你们两位来说，今天会是多美好的一天啊！”彼得森勋爵沿着长廊朝他们奔来。“我想，未来的女王已经决定由汉斯王子护送她去典礼了。”接着他向公爵示意。“不如我带您下去，帮您在前面找个座位？”谢天谢地有彼得森勋爵！

paras.en: The Duke ignored him. “I was just thinking about how elated the people will be to see Hans of the Southern Isles on her arm publicly for the first time.
paras.zh: 公爵没理他。“我刚在想，人民第一次公开看见她挽着南方群岛的汉斯，该有多欢腾。

paras.en: They’re not only getting a queen, they’re getting a potential king, too.
paras.zh: 他们不仅将迎来一位女王，还白得一位潜在的国王。

paras.en: Today would be a fine day to announce their union.
paras.zh: 今天正是宣布他们结合的良辰吉日。

paras.en: Don’t you think?” Elsa blushed.
paras.zh: 你不觉得吗？”艾莎脸红了。

paras.en: Lord Peterssen shifted uncomfortably.
paras.zh: 彼得森勋爵不自在地挪了挪身子。

paras.en: Hans looked away.
paras.zh: 汉斯把目光移开。

paras.en: She was growing tired of the Duke’s pushiness.
paras.zh: 她越来越受够了公爵的咄咄逼人。

paras.en: Marriage was not on her mind.
paras.zh: 她根本没在想结婚的事。

paras.en: She and Hans had developed a lovely friendship that could perhaps become more, but she had a crown to think of first and secrets that were consuming her.
paras.zh: 她和汉斯之间发展出一段美好的友谊，或许能更进一步，但她得先把王冠放在心上，还有那些吞噬着她的秘密。

paras.en: Plus, it was her coronation day.
paras.zh: 何况，今天是她的加冕日。

paras.en: Elsa heard a crash inside her room.
paras.zh: 艾莎听见房间里传来一声撞击。

paras.en: Olaf ! “Your Grace, Elsa and I have already discussed this.” Hans’s voice was curt. “Her duties come first.” Lord Peterssen nodded agreeably. “Of course, but still, announcing an engagement today, when Elsa is standing in front of her kingdom, would show them she will be a queen of the people,” the Duke insisted.
paras.zh: 雪宝！“殿下，艾莎和我已经商量过了。”汉斯的声音很生硬。“她的职责优先。”彼得森勋爵连连点头赞同。“当然，可今天宣布订婚，当着全国人民的面，能让他们看到她将是一位属于人民的女王，”公爵坚持道。

paras.en: She couldn’t believe what she was hearing.
paras.zh: 她简直不敢相信自己听到的。

paras.en: Anger bubbled up inside her. “Princess?” the Duke pressed. “Don’t you agree?” “I think this conversation should take place later,” Lord Peterssen said, checking his pocket watch. “The chapel is already full.
paras.zh: 怒火在她心中翻涌。“公主？”公爵逼问。“您不赞同吗？”“我觉得这场谈话该晚些时候再进行，”彼得森勋爵看了看怀表说。“小教堂已经坐满了。

paras.en: We should be starting the ceremony soon.” Hans looked at Elsa questioningly. “He brings up a good point, but the decision rests with you.
paras.zh: 我们该很快开始典礼了。”汉斯用询问的目光看着艾莎。“他说得在理，但决定权在你。

paras.en: What do you think?” “I…” Elsa hesitated, feeling her fingers starting to tingle.
paras.zh: 你怎么想？”“我……”艾莎犹豫了，感到指尖开始发麻。

paras.en: No matter how much she enjoyed Hans’s company, they’d only known each other a short while.
paras.zh: 不管她多喜欢有汉斯作伴，他们相识不过短短一段时日。

paras.en: She couldn’t put her finger on it, but something was definitely holding her back. “Have you even properly asked the princess?” the Duke asked, hitting Hans in the arm. “A princess deserves a proper proposal.” Hans’s cheeks turned red. “No, but—” “Ask the girl!” the Duke said jovially.
paras.zh: 她说不清原因，但确有某种东西在拖住她。“你正经向公主求过婚吗？”公爵问，捶了捶汉斯的手臂。“公主值得一场正式的求婚。”汉斯的脸红了。“还没有，可是——”“去问这姑娘！”公爵乐呵呵地说。

paras.en: Lord Peterssen ran a hand through his thinning hair. “Today is the day!” “Elsa!” It was Olaf.
paras.zh: 彼得森勋爵用手捋了捋稀疏的头发。“今天就是日子！”“艾莎！”是雪宝。

paras.en: He had never yelled to her when she was with people. “Elsa!” Maybe he was in trouble!
paras.zh: 当着别人的面，他可从没这样喊过她。“艾莎！”也许他有麻烦了！

paras.en: Lord Peterssen looked puzzled. “Forgive me, but I think I left something in my room,” she said.
paras.zh: 彼得森勋爵一脸困惑。“抱歉，我想我落了东西在房间里，”她说。

paras.en: Her whole body was starting to tingle.
paras.zh: 她整个身体开始发麻。

paras.en: Hans didn’t seem to hear her, because he was already getting down on one knee.
paras.zh: 汉斯似乎没听见她的话，因为他已经单膝跪下了。

paras.en: The sensation had never taken over her whole body before.
paras.zh: 这种感觉从未如此席卷她的全身。

paras.en: Suddenly, she felt as if the walls were closing in.
paras.zh: 突然，她觉得墙壁仿佛在向内合拢。

paras.en: She had to get to Olaf.
paras.zh: 她得去雪宝那儿。

paras.en: The prince looked up at her shyly. “Princess Elsa of Arendelle, will you marry me?” “Elsa!” Olaf called again, louder than before. “I believe Gerda is calling me,” Elsa said sheepishly, and looked down at Hans.
paras.zh: 王子羞怯地抬头望着她。“阿伦黛尔的艾莎公主，你愿意嫁给我吗？”“艾莎！”雪宝又叫了一声，比方才更响。“我想是格尔达在叫我，”艾莎难为情地说，低头看着汉斯。

paras.en: Her face felt flushed. “Would you excuse me for a moment?” Hans couldn’t hide his surprise. “Yes, by all means…” He trailed off.
paras.zh: 她的脸发烫。“能让我失陪片刻吗？”汉斯掩饰不住惊讶。“当然，请便……”他说不下去了。

paras.en: The Duke sighed. “We will wait for you—and your answer,” he said with a thin smile.
paras.zh: 公爵叹了口气。“我们会等您——还有您的答复，”他皮笑肉不笑地说。

paras.en: Hans stood up quickly and adjusted the medals on his jacket.
paras.zh: 汉斯飞快地站起身，整理了一下外套上的奖章。

paras.en: He didn’t make eye contact with her.
paras.zh: 他没有与她眼神相接。

paras.en: The whole situation was uncomfortable, and the Duke was making it worse.
paras.zh: 整件事都令人尴尬，而公爵让局面更糟。

paras.en: She was upset, but she had to get to Olaf and see what was wrong.
paras.zh: 她心里烦乱，但必须去雪宝那儿看看出了什么事。

paras.en: Elsa opened the door a crack, slipped inside, and shut the door.
paras.zh: 艾莎把门推开一条缝，闪身进去，关上门。

paras.en: Olaf was standing right behind her, hopping up and down. “Olaf, what is the matter?” Elsa whispered. “You can’t shout like that.
paras.zh: 雪宝就站在她身后，一上一下地蹦跳。“雪宝，怎么了？”艾莎低声问。“你不能那样大喊。

paras.en: Someone—” “I think I found something!” he cheered. “I pushed your hope chest too far and it banged into the desk and your lockbox fell off.
paras.zh: 会有人——”“我好像发现了什么！”他欢呼道。“我把你的珍宝箱推得太远，它撞到书桌，你的小锁箱就掉下来了。

paras.en: Come see!” Her green lockbox was on its side, empty.
paras.zh: 快来看！”她的绿色小锁箱侧翻在地，空了。

paras.en: The interior of the lid should have had a lining draping across, but now it was sagging and showed a hollow section in the top arch.
paras.zh: 箱盖内侧本该有一层衬里铺着，可现在它松垮下来，露出顶部拱形处一块中空的部分。

paras.en: It looked like something was behind it. “See?” Olaf pointed to the liner. “My hands can’t fit just right to pull it away, but something is behind that green stuff.
paras.zh: 看上去那后面藏着什么东西。“看见没？”雪宝指着衬里。“我的手塞不进去把它扯开，但那绿东西后面有东西。

paras.en: Look!
paras.zh: 看！

paras.en: Look!” Olaf wasn’t wrong.
paras.zh: 看！”雪宝没说错。

paras.en: Gently, she pulled the velvet away, revealing the hollowed-out top.
paras.zh: 她轻轻扯开天鹅绒，露出挖空了的顶部。

paras.en: A canvas had been carefully hidden inside.
paras.zh: 里面小心地藏着一幅画布。

paras.en: Elsa quickly unfolded it.
paras.zh: 艾莎迅速把它展开。

paras.en: She was astonished to see it was a painting.
paras.zh: 她惊讶地发现，那是一幅画。

paras.en: At first glance, it looked like the portrait of her family that hung in the Great Hall.
paras.zh: 乍一看，它很像挂在大礼堂里那幅全家画像。

paras.en: But this painting had four people in it: the king, the queen, Elsa, and another little girl.
paras.zh: 但这幅画里有四个人：安格瑞国王、伊杜娜王后、艾莎，还有另一个小女孩。

paras.en: The child was a few years younger than Elsa, and she was the spitting image of the king.
paras.zh: 那孩子比艾莎小几岁，和安格瑞国王长得一模一样。

paras.en: She had wide-set blue eyes, bright red hair set in pigtails, and a sprinkle of freckles dotting her nose.
paras.zh: 她一双蓝眼睛分得较开，亮红色的头发扎成两条辫子，鼻子上点缀着几粒雀斑。

paras.en: She wore a pale green dress, and she was clutching Elsa’s arm as if she might never let go.
paras.zh: 她穿着淡绿色的裙子，紧紧抓着艾莎的手臂，仿佛永远不肯松开。

paras.en: Elsa touched the painting and started to cry. “It’s Anna!” she said.
paras.zh: 艾莎抚摸着画，哭了起来。“是安娜！”她说。

paras.en: She knew it for certain.
paras.zh: 她确信无疑。

paras.en: The memories flooded her body so quickly she felt like she was drowning. “I remember,” Elsa said in surprise, and then she collapsed on the floor.
paras.zh: 记忆如潮水般涌遍全身，快得让她仿佛要溺毙其中。“我想起来了，”艾莎惊讶地说，随即瘫倒在地。

paras.en: Thirteen Years Earlier… The flour was everywhere.
paras.zh: 十三年前……面粉到处都是。

paras.en: It blanketed the floor, was sprinkled all over the wood table, and had made its way into Anna’s hair.
paras.zh: 它盖住了地板，撒满了木桌，还落进了安娜的头发里。

paras.en: The five-year-old didn’t mind.
paras.zh: 这个五岁的小女孩并不在意。

paras.en: She lifted another scoop of flour from the jar and threw it into the air. “It looks like snow!” Anna said as the flour rained down.
paras.zh: 她又从罐子里舀起一勺面粉，抛向空中。“像下雪一样！”面粉纷纷落下时，安娜说。

paras.en: One of her pigtails was falling out, even though her hair had just been done an hour earlier. “Try it, Elsa!
paras.zh: 她的一条辫子已经散了，尽管头发才在一个小时前梳好。“你也试试，艾莎！

paras.en: Try it!” “You’re making a mess.” Elsa smiled despite herself and tried to tidy up behind her. “Princess Anna, please try to keep the flour in the bowl,” Olina begged. “But it’s so much fun to throw, Miss Olina!” Anna said, giggling as she tossed more flour into the air. “Why don’t you two prepare the dough and I’ll get the stove ready?” Olina suggested. “Okay, Anna, you can come help me.” Elsa pushed a loose strand of blond hair off her face and creamed the soft butter by hand with a wooden spoon.
paras.zh: 你也试试！”“你在弄得一团糟。”艾莎不由得笑了，一边试着在她身后收拾。“安娜公主，求你尽量把面粉留在碗里，”奥琳娜央求道。“可抛面粉太好玩了，奥琳娜小姐！”安娜咯咯笑着，又往空中抛了更多面粉。“你们俩去和面团，我来把炉子准备好，怎么样？”奥琳娜提议。“好啊，安娜，你过来帮我。”艾莎把垂在脸前的一缕金色散发拨开，用手拿木勺把软黄油打成奶油状。

paras.en: Anna climbed up on a stool next to Elsa and watched.
paras.zh: 安娜爬上艾莎身旁的小凳子，看着她。

paras.en: Together, they added the sugar, flour, vanilla extract, and milk.
paras.zh: 她们一起加入糖、面粉、香草精和牛奶。

paras.en: They took turns stirring until the cookie mixture was a smooth pale yellow.
paras.zh: 她们轮流搅拌，直到饼干面糊变得顺滑、呈淡黄色。

paras.en: Elsa cracked the eggs, since the last time Anna did them, she’d gotten shells in a batch of cookies they served to the king of Sondringham.
paras.zh: 艾莎负责打鸡蛋，因为上一次安娜打蛋时，把蛋壳掉进了端给松德里厄姆国王的那批饼干里。

paras.en: Elsa was still stirring the mixture when Anna got bored and started racing around the kitchen.
paras.zh: 艾莎还在搅拌面糊，安娜就无聊起来，开始绕着厨房跑。

paras.en: Elsa laughed, abandoning her spoon and running after her.
paras.zh: 艾莎笑了，丢下勺子去追她。

paras.en: Suddenly, Mama swooped in and grabbed both of them. “This looks wonderful, girls,” Mama said. “Your father is going to be so surprised.
paras.zh: 忽然，妈妈俯身一把搂住她们俩。“看起来真棒，姑娘们，”妈妈说。“你们的爸爸准会大吃一惊。

paras.en: You know how much he loves your krumkaker.” “Crumbs cake-r.” Anna tried hard to say the word, but she never could. “Crumb cake?” Mama and Elsa laughed. “Krumkaker,” Mama said, the word rolling off her tongue smoothly. “I’ve been using this recipe since I was your age.
paras.zh: 你们知道他多爱吃你们的krumkake（脆饼）。”“克—鲁姆—脆饼。”安娜努力想说对这个词，却总也说不好。“脆饼？”妈妈和艾莎都笑了。“Krumkake，”妈妈流利地吐出这个词。“从我像你们这么大时起，就一直用这个配方了。

paras.en: I used to bake these with my best friend.” “That’s where you learned to bake with love,” Anna said. “Yes, I did,” Mama agreed, fixing Anna’s right pigtail.
paras.zh: 我以前常和我最好的朋友一起烤这些。”“你就是从那儿学会带着爱烘焙的，”安娜说。“没错，”妈妈一边整理安娜右边的辫子，一边应道。

paras.en: Together, they huddled around the stove as Olina lit it and placed the decorative two-sided iron griddle on top of the flame to heat up.
paras.zh: 她们一起围在炉子旁，奥琳娜点燃炉火，把那只用做装饰的双面铁模放在火上加热。

paras.en: Their krumkake griddle had the Arendelle coat of arms on it, a touch their father loved.
paras.zh: 她们的krumkake脆饼模上刻着阿伦黛尔的纹章，这是她们父亲最爱的一点。

paras.en: Mama poured the first scoop of batter into the center of the griddle and closed it, holding it over the flame.
paras.zh: 妈妈把第一勺面糊倒进模具中央，合上盖子，举在火上。

paras.en: Together, they counted to ten; then she flipped the griddle over and they counted out ten seconds again.
paras.zh: 她们一起数到十；然后妈妈把模具翻过来，她们又数了十秒。

paras.en: The hardest part of the process was removing the baked dough from the griddle so they could mold it around a cone-shaped rolling pin to form the cookie.
paras.zh: 过程中最难的一步，是把烤好的面饼从模具上取下来，再裹在锥形的擀面杖上，塑成饼干的形状。

paras.en: Olina and Mama never let them help with that part.
paras.zh: 那一步奥琳娜和妈妈从不让她们插手。

paras.en: Olina claimed she had calluses on her fingertips from getting burned by the griddle one too many times.
paras.zh: 奥琳娜说，自己的指尖因为被模具烫了太多次，都长老茧了。

paras.en: But when the cookie was cool, it was removed from the cone, and that was when both girls were allowed to sprinkle it with powdered sugar.
paras.zh: 不过等饼干凉了，从锥子上取下来后，两个女孩才被允许在上面撒糖粉。

paras.en: Sometimes they left the cookies hollow, and other times they filled them with a sweet, creamy filling.
paras.zh: 有时她们让饼干中空，有时则填入甜甜的奶油馅。

paras.en: Papa liked them plain.
paras.zh: 爸爸喜欢原味的。

paras.en: Before they knew it, they’d made half a dozen cookies and had enough batter to make at least a dozen more. “Why don’t you three keep going and I’ll be right back?” Olina told them, wiping her hands on her apron. “I just need to accept this vegetable delivery.” “Can I try using the griddle?
paras.zh: 不知不觉间，她们已经做了半打饼干，面糊还够再做至少一打。“你们三个接着做，我马上回来？”奥琳娜擦了擦围裙上的手，对她们说。“我得去收一下送来的蔬菜。”“我能试试用模具吗？

paras.en: Please?
paras.zh: 求你了？

paras.en: Can I try?” Anna begged. “No, darling,” Mama told her. “You’ll burn your fingers.” Anna watched her mother remove the griddle from the stove and pull the baked dough out of it.
paras.zh: 我能试试吗？”安娜央求。“不行，亲爱的，”妈妈对她说。“你会烫到手指的。”安娜看着妈妈把模具从炉上拿下，把烤好的面饼取出来。

paras.en: She wrapped it around the krumkake pin to form its shape. “Your Majesty?” Kai appeared in the kitchen doorway. “The king has asked for you to make an appearance in the council chambers.” Mama looked at the girls. “I’ll be right back,” she promised. “Don’t touch the griddle till Olina or I return.” Elsa nodded, but by the time she turned around, Anna was already on her tippy-toes, scooping the batter onto the middle of the griddle. “Anna!
paras.zh: 她把面饼裹在krumkake脆饼棍上塑形。“陛下？”凯出现在厨房门口。“安格瑞国王请您到议事厅露个面。”妈妈看了看两个女孩。“我马上回来，”她答应道。“在奥琳娜或我回来前，别碰模具。”艾莎点点头，可等她转过身，安娜已经踮起脚尖，把面糊舀到了模具中央。“安娜！

paras.en: Mama said not to touch it.” “I can do it,” Anna insisted, counting to herself and flipping the griddle. “I want to bake my own cookie for Papa.” “Wait for Miss Olina,” Elsa told her, but Anna was impulsive.
paras.zh: 妈妈说了别碰它。”“我能行，”安娜坚持道，一边自己数着数，把模具翻了面。“我想给爸爸烤一块自己的饼干。”“等奥琳娜小姐回来，”艾莎对她说，可安娜性子急。

paras.en: She hated rules.
paras.zh: 她讨厌规矩。

paras.en: Elsa, on the other hand, swore by them.
paras.zh: 艾莎则相反，把规矩奉为圭臬。

paras.en: Anna opened the griddle and tried to pull the crispy dough from the middle of the grate. “Ouch!” she cried, dropping the dough onto the floor and waving her fingers frantically. “I got burned!” Anna burst into tears. “Let me see.” Elsa grabbed her sister’s hand.
paras.zh: 安娜打开模具，想把中间那块脆饼从格栅上扯下来。“哎哟！”她叫道，把面饼掉到地上，疯狂甩动着手指。“我烫到了！”安娜哇地哭出来。“让我看看。”艾莎抓住妹妹的手。

paras.en: Two of her fingers were bright red.
paras.zh: 她的两根手指红得发亮。

paras.en: Elsa needed something cold to put on Anna’s hand to stop the burning sensation.
paras.zh: 艾莎需要找点冰凉的东西敷在安娜手上，止住灼痛。

paras.en: She spotted a copper pot full of water on the table.
paras.zh: 她瞥见桌上有一只装满水的铜壶。

paras.en: Olina wouldn’t be back for a few minutes.
paras.zh: 奥琳娜还要好几分钟才回来。

paras.en: Elsa hovered her fingertips over the pot and concentrated on the water.
paras.zh: 艾莎把指尖悬在铜壶上方，专注地想着水。

paras.en: Seconds later, a blue glow appeared around her hands, and snowflakes and crystals began to flow.
paras.zh: 几秒钟后，她双手周围亮起蓝光，雪花与冰晶开始涌动。

paras.en: Anna stopped crying. “Oooh.” Within seconds, the water in the pot was frozen solid. “Put your hand on here to cool it down,” Elsa instructed as the ice crackled.
paras.zh: 安娜不哭了。“噢——”转眼间，壶里的水冻成了实心的冰。“把手放上来降温，”冰块咔嚓作响，艾莎指挥道。

paras.en: Anna ran over to touch it.
paras.zh: 安娜跑过去摸它。

paras.en: Neither of them heard their mother return. “Girls!” Mama’s voice was dangerously low.
paras.zh: 两人都没听见妈妈回来。“姑娘们！”妈妈的声音低得吓人。

paras.en: Elsa hid her hands behind her back, but it was too late.
paras.zh: 艾莎把双手藏到背后，但为时已晚。

paras.en: She had disobeyed Mama by using her gift in public, where someone else might see. “You know better than to—” “How are the cookies coming?” Olina asked, returning with a basket of fresh vegetables, which she placed on the counter.
paras.zh: 她在有人可能看见的公开场合动用了天赋，违背了妈妈的话。“你该知道不能——”“饼干烤得怎么样了？”奥琳娜提着一篮新鲜蔬菜回来，把篮子搁在台面上，问道。

paras.en: She started when she noticed the copper pot she had just filled with water. “My word!
paras.zh: 她猛地一愣，注意到自己刚装满水的铜壶。“天哪！

paras.en: What happened to my pot?
paras.zh: 我的壶怎么了？

paras.en: How could the water freeze on such a warm night?” Mama pulled Anna and Elsa to her sides. “Strange, indeed!
paras.zh: 这么暖的夜里，水怎么会冻住？”妈妈把安娜和艾莎拉到自己身边。“确实奇怪！

paras.en: Olina, Anna burned her fingers on the stove.
paras.zh: 奥琳娜，安娜在炉子上烫到了手指。

paras.en: I’m going to bandage them and get the girls to bed.” “But the cookies…” Elsa protested.
paras.zh: 我这就去给她包扎，然后带姑娘们上床睡觉。”“可饼干……”艾莎抗议道。

paras.en: Her mother flashed her a sharp look. “Olina will finish them and you can give the cookies to your father over breakfast.
paras.zh: 妈妈向她投来锐利的一瞥。“奥琳娜会把它们做完，你早餐时再把饼干给爸爸。

paras.en: We’re done baking this evening.” Olina didn’t say anything.
paras.zh: 今晚的烘焙就到这儿了。”奥琳娜没说什么。

paras.en: She was still too busy staring at the pot in wonder.
paras.zh: 她还忙着惊奇地盯着那只壶。

paras.en: Elsa hung her head. “Yes, Mama.” In the girls’ shared bedroom, Mama applied a salve to Anna’s fingers and dressed her in her favorite green nightgown, then sent Anna to fetch Papa for story time.
paras.zh: 艾莎低下头。“是，妈妈。”在姐妹俩共用的卧室里，妈妈给安娜的手指涂上药膏，又给她穿上最爱的绿色睡裙，然后打发安娜去叫爸爸来讲故事。

paras.en: Moonlight streaked through the large triangular window as Elsa changed into her blue nightgown behind the dressing panel.
paras.zh: 月光透过那扇大三角窗斜射进来，艾莎在屏风后换上蓝色睡裙。

paras.en: She could hear their mother singing a lullaby as she picked up a few dolls Anna had left on the floor.
paras.zh: 她能听见妈妈一边捡起安娜落在地上的几个娃娃，一边唱着摇篮曲。

paras.en: By the time Elsa climbed into her bed, Mama was by her side. “I’m so sorry, Mama,” Elsa said, still feeling bad.
paras.zh: 等艾莎爬上床，妈妈已守在床边。“真对不起，妈妈，”艾莎说，心里仍不好受。

paras.en: Her mother sat on the edge of her bed. “I know.
paras.zh: 妈妈在床沿坐下。“我知道。

paras.en: And I know it’s not your fault that Anna got hurt.
paras.zh: 我也知道安娜受伤不是你的错。

paras.en: Olina or I should have been watching, but when we can’t…” “It’s my duty to watch over Anna,” Elsa recited diligently. “No,” Mama said. “It’s your job to be a good big sister, but also to protect yourself.
paras.zh: 该看着她的是奥琳娜或我，可我们没看住的时候……”“看护安娜是我的责任，”艾莎认真地背道。“不，”妈妈说。“你的责任是做个好姐姐，但也要保护好自己。

paras.en: What if Olina had walked in when you were using your gift?” Elsa noticed the worry lines on her mother’s forehead.
paras.zh: 要是你动用天赋时奥琳娜走进来，怎么办？”艾莎注意到妈妈额头上的忧纹。

paras.en: She hated upsetting her. “She didn’t see me.” “But she could have,” Mama reminded her. “You must be more careful, Elsa.
paras.zh: 她最不愿让妈妈难过。“她没看见我。”“可她本可能看见的，”妈妈提醒她。“你必须更小心，艾莎。

paras.en: Papa and I know your gift is truly special, but until we know more about it, we want it to be our family secret.
paras.zh: 爸爸和我知道你的天赋的确与众不同，但在我们更了解它之前，我们希望它成为我们家的秘密。

paras.en: Do you understand?” Elsa nodded. “Your father has been trying to learn everything he can.
paras.zh: 你明白吗？”艾莎点点头。“你爸爸一直在尽力了解一切他能了解的。

paras.en: He spends hours in the library reading.” She looked down at their hands and took Elsa’s in hers. “So far, we have found nothing that explains how you could have been born with such powers.” Powers.
paras.zh: 他一整小时一整小时地泡在图书馆里读书。”她低下头看着两人的手，把艾莎的手握在自己手里。“到目前为止，我们什么也没找到，能解释你为何生来就有这样的力量。”力量。

paras.en: It was a word her mother had never used before to explain her gift.
paras.zh: 这是妈妈以前从不用来的、解释她天赋的词。

paras.en: It did feel powerful, seeing the ice shoot out with just the slightest thought.
paras.zh: 只要心头微微一动，冰就迸射而出，那感觉确实很有力量。

paras.en: Sometimes she didn’t have to think about the ice, and it just happened on its own.
paras.zh: 有时她根本不用去想冰，它就自己出现了。

paras.en: Mama held her hand tighter. “For now, we need you to promise to only use your gift when you are around your father, Anna, and me.” Elsa looked down. “Yes, Mama, but…sometimes I don’t know how to control the ice,” she admitted. “When I get upset, it’s even worse.
paras.zh: 妈妈握紧她的手。“眼下，我们需要你答应，只有在爸爸、安娜和我身边时，才动用你的天赋。”艾莎低下头。“是，妈妈，可是……有时候我不知道怎么控制冰，”她承认。“我一难过，情况就更糟。

paras.en: I know Papa says to conceal, don’t feel.
paras.zh: 我知道爸爸说过要「隐藏起来，别去感受」。

paras.en: But sometimes when I feel too much, I don’t know how to manage the snow.” Her mother hugged her. “We will learn to control your gift so that it doesn’t control you.
paras.zh: 可有时候我感受太强烈，就不知怎么对付这雪了。”妈妈抱住她。“我们会学会控制你的天赋，不让它反过来控制你。

paras.en: I promise!” “Really?” Elsa looked hopeful. “Yes, all we want is to keep you safe,” Mama said. “Both of you.” Just then, they heard Anna’s giggles coming down the hallway, followed by a big belly laugh from Papa. “I will be more careful,” Elsa whispered. “Good girl.” Mama kissed her cheek.
paras.zh: 我保证！”“真的吗？”艾莎露出充满希望的神情。“是的，我们只想保护你的安全，”妈妈说。“你们两个都安全。”就在这时，她们听见走廊里传来安娜的咯咯笑，接着是爸爸开怀的大笑。“我会更小心的，”艾莎轻声说。“好姑娘。”妈妈吻了吻她的脸颊。

paras.en: They looked at the door as Anna and Papa burst into the room, Anna hanging upside down as Papa hung on to her ankles. “Who’s ready for a bedtime story?” Papa asked. “Elsa?
paras.zh: 安娜和爸爸冲进房间，爸爸抓着安娜的脚踝，把她倒吊着，两人一起望向门口。“谁准备好听睡前故事了？”爸爸问。“艾莎？

paras.en: Psst…Elsa?
paras.zh: 嘘……艾莎？

paras.en: Wake up, wake up, wake up!” Elsa’s eyes remained closed. “Anna, go back to sleep.” She felt Anna climb onto her bed and dramatically collapse on top of her. “I just can’t.
paras.zh: 醒醒，醒醒，醒醒！”艾莎闭着眼。“安娜，回去睡觉。”她感到安娜爬上她的床，夸张地瘫在她身上。“我就是睡不着。

paras.en: The sky’s awake!
paras.zh: 天空醒着呢！

paras.en: So I’m awake!
paras.zh: 所以我也醒着！

paras.en: So we have to play!” Elsa opened one eye and pushed Anna off her. “Go play by yourself!” She heard Anna’s body hit the floor and waited for the cry that would tell her whether Anna had hurt herself.
paras.zh: 所以我们得玩！”艾莎睁开一只眼，把安娜推开。“自己玩去！”她听见安娜身体摔到地上，便等着听那声哭喊，好判断安娜有没有摔伤。

paras.en: That made her feel slightly guilty—until she felt Anna pulling open one of her eyelids. “Do you want to build a snowman?” Anna asked coyly.
paras.zh: 这让她有点愧疚——直到她感到安娜拉开她的一只眼皮。“你想堆个雪人吗？”安娜俏皮地问。

paras.en: Elsa couldn’t help sitting up and smiling.
paras.zh: 艾莎忍不住坐起身，笑了起来。

paras.en: It was the middle of the night.
paras.zh: 那是半夜。

paras.en: That meant the castle and all its occupants were fast asleep.
paras.zh: 也就是说，城堡里所有人都睡熟了。

paras.en: She wouldn’t be seen.
paras.zh: 她不会被看见。

paras.en: No one would be frightened.
paras.zh: 没人会被吓到。

paras.en: If there was ever a time for Elsa to practice her gift, that was it.
paras.zh: 若说艾莎有什么时候该练习天赋，那就是现在。

paras.en: Seconds later, they were out of their room, with Anna in boots and Elsa in her slippers, and they rushed down the stairs.
paras.zh: 几秒后，她们出了房间，安娜穿着靴子，艾莎穿着拖鞋，冲下楼梯。

paras.en: Elsa kept shushing Anna while Anna kept whispering, “Come on!
paras.zh: 艾莎不停让安娜嘘声，安娜却一直小声喊：“快呀！

paras.en: Come on!
paras.zh: 快呀！

paras.en: Come on!” They hurried into the deserted Great Hall.
paras.zh: 快呀！”她们匆匆进入空无一人的大礼堂。

paras.en: The room was massive, with large vaulted ceilings and ornate wooden details and wallpaper.
paras.zh: 那房间十分宽敞，高高的拱形天花板上满是华丽的木雕与壁纸纹样。

paras.en: Usually it was decorated for parties, but that night it was empty.
paras.zh: 平时这里会为宴会装饰一番，可那晚空荡荡的。

paras.en: They skidded to a stop in the center of the room. “Do the magic!
paras.zh: 她们一路滑着，在房间中央停下。“变魔法！

paras.en: Do the magic!” Anna jumped up and down with excitement.
paras.zh: 变魔法！”安娜兴奋得上蹦下跳。

paras.en: Elsa glanced at the doors to make sure they were closed.
paras.zh: 艾莎瞥了眼门，确认都关着。

paras.en: Satisfied, she started to roll her hands round and round.
paras.zh: 放心后，她开始把双手一圈圈地转动。

paras.en: A snowball formed between her palms, surrounded by a blue glow. “Ready?” she asked, feeling the rush she got when she was about to use magic.
paras.zh: 一个雪球在她掌心间成形，周围环绕着蓝光。“准备好了吗？”她问，感受到每次要用魔法前那种激动。

paras.en: She threw her hands up and flung the snowball high into the air.
paras.zh: 她双手一扬，把雪球高高抛向空中。

paras.en: Snow started to fall from the ceiling, washing the floor in a blanket of white. “This is amazing!” Anna marveled, her giggles of joy filling Elsa with pride.
paras.zh: 雪开始从天花板落下，给地板铺上一层白毯。“太神奇了！”安娜惊叹，她欢乐的咯咯笑声让艾莎满心自豪。

paras.en: Anna, more than anyone else, loved Elsa’s gift, and she begged her to use it often.
paras.zh: 比起任何人，安娜都更爱艾莎的天赋，常央求她多施展。

paras.en: Their parents, on the other hand, wanted her to keep it private.
paras.zh: 而她们的父母，却希望她把天赋藏着。

paras.en: But if a gift like this could bring such joy, shouldn’t she share it?
paras.zh: 可既然这样的天赋能带来如此欢乐，她难道不该分享吗？

paras.en: Besides, she loved impressing her sister. “Watch this,” Elsa said, and stomped her foot.
paras.zh: 况且，她最爱让妹妹刮目相看。“看这个，”艾莎说着，跺了下脚。

paras.en: Ice began to crackle and cover the floor, like it was their own personal ice-skating rink.
paras.zh: 冰开始咔嚓作响，铺满地板，仿佛成了她们专属的滑冰场。

paras.en: Seeing Anna’s delight only made Elsa want to create more.
paras.zh: 见安娜那么开心，艾莎只想造出更多。

paras.en: She concentrated harder and snow kept falling, ice kept crackling, and the room soon became a winter wonderland.
paras.zh: 她更专注了，雪不停落，冰不停响，房间很快变成了冬日的奇境。

paras.en: Next it was time to make the snowman Anna loved so much.
paras.zh: 接下来该做安娜最爱的雪人了。

paras.en: They rolled his round bottom, then stacked two more snowballs on top.
paras.zh: 她们滚出圆圆的雪球当底座，又往上叠了两个雪球。

paras.en: Elsa’s was perfectly round, but the head Anna made was more of a cylinder.
paras.zh: 艾莎滚的那个滚圆，可安娜做的脑袋更像个圆柱。

paras.en: Anna dashed to the kitchen downstairs to grab a carrot for the snowman’s nose and snag some coal for his eyes and belly.
paras.zh: 安娜冲到楼下厨房，抓了根胡萝卜当雪人的鼻子，又顺了些煤块当它的眼睛和肚子。

paras.en: They snatched some twigs from the fireplace to create his arms and hair.
paras.zh: 她们从壁炉边抽了几根细树枝，做雪人的胳膊和头发。

paras.en: Finished, Elsa stood behind the snowman as Anna watched from one of their parents’ thrones, and Elsa pretended he was alive. “Hi, I’m Olaf,” she said in a funny voice, “and I like warm hugs.” Anna jumped out of the throne and threw herself at the snowman, almost knocking off his head. “I love you, Olaf!” Anna wouldn’t let Olaf out of her sight, so Elsa pushed him around the room as Anna hung on, using him as her skating partner.
paras.zh: 做好了，艾莎站在雪人身后，安娜则坐在父母的一张宝座上看着，艾莎装作雪人是活的。“嗨，我是雪宝，”她用滑稽的声音说，“我喜欢温暖的拥抱。”安娜从宝座上跳下来，扑向雪人，差点撞掉它的脑袋。“我爱你，雪宝！”安娜一刻也不让雪宝离开视线，于是艾莎推着雪人在屋里转，安娜挂在上面，把它当滑冰搭档。

paras.en: Next Anna wanted to jump snow mounds.
paras.zh: 接着安娜想从雪堆上跳过去。

paras.en: Elsa complied, making more and more snow so Anna could leap from one pile to the next. “Hang on!” Elsa told her. “Catch me!” Anna squealed with delight as she pounced from pile to pile in her green nightgown, jumping faster and faster.
paras.zh: 艾莎照做，造出越来越多的雪，好让安娜能从一个雪堆跳到下一个。“抓紧！”艾莎对她喊。“接住我！”安娜穿着绿色睡裙，在一堆堆雪间蹦跳，越跳越快，欢喜地尖叫。

paras.en: Elsa struggled to make snow quicker than Anna could jump. “Again!” Anna shouted. “Wait!” Elsa created the snow piles faster, but she was only one ahead of Anna now. “Slow down!” she cried, but Anna didn’t listen.
paras.zh: 艾莎拼命造雪，要快过安娜蹦跳的速度。“再来！”安娜喊。“等一下！”艾莎更快地堆雪，可现在只比安娜领先一堆了。“慢点！”她喊，可安娜不听。

paras.en: Elsa backed up to give herself more room and felt herself slip and fall.
paras.zh: 艾莎往后退，想给自己多腾点地方，却感到脚下一滑，摔了下去。

paras.en: By the time she looked up, Anna was already in midair with nothing beneath her feet. “Anna!” Elsa panicked, shooting the snow into the air as fast as possible.
paras.zh: 等她抬头，安娜已经腾在半空，脚下空无一物。“安娜！”艾莎慌了，拼命把雪射向空中。

paras.en: The stream of magic collided with Anna, hitting her in the face.
paras.zh: 那道魔法击中了安娜，正中她的脸。

paras.en: Anna tumbled down the nearest snow pile.
paras.zh: 安娜从最近的雪堆上滚落。

paras.en: She wasn’t moving.
paras.zh: 她一动不动。

paras.en: Elsa rushed to her side. “Anna!” she cried, taking her little sister into her arms, but Anna wouldn’t wake up.
paras.zh: 艾莎冲到她身边。“安娜！”她喊着，把小妹妹抱进怀里，可安娜怎么也不醒。

paras.en: A streak of white hair slowly wove itself through her red locks.
paras.zh: 一缕白发缓缓缠进她红色的发丝间。

paras.en: Fear bubbled up inside Elsa, her breath caught in her throat, and her whole body began to tremble. “Mama!
paras.zh: 恐惧在艾莎心中翻涌，她屏住呼吸，浑身开始发抖。“妈妈！

paras.en: Papa!” she cried at the top of her lungs.
paras.zh: 爸爸！”她扯着嗓子喊。

paras.en: The ice around the sisters began to crack and grow, covering the entire floor and crawling up the walls.
paras.zh: 姐妹俩周围的冰开始咔嚓开裂、蔓延，盖住整片地板，又顺着墙往上爬。

paras.en: It thickened and rumbled, knocking over Olaf, who broke into pieces. “You’re okay, Anna,” Elsa cried, cradling her in her arms. “I’ve got you.” When their parents ran into the room, they saw Elsa sitting with Anna’s motionless body.
paras.zh: 冰越结越厚，隆隆作响，把雪宝撞倒，摔成了碎片。“你没事，安娜，”艾莎抱着她，哭着说。“我抓住你了。”父母冲进房间时，看见艾莎抱着一动不动的安娜坐在地上。

paras.en: Mama looked so frightened Elsa’s terror grew, causing the ice to spread further. “Elsa, what have you done?” Papa shouted. “This is getting out of hand.” “It was an accident.
paras.zh: 妈妈吓得脸色惨白，艾莎的恐惧更甚，冰蔓延得更远了。“艾莎，你都做了什么？”爸爸喊。“这失控了。”“这是个意外。

paras.en: I’m sorry, Anna,” Elsa said, her voice trembling as Mama took Anna from her. “She’s ice cold,” Mama said quietly, fear seeping into her voice. “I know where we have to go,” Papa said, moving quickly and motioning for Elsa and Mama to follow. “Is Anna going to be okay?
paras.zh: 对不起，安娜，”艾莎说，声音发颤，妈妈从她手中接过安娜。“她冰冰凉，”妈妈轻声说，声音里渗着恐惧。“我知道该去哪儿，”爸爸说着，迅速行动，示意艾莎和妈妈跟上。“安娜会没事的吧？

paras.en: Mama?
paras.zh: 妈妈？

paras.en: Will she be okay?” Elsa whispered.
paras.zh: 她会没事的吧？”艾莎小声问。

paras.en: She had never been more frightened.
paras.zh: 她从未如此害怕过。

paras.en: But no one answered her.
paras.zh: 可没人回答她。

paras.en: Elsa choked back sobs.
paras.zh: 艾莎强忍住啜泣。

paras.en: This was why her parents told her to be careful when using her gift.
paras.zh: 这正是父母要她动用天赋时小心的原因。

paras.en: Look what had happened to Anna.
paras.zh: 看看安娜出了什么事。

paras.en: If that was what her powers could do, she didn’t want them anymore.
paras.zh: 如果这就是她的力量能造成的后果，她再也不想要了。

paras.en: Why did her magic have to ruin everything?
paras.zh: 为什么她的魔法非要毁掉一切？

paras.en: Why couldn’t she be normal like everyone else?
paras.zh: 为什么她不能像别人一样正常？

paras.en: Anger pulsed inside her, and she felt her heart beat faster.
paras.zh: 怒火在她体内悸动，她感到心跳加速。

paras.en: Snow started to swirl around her fingertips, and she couldn’t stop it.
paras.zh: 雪开始在她指尖盘旋，她停不下来。

paras.en: No!
paras.zh: 不！

paras.en: She took a few deep breaths, trying to calm down. “Elsa!” her mother called.
paras.zh: 她深呼吸了几下，想让自己平静。“艾莎！”妈妈唤道。

paras.en: Elsa followed her mother into the library and watched her lock the door behind her.
paras.zh: 艾莎跟着妈妈走进图书室，看着妈妈在身后锁上门。

paras.en: Mama wrapped Anna in a blue blanket and held her tight while Papa pulled books off the shelf, searching for something.
paras.zh: 妈妈用蓝毯子裹住安娜，紧紧抱着，爸爸则从书架上抽书，寻找着什么。

paras.en: No one spoke.
paras.zh: 没人说话。

paras.en: If anything happened to her sister, Elsa would never forgive herself. “This is it,” Papa said, holding up a red book.
paras.zh: 要是妹妹有个三长两短，艾莎永远不会原谅自己。“就是这本，”爸爸举起一本红皮书，说道。

paras.en: It looked rather old, and Elsa didn’t understand the writing when he opened it in front of them.
paras.zh: 书看上去相当陈旧，他在她们面前翻开时，艾莎看不懂上面的文字。

paras.en: The book was full of symbols.
paras.zh: 书里满是符号。

paras.en: There was a picture of a troll standing over a body with a blue spirit seeping out of the person’s head. “Yes, this is the one,” Mama agreed as a map fell out of the book and fluttered to the floor.
paras.zh: 画上有一个地精站在一具躯体上方，一缕蓝色魂魄正从那人的头顶渗出来。“对，就是这本，”妈妈应道，这时一张地图从书里掉出，飘落在地。

paras.en: Elsa noticed the map was of Arendelle, with markings that pointed to a place in the mountains.
paras.zh: 艾莎注意到，那是阿伦黛尔的地图，上面有记号指向山里的一处地方。

paras.en: Papa touched Anna’s forehead. “She’s still so cold.” “We have to go to them,” Mama said. “We can’t wait.” “We can take the horses,” Papa said. “Elsa, come with us.
paras.zh: 爸爸摸了摸安娜的额头。“她还是这么冷。”“我们得去找他们，”妈妈说。“不能等了。”“我们骑马去，”爸爸说。“艾莎，跟我们来。

paras.en: Quietly, now.” “Mama, will Anna be okay?” Elsa asked again. “Hush now,” Mama said, and Elsa did as she was told. “We have to get to the stables unseen.” The castle was eerily silent, as if every part of it were shunning Elsa for her mistake.
paras.zh: 现在，安静点。”“妈妈，安娜会没事吗？”艾莎又问。“嘘，别出声，”妈妈说，艾莎照做了。“我们得神不知鬼不觉地到马厩。”城堡里静得诡异，仿佛每一处都在为她的过错而疏远她。

paras.en: Elsa didn’t ask questions.
paras.zh: 艾莎没有多问。

paras.en: She followed her parents into the stables and watched Papa saddle up their horses.
paras.zh: 她跟着父母走进马厩，看着爸爸给马备鞍。

paras.en: He helped Mama onto one and placed Anna in her arms.
paras.zh: 他扶妈妈上了其中一匹，把安娜放进她怀里。

paras.en: Then he motioned for Elsa, and he picked her up and placed her in front of him on his horse.
paras.zh: 接着他向艾莎示意，把她抱起，放到自己身前的马上。

paras.en: Seconds later, Papa raced out of the stables.
paras.zh: 几秒后，爸爸骑马冲出马厩。

paras.en: Mama was right beside him.
paras.zh: 妈妈就在他身侧。

paras.en: The two horses gained speed as they ran out the castle gates and into the night.
paras.zh: 两匹马加速奔跑，冲出城堡大门，没入夜色。

paras.en: Elsa concentrated on the path in front of her and tried to remain calm, but she kept freezing things around her without even realizing it.
paras.zh: 艾莎盯着身前的路，努力保持镇定，却不由自主地不断把周围的东西冻住。

paras.en: Papa clutched the map from the book and used the northern lights as his guide.
paras.zh: 爸爸攥着从书里取出的地图，以北极光为指引。

paras.en: Higher and higher into the mountains they climbed, the sea seeming to shrink away.
paras.zh: 他们越爬越高，深入群山，大海仿佛在身后退去。

paras.en: At one point, she could have sworn she heard a boy’s voice, but when she turned around, all she saw was a baby reindeer.
paras.zh: 有一刻，她几乎确信自己听见了一个男孩的声音，可当她转过头，只看见一头小驯鹿。

paras.en: Seconds later, it was gone. “We’re here!” Papa said, stopping suddenly and dismounting.
paras.zh: 几秒后，它就不见了。“我们到了！”爸爸突然停下，翻身下马。

paras.en: He helped Mama and Anna off their horse, then came for Elsa.
paras.zh: 他扶妈妈和安娜下马，又来接艾莎。

paras.en: Where was “here”?
paras.zh: 这是“哪儿”？

paras.en: Papa stood in the middle of a grassy area covered with mossy boulders stacked in strange formations.
paras.zh: 爸爸站在一片草地中央，四周是布满苔藓、以奇异形状堆叠的巨石。

paras.en: Stone steps led down to the center of the area, as if there had been something there once upon a time.
paras.zh: 石阶通向那片区域的中心，仿佛很久以前那里曾有过什么。

paras.en: Steam eerily seeped from hidden geysers all around them.
paras.zh: 诡异的水汽从四周隐蔽的间歇泉里渗出来。

paras.en: Wherever “here” was, it seemed mysterious.
paras.zh: 不管这“哪儿”是哪里，都显得神秘莫测。

paras.en: Mama looked more worried than Elsa had ever seen her before.
paras.zh: 妈妈一脸担忧，比艾莎见过的任何一次都厉害。

paras.en: This is my fault, Elsa thought. “Elsa, come here,” Papa said, and she ran into his arms. “It will be all right.” They were the first words he had said to her since they had been in the Great Hall.
paras.zh: 都是我的错，艾莎想。“艾莎，过来，”爸爸说，她扑进他怀里。“会没事的。”这是自打进了大礼堂后，他对她说的第一句话。

paras.en: Mama was close behind, holding Anna in her arms. “Please!” Papa called into the darkness. “Help!
paras.zh: 妈妈紧随其后，抱着安娜。“求求你们！”爸爸朝黑暗中喊。“救命！

paras.en: It’s my daughter!” Who was Papa talking to?
paras.zh: 我的女儿！”爸爸在跟谁说话？

paras.en: Elsa was about to ask him when she noticed the boulders beginning to rock, then roll down the steps, headed directly for them.
paras.zh: 艾莎正要问他，却注意到那些巨石开始摇晃，接着滚下石阶，直冲他们而来。

paras.en: Elsa pulled at Mama’s leg, burying her face in her dress.
paras.zh: 艾莎拽住妈妈的腿，把脸埋进她的衣裙。

paras.en: Papa pulled the three of them closer as the boulders moved in.
paras.zh: 爸爸把她们三个搂得更紧，巨石正逼近来。

paras.en: Elsa peeked out from her mother’s dress.
paras.zh: 艾莎从妈妈的裙子里探出头。

paras.en: All at once, the boulders stopped moving, and up sprang dozens of small trolls.
paras.zh: 忽然，巨石停住了，蹦出几十只小地精来。

paras.en: They looked as if they were chiseled from stone.
paras.zh: 它们看上去像是用石头凿出来的。

paras.en: The moss that had grown on their backs looked like garments, and different-colored crystals hung from their necks.
paras.zh: 它们背上长的苔藓像衣裳，脖子上挂着各色水晶。

paras.en: They had small tufts of mossy green hair on top of their heads and large ears, and the whites of their close-set eyes glowed in the moonlight.
paras.zh: 它们头顶有一小撮苔绿色的毛发，耳朵很大，长在一起的眼睛眼白在月光下发着光。

paras.en: The trolls reminded Elsa of hedgehogs. “It’s the king!” one of the trolls cried as they shuffled forward.
paras.zh: 地精让艾莎想起刺猬。“是安格瑞国王！”一只地精一边蹒跚向前，一边喊道。

paras.en: A troll with a long mossy cape moved to the front of the pack.
paras.zh: 一只披着长长苔绿色斗篷的地精挪到了队伍最前。

paras.en: He had an intricate beaded necklace. “Make way for Grand Pabbie!” “Your Majesty.” Grand Pabbie bowed his head.
paras.zh: 他戴着一串精致的串珠项链。“给皮比让路！”“陛下。”皮比低下头。

paras.en: He reached for Elsa’s hand. “Born with the powers or cursed?” Elsa inhaled sharply.
paras.zh: 他伸手去握艾莎的手。“是与生俱来的力量，还是被诅咒的？”艾莎倒吸一口凉气。

paras.en: How did he know?
paras.zh: 他怎么知道？

paras.en: Papa seemed to be thinking the same thing. “Born,” he said, sounding nervous. “And they’re getting stronger.” Grand Pabbie motioned to Mama.
paras.zh: 爸爸似乎也想到了同样的问题。“与生俱来的，”他紧张地说。“而且越来越强了。”皮比向妈妈示意。

paras.en: She kneeled down and held Anna out to him, and he put his hand on Anna’s head.
paras.zh: 她跪下，把安娜递给他，他把一只手放在安娜头上。

paras.en: His bushy eyebrows furrowed. “You are lucky it wasn’t her heart.
paras.zh: 他浓密的眉毛皱起。“幸好不是伤在心上。

paras.en: The heart is not so easily changed.” He shrugged. “But the head can be persuaded.” Papa looked at Mama in surprise. “Do what you must,” he told Grand Pabbie. “I recommend we remove all magic, even memories of magic, to be safe,” Grand Pabbie said.
paras.zh: 心可没那么容易改变。”他耸耸肩。“但头脑可以说服。”爸爸惊讶地看着妈妈。“您放手去做吧，”他对皮比说。“为安全起见，我建议抹去全部的魔法，连关于魔法的记忆也一并抹去，”皮比说。

paras.en: Remove all magic? “But she won’t remember I have powers?” Elsa asked, unable to keep quiet. “It’s for the best,” Papa said, touching her shoulder.
paras.zh: 抹去全部魔法？“可她就不记得我有力量了？”艾莎忍不住问。“这是最好的安排，”爸爸说着，碰了碰她的肩膀。

paras.en: Elsa’s circle of people she could trust was small already.
paras.zh: 艾莎能信任的人本就寥寥无几。

paras.en: If Anna didn’t remember she could do magic, who could she share the burden with?
paras.zh: 要是安娜不记得她会魔法，她还能和谁分担这份重担？

paras.en: Her heart started to beat faster.
paras.zh: 她的心跳开始加速。

paras.en: Anna was her fiercest ally.
paras.zh: 安娜是她最铁的盟友。

paras.en: Her baking partner.
paras.zh: 她的烘焙搭档。

paras.en: Her sister.
paras.zh: 她的妹妹。

paras.en: They couldn’t keep secrets from each other. “Listen to me, Elsa,” Grand Pabbie said gently, as if he had heard her thoughts. “Your power will only grow.” He raised his hands to the sky and blue images filled the air.
paras.zh: 她们之间不能有秘密。“听我说，艾莎，”皮比温柔地说，仿佛听见了她的想法。“你的力量只会增长。”他把手举向天空，蓝色的影像布满空中。

paras.en: They turned into the outlines of people and a girl.
paras.zh: 影像化作人群和一个女孩的轮廓。

paras.en: The girl conjured up the most beautiful snowflake Elsa had ever seen. “There is beauty in it, but also great danger.” The snowflake turned bright red and burst.
paras.zh: 那女孩变出艾莎见过最美的雪花。“其中既有美，也有巨大的危险。”雪花变成艳红，炸裂开来。

paras.en: Elsa’s eyes widened. “You must learn to control it,” Grand Pabbie told her. “Fear will be your enemy.” The people’s outlines turned red while the girl in the middle stayed blue.
paras.zh: 艾莎瞪大了眼睛。“你必须学会控制它，”皮比对她说。“恐惧将是你的敌人。”人群的轮廓变成红色，而中间的女孩仍是蓝色。

paras.en: Elsa could sense the girl’s fear.
paras.zh: 艾莎能感受到那女孩的恐惧。

paras.en: Was this meant to be her destiny?
paras.zh: 这难道就是她命中注定的归宿？

paras.en: Would she be an outcast?
paras.zh: 她会成为被放逐的人吗？

paras.en: The red crowds closed in on the girl.
paras.zh: 红色的人群向那女孩逼近。

paras.en: Elsa heard a scream, and the image shattered.
paras.zh: 艾莎听见一声尖叫，影像碎裂了。

paras.en: She hid her face in her father’s chest. “No!” Papa said, and looked at Mama. “We’ll protect her.
paras.zh: 她把脸埋进爸爸的胸口。“不！”爸爸说，望向妈妈。“我们会保护她。

paras.en: She can learn to control it.
paras.zh: 她能学会控制它。

paras.en: I’m sure.
paras.zh: 我确信。

paras.en: We’ll keep her powers hidden from everyone.” He looked at Elsa and paused. “Including Anna.” “No!
paras.zh: 我们会把她的力量对所有人隐瞒。”他看着艾莎，顿了顿。“包括安娜。”“不！

paras.en: Please, no!” Elsa begged.
paras.zh: 求求你，不要！”艾莎恳求。

paras.en: This was too much. “I won’t hurt her again.
paras.zh: 这太过分了。“我不会再伤到她了。

paras.en: I promise.” She looked at Mama. “This isn’t a punishment, darling,” her mother said. “You heard your father and Grand Pabbie.
paras.zh: 我保证。”她看着妈妈。“这不是惩罚，亲爱的，”妈妈说。“你听见你爸爸和皮比说的话了。

paras.en: We must protect both of you.” Elsa couldn’t believe it.
paras.zh: 我们必须保护你们两个。”艾莎不敢相信。

paras.en: She didn’t want Anna not to know the true her.
paras.zh: 她不想让安娜不认识真正的自己。

paras.en: Anna believed in her gift.
paras.zh: 安娜相信她的天赋。

paras.en: Other than her parents, Anna was the only one she could share it with.
paras.zh: 除了父母，安娜是唯一能和她分享的人。

paras.en: Who would she make snow with?
paras.zh: 她还能和谁一起造雪？

paras.en: Without Anna, a gift like this wasn’t much fun at all. “She will be safe this way, Elsa,” Grand Pabbie reminded her. “You both will be.” Elsa tried to think of something that would change their minds, but she couldn’t even get her parents’ attention.
paras.zh: 没有安娜，这样的天赋一点意思都没有。“这样她才安全，艾莎，”皮比提醒她。“你们俩都会安全。”艾莎想找出什么能让他们改变主意，却连父母的注意力都引不来。

paras.en: They were focused on Anna.
paras.zh: 他们的注意力都在安娜身上。

paras.en: Elsa watched in agony as Grand Pabbie touched Anna’s head, then swept his hand into the air.
paras.zh: 艾莎痛苦地看着皮比的手触上安娜的额头，又向空中一挥。

paras.en: Papa patted Elsa’s back. “I know this is hard, but you’re a brave girl.
paras.zh: 爸爸拍了拍艾莎的后背。“我知道这很难，可你是个勇敢的姑娘。

paras.en: You want what’s best for Anna, don’t you?” “Yes,” Elsa said, but she was also thinking, I need Anna.
paras.zh: 你希望安娜好，对不对？”“对，”艾莎说，可她心里也在想：我需要安娜。

paras.en: She’s the only one who understands. “Yes, but Anna is the only one I can share my gift with.
paras.zh: 她是唯一懂我的人。“对，可安娜是唯一能让我分享天赋的人。

paras.en: Don’t take that away.” “You’ll be fine, Elsa,” her father promised.
paras.zh: 别把那夺走。”“你会没事的，艾莎，”爸爸保证。

paras.en: There was a whistling, like the sound of wind, and then an icy blue cloud formed above their heads.
paras.zh: 一阵呼啸，像风声，接着一团冰蓝色的云在他们头顶成形。

paras.en: It reminded Elsa of her own magic.
paras.zh: 那让艾莎想起自己的魔法。

paras.en: She watched as images of her and Anna flashed by: the two of them playing in the snow in the Great Hall, ice-skating across its floor, and building Olaf…all the things they’d done that would have been impossible without magic.
paras.zh: 她看着自己和安娜的影像闪过：两人在大礼堂里玩雪，在地板上的冰面上滑冰，还有堆雪宝……所有这些事，没有魔法就不可能发生。

paras.en: How had Grand Pabbie been able to pull those memories out of her sister’s head?
paras.zh: 皮比是怎么从妹妹的脑海里抽出这些记忆的？

paras.en: Just as quickly, the memories of her and Anna changed.
paras.zh: 同样地快，她和安娜的记忆变了样。

paras.en: The Great Hall moment turned into one of Anna sledding outside.
paras.zh: 大礼堂的那幕变成了安娜在外面滑雪橇。

paras.en: The two of them ice-skating indoors became an excursion on a nearby pond, and their time with Olaf indoors morphed into a scene of them building a snowman in the forest.
paras.zh: 两人在室内滑冰变成在附近池塘出游，她们和雪宝在室内的时光，变成了在森林里堆雪人的一幕。

paras.en: Their memories were being erased.
paras.zh: 她们的记忆正被抹去。

paras.en: It was more than Elsa could bear. “No, please!” Elsa cried, feeling the warmth tingle in her fingertips.
paras.zh: 这超出了艾莎能承受的限度。“不，求求你！”艾莎哭道，感到指尖传来温暖的麻痒。

paras.en: A blue glow hovered above her hands. “Don’t worry.
paras.zh: 一团蓝光悬在她手上。“别担心。

paras.en: I will leave the fun,” Grand Pabbie promised.
paras.zh: 我会留下那些欢乐，”皮比答应道。

paras.en: But it wasn’t about fun.
paras.zh: 可这不只是关于欢乐。

paras.en: It was about the two of them sharing a gift Elsa had been given.
paras.zh: 这是关于她们俩分享艾莎被赋予的天赋。

paras.en: And now the leader of the trolls was taking it away.
paras.zh: 而现在，地精的首领要把它夺走。
