paras.en: Elsa watched in agony as Grand Pabbie swirled the images into a ball, just as she usually conjured snow.
paras.zh: 艾莎痛苦地看着皮比把影像旋成一个球，就像她平时变出雪那样。

paras.en: His hands slowly moved toward Anna’s head.
paras.zh: 他的手缓缓移向安娜的额头。

paras.en: Elsa already knew what would happen.
paras.zh: 艾莎已经知道会发生什么。

paras.en: When Grand Pabbie touched her, the new memories would replace the old ones.
paras.zh: 皮比一碰到她，新的记忆就会取代旧的。

paras.en: Anna and Elsa’s bond would be lost forever.
paras.zh: 安娜和艾莎之间的纽带将永远断掉。

paras.en: Elsa couldn’t let that happen. “No!” she cried, pulling from her father’s embrace.
paras.zh: 艾莎不能让这种事发生。“不！”她哭着，从爸爸的怀抱中挣脱。

paras.en: Her hand connected with Grand Pabbie’s just as his fingers grazed Anna’s forehead. “Elsa, no!” Papa cried as Mama reached for her in a panic.
paras.zh: 她的手正好撞上皮比的手，而他的手指刚擦过安娜的额头。“艾莎，不要！”爸爸喊，妈妈惊慌地去抓她。

paras.en: But it was too late.
paras.zh: 可已经太迟了。

paras.en: An explosion of light vibrated off the boulders around them.
paras.zh: 一团爆裂的光从四周的巨石上震颤开来。

paras.en: Rocks began to crumble and fall from the mountains the valley was nestled between.
paras.zh: 岩石开始碎裂，从环抱山谷的群山上坠落。

paras.en: The trolls ran for cover.
paras.zh: 地精们四散躲避。

paras.en: The light grew brighter and brighter till it burst into what seemed like a million little stars.
paras.zh: 光越来越亮，终于炸开，化作仿佛百万颗小星星。

paras.en: It was the last thing Elsa saw before her world faded to black.
paras.zh: 那是艾莎的世界陷入黑暗前，她看见的最后景象。

paras.en: Elsa awoke from the vivid memory, gasping for air as if she’d been underwater too long.
paras.zh: 艾莎从那段鲜活的回忆中醒来，大口喘着气，仿佛在水下憋了太久。

paras.en: She inhaled deeply, trying hard to remember to keep breathing. “Elsa!
paras.zh: 她深深吸了一口气，努力提醒自己继续呼吸。“艾莎！

paras.en: Elsa!” Olaf was standing over her. “You collapsed!
paras.zh: 艾莎！”雪宝正站在她身旁。“你晕倒了！

paras.en: Are you okay?” Someone was pounding on her bedroom door. “Princess Elsa!
paras.zh: 你没事吧？”有人在敲她的卧室门。“艾莎公主！

paras.en: Princess Elsa!
paras.zh: 艾莎公主！

paras.en: Are you all right?” It was Hans. “Why isn’t she answering?” she heard him shout. “Princess?” It was Lord Peterssen. “Can you hear us?” “Yes!” Elsa called out, her voice sounding shaky. “I will be right there.” How long had she been out? “Elsa, what happened?” Olaf asked.
paras.zh: 你还好吗？”是汉斯。“她怎么不答应？”她听见他喊道。“公主？”是彼得森伯爵。“你能听见我们吗？”“能！”艾莎应了一声，声音有些发颤。“我马上就来。”她到底昏了多久？“艾莎，发生什么事了？”雪宝问。

paras.en: Elsa sat up, her whole body feeling like jelly.
paras.zh: 艾莎坐起身，浑身软得像果冻一样。

paras.en: The memory cut like a knife.
paras.zh: 那段记忆像刀子一样刺进心里。

paras.en: Her powers weren’t new; her parents had known she’d possessed them all along, but somehow she’d forgotten them.
paras.zh: 她的魔力并不新奇；父母一直都知道她拥有魔力，可不知为何，她自己却把它忘了。

paras.en: The pain of that truth and what had happened almost overwhelmed her. “Anna was my sister,” she choked out. “My magic killed her.”
paras.zh: 真相与此事带来的痛苦几乎将她击垮。“安娜是我的妹妹，”她哽咽着说，“是我的魔法害死了她。”

paras.en: Anna’s cheeks were flushed with excitement.
paras.zh: 安娜的脸颊因兴奋而泛红。

paras.en: It was coronation day!
paras.zh: 今天是加冕典礼的日子！

paras.en: The bakery was packed.
paras.zh: 面包房里挤满了人。

paras.en: Even though most people she knew wouldn’t travel to Arendelle to see Princess Elsa’s coronation in person, Harmon was still celebrating in its own way.
paras.zh: 尽管她认识的多数人不会亲自赶到阿伦黛尔去看艾莎公主的加冕，哈蒙镇仍以它自己的方式在庆祝。

paras.en: Many people were closing their shops early and planning to rejoice in the streets with shared food, good friends, and dancing.
paras.zh: 许多人提前关了店，打算走上街头，用分享的食物、好友和舞蹈来欢庆。

paras.en: Ma had baked several cakes for the occasion, Goran from the market was bringing a roasted pig and potatoes, and Papa had talked with some men who were bringing their lutes.
paras.zh: 妈妈为这个场合烤了好几个蛋糕，市场的戈兰会带一头烤猪和土豆来，爸爸也跟几个会带鲁特琴的男人说好了。

paras.en: It was a glorious summer day, and she could feel the charge in the air.
paras.zh: 那是个明媚的夏日，她能感到空气中涌动的兴奋。

paras.en: After three years without a true leader, Arendelle was finally getting its queen.
paras.zh: 在失去真正的君主三年之后，阿伦黛尔终于要有自己的女王了。

paras.en: Coronation day was all about new beginnings and fresh starts.
paras.zh: 加冕日意味着全新的开始与崭新的出发。

paras.en: Anna wished the day when she, too, would get her new beginning could arrive sooner rather than later, but how could she argue with her parents?
paras.zh: 安娜希望，属于她自己的新开始也能早些到来，可她又怎么能跟父母争辩呢？

paras.en: She was still young.
paras.zh: 她还年轻。

paras.en: Sort of.
paras.zh: 算是吧。

paras.en: And they needed her help.
paras.zh: 而且他们需要她帮忙。

paras.en: Definitely.
paras.zh: 绝对需要。

paras.en: Three more years would go by fast…she hoped. “Thank you, Anna!” Mrs.
paras.zh: 再过三年应该很快会过去……她希望如此。“谢谢你，安娜！”埃里克森太太

paras.en: Eriksen said as Anna placed several cinnamon buns in a bag for her. “I will see you later at the party.” “See you tonight!” Anna said, watching Mrs.
paras.zh: 埃里克森太太说着，安娜正把几个肉桂卷装进袋子给她。“晚点派对上见。”“今晚见！”安娜看着埃里克森太太

paras.en: Eriksen open the bakery door.
paras.zh: 埃里克森太太打开面包房的门。

paras.en: When it opened, Anna noticed a young man outside with a reindeer.
paras.zh: 门一开，安娜注意到门外有个年轻人，身边还有一头驯鹿。

paras.en: Their backs were to the door.
paras.zh: 他们背对着门。

paras.en: Kristoff!
paras.zh: 克里斯托夫！

paras.en: She couldn’t believe he had come.
paras.zh: 她简直不敢相信他来了。

paras.en: She wiped her hands on her apron and rushed outside, hearing Kristoff’s conversation with Sven in the process. “Yes, I’m going to talk to her.
paras.zh: 她把双手在围裙上擦干，冲了出去，一路上听见克里斯托夫正和斯文说话。“对，我要去跟她谈谈。

paras.en: Maybe.” Kristoff huffed. “You, Bulda, Grand Pabbie…you act like this is so easy!
paras.zh: 也许吧。”克里斯托夫哼了一声。“你、布尔达、皮比……你们好像觉得这事儿轻而易举！

paras.en: They may be so-called love experts, but they’ve never left the valley.” Sven snorted. “Hi,” Anna interrupted, feeling funny.
paras.zh: 他们也许是所谓的爱情专家，可他们从没离开过山谷。”斯文喷了喷鼻子。“嗨，”安娜插话道，觉得有点不自在。

paras.en: She was suddenly very aware of how she looked, and how he did, too.
paras.zh: 她突然格外在意自己的模样，也在意他眼里的自己。

paras.en: Kristoff had on a bright blue dress shirt and clean pants.
paras.zh: 克里斯托夫穿着一件亮蓝色的衬衫，裤子也干干净净。

paras.en: She was wearing a green dress under a flour-and-icing-covered apron.
paras.zh: 她身上套着一件绿裙子，外面罩着沾满面粉和糖霜的围裙。

paras.en: Her braids, which she’d had in for two days, needed refreshing. “Were you looking for me?
paras.zh: 她编了两天没拆的辫子也该重新打理了。“你是在找我吗？

paras.en: I mean, not actually looking, but you’re here, so maybe…you’re hungry?” He immediately blushed. “What?
paras.zh: 我是说，不是真的在找，但你来了，所以也许……你饿了吧？”他立刻脸红了。“什么？

paras.en: Yes.
paras.zh: 是的。

paras.en: I mean, no.
paras.zh: 我是说，不是。

paras.en: I…” He pressed a bunch of carrots into her hands. “I just wanted to give you what I owed you.” “Oh.” Anna looked down. “You didn’t have to bring me back— oof! ” Sven had bumped into Anna, sending her flying into Kristoff’s arms.
paras.zh: 我……”他把一捆胡萝卜塞进她手里。“我只是想把欠你的还给你。”“哦。”安娜低下头。“你不必专门给我送回来——哎哟！”斯文撞上了安娜，把她整个人撞进了克里斯托夫怀里。

paras.en: The two tumbled backward, falling onto several stacks of flour Anna’s parents hadn’t had a chance to bring into the shop yet. “This is awkward,” Anna said, struggling to get up. “Not because you’re awkward.
paras.zh: 两人一起往后倒，跌在安娜父母还没来得及搬进店里的几摞面粉袋上。“真尴尬，”安娜边挣扎着起身边说，“不是因为你尴尬。

paras.en: Because we’re…I’m…awkward.” She stood up. “You’re gorgeous.
paras.zh: 是因为我们……我……尴尬。”她站起来。“你真好看。

paras.en: Wait, what?” She’d never said anything like that before.
paras.zh: 等等，什么？”她从没说过这种话。

paras.en: Did she think Kristoff was gorgeous?
paras.zh: 她觉得克里斯托夫好看吗？

paras.en: She needed to change the subject fast. “So that’s the only reason you came by?
paras.zh: 她得赶紧换个话题。“所以你过来就为了这个？

paras.en: To give me carrots?” “Oh.
paras.zh: 给我送胡萝卜？”“哦。

paras.en: Uh…” Kristoff looked like a reindeer caught in carriage lights. “Uh…” Sven kept snorting. “I can’t stay.
paras.zh: 呃……”克里斯托夫一脸像被车灯照住的驯鹿的表情。“呃……”斯文不停地喷鼻子。“我待不住了。

paras.en: I have a delivery in Arendelle, so I’m headed down the mountain.” “Down the mountain?” Anna cut in. “That’s where I’m going!
paras.zh: 我在阿伦黛尔有个送货的活儿，正要下山去呢。”“下山？”安娜插嘴道，“我也要去那边！

paras.en: Well, not today, but in three years.
paras.zh: 嗯，不是今天，是三年以后。

paras.en: I’m going to open up my own bakery in Arendelle.” Kristoff scratched his head. “In three years?” “Yes,” Anna said. “My parents want me to run their shop, but I want to leave Harmon someday.” Kristoff just looked at her. “You should understand.
paras.zh: 我要在阿伦黛尔开一家自己的面包房。”克里斯托夫挠了挠头。“三年以后？”“对，”安娜说，“我父母想让我接管他们的店，可我想总有一天离开哈蒙。”克里斯托夫只是看着她。“你应该能理解。

paras.en: You get to see the whole kingdom with your ice business!
paras.zh: 你做冰生意，能把整个王国都看遍！

paras.en: Your carriage takes you everywhere, while I’m always stuck here.” “I wouldn’t call it stuck ,” Kristoff muttered. “Seems like a nice place to live.
paras.zh: 你的马车带你去任何地方，而我总被困在这儿。”“我可不会说‘被困’，”克里斯托夫嘟囔，“这儿看着倒是个宜居的好地方。

paras.en: Try begging to sleep in people’s barns all the time when you’re on the road and being raised in a field full of rocks.” “What?” Anna thought she must have heard him incorrectly. “Nothing.” Kristoff looked away.
paras.zh: 你试试在路上总求着睡别人的谷仓、在满是石头的野地里长大是什么滋味。”“什么？”安娜觉得自己一定是听错了。“没什么。”克里斯托夫把目光移开。

paras.en: Anna thought again of the life Freya had lost.
paras.zh: 安娜又想起弗雷娅失去的生活。

paras.en: She didn’t want to waste another moment being in a place she didn’t truly love. “You don’t understand.” She played with one of her braids.
paras.zh: 她不想再浪费一刻待在自己并不真正热爱的地方。“你不明白。”她摆弄着一条辫子。

paras.en: Three years feels so far away. “Hey.” Kristoff moved closer. “Your hair.” “Oh.” She was used to this question. “The white stripe?
paras.zh: 三年感觉好遥远。“嘿。”克里斯托夫凑近了些。“你的头发。”“哦。”她对这个问题早已习惯。“那道白条纹？

paras.en: I was born with it,” she explained. “That’s what my parents were told.
paras.zh: 我生来就有，”她解释道，“我父母是这么听说的。

paras.en: They actually adopted me when I was a baby.
paras.zh: 他们其实是在我婴儿时收养了我。

paras.en: I dreamt that I was kissed by a troll.” Kristoff’s eyes widened. “Did you say ‘troll’?” He hurried after her to hear more.
paras.zh: 我梦见自己被地精亲吻过。”克里斯托夫睁大了眼睛。“你说‘地精’？”他连忙跟上她，想听更多。

paras.en: “Anna is…dead?” Olaf repeated as if he didn’t understand the words coming out of his mouth.
paras.zh: “安娜……死了？”雪宝重复着，仿佛听不懂从自己嘴里说出的话。

paras.en: Elsa saw his heartbroken face and heard a sob escape her lips before she even realized it was happening. “I think I killed her.” A blue glow appeared above her fingers, ice escaping and climbing up the walls and covering the floor.
paras.zh: 艾莎看着他心碎的脸，还没反应过来，自己嘴里已先溢出一声呜咽。“我想是我害死了她。”她指尖泛起蓝光，冰从指间逃逸，顺着墙壁爬升，铺满了地板。

paras.en: The world waited outside her door, pounding harder to get in.
paras.zh: 门外的人还在敲门，敲得更急了，想要闯进来。

paras.en: The ice couldn’t have come at a worse time, but Elsa was too consumed with grief to care who saw it now.
paras.zh: 冰来得再不是时候不过了，可艾莎沉浸在悲伤里，已经顾不上谁会看见。

paras.en: Anna was dead.
paras.zh: 安娜死了。

paras.en: That was why her parents had hidden her sister’s existence from her.
paras.zh: 这就是父母向她隐瞒妹妹存在的缘由。

paras.en: No wonder Mama had always looked so forlorn.
paras.zh: 难怪妈妈总是一副愁容。

paras.en: Elsa had changed the footprint of their family forever.
paras.zh: 艾莎永远地改变了这个家庭的模样。

paras.en: How could her parents forgive her for what she had done?
paras.zh: 父母怎么可能原谅她的所作所为？

paras.en: How could the kingdom?
paras.zh: 整个王国又怎么能原谅？

paras.en: Wait.
paras.zh: 等等。

paras.en: Elsa stopped crying and thought of the fountain in the courtyard and their family portrait in the hallway.
paras.zh: 艾莎止住哭泣，想起庭院里的喷泉，还有走廊上那幅全家画像。

paras.en: Both showed a family of three.
paras.zh: 两幅画里都只有三口之家。

paras.en: Wouldn’t her parents and Mr.
paras.zh: 难道父母和路登堡先生不想让安娜活在记忆里，把她的样子画进这些作品吗？

paras.en: Ludenburg want to keep Anna’s memory alive by including her in such works of art?
paras.zh: 路登堡先生难道不想吗？

paras.en: Wouldn’t people talk about the lost princess?
paras.zh: 难道人们不会提起这位失踪的公主？

paras.en: Why would her parents have hidden a painting of their original family in Elsa’s lockbox?
paras.zh: 父母为何要把一幅原本一家人的画像藏进艾莎的保险箱？

paras.en: Yet no one had ever uttered a word about Anna before.
paras.zh: 可在此之前，从没有谁提过安娜一个字。

paras.en: In fact, Mama had always told people who asked that she couldn’t have any other children after Elsa. “This doesn’t make sense,” Elsa said, her questions coming faster.
paras.zh: 事实上，有人问起时，妈妈总说她生下艾莎后再也不能有孩子了。“这说不通啊，”艾莎说，脑子里的问题一个接一个冒出来。

paras.en: She felt her heart quicken and heard a whooshing in her ears.
paras.zh: 她感到心跳加速，耳边嗡嗡作响。

paras.en: She was missing something, but what? “I know people have always tried to protect me, but how could Mama and Papa make the whole kingdom forget I had a sister?” “I don’t know,” Olaf said, toddling over. “Maybe this letter will explain it.
paras.zh: 她漏掉了什么，可到底是什么呢？“我知道大家一直想保护我，可妈妈和爸爸怎么能让整个王国都忘了我有个妹妹？”“我不知道，”雪宝迈着小碎步走过来说，“也许这封信能解释。

paras.en: When you dropped the painting, this was underneath it.” Elsa looked up in surprise. “Letter?” Olaf held a piece of parchment in his twig hand.
paras.zh: 你掉下那幅画时，信就压在下面。”艾莎惊讶地抬起头。“信？”雪宝用树枝般的小手举着一张羊皮纸。

paras.en: Elsa recognized the handwriting immediately.
paras.zh: 艾莎立刻认出了那字迹。

paras.en: It was Mama’s. “Elsa!” Lord Peterssen and Hans were both calling to her now, pounding on the door again. “Elsa, are you all right?
paras.zh: 是妈妈的。“艾莎！”彼得森伯爵和汉斯此时都在门外喊她，又敲起门来。“艾莎，你还好吗？

paras.en: Answer us!” Elsa didn’t answer.
paras.zh: 回答我们！”艾莎没有应声。

paras.en: Fingers trembling, she reached for the letter in Olaf’s outstretched hand just as she heard a key jingling in her door.
paras.zh: 她手指发颤，伸向雪宝摊开的小手里的信，就在这时，她听见门锁里传来钥匙的叮当声。

paras.en: Her heart pounding, she skimmed the letter quickly.
paras.zh: 她心怦怦直跳，匆匆扫过那封信。

paras.en: There was no time to read it carefully.
paras.zh: 没时间细读了。

paras.en: Instead, she searched for the answer she most needed to find.
paras.zh: 她转而寻找自己最需要的答案。

paras.en: Her eyes passed over words and phrases like trolls , the Valley of the Living Rock , and a secret we’ve hidden for years , and she kept searching till she found what she was looking for.
paras.zh: 她的目光掠过“地精”“活石山谷”“我们藏了多年的秘密”这样的字眼，不停地找，终于找到了想要的内容。

paras.en: We love you and your sister very much, but circumstance forced us to keep you apart.
paras.zh: 我们非常爱你和你的妹妹，但环境所迫，只得让你们分离。

paras.en: Keep us apart?
paras.zh: 让我们分离？

paras.en: Did that mean Anna was alive?
paras.zh: 难道这意味着安娜还活着？

paras.en: Elsa started to laugh and cry at the same time.
paras.zh: 艾莎又哭又笑，两种情绪同时涌上。

paras.en: She was not alone.
paras.zh: 她并非孤身一人。

paras.en: She had a sister! “Olaf!
paras.zh: 她有个妹妹！“雪宝！

paras.en: She’s alive!
paras.zh: 她还活着！

paras.en: Anna’s alive!” Elsa said as the commotion outside her door increased.
paras.zh: 安娜还活着！”艾莎说，门外的喧闹声越来越响。

paras.en: Olaf’s face broke into a toothy grin. “Where is she?
paras.zh: 雪宝的脸上绽开缺牙的笑。“她在哪儿？

paras.en: We have to find her!” “I know!
paras.zh: 我们得找到她！”“我知道！

paras.en: I know!” Elsa looked down at the letter again, prepared to actually read it this time and learn how this was possible.
paras.zh: 我知道！”艾莎再次低头看着信，准备这次真正读一遍，弄明白这怎么可能。

paras.en: Our darling Elsa, if you’re reading this, we’re gone.
paras.zh: 亲爱的艾莎，如果你读到这封信，我们已不在人世。

paras.en: Otherwise— Her bedroom door flew open.
paras.zh: 否则——”她的卧室门猛地被推开了。

paras.en: The letter slipped from Elsa’s hands as Olaf dove for the dressing area.
paras.zh: 信从艾莎手中滑落，雪宝则一头扎向更衣区。

paras.en: Hans rushed into the room. “Elsa!” he said, his face filled with fear. “What happened?
paras.zh: 汉斯冲进房间。“艾莎！”他脸上写满惊恐，“发生什么事了？

paras.en: Are you all right?” “I’m fine!” Elsa insisted, pushing Hans out the door as he, Lord Peterssen, Gerda, and the Duke attempted to enter.
paras.zh: 你还好吗？”“我没事！”艾莎坚持道，把正要进门的汉斯、彼得森伯爵、格尔达和公爵一起往外推。

paras.en: She moved into the hallway, shut the door behind her, and realized Kai and Olina were also there.
paras.zh: 她退到走廊，关上门，这才发现凯和奥丽娜也在那儿。

paras.en: Elsa wondered: were they in on the secret, too?
paras.zh: 艾莎心想：他们是否也知道这个秘密？

paras.en: Did they know about Anna and where she was?
paras.zh: 他们知道安娜的事，知道她在哪儿吗？

paras.en: She had so many new questions that needed answers.
paras.zh: 她有太多新问题需要答案。

paras.en: Lord Peterssen clutched his chest. “We thought you were hurt.” “No,” Elsa said, laughing despite herself. “I’m fine.
paras.zh: 彼得森伯爵捂着胸口。“我们还以为你受伤了。”“没有，”艾莎说，忍不住笑了起来，“我没事。

paras.en: I’m better than fine.
paras.zh: 比没事还好。

paras.en: Truly.” “Why wouldn’t you answer us?” Hans pleaded. “We thought…” The Duke looked sharply at Elsa over his spectacles. “We thought you were running away from Prince Hans’s proposal.” “Proposal?” Elsa repeated, and then she remembered all at once what they had been discussing before she heard Olaf’s crash and hurried back inside her room. “I…” She needed to read that letter.
paras.zh: 真的。” “你为什么不应我们？”汉斯恳求道，“我们以为……”公爵从眼镜上方锐利地盯住艾莎。“我们以为你是在躲开汉斯王子的求婚。”“求婚？”艾莎重复道，随即一下子想起，在听见雪宝的撞击声、匆匆跑回房之前，他们正谈着什么。“我……”她得读那封信。

paras.en: What circumstances forced her parents to separate their daughters?
paras.zh: 是什么环境迫使父母把两个女儿分开？

paras.en: Why didn’t she learn about her powers until her parents’ death?
paras.zh: 为什么直到父母离世，她才知道自己有魔力？

paras.en: Why didn’t the rest of the kingdom talk about Anna?
paras.zh: 为什么王国里别的人都不提安娜？

paras.en: If her sister was alive, where was she?
paras.zh: 如果妹妹还活着，她在哪里？

paras.en: Had Elsa frightened her away with her magic?
paras.zh: 是艾莎用魔法把她吓跑了吗？

paras.en: She needed to read the letter immediately. “Yes, Prince Hans is waiting for an answer,” said the Duke, motioning to a confused Hans. “I think this conversation should wait till after the coronation,” Hans said. “Yes, we need to go to the chapel,” Lord Peterssen reminded the Duke.
paras.zh: 她得立刻读那封信。“是的，汉斯王子在等一个答复，”公爵朝一脸茫然的汉斯使了个眼色说，“我觉得这番话还是等加冕之后再谈吧，”汉斯说。“对，我们得去小教堂了，”彼得森伯爵提醒公爵。

paras.en: Gerda placed a hand on Elsa’s arm. “Princess, you look flushed.” “Hans, I…” Elsa looked from the prince to the others.
paras.zh: 格尔达把手放在艾莎臂上。“公主，你脸色发红。”“汉斯，我……”艾莎的目光从王子移到其他人身上。

paras.en: All she could think about was Mama’s letter. “I need another moment.” She reached for the door handle.
paras.zh: 她脑中只想得起妈妈的信。“我再需要一会儿。”她伸手去够门把手。

paras.en: The Duke held the door closed. “I think you’ve spent enough time shutting people out,” he said firmly. “Don’t you?” Elsa felt a flash of anger at the Duke’s words. “You can’t talk to the princess like that,” Hans said.
paras.zh: 公爵把门按住。“我想你已经把人关在外面够久了，”他硬邦邦地说，“不是吗？”艾莎对公爵的话腾起一股怒火。“你不能这样跟公主说话，”汉斯说。

paras.en: The two started arguing.
paras.zh: 两人吵了起来。

paras.en: Elsa looked desperately back at her door.
paras.zh: 艾莎绝望地回头望着自己的门。

paras.en: A letter with keys to her past was on one side, while Hans and the Duke were trying to decide her future on the other.
paras.zh: 一边是藏着开启她过往之钥的信，另一边是汉斯和公爵正替她决定未来。

paras.en: Her fingertips started to tingle, and this time she couldn’t hold her emotions back.
paras.zh: 她的指尖开始发麻，这一次她再压不住情绪。

paras.en: She needed to get to that letter. “I’m not doing this right now,” Elsa said shakily, and the Duke tried to interrupt her again. “Now if you’ll excuse me.” The Duke touched her arm. “Princess, if I may—” The tremors going through her body came in waves.
paras.zh: 她得拿到那封信。“我现在没空应付这个，”艾莎声音发颤地说，公爵又想打断她。“现在请恕我失陪。”公爵碰了碰她的手臂。“公主，请允许我——”她全身的颤抖一阵接一阵。

paras.en: Her high collar was beginning to itch terribly, and her emotions were too strong to control. “No, you may not,” Elsa snapped. “I need to go back to my room.
paras.zh: 她的高领开始痒得厉害，情绪强烈得无法控制。“不，你不可以，”艾莎厉声说，“我要回自己房间。

paras.en: You should leave.” “Leave?” The Duke looked outraged. “Before the coronation?” “Princess, there is no time to go back to your room again,” Lord Peterssen pleaded. “The priest is waiting,” Kai added. “Princess?” Gerda said, sounding unsure. “Are you all right?” No, she wasn’t all right.
paras.zh: 你该离开。”“离开？”公爵一脸愤慨，“加冕前就走？”“公主，没时间再回房了，”彼得森伯爵恳求道。“神父在等呢，”凯补了一句。“公主？”格尔达犹豫地问道，“你还好吗？”不好，她一点都不好。

paras.en: She needed to read that letter.
paras.zh: 她得读那封信。

paras.en: Circumstance forced us to keep you apart.
paras.zh: 环境所迫，只得让你们分离。

paras.en: She needed to find Anna.
paras.zh: 她得找到安娜。

paras.en: They’d been separated for far too long.
paras.zh: 他们分离得太久了。

paras.en: Elsa looked from the crowd in front of her to her door again.
paras.zh: 艾莎从眼前的人群望回自己的门。

paras.en: If they wouldn’t let her enter, she’d find another way back inside.
paras.zh: 既然他们不让她进，她就另找路子回到屋里。

paras.en: The castle had many secret passages.
paras.zh: 城堡里有许多密道。

paras.en: She’d go around.
paras.zh: 她从旁边绕。

paras.en: Elsa tried pushing her way through the crowd in desperation.
paras.zh: 艾莎拼命想从人群中挤过去。

paras.en: Her sleeves felt so tight; she could barely move her arms. “Elsa, wait.” Hans reached for her, accidentally pulling off one of her gloves. “Give me my glove!” Elsa panicked.
paras.zh: 她的袖子紧得要命，胳膊几乎动弹不得。“艾莎，等等。”汉斯伸手拉她，不小心扯下了她一只手套。“把手套还我！”艾莎慌了。

paras.en: Hans held it out of reach. “Something is troubling you.
paras.zh: 汉斯把手套举到她够不到的地方。“你心里有事。

paras.en: Please just talk to me,” he said. “Let me help you.” “Princess!
paras.zh: 求你了，跟我说说吧，”他说，“让我帮你。”“公主！

paras.en: The priest is waiting,” Lord Peterssen said. “Weselton is a close trade partner and I should be at the coronation…” the Duke was muttering.
paras.zh: 神父在等呢，”彼得森伯爵说，“威塞尔顿是亲近的贸易伙伴，我本该出席加冕礼的……”公爵还在嘟囔。

paras.en: Gerda tried to intervene. “The princess is upset.” Elsa closed her eyes. “Enough,” she whispered.
paras.zh: 格尔达想打圆场。“公主心情不好。”艾莎闭上眼睛。“够了，”她低声说。

paras.en: The Duke kept talking. “I was trying to help you present yourself in the best possible light after closing yourself away and…” Elsa needed him to stop talking.
paras.zh: 公爵还在说。“你把自己关起来之后，我本想帮你以最好的面貌示人，可是……”艾莎需要他闭嘴。

paras.en: All she could hear inside her head was Mama’s words.
paras.zh: 她脑海里只回响着妈妈的话。

paras.en: We love you and your sister very much.
paras.zh: 我们非常爱你和你的妹妹。

paras.en: Sister.
paras.zh: 妹妹。

paras.en: Sister.
paras.zh: 妹妹。

paras.en: She had a sister!
paras.zh: 她有个妹妹！

paras.en: Nothing else mattered.
paras.zh: 别的都不重要了。

paras.en: She pushed past them and ran down the hall.
paras.zh: 她推开他们，跑向走廊。

paras.en: The voices followed. “Princess, wait!” Kai cried.
paras.zh: 声音在身后追着。“公主，等等！”凯喊道。

paras.en: Elsa was done waiting.
paras.zh: 艾莎受够了等待。

paras.en: She needed to read that letter.
paras.zh: 她得读那封信。

paras.en: Sister.
paras.zh: 妹妹。

paras.en: Sister.
paras.zh: 妹妹。

paras.en: Her breathing became ragged and her fingers tingled so badly they burned. “Princess Elsa!” Hans called. “I said, enough!” Ice flew away from her hands with such force it shot across the floor, spiking into jagged, twisted icicles that formed an immediate barrier between her and the others.
paras.zh: 她的呼吸变得急促，手指麻得发烫。“艾莎公主！”汉斯喊道，“我说，够了！”冰从她手中猛地射出，横扫过地板，骤然刺出扭曲锋利的冰柱，在她和众人之间立起一道屏障。

paras.en: Hans jumped out of the way of a spike that threatened to hit him in the chest.
paras.zh: 汉斯跳开，躲开那根差点戳中他胸口的长刺。

paras.en: The Duke was knocked off his feet.
paras.zh: 公爵被掀翻在地。

paras.en: Frozen crystals of ice floated through the air and silently fell to the floor.
paras.zh: 冻结的冰晶飘在空中，悄无声息地落回地面。

paras.en: Elsa gasped in horror.
paras.zh: 艾莎惊恐地倒吸一口凉气。

paras.en: Her secret was a secret no more. “Sorcery,” she heard the Duke whisper.
paras.zh: 她的秘密再也不是秘密了。“妖术，”她听见公爵低语。

paras.en: His face pulsed with anger as he struggled to stand up. “So that’s why.
paras.zh: 他挣扎着站起来，脸上因愤怒而抽搐。“原来如此。

paras.en: I knew something dubious was going on here!” Elsa grasped her own hand in shock.
paras.zh: 我就知道这里有什么名堂！”艾莎震惊地攥紧自己的手。

paras.en: She locked eyes with Hans and saw his confusion. “Elsa?” he whispered.
paras.zh: 她与汉斯目光相交，看到他眼中的困惑。“艾莎？”他低声唤道。

paras.en: She did the only thing she still could do: run.
paras.zh: 她只能做唯一还能做的事：跑。

paras.en: Down the hall she raced, bursting through the closest set of doors she could find. “There she is!” someone cried.
paras.zh: 她沿着走廊飞奔，撞开离自己最近的那扇门。“她在那儿！”有人喊。

paras.en: Without realizing it, Elsa had exited the castle.
paras.zh: 艾莎不知不觉间已跑出了城堡。

paras.en: She was standing in the courtyard in front of the statue of her and her parents, where hundreds of people were waiting.
paras.zh: 她站在庭院里，面前是她和父母的雕像，几百人正等在那里。

paras.en: When they saw her, the people began to clap and cheer.
paras.zh: 人们看见她，开始鼓掌欢呼。

paras.en: Elsa started to back up, then heard voices.
paras.zh: 艾莎往后退，却听见了人声。

paras.en: Hans, Kai, the Duke, and Lord Peterssen were coming.
paras.zh: 汉斯、凯、公爵和彼得森伯爵正赶过来。

paras.en: With no choice, she ran down the steps, holding up her coronation gown as she darted into the crowd. “It is her!” someone shouted. “Princess Elsa!” People bowed to her.
paras.zh: 无可奈何，她跑下台阶，提起加冕礼服，一头扎进人群。“是她！”有人喊，“艾莎公主！”人们向她鞠躬。

paras.en: Elsa spun around, looking for a path out of the crowd.
paras.zh: 艾莎转着圈，想找出一条穿出人群的路。

paras.en: A man blocked her. “Our future queen!” Elsa’s heart was pounding.
paras.zh: 一个男人挡住她。“我们未来的女王！”艾莎的心怦怦直跳。

paras.en: She tried to go another way.
paras.zh: 她想换条路走。

paras.en: A woman holding a baby stepped forward. “Your Royal Highness,” she said kindly.
paras.zh: 一位抱着婴儿的妇女走上前。“殿下，”她温和地说。

paras.en: Elsa immediately thought of her mother and Anna. “Are you all right?” the woman asked. “No,” Elsa whispered, her eyes darting left and right as she backed up again.
paras.zh: 艾莎立刻想起母亲和安娜。“你还好吗？”妇女问。“不好，”艾莎低声说，眼睛左右乱瞟，又往后退去。

paras.en: She bumped into the fountain with the family statue behind her and put out her hands to stop herself.
paras.zh: 她撞上喷泉，背后就是家族雕像，她伸出双手想稳住自己。

paras.en: Instantly, the water in the fountain froze.
paras.zh: 刹那间，喷泉里的水冻住了。

paras.en: The geyser that was shooting high into the sky crystalized in midair, as if it were reaching out to grab her.
paras.zh: 那冲上天的高高水柱在半空中结晶，仿佛正伸出手要抓住她。

paras.en: The villagers shrieked. “There she is!” she heard the Duke shout from the castle steps. “Stop her!” Elsa saw Hans and Lord Peterssen and hesitated.
paras.zh: 村民尖叫起来。“她在那儿！”她听见公爵在城堡台阶上喊，“拦住她！”艾莎看见汉斯和彼得森伯爵，犹豫了一下。

paras.en: Hans was her safety net, but she couldn’t risk hurting him.
paras.zh: 汉斯是她的安全依靠，可她不能冒险伤到他。

paras.en: She couldn’t risk hurting anyone.
paras.zh: 她不能冒险伤到任何人。

paras.en: She thought about which way to run, but people were on all sides of her.
paras.zh: 她盘算着往哪边跑，可四面八方都是人。

paras.en: Didn’t they realize?
paras.zh: 他们难道不明白吗？

paras.en: She couldn’t control what she was doing.
paras.zh: 她控制不了自己正在做的事。

paras.en: She needed to be alone. “Please, just stay away from me.
paras.zh: 她需要独处。“求你们，离我远点。

paras.en: Stay away!” More snow shot straight from her hands and hit the castle steps, exploding with such force it froze them.
paras.zh: 远点！”更多的雪从她手中直射而出，击中城堡台阶，以惊人的力道炸开，把台阶冻住。

paras.en: The motion knocked the Duke off his feet again, sending his glasses flying.
paras.zh: 这一下又把公爵掀翻，眼镜飞了出去。

paras.en: Elsa was breathing hard in shock.
paras.zh: 艾莎震惊得喘着粗气。

paras.en: The Duke sat up, reaching for his glasses. “Monster.
paras.zh: 公爵坐起来，伸手去摸眼镜。“怪物。

paras.en: Monster! ” he shouted.
paras.zh: 怪物！”他喊道。

paras.en: She wasn’t.
paras.zh: 她不是。

paras.en: She didn’t want to hurt a soul.
paras.zh: 她不想伤害任何生灵。

paras.en: She looked around for someone who understood her, but there was no one.
paras.zh: 她环顾四周，想找個能懂她的人，却一个也没有。

paras.en: Her people looked terrified.
paras.zh: 她的臣民一脸惊恐。

paras.en: Even the kind woman now seemed to be shielding her baby from Elsa.
paras.zh: 就连那位和善的妇女，此刻似乎也在用身子护着怀里的婴儿，避开艾莎。

paras.en: Sister.
paras.zh: 妹妹。

paras.en: Anna had once known that Elsa had the ability to do magic.
paras.zh: 安娜曾经知道艾莎拥有魔法。

paras.en: Surely, Anna would be able to understand her again.
paras.zh: 安娜一定能够再次理解她。

paras.en: Elsa had to find her at all costs.
paras.zh: 艾莎必须不惜一切找到她。

paras.en: Elsa started to run again and didn’t stop till she cleared the castle courtyard and reached the village. “Elsa!” she heard Hans calling. “Elsa!” But she kept running.
paras.zh: 艾莎再次跑起来，直到冲出城堡庭院、跑到镇上才停下。“艾莎！”她听见汉斯在喊，“艾莎！”可她没有停。

paras.en: She spotted the steps leading down to the water and descended them, running until there was nothing but water in front of her.
paras.zh: 她看见通往水边的台阶，便奔了下去，一直跑到面前只剩下水。

paras.en: There was nowhere left to go.
paras.zh: 再也无路可走。

paras.en: She stepped back as she saw Hans approaching, and her foot landed in the water.
paras.zh: 她看见汉斯逼近，往后退去，脚踩进了水里。

paras.en: Instantly, the water froze beneath her shoe.
paras.zh: 瞬间，她鞋下的水面冻住了。

paras.en: She looked down in wonder as tiny crystals of ice spread.
paras.zh: 她惊奇地低头，看细小的冰晶蔓延开来。

paras.en: The wind started to whip up and snow began to fall as she took another step.
paras.zh: 她再迈出一步，风开始呼啸，雪飘落下来。

paras.en: The ice spread again, forming a pathway for her escape.
paras.zh: 冰再次蔓延，为她铺出一条逃生的路。

paras.en: She took it. “Wait, please!” Hans begged, running after her with Lord Peterssen on his trail.
paras.zh: 她踏了上去。“等等，求你了！”汉斯恳求着，和跟在身后的彼得森伯爵一起追来。

paras.en: The snow was falling harder. “Elsa, stop!” Elsa wouldn’t stop now.
paras.zh: 雪下得更猛了。“艾莎，停下！”艾莎此刻不会停。

paras.en: Finding her sister was more important than anything in the world.
paras.zh: 找到妹妹比世间任何事都重要。

paras.en: All thoughts of her coronation slipped away.
paras.zh: 加冕的一切念头都烟消云散。

paras.en: Elsa took a deep breath and continued onto the ice, praying it wouldn’t crack beneath her feet.
paras.zh: 艾莎深吸一口气，继续踏上冰面，祈祷它不会在脚下裂开。

paras.en: The ice held firm, spreading as she ran across it.
paras.zh: 冰稳稳承住她，随着她奔跑不断延伸。

paras.en: Her cape billowing around her, Elsa felt resolve coursing through her veins as she took off across the fjord into the gathering darkness.
paras.zh: 艾莎的披风在身后翻飞，她感到一股决心在血管里奔涌，就此踏过峡湾，没入渐浓的夜色。

paras.en: Suddenly, there was a rumbling beneath Kristoff and Anna’s feet.
paras.zh: 忽然，克里斯托夫和安娜脚下的地面隆隆作响。

paras.en: A flock of birds shot by overhead.
paras.zh: 一群鸟从头顶掠过。

paras.en: Sven started snorting and shuffling as a family of squirrels scurried past them across the street.
paras.zh: 斯文开始喷着鼻子、挪动着蹄子，一窝松鼠从街对面窜过他们身旁。

paras.en: Anna heard someone shriek and saw an elk run past.
paras.zh: 安娜听见有人尖叫，又看见一头麋鹿跑过。

paras.en: Sven tore off. “Sven!” Kristoff shouted.
paras.zh: 斯文撒腿就追。“斯文！”克里斯托夫喊道。

paras.en: Anna and Kristoff chased Sven into the village square.
paras.zh: 安娜和克里斯托夫追着斯文冲进镇上的广场。

paras.en: People had started coming out of their homes and shops to see what was going on.
paras.zh: 人们纷纷走出家门和店铺，想看看出了什么事。

paras.en: Birds and animals began streaming out of the woods in every direction. “What’s happening?” Anna asked as the rumbling grew louder.
paras.zh: 鸟兽从林子里朝四面八方涌出。“发生什么了？”安娜问，隆隆声越来越响。

paras.en: The sun vanished behind the clouds, and a cold wind whipped through the trees, causing them to sway. “Look!” someone shouted, pointing down the mountain.
paras.zh: 太阳躲到云后，冷风刮过树林，吹得枝干摇晃。“看！”有人指着山下喊。

paras.en: It was one of the finest summer days Anna could remember, but the fjord somehow appeared to be freezing over.
paras.zh: 那是安娜记忆里最晴朗的夏日之一，可峡湾不知怎的竟在结冰。

paras.en: A blue glow hovered above the water as it froze, knocking the boats in the harbor sideways.
paras.zh: 水面结冰时，上方悬着一团蓝光，把港里的船撞得歪向一边。

paras.en: Suddenly, the freeze began to trickle up the mountainside, heading right toward them. “Ice,” Kristoff whispered.
paras.zh: 忽然，寒冻顺着山坡往上爬，直冲他们而来。“冰，”克里斯托夫低声说。

paras.en: Anna didn’t understand what was happening, but she knew they had to get out of the way of whatever was coming. “We need to warn the others.
paras.zh: 安娜不明白发生了什么，但她知道必须让开即将到来的东西。“我们得去警告别人。

paras.en: Quickly!” Anna yelled. “Sven!” Sven ran straight toward her.
paras.zh: 快！”安娜喊，“斯文！”斯文径直朝她跑来。

paras.en: Anna jumped onto his back. “Hey!
paras.zh: 安娜跳上他的背。“嘿！

paras.en: Wait for me!” Kristoff ran after them. “Go, Sven!
paras.zh: 等等我！”克里斯托夫追在后面。“走，斯文！

paras.en: Through the village!” “Take cover!” Anna shouted as the blue glow grew closer, ice trailing along right behind it, threatening to overtake them. “Everyone get inside!” Kristoff finally caught up with them and jumped onto Sven’s back behind Anna.
paras.zh: 穿镇而过！”“躲起来！”安娜喊，蓝光越来越近，冰紧随其后，眼看就要追上他们。“大家都进屋去！”克里斯托夫终于追上，跳上斯文背，坐在安娜身后。

paras.en: People began running as the wind whipped up.
paras.zh: 风刮起来，人们开始奔跑。

paras.en: The temperature plummeted and the sky became completely gray.
paras.zh: 气温骤降，天空变得一片灰暗。

paras.en: Suddenly, there was a whooshing sound.
paras.zh: 忽然，传来一阵呼啸声。

paras.en: Sven stopped short, throwing Kristoff and Anna off him as the blue haze washed over them and kept going.
paras.zh: 斯文猛地停住，把克里斯托夫和安娜甩下背，蓝光从他们身上荡过，继续向前。

paras.en: Anna and Kristoff struggled to stand up as the ice crackled and spread under their feet as a squall seemed to draw up around them, filling the sky with snow.
paras.zh: 安娜和克里斯托夫挣扎着站起来，冰在他们脚下噼啪蔓延，一阵狂风似乎在他们四周卷起，把天空填满雪花。

paras.en: Anna didn’t even realize she and Kristoff had been holding on to each other.
paras.zh: 安娜甚至没意识到，自己和克里斯托夫一直紧握着彼此。

paras.en: She kept waiting for the freak storm to pass, but instead, now it was snowing.
paras.zh: 她一直等着这场怪风过去，可它非但没停，反而下起雪来。

paras.en: In the middle of the summer.
paras.zh: 在盛夏里。

paras.en: Her heart pounded hard.
paras.zh: 她的心狂跳不已。

paras.en: What is going on in Arendelle?
paras.zh: 阿伦黛尔到底怎么了？

paras.en: Three days later, Anna was still wondering.
paras.zh: 三天后，安娜仍在暗自纳闷。

paras.en: For the past seventy-two hours she’d watched the scene outside her window.
paras.zh: 过去的七十二小时里，她一直望着窗外的景象。

paras.en: Blinding snow and ice covered the rooftops, blanketed the ground, and piled high in snowdrifts.
paras.zh: 刺眼的雪和冰覆盖了屋顶，盖住大地，堆成高高的雪堆。

paras.en: Ice crackled and formed giant icicles that threatened to topple off rooftops and crash to the ground. “We stay inside,” Papa told Anna and Ma as a fierce wind blew outside their bakery door. “We keep the fire going as long as possible and we bake as much as we can.
paras.zh: 冰噼啪作响，凝成巨大的冰柱，随时可能从屋顶坠落、砸向地面。“我们待在屋里，”爸爸对安娜和妈妈说，门外狂风正猛刮着面包房的门，“火能烧多久就烧多久，能烤多少就烤多少。

paras.en: We need the food.
paras.zh: 我们需要食物。

paras.en: Who knows how long this weather will continue?” Even with a fire raging, the house felt colder than Anna remembered its ever being in winter. “It is good you moved the chickens and the animals into the barn, but it still must be awfully cold,” Ma said, rubbing her arms to keep warm.
paras.zh: 谁知道这天气还要持续多久？”即便炉火正旺，屋里也比安娜记忆里任何一个冬天都冷。“你把鸡和牲口都挪进谷仓是对的，可那儿一定也冷得够呛，”妈妈搓着胳膊取暖说。

paras.en: Anna stared out the window.
paras.zh: 安娜盯着窗外。

paras.en: The streets were deserted.
paras.zh: 街上空无一人。

paras.en: Snow was drifting higher in front of doorways despite people’s best efforts to keep it from piling up.
paras.zh: 尽管人们拼命想不让雪堆起来，门口的雪还是越积越高。

paras.en: They needed a way out of their homes in an emergency, but Anna couldn’t help wondering where they would go in weather like this.
paras.zh: 他们需要一条紧急时逃出家门的路，可安娜忍不住想，这种天气里他们能去哪儿。

paras.en: They’d freeze to death. “It’s awfully crowded now with the animals and that ice delivery boy staying in the barn with his reindeer.” Anna looked up. “Kristoff doesn’t mind.
paras.zh: 他们会冻死的。“现在又是牲口，又是那个和驯鹿一起住谷仓的送冰小子，真是挤得够呛。”安娜抬起头。“克里斯托夫不介意。

paras.en: He likes sleeping in barns,” she joked.
paras.zh: 他喜欢睡谷仓，”她打趣道。

paras.en: Ma looked at her curiously. “You two know each other?” Anna looked out the window again and tried not to let her mother see her blush. “A little.
paras.zh: 妈妈好奇地看着她。“你们俩认识？”安娜又望向窗外，尽量不让妈妈看见自己脸红。“算是吧。

paras.en: I wish he would come inside.” Papa threw another log onto the fire.
paras.zh: 我真希望他能进屋来。”爸爸又往火里添了根柴。

paras.en: Their pile of kindling was getting dangerously low.
paras.zh: 他们那堆引火柴已经少得危险。

paras.en: They’d have to go out and cut down more soon. “I asked him to, but he won’t leave his reindeer.” “I don’t understand,” Anna said. “How could it snow like this in the middle of the summer?” Her gut told her something or someone had caused it. “Is Arendelle cursed?” Ma and Papa looked at each other. “There’s no such thing as curses, right?” Anna pressed.
paras.zh: 他们得很快出去再砍些来。“我请过他，可他不肯离开他的驯鹿。”“我不明白，”安娜说，“大夏天怎么会下这样的雪？”她的直觉告诉她，是某件事或某个人造成的。“阿伦黛尔被诅咒了？”妈妈和爸爸对视一眼。“这世上没有诅咒这回事，对吧？”安娜追问。

paras.en: Why did she think they knew something they weren’t telling her?
paras.zh: 她为什么觉得他们知道些什么，却瞒着她？

paras.en: There was a heavy pounding at the door, and Papa and Ma looked at each other again.
paras.zh: 门外一阵重重的敲门声，爸爸和妈妈又对视了一眼。

paras.en: Papa rushed to the window and peered out. “Let them in!
paras.zh: 爸爸冲到窗边往外窥看。“让他们进来！

paras.en: Quickly!” Ma opened the door, the snow and wind practically overtaking her as she struggled to hold the door for their visitors.
paras.zh: 快！”妈妈打开门，风雪几乎把她吞没，她费力地撑着门，让客人进来。

paras.en: Two men were bundled up from head to toe in hats, gloves, and layers of scarves.
paras.zh: 两个男人从头到脚裹着帽子、手套和一层层围巾。

paras.en: Still, they were shivering. “The snow is getting deeper,” said Goran, unwrapping a scarf from around his face. “Soon it will cover rooftops if it keeps falling.” “That’s impossible,” Ma said, quickly handing him a hot mug of glogg. “It has never snowed that much.” Mr.
paras.zh: 即便如此，他们还在发抖。“雪越来越深了，”戈兰从脸上解下围巾说，“再下下去，很快就要盖过屋顶了。”“那不可能，”妈妈说着，连忙递给他一大杯热格罗格酒，“从没下过那么大的雪。”拉森

paras.en: Larsen looked grim. “I believe we are cursed.” “See!” Anna agreed, and her parents looked awkward. “Did you not see how it came from Arendelle and traveled up the mountain?” Mr.
paras.zh: 拉森先生面色阴沉。“我相信我们被诅咒了。”“看吧！”安娜附和，父母则显得尴尬。“你没看见雪是从阿伦黛尔过来、顺着山爬上来的吗？”拉森

paras.en: Larsen continued. “How else do you explain snow like this in the middle of the summer?
paras.zh: 拉森先生接着说。“大夏天下这样的雪，你还能怎么解释？

paras.en: Something happened at Princess Elsa’s coronation.
paras.zh: 一定是艾莎公主加冕时出了什么事。

paras.en: I am sure of it!” “No one from Arendelle has come to bring news of the princess or what has happened,” Goran agreed. “For all we know, we could have lost her in this weather.” Princess Elsa was their future.
paras.zh: 我敢肯定！” “阿伦黛尔没人捎来公主的消息，也没说出了什么事，”戈兰附和，“照这样下去，我们多半要在这种天气里失去她了。”艾莎公主就是他们的未来。

paras.en: Anna was pinning her hopes to her. “I’m sure she’s fine.
paras.zh: 安娜把希望都寄托在她身上。“我肯定她没事。

paras.en: Right, Ma?” Ma was looking at Papa. “Surely the princess is safe.
paras.zh: 对吧，妈妈？”妈妈望向爸爸。“公主一定平安。

paras.en: She is probably busy preparing the kingdom for this unforeseen blizzard.” Anna looked out the window again, straining to see her beloved Arendelle, but the mountainside was covered in a sheet of ice and there were whiteout conditions.
paras.zh: 她这会儿大概正忙着为王国应对这场突如其来的暴风雪呢。”安娜又望向窗外，努力想看清心爱的阿伦黛尔，可山坡覆着一层冰，白茫茫一片，什么也看不清。

paras.en: Arendelle looked as if it had disappeared. “Then why send no word to all the villages?” Goran asked. “Wouldn’t the castle come to tell us what is happening?
paras.zh: 阿伦黛尔像是凭空消失了。“那为什么不给各个村镇捎个信？”戈兰问，“城堡难道不该来告诉我们发生了什么吗？

paras.en: We can’t continue like this.
paras.zh: 我们不能这样下去了。

paras.en: We are running out of firewood.
paras.zh: 柴火快用光了。

paras.en: The crops we planted must surely be dead by now, and we will have nothing to store for the real winter still to come.
paras.zh: 我们种下的庄稼这会儿肯定都死了，真正的冬天还没到，我们却没有什么可储藏的了。

paras.en: We aren’t prepared for these conditions.” “In a few weeks’ time, we will run out of food,” Mr.
paras.zh: 我们应付不了这种情况。”“再过几周，我们就要断粮了，”拉森

paras.en: Larsen added grimly. “The fjord appears to be frozen over, so no ships can get in or out to send for help.
paras.zh: 拉森先生阴郁地补充，“峡湾似乎冻住了，船进不来也出不去，没法求援。

paras.en: The horses will not last long outside in this weather.
paras.zh: 马在这种天气里在外头撑不了多久。

paras.en: We are done for.” The situation was direr than Anna had realized. “Papa, someone needs to get to Arendelle and find out what is going on.” Papa put his hand on her shoulder and attempted a smile, but it was weak at best. “Why don’t you go to the bakery and make sure the fire is still burning while Ma gets everyone more glogg?” “Papa—” Anna tried to interrupt, but he cut her off. “Go ahead now,” he said softly. “Don’t worry.” “Listen to Papa,” Ma agreed.
paras.zh: 我们完了。”情况比安娜想的更糟。“爸爸，得有人去阿伦黛尔弄清情况。”爸爸把手放在她肩上，勉强挤出一丝微笑。“你去面包房看看火还烧着没有，妈妈给大家再添些格罗格酒，好吗？”“爸爸——”安娜想插话，却被他打断。“去吧，”他轻声说，“别担心。”“听爸爸的，”妈妈也这么说。

paras.en: Anna walked slowly to the kitchen.
paras.zh: 安娜慢慢走向厨房。

paras.en: She looked back, hearing the men and Ma talking quietly by the fire.
paras.zh: 她回头望去，听见男人们和妈妈在火边低声交谈。

paras.en: It popped and crackled even as a breeze blew through cracks in the walls.
paras.zh: 火噼啪作响，风却从墙缝里钻进来。

paras.en: Curses .
paras.zh: 诅咒。

paras.en: Was such a thing possible?
paras.zh: 这种事真的可能吗？

paras.en: Ma and Papa seemed to know something they weren’t saying, but Anna was with Mr.
paras.zh: 妈妈和爸爸似乎知道什么，却不说出口，可安娜站在拉森

paras.en: Larsen: there was something unnatural about the weather and the way the ice had traveled up the mountain.
paras.zh: 拉森先生一边：天气和冰爬山而来的方式，确实透着不自然。

paras.en: Anna had never witnessed anything like that before.
paras.zh: 安娜从前从没见过这种景象。

paras.en: Maybe curses were real.
paras.zh: 也许诅咒是真的。

paras.en: But why was someone or something threatening to destroy their kingdom?
paras.zh: 可为什么有谁或什么东西要威胁毁灭他们的王国？

paras.en: How much longer would they be able to survive like this?
paras.zh: 他们还能这样撑多久？

paras.en: Not long at all.
paras.zh: 撑不了多久。

paras.en: One thing was certain: someone had to get to Arendelle and find answers fast.
paras.zh: 有一件事是确定的：必须有人赶去阿伦黛尔，尽快找出答案。

paras.en: Papa was in no condition to journey to the castle and get help.
paras.zh: 爸爸的状况根本不适合去城堡求援。

paras.en: Goran and Mr.
paras.zh: 戈兰和拉森

paras.en: Larsen were also older.
paras.zh: 拉森先生也都上了年纪。

paras.en: Would they even be able to make it down the mountain?
paras.zh: 他们能下得了山吗？

paras.en: They needed someone skilled at traveling in conditions such as those.
paras.zh: 他们需要一个擅长在这种条件下赶路的人。

paras.en: Someone who was skilled at handling ice.
paras.zh: 一个擅长对付冰的人。

paras.en: Kristoff.
paras.zh: 克里斯托夫。

paras.en: Anna looked back at the others again.
paras.zh: 安娜又回头看了大家一眼。

paras.en: No one noticed her standing near the doorway to the bakery.
paras.zh: 没人注意到她站在面包房门口附近。

paras.en: They didn’t see her quietly go upstairs and search her armoire for her warmest hat, cloak, and gloves.
paras.zh: 他们没看见她悄悄上楼，在衣柜里翻出最暖的帽子、斗篷和手套。

paras.en: They wouldn’t find the note explaining why she had left until they came to her room looking for her.
paras.zh: 要等到进她房间找她时，他们才会发现那张说明她为何离开的字条。

paras.en: And they were too engrossed in their conversation to notice her slip through the bakery doorway and gather supplies of water, bread, and whatever vegetables she could find.
paras.zh: 他们正聊得起劲，没察觉她溜出面包房门，收拾了水、面包和能找到的青菜。

paras.en: Without a word, she pulled open the door, determined to help her people.
paras.zh: 她一言不发地拉开门，下定决心要帮她的人民。

paras.en: She was almost blown back by the wind.
paras.zh: 风差点把她刮回去。

paras.en: Anna was shocked at how cold her exposed face felt, but she kept going, holding on to railings and overturned carts as she slowly made her way to the barn.
paras.zh: 安娜震惊于露出的脸竟如此冰冷，可她仍咬牙前行，抓着栏杆和翻倒的推车，慢慢挪向谷仓。

paras.en: When she arrived, she found Kristoff playing his lute for Sven and the other animals, who were all huddled around a small fire.
paras.zh: 到了那儿，她看见克里斯托夫正为斯文和其他动物弹鲁特琴，大家全挤在一小堆火旁。

paras.en: He saw her and dropped his instrument in surprise. “What are you doing out in this weather?” he asked.
paras.zh: 他看见她，吃惊得掉了手里的琴。“这种天气你跑出来干什么？”他问。

paras.en: Anna’s teeth were chattering.
paras.zh: 安娜牙齿直打颤。

paras.en: She rubbed her arms to keep warm. “I want you to take me to Arendelle.” He sighed and picked up his lute. “I don’t take people places.” “Let me rephrase that.” She threw the bag of supplies at him. “Hey!” He winced and rubbed his shoulder. “Sorry!” She stepped closer, holding her ground. “Take me down the mountain.
paras.zh: 她搓着胳膊取暖。“我要你带我去阿伦黛尔。”他叹了口气，捡起鲁特琴。“我不带人走。”“那我换个说法。”她把那袋物资扔给他。“嘿！”他龇牙揉了揉肩膀。“对不起！”她上前一步，寸步不让。“带我下山。

paras.en: Please.” Sven nudged the bag, and Kristoff opened it.
paras.zh: 求你了。”斯文用鼻子拱了拱袋子，克里斯托夫打开它。

paras.en: Inside were some carrots, rope, and an ice ax.
paras.zh: 里面是几根胡萝卜、一截绳，还有一把冰镐。

paras.en: He looked at her curiously. “Look, we need to figure out how to stop this winter.
paras.zh: 他好奇地看着她。“听着，我们得想办法止住这个冬天。

paras.en: You saw it yourself—the ice started in Arendelle.
paras.zh: 你自己也看见了——冰是从阿伦黛尔开始的。

paras.en: We need to know what happened down there at the coronation that caused this.
paras.zh: 我们得知道加冕礼上到底发生了什么，才酿成这样。

paras.en: It feels…magical.” Kristoff didn’t laugh at her suggestion, so she kept talking. “We need to find out what’s going on and figure out how to protect the kingdom.” Kristoff pulled his hat over his eyes. “We leave at dawn.” She took a horse blanket off a barn stall and threw it at him.
paras.zh: 感觉……像有魔法。”克里斯托夫没笑她这说法，于是她继续说。“我们得弄清发生了什么，想办法保护王国。”克里斯托夫把帽子拉到眼睛上。“天亮我们就走。”她从马厩隔间扯下一条马毯，朝他扔去。

paras.en: It hit Kristoff in the face. “Sorry!
paras.zh: 毯子砸在克里斯托夫脸上。“对不起！

paras.en: Sorry!
paras.zh: 对不起！

paras.en: I’m sorry.
paras.zh: 对不起。

paras.en: I didn’t…” She cleared her throat.
paras.zh: 我不是……”她清了清嗓子。

paras.en: There was no more time to waste. “We leave now.
paras.zh: 没时间可浪费了。“现在就走。

paras.en: Right now.” Anna was going to Arendelle.
paras.zh: 就现在。”安娜要去阿伦黛尔了。

paras.en: It wasn’t the way she had planned to make the journey, but she was going all the same.
paras.zh: 这趟旅程和她设想的不一样，可她照样要去。

paras.en: She thought again in wonder of the frozen castle and the princess.
paras.zh: 她又惊奇地想起那座冰封的城堡和那位公主。

paras.en: Her gut told her someone down there needed her.
paras.zh: 她的直觉告诉她，山下有谁正需要她。

paras.en: Anna could feel it in her bones.
paras.zh: 安娜打骨子里感觉到了。

paras.en: Elsa’s mind was swirling as fast as the snow that fell around her in thick sheets.
paras.zh: 艾莎的思绪翻腾得和周围厚厚落下的雪一样快。

paras.en: She’d run across the fjord, the water beneath her feet freezing as hard as glass with each step.
paras.zh: 她跑过峡湾，脚下的水随着每一步冻得如玻璃般坚硬。

paras.en: She headed deep into the forest and didn’t stop till the moon was overhead.
paras.zh: 她一头扎进森林深处，直到月亮升到头顶才停。

paras.en: Faster and faster she asked her legs to carry her, away from the castle, the village, and the only life she’d ever known.
paras.zh: 她催促双腿越跑越快，逃离城堡、小镇，逃离她唯一熟识的生活。

paras.en: Anna was alive.
paras.zh: 安娜还活着。

paras.en: Nothing was more important than finding her.
paras.zh: 没有什么比找到她更重要。

paras.en: A cold wind whipped her purple cape in front of her face, blocking Elsa’s view.
paras.zh: 一阵冷风把她的紫色披风甩到脸前，挡住了艾莎的视线。

paras.en: She pushed it aside, trying to get her bearings.
paras.zh: 她把披风拨到一边，想辨清方向。

paras.en: She didn’t know where she was, but it didn’t matter.
paras.zh: 她不知自己身在何处，可这不要紧。

paras.en: She had to keep going so she wasn’t followed.
paras.zh: 她得继续走，才不会被跟上。

paras.en: Another gust of wind sent her sideways.
paras.zh: 又一阵狂风把她吹得歪向一侧。

paras.en: The howling whistle sounded like voices.
paras.zh: 呼啸声像极了人声。

paras.en: Monster!
paras.zh: 怪物！

paras.en: Monster!
paras.zh: 怪物！

paras.en: The Duke’s words echoed inside her head.
paras.zh: 公爵的话在她脑中回响。

paras.en: It was coronation day, but instead of being crowned queen, she had revealed her powers and fled Arendelle.
paras.zh: 今天是加冕日，可她没戴上王冠，反而暴露了魔力，逃离了阿伦黛尔。

paras.en: The kingdom was hidden under a deep freeze she had somehow caused.
paras.zh: 王国被她不知怎的造成的严寒深深掩埋。

paras.en: But how?
paras.zh: 可这是怎么做到的？

paras.en: Her magic allowed her to create ice.
paras.zh: 她的魔法能造冰。

paras.en: Could it also change the weather?
paras.zh: 它也能改变天气吗？

paras.en: The idea was awe-inspiring and worrisome at the same time.
paras.zh: 这个念头既令人敬畏，又令人忧心。

paras.en: It was the middle of the summer.
paras.zh: 现在可是盛夏。

paras.en: People weren’t prepared for snow.
paras.zh: 人们没为雪做过准备。

paras.en: How would they manage?
paras.zh: 他们怎么熬得过去？

paras.en: Were they frightened?
paras.zh: 他们害怕吗？

paras.en: Elsa thought again of that mother shielding her baby from her.
paras.zh: 艾莎又想起那位用身子护着婴儿避开自己的母亲。

paras.en: Monster.
paras.zh: 怪物。

paras.en: Was that what her people thought of her now that they knew the truth?
paras.zh: 现在人们知道真相了，是不是都这么看她？

paras.en: She remembered Lord Peterssen’s face when ice had grown around him like daggers.
paras.zh: 她想起冰像匕首般在彼得森伯爵周身生成时，他脸上的神情。

paras.en: Hans had looked equally astonished when a blue glow appeared above her hands and snow blasted into the room.
paras.zh: 当蓝光在她手上浮现、雪花猛地灌进房间时，汉斯也露出同样的惊愕。

paras.en: She could only imagine what the Duke of Weselton was saying about her to anyone who would listen.
paras.zh: 她只能想象威塞尔顿公爵会怎么对每一个肯听的人数落她。

paras.en: They’d all thought they knew her.
paras.zh: 他们都以为自己了解她。

paras.en: The truth was no one did.
paras.zh: 事实是，没人有真正了解。

paras.en: Would Anna?
paras.zh: 安娜会吗？

paras.en: That was when it dawned on her: Did Anna know she was a princess of Arendelle?
paras.zh: 就在这时她猛然想到：安娜知道自己曾是阿伦黛尔的公主吗？

paras.en: Or had she been kept in the dark, as Elsa had been?
paras.zh: 还是说，她也像艾莎一样被蒙在鼓里？

paras.en: Why was Anna’s existence a secret in the first place?
paras.zh: 安娜的存在为何一开始就是个秘密？

paras.en: Her parents had obviously wanted her to find out about Anna, or they wouldn’t have hidden that canvas and letter in her lockbox.
paras.zh: 父母显然想让她发现安娜，否则不会把那幅画和那封信藏进她的保险箱。

paras.en: Why were they being kept apart?
paras.zh: 为什么要把她们分开？

paras.en: How could I have left without that letter?
paras.zh: 我怎么能把那封信落下就走？

paras.en: Elsa cursed herself again.
paras.zh: 艾莎又暗骂自己。

paras.en: And Olaf!
paras.zh: 还有雪宝！

paras.en: What if someone found Olaf in her room?
paras.zh: 要是有人在她房里发现了雪宝怎么办？

paras.en: Her heart started to beat wildly at the thought.
paras.zh: 一想到这，她的心狂跳起来。

paras.en: A blue glow appeared above her fingertips.
paras.zh: 她指尖泛起蓝光。

paras.en: She shook out her hands and tried to concentrate.
paras.zh: 她甩了甩手，努力集中精神。

paras.en: No!
paras.zh: 不行！

paras.en: She couldn’t let her powers control her.
paras.zh: 她不能让魔力控制了她。

paras.en: The only way to save Olaf and retrieve the letter was to go back to the castle.
paras.zh: 要救雪宝、取回那封信，唯一的办法就是回城堡。

paras.en: Elsa turned toward home—or at least she thought she did.
paras.zh: 艾莎朝家的方向转过身——至少她以为那是家的方向。

paras.en: Arendelle was obscured by the blinding snow.
paras.zh: 阿伦黛尔被刺眼的雪遮得严严实实。

paras.en: She couldn’t find her way back if she tried.
paras.zh: 就算她想找，也找不到回去的路。

paras.en: And even if she did… Monster.
paras.zh: 就算找到了……怪物。

paras.en: That was what the Duke had called her.
paras.zh: 那是公爵对她的称呼。

paras.en: What if Lord Peterssen and the advisors agreed with him?
paras.zh: 要是彼得森伯爵和众臣也附和呢？

paras.en: She’d be sent to the dungeons.
paras.zh: 她会被关进地牢。

paras.en: She’d lose her crown.
paras.zh: 她会失去王冠。

paras.en: She’d never find Anna.
paras.zh: 她永远找不到安娜。

paras.en: Just breathe, she reminded herself, and the blue glow above her hands disappeared.
paras.zh: “只管呼吸，”她提醒自己，手上的蓝光随之消失。

paras.en: Olaf was a pro when it came to hiding.
paras.zh: 论躲藏，雪宝可是行家。

paras.en: Over the past few years, they’d worked out a number of places in her room for him to disappear to if anyone came calling.
paras.zh: 过去几年，他们在她房里布置了好几处地方，一有人来叫他就能藏进去。

paras.en: Now if he just heard a voice outside her door, he’d spring into action.
paras.zh: 现在只要听见门外有声音，他就会立刻行动。

paras.en: Besides, no one had entered her room since her parents died.
paras.zh: 再说，父母去世后，从没人进过她的房间。

paras.en: Chances were they weren’t going to look in her room now, either.
paras.zh: 多半现在他们也不会去翻她的房间。

paras.en: Hopefully Olaf had heard the commotion, grabbed the letter, and hid.
paras.zh: 但愿雪宝听见了动静，抓了信藏起来。

paras.en: When things calmed down, she’d find a way to go back for him.
paras.zh: 等风头过去，她会想办法回去找他。

paras.en: Olaf knew she’d never abandon him.
paras.zh: 雪宝知道她绝不会抛下他。

paras.en: That just left the problem of the missing letter.
paras.zh: 眼下只剩那封丢失的信这个难题。

paras.en: Think, Elsa, she willed herself.
paras.zh: “想想，艾莎，”她对自己说。

paras.en: What do you remember reading?
paras.zh: 你还记得读了什么？

paras.en: She’d been so excited she’d only skimmed it the first time, looking for what was most important: proof that Anna existed.
paras.zh: 她当时太激动，只草草扫了一遍，找最要紧的：安娜存在的证据。

paras.en: But she had noted a few other phrases.
paras.zh: 但她也留意到了另外几个词。

paras.en: There was something written about trolls.
paras.zh: 信里提到了地精。

paras.en: That made sense.
paras.zh: 这说得通。

paras.en: In her vision, she’d seen a large group of trolls and their leader, called Grand Pabbie.
paras.zh: 在她的幻象里，她见过一大群地精和他们的首领，名叫皮比。

paras.en: The family had traveled far by horse to find him, crossing a river and climbing into the mountains to a valley.
paras.zh: 一家人骑着马远道而去寻他，渡过一条河，爬上山，来到一个山谷。

paras.en: The mountain range ahead of her was remote and imposing.
paras.zh: 她前方的山脉遥远而巍峨。

paras.en: Maybe that was where Grand Pabbie was!
paras.zh: 也许皮比就在那儿！

paras.en: In the distance, the rocky face of the North Mountain loomed, large and impressive.
paras.zh: 远处，北山的岩壁赫然耸立，庞大而壮观。

paras.en: Even in the summer, the peak was covered with snow.
paras.zh: 即便在夏天，山顶也覆着雪。

paras.en: Few had attempted to climb it, which meant no one would follow her up there.
paras.zh: 很少有人尝试攀登，这意味着没人会跟她上去。

paras.en: The mountain was a kingdom of isolation, and it looked like she was the queen.
paras.zh: 这座山是一个与世隔绝的王国，而她仿佛就是女王。

paras.en: She’d keep going in that direction until she found the trolls or her legs gave out.
paras.zh: 她会一直朝那个方向走，直到找到地精，或是双腿撑不住。

paras.en: She wasn’t even tired.
paras.zh: 她甚至不觉得累。

paras.en: And the cold never bothered her, anyway.
paras.zh: 反正寒冷从没让她困扰过。

paras.en: For two days, Elsa trudged through the snow to reach the base of the North Mountain.
paras.zh: 整整两天，艾莎在雪中跋涉，终于抵达北山脚下。

paras.en: It was a feat she hadn’t been sure she could manage, but when she finally arrived, she had a bigger problem.
paras.zh: 这是她本不确定自己能做到的壮举，可当她终于到达时，却遇到更大的难题。

paras.en: She might not have been cold, but she definitely didn’t have the equipment to climb a rocky facade.
paras.zh: 她也许不冷，但确实没有攀登岩壁的设备。

paras.en: Or did she?
paras.zh: 还是说，她有？

paras.en: No one could see her at that altitude.
paras.zh: 在那个高度，没人能看见她。

paras.en: She didn’t have to conceal her powers in the middle of the wilderness.
paras.zh: 在荒野之中，她不必遮掩自己的魔力。

paras.en: After having been locked away in her room, hiding her secret from the world, she was suddenly free to use her magic in a way she never had before.
paras.zh: 在被锁在房里、向世界隐藏秘密之后，她忽然可以自由地使用魔法，用一种从前从未有过的方式。

paras.en: All her practice had led her to that moment: what could she create to help her move mountains?
paras.zh: 她所有的练习都通向这一刻：她能造出什么来帮自己翻山越岭？

paras.en: Elsa looked down at her hands.
paras.zh: 艾莎低头看自己的手。

paras.en: She was wearing only one glove.
paras.zh: 她只戴着一只手套。

paras.en: Her gloves had served as “protection” from her powers for far too long.
paras.zh: 手套充当她魔力的“保护”，已经太久了。

paras.en: It was time to let go.
paras.zh: 是时候放手了。

paras.en: She pulled the glove off and let it fly into the wind.
paras.zh: 她扯下手套，任它随风飞走。

paras.en: She was finally free.
paras.zh: 她终于自由了。

paras.en: Lifting her hand to the sky, she concentrated on creating a giant snowflake that crystallized in midair and floated away.
paras.zh: 她把手举向天空，凝神造出一片巨大的雪花，在半空中结晶，飘然远去。

paras.en: Then she lifted her other hand and made another snowflake, watching it fly away as well.
paras.zh: 接着她举起另一只手，又造出一片雪花，看着它也飞走。

paras.en: Pulse racing, Elsa kept building, her face breaking into a smile as she realized the possibilities were endless.
paras.zh: 艾莎心跳加速，不停地造着，脸上漾开笑意，意识到可能性无穷无尽。

paras.en: Here she could really use her gift and see what she was capable of.
paras.zh: 在这里，她才能真正施展天赋，看清自己的能耐。

paras.en: A blue glow circled her swirling arms as she imagined crystals that immediately froze and shattered into snow.
paras.zh: 蓝光绕着她挥舞的手臂盘旋，她想象着晶体瞬间冻结、碎成雪花。

paras.en: Think bigger, Elsa resolved as she shot a stream of ice up the mountainside.
paras.zh: “想得再大些，”艾莎下定决心，朝山坡射出一道冰流。

paras.en: What else can I do? she wondered.
paras.zh: 我还能做什么？她心想。

paras.en: Anything.
paras.zh: 一切。

paras.en: Everything I can think of!
paras.zh: 只要我想得到，统统都能！

paras.en: She’d never felt so alive.
paras.zh: 她从没这么鲜活过。

paras.en: Elsa kept shooting snow into the air as she ran closer to the base of the North Mountain, stopping short when she stared into a gorge with a hundred-foot drop.
paras.zh: 艾莎一边朝北山脚跑去，一边不停把雪射向空中，当她望见一道百尺深的峡谷时，猛地停住脚步。

paras.en: Once more, her cape caught on the wind, hitting her in the face.
paras.zh: 她的披风又一次被风卷起，拍在脸上。

paras.en: The item served no purpose on a mountaintop.
paras.zh: 这东西在山顶上毫无用处。

paras.en: Elsa unclipped the brooch holding it closed and let the cape fly off the side of the mountain, disappearing into the darkness.
paras.zh: 艾莎解开固定披风的胸针，任它飞下山崖，没入黑暗。

paras.en: The gorge was a different problem.
paras.zh: 峡谷是另一个难题。

paras.en: It had to be almost thirty feet across.
paras.zh: 它差不多有三十尺宽。

paras.en: It was impossible to jump, but with powers like hers, why did she need to worry about jumping?
paras.zh: 跳过去不可能，可凭她这样的魔力，何必为跳不跳发愁？

paras.en: For so long she had feared anyone’s knowing she had powers, but in her recovered memories, her family looked at them as a gift.
paras.zh: 长久以来，她害怕任何人知道她有魔力，可在她找回的记忆里，家人却把它视为礼物。

paras.en: Now she could see why: look at what she could create with her two hands!
paras.zh: 此刻她明白了原因：瞧瞧她用一双手能造出什么！

paras.en: If she used to make winter wonderlands in the castle for Anna, why couldn’t she create an ice palace on a mountaintop?
paras.zh: 既然她曾在城堡里为安娜造出冬日仙境，为什么不能在山顶造一座冰宫？

paras.en: Let your fears go, she reminded herself.
paras.zh: “放下你的恐惧，”她提醒自己。

paras.en: She imagined a staircase of ice connecting both sides of the gorge.
paras.zh: 她想象一道冰做的阶梯，连接峡谷两端。

paras.en: Was it possible?
paras.zh: 这可能吗？

paras.en: What about a staircase that carried her up the entire mountain?
paras.zh: 那么一道载着她直上山顶的阶梯呢？

paras.en: Anything was possible if she believed in her powers like Anna once had.
paras.zh: 只要像安娜曾经那样相信自己的魔力，一切皆有可能。

paras.en: Elsa took a deep breath and backed up a few paces before running across the snowy peak.
paras.zh: 艾莎深吸一口气，后退几步，随后跑过积雪的山巅。

paras.en: Staircase, she thought as her hands shot out in front of her, forming several icy steps that climbed into the air.
paras.zh: “阶梯，”她想着，双手向前伸出，凝出几级冰阶，向空中攀升。

paras.en: She paused for a split second before gingerly stepping onto the first one.
paras.zh: 她微微一顿，小心翼翼地踏上第一级。

paras.en: The stairs were so sturdy she ran up them, throwing her hands out over and over, creating steps that led her all the way to the peak of the North Mountain.
paras.zh: 台阶稳得很，她一路跑上去，一次次挥手，造出一级级台阶，直通北山顶峰。

paras.en: Her mind and her fingertips somehow worked in perfect harmony to create exactly what she needed at exactly the right moment.
paras.zh: 她的思绪与指尖仿佛完美合拍，在恰好的时刻造出恰好的所需。

paras.en: When Elsa finally reached the top, she didn’t find any trolls, but the view was breathtaking.
paras.zh: 当艾莎终于到达山顶，地精没找到，眼前的景致却美得摄人心魄。

paras.en: Few mountaineers had climbed to such heights, and there she was, high over the entire kingdom.
paras.zh: 很少有登山者爬到这样的高度，而她就在那儿，高高凌驾于整个王国之上。

paras.en: Arendelle was far in the distance, as tiny as a speck.
paras.zh: 阿伦黛尔远在天边，小得像一粒微尘。

paras.en: Even if she hadn’t found the trolls yet, the North Mountain felt like a good place for her to recharge and figure out how to find Anna.
paras.zh: 即便还没找到地精，北山也是个让她养精蓄锐、琢磨如何找到安娜的好地方。

paras.en: She’d build a palace as stunning as the landscape to shelter in.
paras.zh: 她要建一座与这风景一样惊人的宫殿来栖身。

paras.en: One that reflected the new her.
paras.zh: 一座映出全新自我的宫殿。

paras.en: Mama had called her powers a gift, hadn’t she?
paras.zh: 妈妈说过她的魔力是礼物，不是吗？

paras.en: Well, they were.
paras.zh: 嗯，它确实是。

paras.en: And there was no reason to conceal them from the world at the top of a mountain.
paras.zh: 而在山顶，更没有理由向世人隐藏它。

paras.en: Elsa stomped her foot into the snow, creating a giant snowflake that unfurled under her.
paras.zh: 艾莎一脚踩进雪里，造出一片巨大的雪花，在脚下舒展铺开。

paras.en: The snowflake multiplied again and again, forming the footprint for her new home.
paras.zh: 雪花一次次分裂增殖，勾出她新家的轮廓。

paras.en: Next she imagined her fortress rising into the air, and it did just that, the frozen wonder growing and expanding.
paras.zh: 接着她想象自己的堡垒升向空中，它果真如此，这冰的奇迹不断生长、扩展。

paras.en: This time, the ice didn’t form sharp, jagged daggers.
paras.zh: 这一回，冰没有凝成锋利歪斜的尖刺。

paras.en: She created ornate columns and archways more exquisite than even those found in Arendelle Castle.
paras.zh: 她造出华美的立柱与拱门，比阿伦黛尔城堡里的那些还要精致。

paras.en: Elsa filled in every detail she could think of for her home, until she created the peaks that would be her roof.
paras.zh: 艾莎填满她能想到的关于家的每一处细节，直到造出将作为屋顶的尖塔。

paras.en: For a final touch, Elsa made a giant snowflake that burst into the most intricate chandelier she could imagine.
paras.zh: 最后的点缀，艾莎造出一片巨大的雪花，绽开成她能想象到的最繁复的吊灯。

paras.en: Standing inside her creation, Elsa knew there was still something missing.
paras.zh: 站在自己的作品中，艾莎知道还缺了点什么。

paras.en: She had created a new look for her life, but hadn’t done a thing to change her own appearance.
paras.zh: 她为生活创造了新模样，却还没动自己分毫。

paras.en: Pulling at her uncomfortable hairstyle, she let several loose tendrils frame her face.
paras.zh: 她扯了扯不舒服的发型，让几缕散落的发丝垂在脸侧。

paras.en: Next, she took out the tight bun, and her braided hair hung down her back.
paras.zh: 接着，她解开紧绷的发髻，编好的长发垂落背脊。

paras.en: Elsa didn’t stop there.
paras.zh: 艾莎没有就此停下。

paras.en: This gown had weighed her down for too long.
paras.zh: 这件礼服拖累她太久了。

paras.en: It was time for it to go as well.
paras.zh: 也该让它去了。

paras.en: With a wave of her hands, she imagined a new dress that suited her personality and style.
paras.zh: 她双手一挥，想象一件贴合她性情与风格的裙装。

paras.en: Something light and freeing.
paras.zh: 要轻盈，要自在。

paras.en: Ice crystallized over the bottom of her teal dress, forming a new one that was a shimmering pale blue.
paras.zh: 冰在她的青绿色裙摆上结晶，凝成一条崭新的、泛着微光的淡蓝长裙。

paras.en: Gone were the itchy high collar and the annoying long sleeves that restricted her movements.
paras.zh: 发痒的高领和碍手碍脚的长袖都不见了。

paras.en: Her new gown was strapless, her neck was open, and her arms were loosely wrapped in silk.
paras.zh: 她的新礼服无肩带，脖颈敞露，手臂松松裹着丝绸。

paras.en: A light sheer cape was made up of a pattern of snowflakes as unique as she was.
paras.zh: 轻薄半透的披风，由和她一样独特的雪花图案织成。

paras.en: By the time she was finished creating her fortress and a new look, the sun was beginning to rise over the mountains.
paras.zh: 等她造完堡垒、换好新妆，太阳正从群山后升起。

paras.en: Elsa stepped out onto one of her balconies and reveled at the majesty of her new kingdom.
paras.zh: 艾莎走上其中一个阳台，沉醉于她新王国的壮美。

paras.en: Anna would like it here, Elsa thought with satisfaction.
paras.zh: 安娜会喜欢这里的，艾莎满意地想。

paras.en: She just had to find her.
paras.zh: 她只需找到安娜。

paras.en: Looking out over the snow and the ice, Elsa tried to imagine where Grand Pabbie and the trolls might be.
paras.zh: 望着雪与冰，艾莎试着想象皮比和地精们会在哪里。

paras.en: If they weren’t hidden at the top of the North Mountain, where were they?
paras.zh: 要是他们没藏在北山顶，又会在哪儿？

paras.en: She drummed her fingers on the icy railing of the balcony and thought again of her vison.
paras.zh: 她用指尖敲着阳台的冰栏，又想起她的幻象。

paras.en: The night Papa and Mama had taken them up into the mountains to find the trolls, Papa had held on to a map.
paras.zh: 那一晚，爸爸和妈妈带他们上山找地精，爸爸手里攥着一张地图。

paras.en: Think, Elsa.
paras.zh: 想想，艾莎。

paras.en: What was he looking for?
paras.zh: 他当时在找什么？

paras.en: Where did we go?
paras.zh: 我们去了哪儿？

paras.en: It was some sort of valley.
paras.zh: 是某种山谷。

paras.en: The Valley of the Living Rock!
paras.zh: 活石山谷！

paras.en: She’d spotted that name in the letter.
paras.zh: 她在信里见过这个名字。

paras.en: That had to be where Grand Pabbie was hidden.
paras.zh: 皮比一定就藏在那儿。

paras.en: Based on how long it had taken to reach the North Mountain, Elsa had to guess the Valley of the Living Rock was at least a day’s walk from there, and she would have to go back down the mountain to find it.
paras.zh: 按抵达北山所花的时间推算，艾莎猜想活石山谷离这儿至少还有一天的路程，而她得下山才能找到它。

paras.en: She yawned despite herself.
paras.zh: 她不由自主地打了个哈欠。

paras.en: It had been days since she’d rested.
paras.zh: 她已经好几天没休息了。

paras.en: She needed sleep, but when she woke, she’d begin another journey—one that would lead her to her sister.
paras.zh: 她需要睡觉，可醒来之后，她就要踏上另一段旅程——一段将引她走向妹妹的旅程。

paras.en: “This is really nice!” Anna exclaimed as she climbed onto the bench next to Kristoff and admired his sleigh.
paras.zh: 这真是太棒了！”安娜爬上克里斯托夫旁边的长凳，欣赏着他的雪橇，赞叹道。

paras.en: The sled was far superior to the one her papa had.
paras.zh: 这雪橇比她爸爸那辆要好得多。

paras.en: The upper half of Kristoff’s sleigh was shiny dark wood, while the lower part was hand-painted black and red, with beige triangles outlining the rim.
paras.zh: 克里斯托夫的雪橇上半部分是闪亮的深色木头，下半部分则手绘成黑红两色，米色的三角形勾勒出边缘。

paras.en: The pattern reminded her of teeth.
paras.zh: 这图案让她想起了牙齿。

paras.en: It was clear this sleigh was not to be messed with.
paras.zh: 显然，这雪橇可不好惹。

paras.en: Anna threw her sack in the back, and it landed next to Kristoff’s reddish lute, his sack, and some mountaineering equipment. “Careful!” Kristoff barked. “You almost broke my lute.” “Sorry!” Anna winced. “Didn’t know you were bringing your lute with you on this trip.
paras.zh: 安娜把包袱扔到后面，正好落在克里斯托夫那把泛红的鲁特琴、他的包袱和一些登山装备旁边。“小心！”克里斯托夫喝道。“你差点弄坏我的琴。”“对不起！”安娜缩了缩脖子。“不知道你这趟还带着鲁特琴。

paras.en: I’m not sure you’ll really have time to play the next few days.” Kristoff gave her a look. “I only have it in the sleigh because I carry all of Sven’s and my belongings in here.
paras.zh: 我可不信接下来几天你真有空弹。”克里斯托夫白了她一眼。“我把它放在雪橇里，只是因为我和斯文的东西全装在这儿。

paras.en: We just paid the sled off, so I don’t need you breaking anything.” “Got it, sorry.” Anna folded her hands in her lap, thankful she had found her mittens before she ran out of the house.
paras.zh: 这雪橇我们刚付清钱，所以我可不需要你弄坏任何东西。”“知道了，抱歉。”安娜把双手叠放在腿上，心里庆幸自己跑出家门前找到了手套。

paras.en: She was only trying to make conversation.
paras.zh: 她不过是想找话说。

paras.en: How could she know Kristoff didn’t live in a house like she did?
paras.zh: 她哪知道克里斯托夫不像她那样住在房子里？

paras.en: And here she was running away from her home without permission to try to save Arendelle.
paras.zh: 而她现在竟是未经允许离家出走，想要去拯救阿伦黛尔。

paras.en: Her parents would understand—she hoped.
paras.zh: 她希望父母能理解。

paras.en: Although they might not be thrilled when they learned she had left Harmon with the ice deliverer, who was practically a total stranger.
paras.zh: 不过等他们得知她把哈蒙留给了那个送冰人——几乎完全是个陌生人——恐怕不会太高兴。

paras.en: What was she thinking?
paras.zh: 她当时在想什么？

paras.en: How was a girl who had never left her village before going to save the entire kingdom from a freak summer snowstorm?
paras.zh: 一个从未离开过村庄的女孩，要怎么把整个王国从这场反常的夏日暴风雪中拯救出来？

paras.en: By following her heart, she decided.
paras.zh: 她下定决心：跟着心走。

paras.en: Call it intuition or her gut, but she knew someone was out there looking for her.
paras.zh: 也许这叫直觉，或是第六感，但她知道外面有个人正在寻找她。

paras.en: Either that, or the snow was making her a little batty already.
paras.zh: 要么就是，大雪已经把她弄得有点神智不清了。

paras.en: The sled hit a bump and she bumped into Kristoff.
paras.zh: 雪橇颠了一下，她撞上了克里斯托夫。

paras.en: She locked eyes with him for a moment, her cheeks burning before they both looked away.
paras.zh: 她与他对视了片刻，脸颊发烫，两人随即都移开了目光。

paras.en: Anna slid over so that it wouldn’t happen again. “Hang on,” he said, staring straight ahead as he cracked the reins. “We like to go fast.” Fast was exactly what she needed.
paras.zh: 安娜往旁边挪了挪，免得再撞上。“坐稳了，”他目视前方，甩响鞭子说道。“我们喜欢开快。”快，正是她需要的。

paras.en: She had to get to Arendelle, figure out where this weather was coming from, and get back to Harmon before her parents started to worry.
paras.zh: 她得赶到阿伦黛尔，弄清这天气的来由，并在父母开始担心前赶回哈蒙。

paras.en: Who was she kidding?
paras.zh: 她骗谁呢？

paras.en: They were probably already worried.
paras.zh: 他们恐怕已经担心起来了。

paras.en: Relax, Anna, she told herself.
paras.zh: 放松点，安娜，她对自己说。

paras.en: Focus on your plan, and try to enjoy the ride.
paras.zh: 专注于计划，尽量享受这段旅程。

paras.en: She was finally leaving the village!
paras.zh: 她终于要离开村庄了！

paras.en: She put her feet up on the front of Kristoff’s sleigh. “I like fast.” “Whoa, whoa, whoa!” Kristoff nudged her boots. “Get your feet down.
paras.zh: 她把脚翘在克里斯托夫的雪橇前栏上。“我喜欢快。”“哇，哇，哇！”克里斯托夫用靴子碰了碰她的脚。“把脚放下去。

paras.en: This is fresh lacquer.
paras.zh: 这可是刚上的漆。

paras.en: Seriously, were you raised in a barn?” He spit on the wood and wiped the area where her feet had been.
paras.zh: 说真的，你是在谷仓里长大的吗？”他往木头上吐了口唾沫，擦了擦她脚踩过的地方。

paras.en: His spittle went flying into her eye.
paras.zh: 他的唾沫星子飞进了她眼睛里。

paras.en: Anna wiped her face with the back of her mitten. “No, I was raised in a bakery.
paras.zh: 安娜用 MITTEN 背面擦了擦脸。“不，我是在面包房里长大的。

paras.en: What about you?” “I was raised not far from here.” He kept his eyes on the path. “Stay alert.
paras.zh: 你呢？”“我是在离这儿不远的地方长大的。”他眼睛盯着路。“保持警惕。

paras.en: We need to watch for wolves.” Anna sighed.
paras.zh: 我们得防着狼。”安娜叹了口气。

paras.en: He wasn’t going to reveal anything about himself, was he?
paras.zh: 他是不打算透漏半点自己的事了，对吧？

paras.en: She really was traveling to Arendelle with a total stranger.
paras.zh: 她当真是和一个完全陌生的人一起前往阿伦黛尔。

paras.en: Well, he couldn’t stay a stranger for long.
paras.zh: 不过，他也不会一直是陌生人。

paras.en: Not when they had a two-day journey ahead of them to get down the mountain to Arendelle.
paras.zh: 毕竟他们还要花两天才能下山抵达阿伦黛尔。

paras.en: When they got tired, they made camp in someone’s barn.
paras.zh: 累了的时候，他们就在人家的谷仓里扎营。

paras.en: Kristoff didn’t even ask if they could use it (“Who’s coming out to check on us in this weather?”).
paras.zh: 克里斯托夫连问都不问能不能用（“这种天气谁会出来查看我们？”）。

paras.en: Then they rose before the sun to journey on.
paras.zh: 然后他们在日出前就起身继续赶路。

paras.en: Anna watched as Arendelle grew closer and closer.
paras.zh: 安娜眼看着阿伦黛尔越来越近。

paras.en: As the castle came into view that afternoon, she was too in awe to talk anymore.
paras.zh: 那天下午，城堡映入眼帘时，她惊叹得说不出话来。

paras.en: Arendelle was just like she pictured it in her mind.
paras.zh: 阿伦黛尔和她想象中的一模一样。

paras.en: Even covered in snow and ice, the castle was magnificent nestled among the mountains.
paras.zh: 即便覆盖着冰雪，城堡依山而建，依然宏伟壮丽。

paras.en: And the village surrounding it was ten times the size of Harmon. “Whoa, look at the fjord,” Kristoff said, pointing to the harbor.
paras.zh: 而环绕它的村庄有哈蒙的十倍大。“哇，看那峡湾，”克里斯托夫指着港口说。

paras.en: Dozens of ships listed on the frozen water.
paras.zh: 几十艘船在冰冻的水面上倾斜着。

paras.en: Covered in snow and ice, they looked like a ship graveyard.
paras.zh: 覆着冰雪的它们，看上去就像一片船舶坟场。

paras.en: The village was equally eerie.
paras.zh: 村庄也同样诡异。

paras.en: Even though it was the middle of the afternoon, no one was outside in this weather.
paras.zh: 尽管已是午后，这种天气下却没有人在外面。

paras.en: Everywhere, lanterns and green-and-gold flags bearing Princess Elsa’s silhouette were frozen solid. “We should find the castle courtyard,” Kristoff suggested. “Maybe someone there will know what’s going on.” “Make a right at the butcher’s shop next to the stables,” Anna said without thinking.
paras.zh: 到处都是灯笼和印有艾莎公主剪影的金绿旗帜，全冻得硬邦邦的。“我们该去城堡庭院，”克里斯托夫建议道。“那儿也许有人知道出了什么事。”“在马厩旁的肉铺那儿右拐，”安娜不假思索地说。

paras.en: Kristoff did a double take. “I thought you’d never been here before.” The butcher’s shop was straight ahead.
paras.zh: 克里斯托夫吃了一惊。“我还以为你从未来过这里。”肉铺就在正前方。

paras.en: The stables were next to it, but she was certain the courtyard was around the corner.
paras.zh: 马厩就在它旁边，但她确信庭院就在拐角处。

paras.en: Anna felt a tingle go up her spine. “I haven’t.” How did she know where to go?
paras.zh: 安娜感到脊背一阵发麻。“我没来过。”她怎么知道该怎么走？

paras.en: Kristoff followed Anna’s directions to the castle courtyard.
paras.zh: 克里斯托夫照安娜的指点来到了城堡庭院。

paras.en: A crowd was gathered around a large bonfire burning near the castle gates.
paras.zh: 城堡大门附近，一群人围着一堆燃烧的篝火。

paras.en: He dismounted and gave Sven carrots. “Let’s see what’s going on,” Anna suggested, and patted Sven on the back. “Nice job, buddy.
paras.zh: 他下了车，给了斯文几根胡萝卜。“去看看出了什么事吧，”安娜提议，拍了拍斯文的背。“干得好，老伙计。

paras.en: Why don’t you take a rest for a bit?” Sven looked happy to oblige.
paras.zh: 你先歇一会儿吧？”斯文乐得从命。

paras.en: As they got closer, Anna could see men in green uniforms passing out blankets and cloaks to villagers waiting in line.
paras.zh: 走近了，安娜看见穿绿制服的人正把毛毯和斗篷分发给排队的村民。

paras.en: Someone was also directing them to where they could get a mug of hot glogg.
paras.zh: 还有人指引他们去领一杯热格罗格酒。

paras.en: Anna looked up and gasped.
paras.zh: 安娜抬头一看，倒吸一口凉气。

paras.en: The water in the fountain had frozen midstream, curving in a pattern that was both beautiful and frightening.
paras.zh: 喷泉里的水在半空中冻结，弯成一种既美丽又骇人的形状。

paras.en: She’d never seen water freeze like that before.
paras.zh: 她从没见过水这样结冰。

paras.en: In the middle of the fountain stood a bronze sculpture of the king, the queen, and the princess as a young girl.
paras.zh: 喷泉中央立着一座青铜雕像，是国王、王后和还是小女孩的公主。

paras.en: Anna leaned on the fountain railing, trying to get a closer look.
paras.zh: 安娜靠在喷泉栏杆上，想看得更清楚些。

paras.en: Then she heard someone shouting. “The future queen has cursed this land!” A small, skinny man with glasses, a white mustache, and a military uniform was standing on the castle steps, talking to anyone who would listen.
paras.zh: 这时她听见有人喊道。“未来的女王诅咒了这片土地！”一个瘦小的男人站在城堡台阶上，戴着眼镜、留着白胡子、穿着军装，正对愿意听的人嚷嚷。

paras.en: Future queen?
paras.zh: 未来的女王？

paras.en: Cursed?
paras.zh: 诅咒？

paras.en: There was that word again.
paras.zh: 又是那个词。

paras.en: Anna joined a group of people standing in front of him. “Why would she want to hurt Arendelle?” someone asked, and others murmured in agreement. “She wouldn’t!” another man interrupted.
paras.zh: 安娜挤进站在他面前的一群人里。“她为什么要伤害阿伦黛尔？”有人问，其他人低声附和。“她不会的！”另一个男人打断道。

paras.en: He was dark-haired and large around the middle, and his face seemed kind, unlike the little man’s. “My dear people, your future queen would never hurt you.
paras.zh: 他头发乌黑、身材壮实，面容和善，与那小个子不同。“我亲爱的子民们，你们未来的女王绝不会伤害你们。

paras.en: We are doing everything we can to find the princess and stop this winter.
paras.zh: 我们正在竭尽全力寻找公主，阻止这场寒冬。

paras.en: As I’ve been saying for the past few days, the castle is open to anyone who needs it.
paras.zh: 正如我这几天一直所说的，城堡向任何有需要的人敞开。

paras.en: We have enough food and blankets for everyone.” “Don’t be a fool!” the short man snapped. “Food will eventually run out.
paras.zh: 我们有足够的食物和毛毯分给所有人。”“别傻了！”矮个子厉声说。“食物迟早会耗尽。

paras.en: We cannot survive in this strange weather forever!” “Don’t listen to the Duke of Weselton,” Lord Peterssen countered. “We must stay calm.” “What are we going to do?” asked a woman with a baby bundled up inside her cloak. “All of my vegetables have died in this weather!” “We weren’t prepared for winter in the middle of the summer,” a man shouted. “We haven’t even begun to hunt for food for the cold season.
paras.zh: 这种怪天气我们可活不长！”“别听威斯尔顿公爵的，”彼得森勋爵反驳道。“我们必须保持冷静。”“我们该怎么办？”一个把婴儿裹在斗篷里的女人问道。“我所有的蔬菜都冻死在这天气里了！”“我们可没料到夏天里会来冬天，”一个男人喊道。“我们连过寒季的存粮都还没开始准备呢。

paras.en: There won’t be enough to eat this winter if the weather doesn’t change soon.” The Duke smiled. “Do not fear!
paras.zh: 要是天气不快点好转，这个冬天就没够吃的了。”公爵微微一笑。“不必害怕！

paras.en: Prince Hans of the Southern Isles will save us all.” The crowd clapped half-heartedly, but Lord Peterssen mumbled something and turned away.
paras.zh: 南方群岛的汉斯王子会拯救我们所有人。”人群稀稀拉拉地鼓掌，彼得森勋爵却嘟囔了几句，转过身去。

paras.en: Anna was glad to hear this Prince Hans was supposedly going to save them, but how?
paras.zh: 安娜听说这位汉斯王子据说要来拯救他们，心里高兴，可怎么救呢？

paras.en: And from what?
paras.zh: 又是从什么里救出来？

paras.en: Could he change the weather? “Excuse me, but who is Prince Hans?” she spoke up. “What are you doing?” Kristoff muttered fiercely under his breath. “Getting answers.” Anna grabbed his hand and dragged him with her, snaking through the crowd until they were standing right in front of the castle steps. “Weren’t you listening?” the Duke asked rudely. “The prince has been staying in Arendelle for a while and is well versed in matters of the kingdom.
paras.zh: 他能改变天气吗？“打扰一下，汉斯王子是谁？”她大声问道。“你在干什么？”克里斯托夫压低声音凶巴巴地嘀咕。“找答案。”安娜抓住他的手，拽着他蛇一般地穿过人群，一直挤到城堡台阶正前方。“你没在听吗？”公爵粗鲁地问。“王子已在阿伦黛尔住了一阵子，对王国事务了如指掌。

paras.en: He has graciously agreed to step in and fix this situation.
paras.zh: 他已欣然同意出面扭转这一局面。

paras.en: We must stop her before we’re too late.” “Stop who?” Anna asked.
paras.zh: 我们必须在为时已晚前阻止她。”“阻止谁？”安娜问。

paras.en: The Duke rolled back his shoulders. “Did you not see for yourself what she did?
paras.zh: 公爵挺了挺肩。“你没亲眼看见她做了什么吗？

paras.en: With such a large crowd gathered for the coronation?
paras.zh: 加冕典礼上聚集了那么多人？

paras.en: She nearly killed me!” “No, I’m sorry, I didn’t see anything,” Anna said. “We just journeyed down the mountain.
paras.zh: 她差点要了我的命！”“不，抱歉，我什么都没看见，”安娜说。“我们刚从山上下来。

paras.en: My village is way up there.” She pointed to a tiny speck that was almost completely obscured. “We were preparing to celebrate the queen’s coronation when this unusual weather blew in.
paras.zh: 我的村庄在那边老远。”她指向一个几乎完全被遮住的小点。“我们正准备庆祝女王加冕，这反常的天气就刮来了。

paras.en: We’re worried about what’s happening, too, which is why we’re here for answers.
paras.zh: 我们也在担心发生了什么，所以才来这里寻个答案。

paras.en: So I apologize, but who are you talking about?” “The princess!” The Duke jumped up and down like a toddler. “She’s a monster!” “The princess?” Anna repeated, her heart thumping wildly as a ringing started in her ears.
paras.zh: 所以我道歉，但你们说的到底是谁？”“公主！”公爵像个小小孩似的又蹦又跳。“她是个怪物！”“公主？”安娜重复道，心狂跳起来，耳边嗡嗡作响。

paras.en: I have to find her, she thought suddenly, but she wasn’t sure why she thought she could. “Why would Princess Elsa try to hurt you?” “She didn’t,” interrupted Lord Peterssen. “The princess wouldn’t hurt anyone.
paras.zh: 我得找到她，她忽然想，却不明白自己为何觉得自己办得到。“艾莎公主为什么要伤害你们？”“她没有，”彼得森勋爵打断道。“公主不会伤害任何人。

paras.en: She was frightened and ran off, but she’ll return.
paras.zh: 她受了惊吓跑开了，但她会回来的。

paras.en: She’d never abandon her people.” He glared at the Duke. “And I would prefer if you didn’t call the future queen a monster.” “She froze the fjord!” a man called out. “We can’t get our ships in or out of the harbor!” “We’re trapped here because of her!” someone else yelled. “How am I going to feed my family if we can’t get food?” a woman cried while a baby wailed in the distance. “Her magic has frozen the whole kingdom.
paras.zh: 她绝不会抛弃她的子民。”他瞪了公爵一眼。“而且我更希望你们别把未来的女王叫作怪物。”“她冻住了峡湾！”一个男人喊道。“我们的船进不了港也出不了港！”“我们被她困在这儿了！”另一个人嚷嚷。“要是弄不到食物，我怎么养活全家？”一个女人哭喊着，远处传来婴儿啼哭。“她的魔法把整个王国都冻住了。

paras.en: If it is no better where these people have come from, we are truly doomed!” “Wait,” Kristoff interrupted. “Are you telling me the future queen caused this snowstorm?
paras.zh: 要是这些人所来的地方也一样糟，那我们真没救了！”“等等，”克里斯托夫打断道。“你是说未来的女王引发了这场暴风雪？

paras.en: How?” “Sorcery!
paras.zh: 怎么引发的？”“妖术！

paras.en: Witchcraft!” the Duke railed. “After her powers were revealed, she fled across the fjord, creating this eternal winter.
paras.zh: 巫术！”公爵咆哮道。“她的力量暴露后，便逃过峡湾，制造了这场永冬。

paras.en: She must be stopped!
paras.zh: 必须阻止她！

paras.en: Prince Hans went after the princess.
paras.zh: 汉斯王子去追公主了。

paras.en: He is hoping to talk some sense into her.” “The princess has powers?” Anna asked. “She made all this snow and ice?
paras.zh: 他希望能劝她回心转意。”“公主有魔力？”安娜问。“这些都是她造的雪和冰？

paras.en: Why, that’s incredible!” The Duke narrowed his eyes at her. “Who are you, girl?” Kristoff stood taller, shifting his body slightly in front of hers.
paras.zh: 哎呀，那太了不起了！”公爵眯起眼睛打量她。“你这丫头是谁？”克里斯托夫挺直身子，微微挪到她身前。

paras.en: She nudged him aside. “Someone who wants to stop this winter as much as you do,” Anna said firmly. “And I don’t see how threatening the princess will help anyone.” The Duke was grim. “I suggest you find somewhere to keep warm until Prince Hans returns.
paras.zh: 她把他拨到一边。“一个和你一样想结束这场寒冬的人，”安娜坚定地说。“而且我看不出威胁公主对谁有好处。”公爵脸色阴沉。“我建议你找个地方取暖，等汉斯王子回来。

paras.en: You’ll never make it back up the mountain in these conditions.
paras.zh: 这种天气你根本回不了山上。

paras.en: It’s growing colder.
paras.zh: 天越来越冷了。

paras.en: This winter won’t end till we find the princess and make her stop the madness.” He headed back into the castle, and the crowd started to disperse. “Wait!” Anna cried.
paras.zh: 不找到公主、让她停止这疯狂举动，冬天就不会结束。”他转身走进城堡，人群开始散去。“等等！”安娜喊道。

paras.en: The Duke ignored her.
paras.zh: 公爵没理她。

paras.en: There was something about that man she did not like. “You expect this Prince Hans to find her on his own?” Anna ran after them.
paras.zh: 那男人身上有某种她不喜欢的东西。“你指望这位汉斯王子独自找到她？”安娜追了上去。

paras.en: No one was listening. “Wait!” She turned back to Kristoff.
paras.zh: 没人理会。“等等！”她回头看向克里斯托夫。

paras.en: He and Lord Peterssen were the only people still standing there. “If the princess caused this winter, it had to be by mistake.
paras.zh: 他和彼得森勋爵是仅剩还站在那儿的人。“要是公主引发了这个冬天，那一定是出于意外。

paras.en: She must feel so helpless!” Lord Peterssen rubbed his hands in front of the fire to keep warm. “And frightened.
paras.zh: 她一定感到很无助！”彼得森勋爵在火前搓着手取暖。“也很害怕。

paras.en: I imagine she kept these powers from all of us for fear of how we’d react—and people are as frightened as she feared.
paras.zh: 我猜她向所有人隐瞒这些力量，是怕我们的反应——而人们果然和她担心的一样害怕。

paras.en: Maybe if she just came back and explained herself…” He looked up at the sky as snowflakes fell on his face. “I just hope we find her before it’s too late.” Anna stared again at the bronze statue of the royal family covered in ice. “Her magic and what she’s capable of is so beautiful.” “ If one is prepared for this kind of weather,” Kristoff said, standing close to the fire. “No one wants to see snow in the middle of the summer.” “No, they do not.” Lord Peterssen rubbed his hands to keep warm. “I just hope Prince Hans finds her and convinces her to come back to us so we can fix this.” “Do you have any idea where she went?” Anna asked. “I didn’t see the princess run,” Lord Peterssen admitted, “but many saw her flee across the fjord and head in the direction of the North Mountain.
paras.zh: 也许只要她回来解释一下……”他抬头望天，雪花落在脸上。“我只希望我们在为时已晚前找到她。”安娜再次盯着那座覆着冰的皇家青铜雕像。“她的魔法和她所能做的，真是美极了。”“要是有人为这种天气做好准备的话，”克里斯托夫站在火边说。“没人在盛夏想看见雪。”“是啊，没人想。”彼得森勋爵搓着手取暖。“我只希望汉斯王子找到她，说服她回到我们身边，这样我们才能解决这一切。”“你知道她去哪儿了吗？”安娜问。“我没看见公主跑，”彼得森勋爵承认，“但许多人看见她逃过峡湾，朝北山方向去了。

paras.en: It isn’t much to go on, I know.” He rubbed his arms. “If you’ll excuse me, I’m going back inside.
paras.zh: 我知道，这点线索不算多。”他搓了搓胳膊。“恕我失陪，我回屋里去了。
