paras.en: Please have some hot glogg before you journey home again.
paras.zh: 你们回程前请喝点热格罗格酒。

paras.en: Hopefully this weather will turn before you must go back.” “Go back?
paras.zh: 但愿这天气在你们必须回去前能好转。”“回去？

paras.en: But…” She couldn’t go back yet.
paras.zh: 可是……”她还回不去。

paras.en: Now that she knew the storm was caused by magic, she couldn’t just walk away.
paras.zh: 既然她知道这场风暴是魔法引起的，她就不可能一走了之。

paras.en: She had to help bring back summer and find the princess.
paras.zh: 她得帮忙把夏天找回来，找到公主。

paras.en: Anna understood why the princess would be frightened, but why head to the North Mountain?
paras.zh: 安娜明白公主为何害怕，可她为什么要去北山？

paras.en: Was something up there?
paras.zh: 那里有什么东西吗？

paras.en: Her skin prickled.
paras.zh: 她的皮肤一阵刺痛。

paras.en: I think I’m supposed to help her.
paras.zh: 我想我注定要帮她。

paras.en: The closer she got to the castle, the more she felt it.
paras.zh: 她离城堡越近，这种感觉就越强烈。

paras.en: Now her gut was telling her to walk into the castle, but that didn’t make sense.
paras.zh: 此刻她的直觉告诉她要走进城堡，但这说不通。

paras.en: If the people were right, Elsa was halfway up the North Mountain.
paras.zh: 要是人们说得对，艾莎现在该在北山半腰。

paras.en: Still, staring up at the lit windows and archways of the castle, Anna felt a magnetic pull.
paras.zh: 然而，望着城堡里亮着灯的窗户和拱门，安娜感到一股磁石般的吸引力。

paras.en: She knew something was waiting for her inside. “Do you want some glogg?” Kristoff asked, pulling her from her thoughts. “I’ve never been a fan, but if we’re going to begin the journey back to Harmon to tell everyone what’s going on, then we should probably eat and drink something.
paras.zh: 她知道里面有东西在等她。“想喝点格罗格酒吗？”克里斯托夫问，把她从思绪中拉回。“我一向不喜欢那玩意儿，可要是我们要动身回哈蒙，告诉大家出了什么事，那咱们大概得吃点喝点。

paras.en: And get more carrots for Sven.” He watched Anna walk right past him. “Hey!
paras.zh: 再给斯文多弄点胡萝卜。”他眼看着安娜从他身边走了过去。“嘿！

paras.en: Where are you going?” Anna climbed the castle steps to the entrance.
paras.zh: 你去哪儿？”安娜登上城堡台阶，走向入口。

paras.en: There were no guards to be seen, and the crowd had dispersed.
paras.zh: 看不见一个卫兵，人群也已散去。

paras.en: If there was ever a good moment to enter, this was it. “Hey, hey, hey!” Kristoff rushed in front of her. “You can’t just walk inside the royal castle uninvited!” “I am invited!
paras.zh: 要说进门的良机，此刻正是。“嘿，嘿，嘿！”克里斯托夫冲到她面前。“你不能就这么不请自来地走进皇家城堡！”“我受邀请了！

paras.en: Sort of.
paras.zh: 算是吧。

paras.en: Didn’t Lord Peterssen say the castle was open if anyone needed it?” Anna ducked under his arm and continued up the stairs.
paras.zh: 彼得森勋爵不是说了，谁有需要城堡都敞开吗？”安娜从他胳膊下钻过，继续上台阶。

paras.en: The coast was still clear.
paras.zh: 四下依然无人。

paras.en: She could make it inside unnoticed and then…well, who knew?
paras.zh: 她可以神不知鬼不觉地溜进去，然后……谁知道呢？

paras.en: She just had to get inside. “Lord Peterssen meant if you needed help.” Kristoff slid on a patch of ice on the steps. “The glogg is outside the entrance.
paras.zh: 她只是必须进去。“彼得森勋爵的意思是，如果你需要帮助的话。”克里斯托夫在台阶的冰面上打滑。“格罗格酒在入口外头。

paras.en: He didn’t mean go inside.” But she had to get inside.
paras.zh: 他不是让你进去。”可她必须进去。

paras.en: It was as if the place were calling to her.
paras.zh: 仿佛那地方在呼唤她。

paras.en: She could feel it in her bones, but she didn’t know how to explain that to Kristoff. “No one is even guarding the entrance.
paras.zh: 她骨子里都感觉到了，却不知怎么向克里斯托夫解释。“连入口都没人守。

paras.en: It’s like someone wants us to come in.
paras.zh: 就好像有人想让我们进来。

paras.en: I’ll only be a minute.
paras.zh: 我就进去一会儿。

paras.en: I just need to see something.” “Anna!” Kristoff tried to keep up with her.
paras.zh: 我只是想看看一样东西。”“安娜！”克里斯托夫想跟上她。

paras.en: She reached the top step and opened the door.
paras.zh: 她登上最高一级台阶，推开了门。

paras.en: The second she walked inside, she felt a strange calm come over her.
paras.zh: 她一走进去，就感到一种奇异的平静笼罩全身。

paras.en: Anna stared up at the high vaulted ceiling in the two-story entranceway.
paras.zh: 安娜抬头望着两层高门厅里高耸的拱顶。

paras.en: The room had a central staircase with two sets of stairs that both led to a second-story landing.
paras.zh: 大厅中央是一道楼梯，两段台阶都通向二楼的回廊。

paras.en: Portraits decorated the walls on both levels.
paras.zh: 两层墙上都装饰着肖像画。

paras.en: Why does this room seem so familiar? she wondered.
paras.zh: 这房间为何如此眼熟？她纳闷。

paras.en: I’ve never been here before.
paras.zh: 我以前从未来过这里。

paras.en: She glanced up at the central staircase again and had a sudden vision of a redheaded girl in a nightgown and bare feet racing down the staircase, giggling.
paras.zh: 她又瞥了眼中央楼梯，忽然眼前浮现一个穿睡衣、光着脚的红发女孩咯咯笑着冲下楼梯的画面。

paras.en: Anna jumped in surprise. “It’s me,” she said softly, running toward the stairs. “Don’t go upstairs!
paras.zh: 安娜吃惊地跳了一下。“那是我，”她轻声说，朝楼梯跑去。“别上楼！

paras.en: Are you crazy?” Kristoff grabbed her arm but stopped talking when he saw her expression. “What is it?” The image vanished.
paras.zh: 你疯了吗？”克里斯托夫抓住她的胳膊，但看到她的神情便住了口。“怎么了？”那画面消失了。

paras.en: This doesn’t make sense.
paras.zh: 这说不通。

paras.en: Anna’s knees buckled. “Whoa!” Kristoff held her up. “What’s going on?” “I thought…I…” Anna wasn’t sure how to explain what she had just seen without sounding crazy.
paras.zh: 安娜的双膝一软。“哇！”克里斯托夫扶住她。“怎么回事？”“我好像……我……”安娜不知该怎么解释刚才所见，才不显得疯疯癫癫。

paras.en: She spun around, trying to get her bearings, and spotted the portrait of the royal family.
paras.zh: 她转过身，定了定神，看见了那幅皇家全家福。

paras.en: Anna stepped closer, staring at the picture curiously.
paras.zh: 安娜走近几步，好奇地盯着画。

paras.en: Freya?
paras.zh: 弗蕾雅？

paras.en: Anna gasped in surprise.
paras.zh: 安娜惊讶地倒吸一口气。

paras.en: The queen and Freya looked exactly alike.
paras.zh: 王后和弗蕾雅长得一模一样。

paras.en: How is that possible? she thought, and reached up to touch the painting then saw a flash.
paras.zh: 这怎么可能？她想，伸手去触摸画作，随即看见一道闪光。

paras.en: She saw her younger self sitting on a bench with her legs dangling while someone painted her portrait. “Anna, hold still!” the person said.
paras.zh: 她看见年幼的自己坐在长凳上，双腿悬空，有人正为她画像。“安娜，别动！”那人说。

paras.en: She felt her knees wobble again. “Are you okay?” Kristoff asked. “It’s so strange, but I feel like I’ve been here before.” Anna clung to his arm so she wouldn’t fall. “Have you?” Kristoff asked quietly.
paras.zh: 她又感到膝盖发软。“你还好吗？”克里斯托夫问。“真奇怪，可我觉得自己以前来过这里。”安娜抓住他的胳膊以免摔倒。“是吗？”克里斯托夫轻声问。

paras.en: Anna looked at him.
paras.zh: 安娜看着他。

paras.en: Her voice was small. “No.” “We should leave,” he said, sounding worried.
paras.zh: 她声音微弱。“没有。”“我们该走了，”他担忧地说。

paras.en: Anna shook her head. “We can’t.
paras.zh: 安娜摇了摇头。“不行。

paras.en: There’s something here I’m meant to find.” She let go of him and headed up the staircase to the next floor.
paras.zh: 这里有我注定要找的东西。”她松开手，朝上层楼梯走去。

paras.en: This time he didn’t stop her.
paras.zh: 这一次他没有阻止她。

paras.en: Kristoff silently followed her down the long hallway past several rooms.
paras.zh: 克里斯托夫默不作声地跟着她穿过长廊，经过几间屋子。

paras.en: She heard the wind howling outside the windows as she climbed another staircase.
paras.zh: 她爬上另一段楼梯时，听见窗外狂风呼啸。

paras.en: She stopped abruptly when she saw a wall of jagged icicles blocking their path.
paras.zh: 看到一堵参差不齐的冰柱墙挡住去路，她猛地停住。

paras.en: Kristoff touched the sharp point on one of the icicles. “What happened here?” “It had to be the princess when she was trying to get away,” Anna guessed.
paras.zh: 克里斯托夫摸了摸一根冰柱的尖头。“这里怎么了？”“一定是公主想逃走时弄的，”安娜猜测。

paras.en: But what had frightened her in the first place?
paras.zh: 可最初到底是什么吓到了她？

paras.en: The ice she’d created looked almost like a sculpture, twisting and turning into a shape Anna couldn’t put her finger on.
paras.zh: 她造出的冰几乎像一座雕塑，盘旋扭转成安娜说不清的形状。

paras.en: She’d never seen anything like it before. “I never knew winter could be so magical.” “Yeah…it really is beautiful, isn’t it?” someone behind them said. “But it’s so colorless.
paras.zh: 她从没见过这样的东西。“我从不知道冬天竟能如此神奇。”“是啊……真的很美，不是吗？”身后有人说道。“可它太没有色彩了。

paras.en: You know, how about a little variety?
paras.zh: 我说，来点变化怎么样？

paras.en: Must we bleach the joy out of it all?” Anna and Kristoff turned around and immediately jumped.
paras.zh: 非得把其中的欢乐都漂得褪了色吗？”安娜和克里斯托夫转过身，立刻跳了起来。

paras.en: The person speaking was a walking, talking snowman with short, stout legs, a plump bottom, a thin oval head, teeth, and a carrot nose.
paras.zh: 说话的是个会走会说的雪人，短短粗粗的腿、圆滚滚的身子、瘦长的椭圆脑袋、一口牙，还有个胡萝卜鼻子。

paras.en: A cloud with a flurry followed him. “I’m thinking like maybe some crimson, chartreuse…” The snowman continued to babble as he approached. “How ’bout yellow?
paras.zh: 一小团飘雪跟着他。“我在想，比如来点深红、黄绿……”雪人边走近边絮叨。“黄色怎么样？

paras.en: No, not yellow.
paras.zh: 不，不要黄色。

paras.en: Yellow and snow?
paras.zh: 黄色和雪？

paras.en: Brrr…no go.
paras.zh: 哆……不行。

paras.en: Am I right?” He blinked at Anna.
paras.zh: 我说得对吧？”他冲安娜眨了眨眼。

paras.en: Anna screamed and reflexively kicked his head, sending it flying off his body and into Kristoff’s arms. “Hi!” the head said. “You’re creepy!” Kristoff tossed the snowman’s head back to Anna. “I don’t want it!” Anna threw it back to him. “Back atcha!” Kristoff sent it her way again. “Please don’t drop me,” the head said as its body ran at her, waving its twig arms.
paras.zh: 安娜尖叫一声，本能地踢了他的头一脚，脑袋飞离身子，落进克里斯托夫怀里。“嗨！”脑袋说。“你真吓人！”克里斯托夫把雪人的脑袋扔回给安娜。“我不要它！”安娜又扔回给他。“还给你！”克里斯托夫再次朝她扔去。“请别把我掉地上，”脑袋说，与此同时它的身子挥着树枝胳膊朝她跑来。

paras.en: Now Anna felt bad. “Sorry.
paras.zh: 这下安娜觉得过意不去。“对不起。

paras.en: I won’t.” She was talking to a snowman.
paras.zh: 我不会的。”她在跟一个雪人说话。

paras.en: How was that possible? “All right,” the head said. “We got off to a bad start.
paras.zh: 这怎么可能？“好吧，”脑袋说。“我们开头不太顺利。

paras.en: Can you put me back together?” The body waited patiently next to her.
paras.zh: 能把我还拼回去吗？”身子在她身旁耐心等着。

paras.en: Was the snowman serious?
paras.zh: 雪人是认真的吗？

paras.en: Carefully, she reached out with the head. “Ew!
paras.zh: 她小心翼翼地拿着脑袋伸过去。“呃！

paras.en: Ew!” Anna cried as she placed it back onto his body.
paras.zh: 呃！”安娜边叫边把脑袋安回身子上。

paras.en: In her haste, she put the head on upside down.
paras.zh: 匆忙间，她把脑袋给倒着安上了。

paras.en: The snowman looked confused. “Wait, what am I looking at right now?
paras.zh: 雪人一脸茫然。“等等，我现在看到的是什么？

paras.en: Why are you hanging from the ceiling like a bat?” Anna knelt down. “Okay, wait a second.” She flipped his head the right way. “Ooh!
paras.zh: 你们怎么像蝙蝠似的挂在天花板上？”安娜跪下来。“好，等一下。”她把他的脑袋翻正。“噢！

paras.en: Thank you!” the snowman said. “Now everything’s perfect!” Anna wasn’t sure about perfect.
paras.zh: 谢谢你！”雪人说。“现在一切完美了！”安娜可不敢说“完美”。

paras.en: It was snowing in the middle of the summer, the princess had the power to create ice, they were talking to a snowman, and Anna was having the strangest sense of déjà vu standing in the middle of Arendelle Castle.
paras.zh: 盛夏里下着雪，公主拥有造冰的魔力，他们正和一个雪人说话，而安娜站在阿伦黛尔城堡中央，有一种最奇怪的似曾相识感。

paras.en: She stared harder at the snowman.
paras.zh: 她更仔细地盯着雪人。

paras.en: He seemed familiar as well, from the curve of his head to his front teeth and twig hair.
paras.zh: 他也显得眼熟，从脑袋的弧度，到门牙，再到树枝般的头发。

paras.en: He’s the snowman from my dreams! she realized.
paras.zh: 他是我梦里的那个雪人！她恍然。

paras.en: He inspired my cookies.
paras.zh: 我的饼干就是照他做的。

paras.en: How can that be if I’m just meeting him for the first time?
paras.zh: 可我要是第一次见到他，这怎么可能？

paras.en: She started to hyperventilate.
paras.zh: 她开始喘不上气来。

paras.en: Kristoff stared at her strangely. “I didn’t mean to scare you!
paras.zh: 克里斯托夫奇怪地盯着她。“我没想吓你！

paras.en: Let’s start over,” the snowman told her. “Hi, everyone.
paras.zh: 我们重新来过吧，”雪人对她说。“大家好。

paras.en: I’m Olaf, and I like warm hugs.” She tried to calm herself down. “Olaf,” Anna repeated .
paras.zh: 我是雪宝，我喜欢温暖的拥抱。”她努力让自己平静下来。“雪宝，”安娜重复道。

paras.en: I know this name.
paras.zh: 我知道这个名字。

paras.en: Why? “And you are…?” Olaf looked at her patiently. “Oh…um, I’m Anna.” “Anna?
paras.zh: 为什么？”“那你呢……？”雪宝耐心地看着她。“哦……嗯，我是安娜。”“安娜？

paras.en: Huh.” Olaf scratched his chin. “I think I was supposed to remember something about an Anna.
paras.zh: 嗯。”雪宝挠了挠下巴。“我想我本该记得关于一个叫安娜的什么事。

paras.en: I’m not sure what it was, though.” Anna’s heart started to beat fast again.
paras.zh: 不过我不确定那是什么。”安娜的心又开始狂跳。

paras.en: She moved in closer. “You were?” “And you are…?” Olaf asked Kristoff as he pulled off one of the snowman’s twig arms. “Fascinating,” Kristoff muttered as the twig arm he was holding continued to move even though it wasn’t attached to Olaf’s body. “He’s Kristoff,” Anna replied. “We came here together.” She watched the snowman continue to move around.
paras.zh: 她凑近了些。“你记得？”“那你呢……？”雪宝一边问克里斯托夫，一边拔下自己的一条树枝胳膊。“真有意思，”克里斯托夫嘀咕，他手里那条树枝胳膊虽已脱离雪宝身子却仍在动。“他是克里斯托夫，”安娜答道。“我们一起来的。”她看着雪人继续走动。

paras.en: If Elsa could make ice, then maybe she could make a walking, talking snowman, too. “Olaf…did Elsa build you?” “Yeah.
paras.zh: 既然艾莎能造冰，那她也许也能造出一个会走会说的雪人。“雪宝……是艾莎造的你吗？”“是啊。

paras.en: Why?” Olaf replied.
paras.zh: 怎么了？”雪宝答道。

paras.en: Progress! “Do you know where she is?” Anna held her breath. “Yeah.
paras.zh: 有进展！“你知道她在哪儿吗？”安娜屏住呼吸。“知道。

paras.en: Why?” Olaf asked again.
paras.zh: 怎么了？”雪宝又问。

paras.en: Her palms began to sweat.
paras.zh: 她的手心开始冒汗。

paras.en: This felt right.
paras.zh: 这感觉对了。

paras.en: She was on to something.
paras.zh: 她摸到门道了。

paras.en: Olaf knew where to find the princess. “Do you think you could show us the way?” Kristoff bent the twig.
paras.zh: 雪宝知道去哪里找公主。“你能带我们过去吗？”克里斯托夫弯了弯那根树枝。

paras.en: Instead of snapping, it bent right back into place. “How does this thing work?” he interrupted.
paras.zh: 它没折断，反而弹回原状。“这东西是怎么动的？”他插嘴问。

paras.en: The twig smacked Kristoff in the face. “Hey!” Olaf snatched the arm back and stuck it onto his body. “Trying to concentrate here.” He looked at Anna again. “Yeah.
paras.zh: 树枝啪地打在克里斯托夫脸上。“嘿！”雪宝一把夺回胳膊装回身上。“我正想集中精神呢。”他又看着安娜。“知道。

paras.en: Why?” “I’ll tell you why.
paras.zh: 怎么了？”“我来告诉你为什么。

paras.en: We need Elsa to bring back summer,” Kristoff said. “Summer!” Olaf gasped. “Oh, I don’t know why, but I’ve always loved summer, and sun, and all things hot.” “Really?” Kristoff almost laughed. “I’m guessing you don’t have much experience with heat.” “Of course I do,” Olaf argued. “I’ve lived through winter, spring, summer, and fall, but I’ve always seen it through Elsa’s window.” He sighed. “Sometimes I like to close my eyes and imagine what it would be like to experience weather outside the castle.
paras.zh: 我们需要艾莎把夏天带回来，”克里斯托夫说。“夏天！”雪宝倒吸一口气。“哦，我不知道为什么，可我一直喜欢夏天、阳光，还有一切热乎乎的东西。”“真的？”克里斯托夫差点笑出来。“我猜你没怎么体验过热吧。”“我当然体验过，”雪宝争辩道。“我经历过冬、春、夏、秋，只是一直是透过艾莎的窗户看到的。”他叹了口气。“有时我喜欢闭上眼睛，想象在城堡外感受天气会是什么样。

paras.en: Or even outside Elsa’s chambers, but I guess I’m doing that now.
paras.zh: 或者哪怕就在艾莎的房间外，不过我想我现在正体验着呢。

paras.en: I couldn’t wait anymore.
paras.zh: 我再也等不下去了。

paras.en: Elsa didn’t come back after Hans and the Duke came for her, so I wanted to go find her.” He looked at Anna. “She was looking for you.” “Me?” Anna stepped back, bumping into Kristoff. “She doesn’t even know me.” Her heart was beating so fast it felt like it would come out of her chest.
paras.zh: 汉斯和公爵来找过她之后，艾莎就没回来，所以我想去找她。”他看着安娜。“她当时在找你。”“我？”安娜后退一步，撞上克里斯托夫。“她根本不认识我。”她的心跳快得仿佛要蹦出胸膛。

paras.en: In her head, images flashed by again.
paras.zh: 她脑海里，画面再次闪过。

paras.en: She heard the little girl she had seen on the stairs laughing and saw, again, the image of herself on a bench while someone drew her.
paras.zh: 她听见楼梯上那个小女孩的笑声，又看见自己坐在长凳上、有人为她画像的画面。

paras.en: Neither of those things had happened before.
paras.zh: 这两件事此前都不曾发生。

paras.en: She’d never been to Arendelle or the castle, yet it, too, seemed familiar.
paras.zh: 她从没来过阿伦黛尔或城堡，可这里也同样眼熟。

paras.en: And now finding Olaf—that felt like it was meant to be.
paras.zh: 而如今遇见雪宝——那感觉像是命中注定。

paras.en: She wasn’t sure why Olaf thought he knew her, but her heart said he might be right. “Are you sure about that?” Olaf asked. “Olaf?
paras.zh: 她不确定雪宝为何觉得自己认识她，但她的心告诉她，他也许是对的。“你确定吗？”雪宝问。“雪宝？

paras.en: Will you help us find Elsa?” She held out her hand.
paras.zh: 你愿意帮我们找艾莎吗？”她伸出手。

paras.en: Olaf took it and toddled down the hall, heading for the stairs. “Come on!
paras.zh: 雪宝握住她的手，摇摇摆摆地穿过走廊，朝楼梯走去。“快点！

paras.en: Elsa’s this way.
paras.zh: 艾莎在这边。

paras.en: Let’s go bring back summer!” Kristoff shook his head as he followed. “Are we really listening to a talking snowman now?” Anna looked back at him. “Yes!
paras.zh: 我们去把夏天带回来！”克里斯托夫边跟着边摇头。“我们现在真在听一个会说话的雪人指挥？”安娜回头看他。“对！

paras.en: We can’t go back to Harmon yet.
paras.zh: 我们还不能回哈蒙。

paras.en: Not if we can help find the princess and stop this winter.” Kristoff sighed. “Fine, but Sven isn’t going to like this.” Anna gave the castle one last lingering look.
paras.zh: 只要我们能帮忙找到公主、结束这场寒冬，就不能走。”克里斯托夫叹了口气。“行吧，可斯文不会喜欢这样。”安娜最后依依不舍地望了城堡一眼。

paras.en: She had a feeling she’d be back.
paras.zh: 她有种预感，自己还会回来。

paras.en: She wasn’t sure what her purpose was yet, but something told her finding Elsa would give her the answers she needed.
paras.zh: 她还不确定自己的使命是什么，但有个声音告诉她，找到艾莎就能得到她需要的答案。

paras.en: She was so preoccupied she didn’t notice the Duke standing in the shadows, watching the unlikely trio leave the castle.
paras.zh: 她心事太重，竟没注意到公爵正站在暗影里，注视着这奇怪的三人组离开城堡。

paras.en: As Elsa set off on her new journey, she realized she had no idea how to find the Valley of the Living Rock.
paras.zh: 艾莎踏上新的旅程时，才发现自己根本不知该如何去找活石谷。

paras.en: In her memory, she hadn’t looked at landmarks or paid attention to the route her family took.
paras.zh: 在她的记忆里，她当年没留意路标，也没注意家人走的路线。

paras.en: She was just a child.
paras.zh: 那时她只是个孩子。

paras.en: And now, with the kingdom covered in white, it made finding her way even harder.
paras.zh: 而如今王国一片雪白，要找到路就更难了。

paras.en: What she really needed was a map.
paras.zh: 她真正需要的是一张地图。

paras.en: But would a regular map mark off a magical location such as the valley?
paras.zh: 可一张普通地图会标出像活石谷这样的魔法之地吗？

paras.en: There was only one way to find out.
paras.zh: 只有一个办法能弄清楚。

paras.en: She needed to locate someone who lived in the mountains and might know the area.
paras.zh: 她得找个住在山里、或许熟悉那一带的人。

paras.en: Elsa used her magic to quicken her search, creating a sleigh made out of ice to take her down the mountain.
paras.zh: 艾莎用魔法加快了搜寻，造出一辆冰做的雪橇，载她下山。

paras.en: The sleigh gained speed as she crossed into the forest.
paras.zh: 雪橇驶入森林，速度越来越快。

paras.en: When she saw a smokestack in the distance, she headed directly for it.
paras.zh: 远远望见一座烟囱，她径直朝它驶去。

paras.en: The building was partially covered in a snowdrift.
paras.zh: 那幢房子被雪堆半掩着。

paras.en: Ice had frozen on the sign on the porch.
paras.zh: 门廊招牌上结了冰。

paras.en: Elsa tapped it and the ice broke off, allowing her to read the sign: Wandering Oaken’s Trading Post and Sauna.
paras.zh: 艾莎敲了敲，冰脱落下来，她看清了招牌：漫游橡木杂货店与桑拿房。

paras.en: Elsa paused before knocking.
paras.zh: 艾莎敲门前顿了顿。

paras.en: What if someone inside recognized her?
paras.zh: 要是里面有人认出她怎么办？

paras.en: Walking into the shop wearing an evening gown would give her away.
paras.zh: 穿着晚礼服走进店里会暴露身份。

paras.en: With a wave of her hand, Elsa created a sparkling royal blue hooded cloak.
paras.zh: 她手一挥，造出一件闪闪发光的宝蓝色带帽斗篷。

paras.en: She pulled the hood over her head and hoped it hid her familiar face.
paras.zh: 她把兜帽拉过头顶，但愿能遮住那张众人熟悉的面孔。

paras.en: Then she walked up the steps and into the shop.
paras.zh: 然后她走上台阶，进了店里。

paras.en: A man in a patterned sweater with a matching hat was seated behind a counter. “Hoo-hoo!
paras.zh: 一个穿着花纹毛衣、戴着同款帽子的男人坐在柜台后。“吼吼！

paras.en: Big summer blowout!” he said. “Half off swimming suits, clogs, and a sun balm of my own invention.
paras.zh: 夏日大甩卖！”他说。“泳衣、木屐，还有我自己发明的防晒膏，统统半价。

paras.en: If you’re looking for cold weather gear, we don’t have much left in our winter department.” He pointed to a sparse corner of the shop that had a lone snowshoe sitting in it. “Thank you, but I have all I need for this weather.” Elsa stood in the shadows as she looked around the dimly lit space.
paras.zh: 要是你想找御寒装备，我们冬装区没剩多少了。”他指向店里一个空荡荡的角落，那儿孤零零放着一只雪鞋。“谢谢，不过这种天气我该有的都有了。”艾莎站在阴影里，打量着这间昏暗的铺子。

paras.en: The shelves were cramped with supplies from ice axes to clothing and food. “What I really need is a map.” She paused. “Or directions to the Valley of the Living Rock.” His blue eyes widened. “Ooh, yes, a map I have, ja ?
paras.zh: 货架上塞满了从冰镐到衣物、食物的各种物资。“我真正需要的是一张地图。”她顿了顿。“或者去活石谷的路线。”他蓝色的眼睛睁大了。“噢，对，地图我倒有一张，是吧？

paras.en: But I don’t know of this place you mention, dear.” He shimmied out from behind the narrow counter, trying hard to keep his large frame from knocking over any of the books stacked on the shelf behind him.
paras.zh: 可你说的这地方，亲爱的，我从未听闻。”他从窄柜台后挪出身子，尽力不让自己庞大的身躯碰倒身后架子上堆着的书。

paras.en: He unfurled a large scroll and showed it to Elsa, pointing out different landmarks.
paras.zh: 他展开一卷大地图，指给艾莎看，标出各处地标。

paras.en: One looked like a rocky area just northwest of where Elsa’s sleigh was stopped. “I hope you find what you’re looking for, even if this isn’t the weather to be traveling in.
paras.zh: 有一处像是艾莎雪橇停驻点西北方向的岩石地带。“但愿你找到要找的东西，尽管这天气实在不宜出行。

paras.en: The only one crazy enough to be out in this storm is you, dear,” Oaken added. “A real howler in July, huh?
paras.zh: 亲爱的，敢在这风暴里出门的疯子只有你一个，”橡木补充道。“七月里这么号叫的天气，嗯？

paras.en: Wherever could it be coming from?” “The North Mountain,” she murmured without thinking.
paras.zh: 这到底是从哪儿来的？”“北山，”她不假思索地低声说。

paras.en: She pressed some coins into Oaken’s hand. “Thank you for the map.” She shuffled out again and discarded her cloak.
paras.zh: 她往橡木手里按了几枚硬币。“谢谢你的地图。”她拖着步子出去，脱下了斗篷。

paras.en: Oaken had been right about the howler part: the wind had picked up that day, and many areas were now covered in a thick ice.
paras.zh: 橡木说的“号叫”一点没错：那天风势更猛，许多地方如今覆着厚厚一层冰。

paras.en: Elsa climbed into her sleigh again and, using her magic to propel her, crossed the river and glided along while watching closely for the rocky area that she suspected could be the valley.
paras.zh: 艾莎再次钻进雪橇，用魔力驱动，渡过河，一路滑行，密切留意那片她疑心可能就是活石谷的岩石地带。

paras.en: Slowly the landscape started to change.
paras.zh: 景色渐渐变了。

paras.en: Snow-covered trees gave way to large boulders.
paras.zh: 覆雪的树木让位给巨大的卵石。

paras.en: Something about it looked familiar.
paras.zh: 这地方有种熟悉感。

paras.en: Elsa stopped and hid the sleigh behind a row of trees, then followed a craggy path until she reached what seemed to be an entrance to the valley.
paras.zh: 艾莎停下，把雪橇藏在树丛后，然后沿着一条崎岖小径，走到看似谷口的地方。

paras.en: As she as she got closer, she knew she was in the right place.
paras.zh: 越走越近，她确信自己来对地方了。

paras.en: The valley looked just like it had in her memories; steam-billowing geysers dotted the wide-open spaces of the landscape, which was seemingly untouched by the deep freeze over the kingdom.
paras.zh: 山谷和她记忆中一模一样；喷着蒸汽的间歇泉点缀在开阔的地面上，这片土地似乎未被笼罩王国的严寒所触及。

paras.en: A low-lying fog made it difficult to see, but she recognized a circle where hundreds of small boulders sat in a strange formation.
paras.zh: 低垂的雾气让视线模糊，但她认出了那个圆圈——数百块小卵石以奇异的阵型排列其中。

paras.en: As she neared them, her breath hastened.
paras.zh: 走近时，她的呼吸急促起来。

paras.en: These were the boulders in her vison that had rocked and rolled when her father called to the trolls. “Hello?” Elsa heard her voice echo from the walls of the mountains. “I need your help.” The rocks didn’t move, so she tried a different approach. “Grand Pabbie?
paras.zh: 这正是她幻象里那些卵石——当年父亲呼唤地精时，它们曾翻滚摇动。“有人吗？”艾莎听见自己的声音在群山间回荡。“我需要你们的帮助。”石头没有动，于是她换了种方式。“皮比？

paras.en: It is Princess Elsa of Arendelle.
paras.zh: 我是阿伦黛尔的艾莎公主。

paras.en: I am trying to find my sister.” Suddenly, the boulders began to shake.
paras.zh: 我在寻找我的妹妹。”忽然，那些卵石开始震颤。

paras.en: Elsa stepped back as they tumbled toward her, a large one rolling to a stop at her feet and transforming into a troll.
paras.zh: 艾莎后退一步，卵石朝她滚来，其中一块大的滚到她脚边停住，变成了一个地精。

paras.en: The other boulders became trolls as well.
paras.zh: 其他的卵石也都变成了地精。

paras.en: She knew immediately that the one with the yellow crystal necklace and mossy robe was the one she was looking for. “Grand Pabbie?” she asked, and he nodded. “I am here to seek your help.” “Princess Elsa,” he said in a gravelly voice. “It has been a long time.” Elsa glanced at the whites of his big eyes. “I’m looking for my sister.
paras.zh: 她立刻认出那个戴着黄水晶项链、披着苔藓长袍的就是她要找的。“皮比？”她问，他点了点头。“我是来寻求您的帮助。”“艾莎公主，”他用沙哑的声音说。“好久不见了。”艾莎瞥了瞥他大眼睛里的眼白。“我在找我的妹妹。

paras.en: The kingdom doesn’t seem to know of her existence, but I remember her.
paras.zh: 王国似乎无人知晓她的存在，可我记得她。

paras.en: The memories came flooding back the morning of my coronation when I saw a portrait of my parents and me with a small redheaded girl.
paras.zh: 加冕典礼那天早上，我看见一幅画：父母、我和一个小红发女孩，记忆便如潮水般涌回。

paras.en: I knew immediately it was Anna.” Grand Pabbie nodded. “I see.” “My parents brought Anna and me to you for help when we were children.” Tears started to flow before she could stop them. “I know I accidentally struck her with my magic, but I didn’t mean to hurt her,” she whispered. “Of course not, child.” Grand Pabbie reached out, and Elsa knelt down in front of him and put her hands in his.
paras.zh: 我立刻知道那是安娜。”皮比点点头。“我明白了。”“我们小时候，父母带我和安娜来找您帮忙。”泪水不由自主地流下。“我知道自己不小心用魔法击中了她，可我不是有意伤她，”她低声说。“当然不是，孩子。”皮比伸出手，艾莎在他面前跪下，把手放进他手里。

paras.en: His were coarse and cold. “I didn’t want her to forget my magic, but somehow in interfering with your spell, I must have messed up everything,” she said, getting choked up. “I lost my sister and my powers in the process.” “It was a grave mistake,” he agreed. “I didn’t learn I still had powers until a few years ago.
paras.zh: 他的手粗糙而冰凉。“我不想让她忘了我的魔法，可不知怎的，我干扰了您的咒语，一定把一切都搞砸了，”她说着哽咽起来。“过程中我失去了妹妹，也失去了魔力。”“那是个严重的错误，”他认同道。“直到几年前我才发现自己仍有魔力。

paras.en: They suddenly reappeared when my parents died,” Elsa added.
paras.zh: 父母去世时，它们忽然又回来了，”艾莎补充道。

paras.en: The memory was still so painful that it hurt to talk about. “We were all sorry to hear of your parents’ passing,” Grand Pabbie said, and the trolls around him nodded. “Thank you.
paras.zh: 那段记忆仍如此痛楚，说起便伤心。“得知你父母离世，我们都很悲痛，”皮比说，周围的地精纷纷点头。“谢谢。

paras.en: Life without them has been difficult,” Elsa admitted. “Learning I have a sister has given me hope again.” Tears sprang to her eyes. “Now I can think of nothing else but finding her.
paras.zh: 没有他们，日子很难熬，”艾莎坦言。“得知自己有个妹妹，又让我有了希望。”泪水涌上她的眼眶。“现在我满心只想找到她。

paras.en: Can you help me?” “Elsa, I feel your pain, but you must listen to me,” Grand Pabbie said, and a hush fell over the other trolls. “You cannot try to find her.” Elsa pulled her hands away. “Why not?” “The curse that has kept you apart is something even I cannot fully understand,” he explained. “If you remember Anna, then that magic is starting to fade, but until this curse holding you both is broken, you cannot intervene.” Curse?
paras.zh: 您能帮我吗？”“艾莎，我感受到你的痛苦，可你必须听我说，”皮比说，其他地精顿时安静下来。“你不能去寻找她。”艾莎抽回双手。“为什么不行？”“将你们分开的诅咒，连我也无法完全理解，”他解释道。“既然你记起了安娜，说明那魔法正在消退，但在束缚你们两人的诅咒解除前，你无法插手。”诅咒？

paras.en: Intervene?
paras.zh: 插手？

paras.en: All she wanted was to see her sister. “I don’t understand.” Elsa started to cry in earnest. “How are we cursed?
paras.zh: 她只想见妹妹一面。“我不明白。”艾莎真的哭了起来。“我们被下了什么诅咒？

paras.en: You truly won’t help me find her?
paras.zh: 您当真不肯帮我找她？

paras.en: Anna is the only family I have left.” Grand Pabbie sighed deeply. “It’s not that I won’t.
paras.zh: 安娜是我仅剩的亲人了。”皮比深深叹了口气。“不是我不肯。

paras.en: I can’t.
paras.zh: 是我不能。

paras.en: You just need to hold on a little while longer.” “Hold on?
paras.zh: 你只需再坚持一阵子。”“坚持？

paras.en: We’ve been separated for years!” She was sobbing now. “Anna is all I have left.
paras.zh: 我们分别已多年！”她抽泣起来。“安娜是我仅剩的一切。

paras.en: Why would you use magic to keep us apart?” “You have been through so much, child, I know.
paras.zh: 你为何要用魔法拆散我们？”“孩子，你经历了太多，我知道。

paras.en: What is the last thing you remember?” he asked. “The last thing I saw in my vision was me reaching out to stop you from erasing Anna’s memories.” Elsa looked at him. “I feared my magic had killed her, but then I found a letter from my parents that explained Anna was alive.
paras.zh: 你记得的最后一件事是什么？”他问。“我幻象里看到的最后画面，是我伸手阻止你抹去安娜的记忆。”艾莎看着他。“我怕自己的魔法害死了她，可后来我找到父母留下的信，信中说安娜还活着。

paras.en: But…I had to leave before I could find out where she was and why we were separated.” He held out his hands again. “Perhaps I can fill in the rest.” He touched his forehead, then swept his hand into the air.
paras.zh: 可是……我还没弄清她在哪儿、我们为何分开，就不得不离开。”他再次伸出双手。“也许余下的我能补上。”他按住自己的额头，然后把手扫向空中。

paras.en: A bluish-white line of stars followed his fingers, sweeping into the sky, where an image from the past appeared that both Elsa and the trolls could see.
paras.zh: 一条蓝白色星线随他的手指划过，升入天空，浮现出一幅过往的画面，艾莎和地精们都看得见。

paras.en: Elsa recognized the image immediately: it showed her parents, and Anna, and herself, on the night she accidentally struck her sister with her magic.
paras.zh: 艾莎立刻认出了那画面：那是她不小心用魔法击中妹妹的那晚，父母、安娜和她自己。

paras.en: The memory replayed the vision she had seen on her coronation day, and once again she saw her much younger self reach out to keep Grand Pabbie from erasing Anna’s memories.
paras.zh: 记忆重播了她加冕日所见的那一幕，她再次看见年幼许多的自己伸出手，阻止皮比抹去安娜的记忆。

paras.en: Grand Pabbie and her mother tried to stop her, but they had been too late.
paras.zh: 皮比和母亲想拦住她，却已太迟。

paras.en: Once her hand connected with the troll’s, there was an explosion of blue light.
paras.zh: 她的手一碰到地精，便爆出一团蓝光。

paras.en: That was where Elsa’s memory had ended, but Grand Pabbie’s vision kept going.
paras.zh: 艾莎的记忆到此为止，可皮比的幻象还在继续。

paras.en: Elsa watched as her younger self and Grand Pabbie were thrown backward.
paras.zh: 艾莎看着年幼的自己与皮比被震得向后飞出。

paras.en: Trolls ran for cover as Papa shielded Mama and Anna.
paras.zh: 地精们四散躲避，爸爸护住了妈妈和安娜。

paras.en: When the dust cleared, she saw her younger self unconscious on the ground.
paras.zh: 尘埃落定，她看见年幼的自己倒在地上不省人事。

paras.en: Mama gently put Anna down and ran to Elsa’s side. “What happened to my daughter?” Papa rushed over.
paras.zh: 妈妈轻轻放下安娜，跑向艾莎身边。“我女儿怎么了？”爸爸冲了过来。

paras.en: The image was almost too much to bear. “My powers connected with Elsa’s.” Grand Pabbie was out of breath. “I believe it changed the magic somehow.” “What does that mean?” Papa asked.
paras.zh: 那画面几乎令人无法承受。“我的魔力与艾莎的相连了。”皮比上气不接下气。“我相信它某种程度改变了魔法。”“这是什么意思？”爸爸问。

paras.en: To Elsa’s horror, while they spoke, Anna slowly began to freeze from the tips of her shoes up to her legs.
paras.zh: 令艾莎惊恐的是，他们说话间，安娜从鞋尖开始，慢慢往上冻到双腿。

paras.en: In seconds, ice would overtake Anna’s whole body.
paras.zh: 再过几秒，冰就会吞没安娜全身。

paras.en: Grand Pabbie turned around just in time. “Your Majesty, grab Elsa!” he called to the king. “Run to higher ground!
paras.zh: 皮比及时转过身。“陛下，抱住艾莎！”他对国王喊道。“往高处跑！

paras.en: Quickly!” Papa scooped up Elsa in his arms and ran up the stone steps to the entrance of the valley.
paras.zh: 快！”爸爸一把抱起艾莎，跑上石阶，冲向谷口。

paras.en: When Mama saw Anna’s small body slowly turning to ice she ran for her, but could do nothing to stop it.
paras.zh: 妈妈看见安娜小小的身子渐渐变成冰，便朝她跑去，却无力阻止。

paras.en: Neither could Grand Pabbie.
paras.zh: 皮比也一样。

paras.en: Elsa felt her heart beat wildly as she watched the scene.
paras.zh: 艾莎看着这一幕，心狂跳不止。

paras.en: It was pandemonium.
paras.zh: 现场一片混乱。

paras.en: Even some of the trolls were crying out and frightened.
paras.zh: 连一些地精也惊叫起来，吓得不行。

paras.en: But as the distance between Anna’s and Elsa’s bodies increased, the ice on Anna began to melt.
paras.zh: 可随着安娜与艾莎身体的距离拉大，安娜身上的冰开始融化。

paras.en: Mama picked Anna up and held her close, crying softly in relief. “What just happened to Anna?” Mama cried. “I don’t understand.
paras.zh: 妈妈抱起安娜，紧紧搂着，如释重负地轻声啜泣。“安娜刚才怎么了？”妈妈哭着问。“我不明白。

paras.en: I thought you removed the ice.” Grand Pabbie knelt down by Anna’s side and placed his hands on her head.
paras.zh: 我以为你已消除了冰。”皮比在安娜身旁跪下，把手放在她头上。

paras.en: He looked from Anna to the king, who held Elsa on higher ground.
paras.zh: 他看看安娜，又看看站在高处的国王怀里抱着艾莎。

paras.en: Everyone watched as Grand Pabbie made his way up to the king and placed his hands on Elsa’s head as well.
paras.zh: 众人望着皮比走上前去，也把手放在艾莎头上。

paras.en: The valley was quiet as he came back down to the center of the circle to the queen. “Grand Pabbie, what is it?” one of the trolls asked. “I’m afraid they’ve been cursed,” Grand Pabbie whispered. “Cursed?” Mama repeated. “How?” “It happened when Elsa’s and my magic crossed,” he explained. “We were both trying to accomplish different things with magic—I wanted to remove Anna’s memories of magic, while Elsa wanted to keep them.
paras.zh: 他回到圆圈中央，走向王后，山谷一片寂静。“皮比，怎么了？”一个地精问。“恐怕他们被诅咒了，”皮比低声说。“诅咒？”妈妈重复道。“怎么会的？”“那是在艾莎的魔法和我的魔法交汇时发生的，”他解释道。“我们都想用魔法达成不同的事——我想抹去安娜对魔法的记忆，艾莎却想保留它们。

paras.en: The combination caused something else to happen entirely—a curse.” He looked back and forth between the king and the queen. “It appears Elsa has forgotten her powers.” “But she will remember them, right?” Mama asked. “Eventually.
paras.zh: 两者结合，完全引发了别的事——一道诅咒。”他在国王和王后之间来回看着。“看来艾莎已忘了自己的魔力。”“可她会想起来的，对吧？”妈妈问。“迟早。

paras.en: For now, her powers are wrapped up in her fear for her sister,” Grand Pabbie explained. “She won’t remember how to use them till this strange magic fades.” “And when will that be?” Papa asked.
paras.zh: 目前，她的魔力包裹在对妹妹的恐惧之中，”皮比解释道。“在这陌生魔法消退前，她不会想起怎么使用。”“那要等到什么时候？”爸爸问。

paras.en: Grand Pabbie’s face was solemn. “When she needs her sister more than she ever has before.” “But they need each other now,” Mama said, the desperation in her voice clear. “We don’t always get what we want—that’s what curses teach us,” Grand Pabbie told her gently. “Magic can be unpredictable, especially when more than one kind interacts.
paras.zh: 皮比神色凝重。“当她比以往任何时候都更需要妹妹的时候。”“可她们现在就需要彼此，”妈妈说，声音里的绝望显而易见。“我们未必总能如愿——这正是诅咒教给我们的，”皮比温和地对她说。“魔法难以预料，尤其当不止一种魔法相互交织时。

paras.en: It appears the curse affected each sister differently.
paras.zh: 看来诅咒对两姐妹的影响各不相同。

paras.en: Anna cannot be near Elsa without ice consuming her body and traveling to her heart.
paras.zh: 安娜一旦靠近艾莎，冰就会吞没她的身体并直达心脏。

paras.en: If it stays there too long, it grows, as ice can do, and it will eventually kill her.” Mama burst into tears. “And Elsa, while physically fine, cannot survive long-term if she is missing the love of her sister.
paras.zh: 若冰在心里停留太久，便会如冰一般蔓延，最终害死她。”妈妈失声痛哭。“而艾莎，尽管身体无恙，若失去妹妹的爱，也无法长久存活。

paras.en: She is her greatest joy.” Elsa watched Grand Pabbie’s memory in agony.
paras.zh: 安娜是她最大的欢乐。”艾莎痛苦地望着皮比的记忆。

paras.en: This was all her fault.
paras.zh: 这一切全是她的错。

paras.en: If she hadn’t tried to stop Grand Pabbie’s spell, Anna wouldn’t have been hurt.
paras.zh: 若不是她想去阻止皮比的咒语，安娜就不会受伤。

paras.en: This was why they had been separated: Elsa’s being near Anna could kill her.
paras.zh: 这正是她们被分开的原因：艾莎靠近安娜会害死她。

paras.en: How had Elsa’s parents ever forgiven her for what she had done? “Can you reverse the spell?” Papa asked hoarsely.
paras.zh: 艾莎的父母怎么原谅她所做的事？“你能逆转这咒语吗？”爸爸声音沙哑地问。

paras.en: Grand Pabbie looked to the sky, then down at the earth before he spoke. “I don’t believe that’s possible.” Mama cried harder. “But there is hope.
paras.zh: 皮比先望天，又低头看地，才开口。“我想那是不可能的。”妈妈哭得更凶了。“但还有希望。

paras.en: Magic wrapped up in emotions like Elsa’s fades over time.
paras.zh: 像艾莎这样裹挟在情感中的魔法，会随时间消退。

paras.en: This curse won’t last forever.
paras.zh: 这道诅咒不会永远持续。

paras.en: When the time is right—and the girls need each other more than ever before—their curse will be broken.” The queen looked up with bloodshot eyes. “You mean someday it will be safe for Anna and Elsa to be together?” “Yes.” Grand Pabbie looked up at the aurora borealis that shone above them. “I know this isn’t the answer you seek, but your daughters’ love for each other can overcome any curse.” Mama smiled through her tears. “For now, though, they must be kept apart.
paras.zh: 时机成熟——姐妹俩比以往任何时候都更需要彼此时——诅咒就会破除。”王后抬起布满血丝的眼睛。“你是说，总有一天安娜和艾莎能安全相聚？”“是的。”皮比抬头望着在他们头顶闪耀的北极光。“我知道这不是你想要的答案，可你女儿们彼此的爱能战胜任何诅咒。”妈妈含泪微笑。“不过眼下，她们必须分开。

paras.en: No one can say how long this magic will hold.” Throughout the grassy area, trolls whispered to one another about the situation.
paras.zh: 没人说得准这魔法能撑多久。”整片草地上，地精们交头接耳，议论着这情形。

paras.en: Mama and Papa were trying to process their new reality, but it was clearly devastating. “How will we explain this to them?” Mama asked. “They’ll be heartbroken.” “The girls are always together,” Papa told Grand Pabbie. “They won’t want to be separated.” He looked at Mama. “Can you imagine trying to keep them in separate wings of the castle?” “No,” Mama agreed. “Nor would it be safe.
paras.zh: 爸爸妈妈努力接受这新的现实，可显然令人崩溃。“我们怎么跟她们解释？”妈妈问。“她们会心碎的。”“两个女孩总是形影不离，”爸爸对皮比说。“她们不会愿意分开。”他看着妈妈。“你能想象把她们关在城堡不同厢房吗？”“不行，”妈妈同意。“那样也不安全。

paras.en: They wouldn’t understand the consequences of being near one another.
paras.zh: 她们不会明白彼此靠近的后果。

paras.en: An accident could happen in a heartbeat.
paras.zh: 意外可能瞬间发生。

paras.en: Putting this sort of responsibility on them at such a young age is impossible.” “This is true,” Papa agreed. “And if word got out about what could happen to Anna if she was near Elsa, our enemies could try to use the knowledge to their advantage.
paras.zh: 这么小的年纪，不可能让她们担起这样的责任。”“说得对，”爸爸赞同。“而且要是安娜靠近艾莎会有什么后果传了出去，我们的敌人就可能利用这点为所欲为。

paras.en: We can’t let our daughters be pawns in someone else’s game,” he said firmly. “No.” Tears streamed down Mama’s cheeks. “What do we do?” Grand Pabbie looked from Papa to Mama sadly. “Separate wings, I fear, are not enough.
paras.zh: 我们不能让女儿成为别人棋局中的棋子，”他坚定地说。“不行。”泪水顺着妈妈脸颊滑落。“我们该怎么办？”皮比难过地从爸爸看到妈妈。“只分厢房，恐怕还不够。

paras.en: And the king is right—the world cannot know Anna and Elsa’s weaknesses.
paras.zh: 而且国王说得对——世人不能知晓安娜和艾莎的弱点。

paras.en: They are both heirs to this kingdom.
paras.zh: 她们都是王国的继承人。

paras.en: It’s too dangerous.” Elsa could tell what Grand Pabbie was saying weighed heavily on her parents. “They won’t be able to stand the separation,” Mama said. “I know my daughters.” Grand Pabbie thought for a moment. “Perhaps I can help.” He looked at Mama. “Magic can still make the impossible possible.
paras.zh: 太危险了。”艾莎看得出，皮比的话沉重地压在父母心头。“她们承受不了分离，”妈妈说。“我了解我的女儿们。”皮比想了想。“也许我能帮忙。”他看着妈妈。“魔法仍能让不可能变为可能。

paras.en: I could do a spell that will hide one of the children’s identities from all but the two of you until the curse has lifted.
paras.zh: 我可以施一道咒，将其中一个孩子的身份对除你们二人外的所有人隐藏，直到诅咒解除。

paras.en: It will keep both your daughters safe from harm in the kingdom, but it will also protect their fragile hearts if we remove their memories of each other as well.” Mama looked startled. “Only until the curse lifts,” he assured her. “If we do that, neither child will remember the other when they wake.” Realization of what the troll was saying was written all over Mama’s face.
paras.zh: 这能让你的两个女儿在王国里免受伤害，而且若我们也抹去她们对彼此的记忆，还能保护她们脆弱的心。”妈妈一脸惊愕。“只到诅咒解除为止，”他向她保证。“若这么做，两个孩子醒来后都不会记得对方。”妈妈脸上写满了对地精所言的领悟。

paras.en: She looked from one daughter to the other one, just feet away. “This feels so cruel.
paras.zh: 她从其中一个女儿望向几步外的另一个。“这感觉太残忍了。

paras.en: And yet, I don’t believe we have any other choice.” She looked at Papa. “At least they won’t have to live with the truth their father and I possess.” Grand Pabbie looked at her sadly. “It is not fair,” he agreed.
paras.zh: 可我相信我们别无选择。”她看着爸爸。“至少她们不必背负我和父亲所知的真相。”皮比难过地看着她。“这不公平，”他认同道。

paras.en: Mama rose to her full height.
paras.zh: 妈妈站直了身子。

paras.en: Her lower lip wobbled as she looked at Papa, her eyes filled with tears. “We have to let Grand Pabbie help them forget each other’s existence until the curse lifts.
paras.zh: 她望着爸爸，下唇颤抖，眼里满是泪水。“我们必须让皮比帮她们忘记彼此的存在，直到诅咒解除。

paras.en: We need to find someplace safe for one of them to go.
paras.zh: 我们得为其中一个找个安全的地方去。

paras.en: It’s the only way.” Papa appeared as devastated as Mama. “But how do we decide who stays with us?” Even some of the trolls were weeping for the king and queen.
paras.zh: 这是唯一的办法。”爸爸和妈妈一样心碎。“可我们怎么决定谁留在我们身边？”连一些地精也为国王和王后落泪。

paras.en: Elsa watched the scene with tears streaming down her face.
paras.zh: 艾莎望着这一幕，泪流满面。

paras.en: She felt her parents’ pain.
paras.zh: 她感受到父母的痛楚。

paras.en: Mama finally spoke. “Elsa will stay with us,” she decided. “She is next in line to the throne, and her powers are too strong for her to control on her own.” Papa was crying now, too. “You know this is how it has to be, Agnarr.
paras.zh: 妈妈终于开口。“艾莎留在我们身边，”她决定。“她是王位第一继承人，而且她的魔力太强，自己控制不住。”爸爸也哭了。“你知道必须如此，安格瑞。

paras.en: Once Elsa remembers she has them, we need to be there to help her understand.” Papa nodded. “You are right.
paras.zh: 一旦艾莎想起自己有魔力，我们需要陪着帮她明白。”爸爸点头。“你说得对。

paras.en: But where will Anna go?” His voice was breaking. “Is there someone you trust to look after your daughter as if she were their own?” Grand Pabbie asked Mama. “There is,” she whispered. “I’d trust this friend with my life.
paras.zh: 可安娜去哪儿？”他声音哽咽。“有没有你信任的人，能像对待亲生女儿一样照顾你的女儿？”皮比问妈妈。“有，”她低声说。“我愿把命托付给这位朋友。

paras.en: But raising my daughter is a lot to ask.” “Nothing is too much to ask when it is done out of love,” Grand Pabbie reminded her. “And to ease your anguish, Anna can be hidden in plain sight.” Grand Pabbie looked at Mama. “You are the only two who will remember her true birthright.
paras.zh: 可抚养我女儿是个不小的请求。”“出于爱去做的事，再难也不为过，”皮比提醒她。“而且为减轻你的痛苦，安娜可以掩藏在众目睽睽之下。”皮比看着妈妈。“你们二人将是唯一记得她真实身份的人。

paras.en: You can still see her when you want, but she won’t know her true identity.” Papa and Mama looked at each other from across the valley.
paras.zh: 你们想见她时仍能见，可她不会知道自己的真实身份。”爸爸和妈妈隔谷相望。

paras.en: Both of them had tears steaming down their face.
paras.zh: 两人脸上都淌着热泪。

paras.en: Papa turned to Grand Pabbie. “Do what you must.
paras.zh: 爸爸转向皮比。“该怎么做就做吧。

paras.en: Just protect both our daughters.” He hesitated, the words almost too hard for him to say out loud. “Help Elsa forget she has a sister, erase Anna’s memories of her past life, and…remove Anna’s existence from the kingdom’s memory.” Watching them, Elsa understood her parents’ decision, but she could also feel their pain, which mirrored her own.
paras.zh: 只要护住我们的两个女儿。”他犹豫了，这句话几乎难以说出口。“帮艾莎忘记自己有个妹妹，抹去安娜对过往的记忆，还有……把安娜的存在从王国的记忆里抹掉。”望着他们，艾莎理解父母的决定，却也感受到与他们如出一辙的痛苦。

paras.en: If only she hadn’t interfered… Closing his eyes, Grand Pabbie raised his hands to the stars again.
paras.zh: 要是她当初没有插手就好了……皮比闭上眼，再次向星辰举起双手。

paras.en: The images of Anna’s and Elsa’s separate lives swept past them like clouds.
paras.zh: 安娜与艾莎各自人生的画面如云般从他们眼前掠过。

paras.en: He rolled the images into one and pressed a hand to Anna’s forehead.
paras.zh: 他将画面合而为一，把手按在安娜的额头。

paras.en: Then he walked up the steps and did the same thing to Elsa.
paras.zh: 然后他走上台阶，对艾莎做了同样的事。

paras.en: A flash of bright white light rippled across the valley like an earthquake, traveling to the far reaches of the kingdom before disappearing. “It is done,” Grand Pabbie said. “And now I have a gift—your future.” Grand Pabbie raised his hands into the sky again and showed Mama and Papa new images.
paras.zh: 一道刺眼的白光如地震般在山谷间荡开，传遍王国最远的角落，随即消失。“完成了，”皮比说。“现在我有份礼物——你们的未来。”皮比再次把手举向天空，给爸爸妈妈看新的画面。

paras.en: One was of Anna playing happily in a village courtyard with a group of children.
paras.zh: 一幅是安娜和一群孩子在村庄庭院里快乐地玩耍。

paras.en: The other was of Elsa studying with her father in the library.
paras.zh: 另一幅是艾莎在书房里和父亲一起学习。

paras.en: Both girls were smiling.
paras.zh: 两个女孩都在微笑。

paras.en: Both were thriving.
paras.zh: 两个都茁壮地成长着。

paras.en: They just weren’t together.
paras.zh: 只是不在一起。

paras.en: Mama and Papa attempted to smile through the sadness. “When the time is right, they will remember and be reunited,” Grand Pabbie promised.
paras.zh: 爸爸妈妈强忍悲伤，努力挤出微笑。“时机成熟时，她们会记起彼此，重新团聚，”皮比许诺。

paras.en: That was the last thing Elsa heard before Grand Pabbie touched the memory in the sky and it seemingly swirled back into his hand, which he pressed again to his forehead. “Do you understand now why it isn’t safe for you to find Anna?” he asked gently. “But I remember Anna,” Elsa said, her voice rising. “Doesn’t that mean the curse is broken?” Grand Pabbie shook his head. “It is starting to break, but if the curse were truly broken, not only would you remember your sister, the whole kingdom would as well.” Elsa’s heart sank.
paras.zh: 这是艾莎听到的最后一句——皮比触摸空中的记忆，它仿佛旋回他手中，他又一次按上额头。“你现在明白，为何找安娜对你不安全了吧？”他温和地问。“可我记得安娜了，”艾莎声音提高。“那不意味着诅咒解除了吗？”皮比摇了摇头。“它刚开始破，可若诅咒真的解除，不止你会记起妹妹，整个王国也会。”艾莎的心一沉。

paras.en: Grand Pabbie was right.
paras.zh: 皮比是对的。

paras.en: She was still the only one who knew who Anna was.
paras.zh: 她仍是唯一知道安娜是谁的人。

paras.en: Aside from Olaf, and he was an unreliable source at best.
paras.zh: 雪宝除外，而他也充其量是个不靠谱的消息源。

paras.en: She tried to hold back fresh tears. “How do you know Anna doesn’t remember me yet?
paras.zh: 她忍住新涌出的泪水。“你怎么知道安娜还没记起我？

paras.en: What if she’s out there right now looking for me, too?” Grand Pabbie squeezed her hands. “I would know.
paras.zh: 万一她此刻也在外面找我呢？”皮比握紧她的手。“我会知道。

paras.en: You would, too.
paras.zh: 你也会。

paras.en: Elsa, you must stay calm—I can see beyond the valley, and I know what fear is doing to your magic.
paras.zh: 艾莎，你必须保持冷静——我能望见山谷之外，也知道恐惧正对你的魔法做些什么。

paras.en: The kingdom is wrapped in an eternal winter.” “I didn’t mean for that to happen,” Elsa said softly. “I don’t know how to fix it.” “You will figure it out,” he assured her. “You must concentrate on controlling your powers.
paras.zh: 王国被裹在永冬之中。”“我不是故意要让这发生的，”艾莎轻声说。“我不知道怎么补救。”“你会想出来的，”他向她保证。“你必须先专心控制好自己的力量。

paras.en: The rest will come.
paras.zh: 其他的自然会来。

paras.en: The magic is fading.
paras.zh: 魔法正在消退。

paras.en: I can feel it!
paras.zh: 我能感觉到！

paras.en: You are remembering your past.
paras.zh: 你正记起自己的过去。

paras.en: Soon Anna will as well.
paras.zh: 安娜很快也会。

paras.en: But until she does, you must keep your distance.
paras.zh: 但在她记起之前，你必须与她保持距离。

paras.en: Your sister’s life depends on it.” Elsa looked at the way out of the valley.
paras.zh: 你妹妹的命就系于此。”艾莎望向出谷的路。

paras.en: Beyond the rocks, she saw the snow squall.
paras.zh: 岩石之外，她看见那场雪暴。

paras.en: She had thought finding Anna would change everything, but she was wrong.
paras.zh: 她原以为找到安娜就能改变一切，可她错了。

paras.en: Elsa had given her all the past few days and fought to find her family.
paras.zh: 过去几天，艾莎已倾尽全力，奋力寻找家人。

paras.en: She couldn’t even do that now.
paras.zh: 如今她连这都做不到了。

paras.en: If she got too close to Anna, ice would consume her.
paras.zh: 若她离安娜太近，冰就会吞没安娜。

paras.en: Even after all that time, she was destined to be alone.
paras.zh: 即便过了那么久，她仍注定孤独一人。

paras.en: “Snow.
paras.zh: Snow.

paras.en: Why did it have to be snow?” Anna asked, shivering as Kristoff and Sven led the sleigh into the mountains with her and Olaf tucked inside. “She couldn’t have had tropical magic that covered the fjords in white sand and warm sunshine?” “I love the sun!” Olaf butted in, his personal flurry crashing into the front seat of the sleigh as they bounced along the uneven path. “I mean, I think I like it.
paras.zh: “为什么非得是雪呢？”安娜打着哆嗦问道。克里斯托夫和斯文赶着雪橇进了山，她和雪宝缩在雪橇里。“她就不能有点热带魔法，把峡湾铺满白沙、洒满暖阳吗？”“我爱太阳！”雪宝插嘴道，他身边那团专属小雪花随着雪橇在不平的山路上颠簸，直撞到前座的靠背上。“我是说，我想我是喜欢的。在城堡里待着，很难说清楚太阳到底是什么感觉。”

paras.en: It’s hard to tell what it does from inside the castle.” “I don’t think you’d like it much.” Kristoff squinted hard at the path ahead of them.
paras.zh: “我觉得你大概不会太喜欢。”克里斯托夫眯起眼睛，死死盯着前方的路。

paras.en: The snow had started to fall harder since they’d left Arendelle, and it was coming down in sheets.
paras.zh: 离开阿伦黛尔后，雪越下越大，简直像挂起了雪帘。

paras.en: Anna wasn’t sure how Kristoff and Sven could see where they were going.
paras.zh: 安娜弄不明白，克里斯托夫和斯文究竟是怎么看清路的。

paras.en: Night had fallen, and the tiny lantern that hung off the edge of the sleigh wasn’t giving much light.
paras.zh: 夜幕已经降临，挂在雪橇边上的小灯笼照不出多少亮光。

paras.en: They’d have to find shelter somewhere soon, but Anna hadn’t seen any houses or villages in hours.
paras.zh: 他们得赶紧找个避风的地方，可安娜已经好几个小时没看到任何房屋或村庄了。

paras.en: Suddenly, they came to a wall of snow that made the route impassable.
paras.zh: 忽然，他们撞上一堵雪墙，路被彻底堵死了。

paras.en: The alternative was a hilly incline that didn’t even look like a real path. “Are you sure Elsa went this way?” Kristoff asked Olaf as he led Sven up the uncharted terrain that was covered in ice. “Yes.
paras.zh: 另一条路是个布满冰面的陡坡，连正经小路都算不上。“你确定艾莎是从这边走的？”克里斯托夫赶着斯文爬上这片未开拓的冰原，问雪宝。“确定。不确定。”雪宝用一根小树枝挠了挠脑袋。

paras.en: No.” Olaf scratched his head with one of his twigs. “Again, everything I saw was through a window.
paras.zh: “再说一遍，我看到的都是在窗户里。

paras.en: I heard shouting and saw ice freezing, and then I looked out and saw Elsa—at least, I think it was Elsa, because who else can make snow?—running across the fjord as it turned to ice.
paras.zh: 我听到喊声，看到冰在冻结，然后朝窗外望去，看见艾莎——至少我觉得那是艾莎，因为除了她还有谁能造雪呢？——正跑过渐渐结冰的峡湾。

paras.en: Then she disappeared into the trees!” Olaf frowned. “And I lost sight of her.” Kristoff took his eyes off the path and looked at Anna. “Remind me again why we listened to a talking snowman?
paras.zh: 接着她就消失在树林里了！”雪宝皱起眉头。“然后我就看不见她了。”克里斯托夫把视线从路上移开，看向安娜。“再提醒我一下，我们为什么要听一个会说话的雪人的？

paras.en: We’re in deep snow, the wind is howling, we have no shelter, and I’m sledding up a mountain based on a hunch.” “It’s not like we had a better option,” Anna pointed out. “It’s going to be fine!
paras.zh: 我们深陷雪中，狂风呼啸，无遮无挡，而我正凭一个猜测往山上滑雪橇呢。”“我们又没有更好的选择，”安娜指出。“会没事的！

paras.en: Olaf will help us find her.
paras.zh: 雪宝会帮我们找到她的。

paras.en: He knows Elsa better than anyone, don’t you?” “Yes!” Olaf insisted as the sleigh took a narrow turn and started to climb again. “I know lots about Elsa, because she made me three years ago and I never left her room.” His eyes lit up. “Wait!
paras.zh: 他比谁都了解艾莎，对吧？” “对！”雪宝坚持道。雪橇拐过一道窄弯，又开始往上爬。“我可了解艾莎了，因为她是三年前把我造出来的，而我从来没离开过她的房间。”他的眼睛一亮。“等等！

paras.en: I’m wrong.
paras.zh: 我说错了。

paras.en: Sometimes she snuck me through one of the secret passageways and we went up to the bell tower or the attic.
paras.zh: 有时候她会偷偷带我穿过一条秘密通道，去钟楼或者阁楼。

paras.en: Once, we got to go to the Great Hall and Elsa made a giant snow hill that we slid down.
paras.zh: 有一次，我们溜进了大礼堂，艾莎堆了一座巨大的雪坡，我们从上面滑下来。

paras.en: But that was in the middle of the night.” Anna felt the hair on the back of her neck stand up.
paras.zh: 不过那是在半夜。”安娜只觉得后颈的汗毛竖了起来。

paras.en: Suddenly she remembered being very small and sliding down a snow hill inside a giant hall with a blond girl—and they were both holding on to a snowman.
paras.zh: 忽然，她想起自己很小的时候，曾和一个金发女孩在一座巨大的厅堂里顺着雪坡滑下——两人都紧紧抱着一个雪人。

paras.en: She looked at Olaf again. “Did you just do that?” “Do what?” Olaf asked. “Make me see that,” Anna answered.
paras.zh: 她又看向雪宝。“刚才是你让我看到那些的吗？”“看到什么？”雪宝问。“让我看到那一幕，”安娜答道。

paras.en: Maybe the cold was getting to her. “See what?” Olaf asked as the sleigh hit a rock and took air.
paras.zh: 也许是寒冷让她产生了幻觉。“看到什么？”雪宝问，这时雪橇撞上一块石头，腾空弹起。

paras.en: It crashed back down, and Olaf’s flurry smacked Anna and Kristoff in the face.
paras.zh: 雪橇重重落回地面，雪宝的小雪花啪地拍在安娜和克里斯托夫脸上。

paras.en: Anna rubbed her eyes and felt the memory fading away.
paras.zh: 安娜揉了揉眼睛，觉得那段记忆渐渐淡去。

paras.en: The gruff look on Kristoff’s face was replaced with an expression of mild concern. “I think you’ve been in the cold too long.” “I think so, too,” Anna agreed. “I’m starting to see things that aren’t there.” She glanced at the snowman again. “Like you.
paras.zh: 克里斯托夫粗犷的神情被一丝担忧取代。“我觉得你在外面挨冻太久了。”“我也这么想，”安娜附和。“我开始看到一些不存在的东西了。”她又瞥了雪人一眼。“比如你。

paras.en: At least, I think it was you.
paras.zh: 至少，我觉得那应该是你。

paras.en: The two of us were riding a snow hill together inside a big room.” “That’s because we did!” Olaf said.
paras.zh: 你和我一起在大屋子里滑雪坡呢。”“那是因为我们真的滑过呀！”雪宝说。

paras.en: Anna’s breath started to come faster. “When?” Her parents had told her they’d adopted her as a baby, but what if that wasn’t true?
paras.zh: 安娜的呼吸急促起来。“什么时候？”养父母告诉她，她是襁褓中被收养的，可万一那不是真的呢？

paras.en: Anna’s earliest memories with Tomally and Johan were later—starting school, standing on a stool and baking bread next to her mother, waiting for Freya to pull up outside their home.
paras.zh: 安娜对托玛丽和约翰最早记忆是在更晚之后——开始上学、站在小凳上挨着母亲烤面包、在家门外等弗雷娅赶车回来。

paras.en: In all those, she was a girl of about six or seven.
paras.zh: 在那些画面里，她大约是个六七岁的小女孩。

paras.en: True, no one remembered being a baby, but the little girl in her visions looked and sounded just like her.
paras.zh: 的确，谁都不记得自己还是婴儿时的样子，可她幻象里那个小女孩的模样和声音，分明就是她自己。

paras.en: She couldn’t be more than four or five.
paras.zh: 那小女孩顶多四五岁。

paras.en: What were these sudden flashes of memories she couldn’t fully remember?
paras.zh: 这些她记不真切、却突然闪现的记忆片段，究竟是什么？

paras.en: Were they memories of her first family?
paras.zh: 是她第一个家庭的记忆吗？

paras.en: Sometimes she wondered who her birth parents were and why they had given her up, but she never asked Tomally or Johan.
paras.zh: 有时候她会想，自己的亲生父母是谁，又为什么把她送走，可她从没问过托玛丽或约翰。

paras.en: She didn’t want to hurt them by asking.
paras.zh: 她不想因为追问而伤他们的心。

paras.en: She always said the only thing she remembered about her former life was being kissed by a troll.
paras.zh: 她总说，对从前那段生活，自己唯一记得的，就是被地精亲了一口。

paras.en: It had seemed a funny thing to say when other kids asked about her adoption, but the truth was—she really remembered this happening.
paras.zh: 别的孩子问起她被收养的事时，这话听起来挺好笑，可事实是——她真的记得这件事发生过。

paras.en: It felt like a dream—a fuzzy memory, really—of being asleep while a troll talked to her and then kissed her on the forehead.
paras.zh: 那感觉像一个梦——说白了就是一段模糊的记忆——她睡着的时候，一个地精对她说话，然后亲了亲她的额头。

paras.en: She had seen it in her dreams so many times that she truly believed it.
paras.zh: 她在梦里见过太多次，于是真的相信了。

paras.en: She just didn’t share that with other people.
paras.zh: 她只是没跟别人说起过。

paras.en: She’d mentioned it to her parents once or twice.
paras.zh: 她曾跟养父母提过一两次。

paras.en: Now that she thought about it, they’d never denied it. “Olaf?” Anna tried again. “Did you and I really go sledding…indoors?” Olaf nodded. “But how is that possible?
paras.zh: 现在回想起来，他们从没否认过。“雪宝？”安娜又试了一次。“你和我真的在屋里滑过雪橇？”雪宝点了点头。“可那怎么可能呢？

paras.en: I’d never left my village before this trip.
paras.zh: 在这次出行之前，我从未离开过自己的村庄。

paras.en: Are you sure you haven’t traveled anywhere outside the castle?” Olaf’s face fell. “I don’t think so.
paras.zh: 你确定你从没去过城堡以外的地方？”雪宝泄了气。“我想没有。

paras.en: Have I?” “I don’t know,” Anna said, feeling frustrated. “Neither do I,” Olaf admitted. “Can you two stop talking?” Kristoff cracked the reins again. “It’s getting harder and harder to see with all this snow.
paras.zh: 我去过吗？”“我不知道，”安娜懊恼地说。“我也不知道，”雪宝承认。“你们两个能别说话了吗？”克里斯托夫又甩了一下缰绳。“雪这么大，视线越来越差了。

paras.en: I’m trying to concentrate.
paras.zh: 我在努力集中精神。

paras.en: This path is too rocky to stay on.
paras.zh: 这条路石头太多，根本不好走。

paras.en: We need to find you somewhere warm to thaw out and then figure out where we’re going next.
paras.zh: 我们得找个暖和的地方让你缓过来，然后再决定下一步去哪儿。

paras.en: We are not staying on a wild-goose chase with a talking snowman who doesn’t know where he’s going.” “But—” Anna said.
paras.zh: 我们可不能跟着一个不知方向的会说话雪人瞎兜圈子。”“可是——”安娜说。

paras.en: Kristoff ignored her. “Give me a second.” He stood up, holding the lantern into the growing darkness. “I thought we were near the valley, but all this snow is changing the view.” “Which valley?” Anna asked.
paras.zh: 克里斯托夫没理她。“给我一会儿。”他站起身，提着灯笼探入越来越浓的黑暗中。“我原以为我们快到那个山谷了，可这一场雪把景色全变了。”“哪个山谷？”安娜问。

paras.en: She was suddenly shivering. “A valley that has no snow,” Kristoff said, sounding as if he’d answered without thinking. “How can a valley have no snow when the whole kingdom is covered in snow?” Olaf asked. “How can a snowman talk?” Kristoff countered.
paras.zh: 她忽然打了个寒颤。“一个没有雪的山谷，”克里斯托夫说，听起来像是想都没想就脱口而出。“整个王国都被雪覆盖了，山谷怎么可能没雪？”雪宝问。“那雪人怎么又会说话呢？”克里斯托夫反问道。

paras.en: In the distance, they heard a wolf howl.
paras.zh: 远处，他们听到一声狼嚎。

paras.en: I need to find Elsa, Anna realized, the need almost overwhelming her.
paras.zh: 我必须找到艾莎，安娜意识到，这股渴望几乎要将她吞没。

paras.en: She closed her eyes, trying to shut out the strange thoughts.
paras.zh: 她闭上眼睛，想把那些奇怪的念头赶出脑海。

paras.en: Maybe Kristoff was right: she needed sleep. “I don’t feel right,” she said, and leaned her head down on the sleigh. “Anna?” Kristoff shook her. “Don’t fall asleep.
paras.zh: 也许克里斯托夫说得对：她需要睡一觉。“我觉得不太对劲，”她说着，把头靠在雪橇上。“安娜？”克里斯托夫摇了摇她。“别睡着。

paras.en: You hear me?
paras.zh: 听到没有？

paras.en: We’re going to find shelter.” He sat her up. “Olaf, I can’t believe I’m going to say this, but keep talking to her till I can find us somewhere to stop.” “Okay, about what?” Olaf asked. “Maybe about why the princess went all ice crazy?” Kristoff snapped the reins again, and Sven continued to climb.
paras.zh: 我们会找到避风处的。”他把她扶起来。“雪宝，真不敢相信我会说出这种话，不过你接着跟她说话，直到我找到能停脚的地方。”“好啊，说什么呢？”雪宝问。“就说说公主为什么发疯变成冰块儿了？”克里斯托夫又甩了甩缰绳，斯文继续往上爬。

paras.en: Anna gave him a dirty look. “She’s not crazy, she’s—” Another flash caused her head to feel like it was going to explode.
paras.zh: 安娜瞪了他一眼。“她没疯，她是——”又一阵闪回让她的脑袋像要炸开一样。

paras.en: Elsa, do the magic!
paras.zh: 艾莎，施展魔法吧！

paras.en: Do the magic! she heard a small voice say.
paras.zh: 施展魔法吧！她听到一个细嫩的声音在说。

paras.en: Next she saw herself sitting on a chair in her nightgown, clapping her hands.
paras.zh: 接着，她看见自己穿着睡衣坐在椅子上，拍着双手。

paras.en: Had she just said the name Elsa?
paras.zh: 她刚才念出了“艾莎”这个名字？

paras.en: That was impossible!
paras.zh: 这不可能！

paras.en: Anna started to hyperventilate.
paras.zh: 安娜开始喘不上气来。

paras.en: What is happening to me? “Faster, Sven!” Kristoff cried, holding Anna up with one hand. “Anna?
paras.zh: 我到底怎么了？“再快些，斯文！”克里斯托夫喊道，用一只手扶住安娜。“安娜？

paras.en: Stay with me, okay?
paras.zh: 撑住，好吗？

paras.en: Hang on.” “Trying,” Anna whispered, but her head felt like it was on fire and she was so tired. “Talk to her, Olaf!” Kristoff shouted. “What can you tell us about Elsa?” “She loved flowers.
paras.zh: 坚持住。”“我尽力，”安娜轻声说，可她的头像着了火，人也累极了。“跟她说话，雪宝！”克里斯托夫大叫。“你跟我们说说艾莎的事？”“她喜欢花。

paras.en: Hans sent her purple heather every week,” Olaf told them. “He was one of the only people who could get her to leave her room.” “That’s nice,” Anna said dreamily.
paras.zh: 汉斯每星期都给她送紫色石楠花，”雪宝告诉他们。“他是少数几个能哄她走出房间的人之一。”“真好，”安娜如梦呓般说道。

paras.en: Kristoff shook her again. “Olaf!
paras.zh: 克里斯托夫又摇了摇她。“雪宝！

paras.en: Keep talking!” “She loved gloves!” Olaf added, bouncing so high in his seat that his head popped off for a second. “She always wore blue ones, even in the summer, and I started to wonder…maybe she has a thing about dirt.
paras.zh: 接着说！”“她喜欢手套！”雪宝补充道，在座位上弹得老高，脑袋一下子都弹飞了。“她总戴蓝色的，连夏天也不例外，于是我开始琢磨……也许她是有点洁癖。

paras.en: Oh!
paras.zh: 哦！

paras.en: And she liked to read maps and books the king and queen left her.
paras.zh: 还有，她喜欢读国王和王后留给她的地图和书。

paras.en: I never met them,” he said sadly. “Elsa told me that was when she stopped coming out of her room.
paras.zh: 我从来没见过他们，”他难过地说。“艾莎告诉我，就是从那时候起，她不再走出房间了。

paras.en: Until this year, when she had to get ready to be queen.
paras.zh: 直到今年，她得为当女王做准备。

paras.en: Then she had to leave her room a lot.” “That’s so sad,” Anna said.
paras.zh: 那之后她就常常得离开房间了。”“太让人难过了，”安娜说。

paras.en: Her voice seemed far away. “It was like she was locking herself away from the world.
paras.zh: 她的声音听起来很遥远。“就好像她在把自己和世界隔绝开。

paras.en: Sometimes I felt like that in Harmon—kept apart from the rest of the kingdom.
paras.zh: 在哈蒙的时候，我有时候也有这种感觉——被隔绝在王国之外。

paras.en: I wanted to see more.” “You will—but you have to stay awake.
paras.zh: 我想看看外面的世界。”“你会的——但你得保持清醒。

paras.en: Barn! ” Kristoff shouted. “Thank goodness.
paras.zh: 谷仓！”克里斯托夫喊道。“谢天谢地。

paras.en: Stop, Sven!” Anna saw the barn through the driving snow and then the world went dark.
paras.zh: 停下，斯文！”安娜透过漫天飞雪看见了谷仓，随后眼前一黑，世界陷入黑暗。

paras.en: Next thing she knew, she was somewhere warm and she could smell hay.
paras.zh: 等她再回过神，已身处一个温暖的地方，鼻尖是干草的气息。

paras.en: She heard a fire crackling nearby.
paras.zh: 她听到近旁火噼啪作响。

paras.en: Her eyes fluttered open. “There you are!” Kristoff said. “You’ve been out for hours.
paras.zh: 她睁开眼。“你醒了！”克里斯托夫说。“你昏睡了好几个小时。

paras.en: Olaf, she’s awake!
paras.zh: 雪宝，她醒了！

paras.en: I thought…I don’t know.” He ran a hand through his hair. “You need…you need soup.” Sven snorted. “Soup?” Anna said groggily.
paras.zh: 我以为……我也不知道。”他用手捋了捋头发。“你需要……你需要喝点汤。”斯文喷了口气。“汤？”安娜昏沉沉地问。

paras.en: She was covered in a wool blanket and appeared to be in a large barn.
paras.zh: 她身上裹着羊毛毯，看样子是在一间大谷仓里。

paras.en: She could see horses nibbling hay in their stalls and chickens in their coop.
paras.zh: 她能看见马厩里的马在嚼干草，鸡笼里的鸡在咯咯叫。

paras.en: A cow mooed close by.
paras.zh: 近旁一头牛哞哞叫着。

paras.en: Everyone was sheltered indoors in this weather. “Yes, she needs soup,” Kristoff argued with the reindeer. “She needs to eat something.
paras.zh: 这种天气，大家都躲进了屋里。“对，她需要喝汤，”克里斯托夫跟驯鹿争辩道。“她得吃点东西。

paras.en: She didn’t have any glogg at the castle like I did, and you ate all the carrots.” Sven snorted again. “I’m just concerned, that’s all.” Sven pawed at the ground. “Yes, that’s all .
paras.zh: 她在城堡里没像我那样喝过热红酒，而胡萝卜全被你吃了。”斯文又喷了口气。“我只是担心她，仅此而已。”斯文用蹄子刨着地面。“对，仅此而已。

paras.en: Enough, Sven.” Kristoff held out a mug. “Here.
paras.zh: 够了，斯文。”克里斯托夫递过一个杯子。“给。

paras.en: You’ll be happy to know I asked the family if we could stay in the barn this time, and they said yes.
paras.zh: 你会高兴的，这次我问过这家人能不能借谷仓歇脚，他们答应了。

paras.en: They were just happy to get news from Arendelle.
paras.zh: 他们只是很高兴能听到阿伦黛尔的消息。

paras.en: Not that we have much news, but seeing a talking snowman seemed to make the kids happy.” Olaf giggled. “They liked my personal flurry, but they said they were tired of the snow.” “Even I’m tired of the snow, and I harvest ice for a living,” Kristoff said. “Anna?
paras.zh: 虽说我们也没什么消息，可看到会说话的雪人，孩子们似乎挺开心。”雪宝咯咯笑起来。“他们喜欢我那团小雪花，不过说也烦透了雪。”“连我都烦透了雪，我可是靠采冰吃饭的，”克里斯托夫说。“安娜？

paras.en: Have some soup.” She sat up slowly.
paras.zh: 喝点汤吧。”她慢慢坐起身。

paras.en: Her head was still pounding.
paras.zh: 她的头还在突突地疼。

paras.en: She groaned.
paras.zh: 她哼了一声。

paras.en: Kristoff held the mug to her lips. “Come on.
paras.zh: 克里斯托夫把杯子凑到她嘴边。“来。

paras.en: Just have a little.” Anna took a sip, feeling the soup warm her insides.
paras.zh: 就喝一点点。”安娜抿了一口，热汤暖进了肚子里。

paras.en: For someone who was so cranky all the time, Kristoff could be really sweet when he wanted to be. “Thank you.” Kristoff blushed. “Yeah, well…” Sven snorted again and Kristoff looked away. “You’re welcome.
paras.zh: 平时总那么暴躁的克里斯托夫，想体贴起来还真是温柔。“谢谢你。”克里斯托夫脸一红。“嗯，那个……”斯文又喷了口气，克里斯托夫把视线移开。“不客气。

paras.en: I just need to get you home in one piece.
paras.zh: 我只想把你平安带回家。

paras.en: And that’s where we’re going—home.” Anna’s eyes widened. “We can’t!
paras.zh: 我们要去的地方就是——家。”安娜瞪大了眼睛。“不行！

paras.en: We’ve got to find Elsa!” Kristoff sat back and sighed. “Look at how sick you’re getting in this weather.” “It’s not the weather,” Anna insisted, but she couldn’t explain what she was feeling.
paras.zh: 我们得找到艾莎！”克里斯托夫往身后一靠，叹了口气。“看看你在这天气里病成什么样了。”“不是天气的缘故，”安娜坚持道，却说不清自己的感受。

paras.en: She knew it sounded crazy, but something told her they needed to keep going until they found Elsa.
paras.zh: 她知道这话听起来荒唐，可有什么东西在告诉她，必须继续走，直到找到艾莎。

paras.en: Maybe Elsa would understand what was happening to her.
paras.zh: 也许艾莎能明白她身上正在发生什么。

paras.en: After all, she knew magic. “Someone’s got to convince her to bring back summer.
paras.zh: 毕竟，她懂魔法。“得有人去说服她把夏天带回来。

paras.en: She’ll listen to Olaf, and if not, we’ll make her listen to us.” “It’s getting colder.” Kristoff put down the mug of soup, which Sven immediately started to lap up. “We can’t keep riding around when Olaf has no clue where he’s going.
paras.zh: 她会听雪宝的，要是不听，我们就逼她听我们的。”“天越来越冷了。”克里斯托夫放下汤杯，斯文立刻舔了起来。“雪宝自己都不知道往哪儿走，我们不能一直这么兜圈子。

paras.en: I know you want to help, but it’s impossible when all we have to go on is a vague suggestion that she was headed toward the North Mountain.
paras.zh: 我知道你想帮忙，可我们手头唯一的线索只是模糊地说她往北山去了，这根本行不通。

paras.en: Let’s face it: no one knows where Princess Elsa really is.” “The Valley of the Living Rock!” Olaf blurted out.
paras.zh: 面对现实吧：没人知道艾莎公主到底在哪儿。”“有生命的石头山谷！”雪宝脱口而出。

paras.en: Kristoff’s eyes widened. “What did you say?” “I’ve never heard of it,” Anna told them. “Neither have I,” Olaf admitted. “Well, I have heard of it.
paras.zh: 克里斯托夫瞪大了眼睛。“你说什么？”“我从来没听说过，”安娜对他们说。“我也没听过，”雪宝承认。“不过，我倒是听说过。

paras.en: I heard a man say the name when he read Elsa’s letter from her mother.
paras.zh: 我听一个男人在读艾莎母亲给她的信时念过这个名字。

paras.en: There was something about the Valley of the Living Rock.
paras.zh: 信里提到了”有生命的石头山谷“。

paras.en: I’m just not sure where that is.” “I know where the Valley of the Living Rock is,” Kristoff said. “So you’ll take me?” Anna asked.
paras.zh: 我只是不知道那地方在哪儿。”“我知道有生命的石头山谷在哪儿，”克里斯托夫说。“那你会带我去？”安娜问。

paras.en: Kristoff ran a hand through his hair. “Do I have to?” She squeezed his hand. “Please?” The fire crackled and popped as Anna waited for an answer.
paras.zh: 克里斯托夫用手捋了捋头发。“非去不可吗？”她捏了捏他的手。“求你了？”安娜等着回答，火堆噼啪作响。

paras.en: Olaf leaned in closer.
paras.zh: 雪宝凑近了些。

paras.en: Sven snorted.
paras.zh: 斯文喷了口气。

paras.en: All eyes were on Kristoff, who was staring at Anna’s hand.
paras.zh: 所有人的目光都落在克里斯托夫身上，他正盯着安娜的手。

paras.en: Finally, he looked up.
paras.zh: 终于，他抬起头。

paras.en: His brown eyes were fiery in the glow of the flames.
paras.zh: 火光映照下，他棕色的眼睛里燃着光。

paras.en: She’d never noticed his freckles before. “Okay,” Kristoff said. “We leave in the morning, but you’d better bundle up.” Anna smiled.
paras.zh: 她以前从没注意过他脸上的雀斑。“好吧，”克里斯托夫说。“我们明早出发，不过你最好穿暖和点。”安娜笑了。

paras.en: For once, she didn’t argue.
paras.zh: 这回，她没有顶嘴。

paras.en: Elsa had no idea how long it had been since she left the valley to head back to the North Mountain.
paras.zh: 艾莎根本不知道，自己离开山谷、返回北山，已经过去了多久。

paras.en: If she couldn’t be with Anna, time no longer mattered.
paras.zh: 如果不能和安娜在一起，时间也就失去了意义。

paras.en: Grand Pabbie’s words played in a loop in her head.
paras.zh: 皮比的话在她脑海里一遍遍回放。

paras.en: Be patient.
paras.zh: 耐心些。

paras.en: She’d been more than patient!
paras.zh: 她岂止是耐心！

paras.en: She had spent the past three years mourning their parents—whom Anna might not even remember—and had been without a sister since she was a child.
paras.zh: 过去三年，她都在为父母哀悼——而安娜也许根本不记得他们了——她从小时候起就失去了妹妹的陪伴。

paras.en: Hadn’t they both lost enough?
paras.zh: 他们失去的难道还不够多吗？

paras.en: When would this curse break?
paras.zh: 这诅咒何时才能破除？

paras.en: She remembered Anna; she needed Anna.
paras.zh: 她记得安娜；她需要安娜。

paras.en: Wasn’t that what Grand Pabbie had said was needed for the magic to dissolve?
paras.zh: 皮比说过，要让魔法消解，需要的难道不就是这个吗？

paras.en: Why didn’t Anna remember her past as well?
paras.zh: 为什么安娜也记不起自己的过去？

paras.en: What if Anna never remembered?
paras.zh: 万一安娜永远记不起来呢？

paras.en: If Anna didn’t remember her, then she didn’t want to go on.
paras.zh: 如果安娜不记得她，那她也不想再撑下去了。

paras.en: She would stay at the top of the mountain until the curse broke, and if it didn’t, then she’d stay there forever.
paras.zh: 她会留在山顶，直到诅咒破除；若破除不了，她便永远留在那里。

paras.en: Her people needed a strong leader, not a queen who was overcome with grief.
paras.zh: 她的子民需要一位坚强的领袖，而不是一个被悲伤击垮的女王。

paras.en: They’d be better off without her.
paras.zh: 没有她，他们会过得更好。

paras.en: Elsa’s sleigh came to a halt at the steps leading to her ice palace.
paras.zh: 艾莎的雪橇停在了通往冰宫的台阶前。

paras.en: When she got out, she no longer looked at her kingdom in wonder.
paras.zh: 下车时，她不再以惊叹的目光眺望自己的王国。

paras.en: She was lost in her own misery.
paras.zh: 她沉浸在自己的痛苦里。

paras.en: Maybe that was why she missed the footsteps in the snow leading to her palace doors.
paras.zh: 也许正因如此，她才没注意到雪地里那串通向宫门的脚印。

paras.en: It wasn’t until she was inside that she realized she wasn’t alone.
paras.zh: 直到进了宫门，她才发觉自己并非独自一人。

paras.en: Elsa jumped in shock. “How did you find me?” “It isn’t hard when you know where to look.” Hans put his hands up to keep her from running away. “I came alone.” He was dressed in a heavy navy coat and gloves, a scarf wrapped around his neck.
paras.zh: 艾莎惊得跳了起来。“你怎么找到我的？”“只要知道去哪儿找，并不难。”汉斯举起双手，不让她跑掉。“我是一个人来的。”他身穿厚实的深蓝外套，戴着手套，脖子上裹着围巾。

paras.en: Both a sword and a crossbow hung from a sheath on his belt.
paras.zh: 他腰间的鞘上挂着一柄剑和一把弩。

paras.en: His boots were covered in snow, and his cheeks and nose were bright pink.
paras.zh: 他的靴子上沾满雪，脸颊和鼻子冻得通红。

paras.en: She could only imagine the journey he had taken to get up the mountain. “How did you…” Her voice trailed off.
paras.zh: 她只能想象他一路爬上山来有多不容易。“你是怎么……”她的声音低了下去。

paras.en: Hans took a step closer. “When you ran off like that, freezing the fjord, I knew you were trying to disappear,” he said. “So I thought: where is the farthest place Elsa could go to escape?
paras.zh: 汉斯走近一步。“你那样跑掉，把峡湾冻住，我就知道你想躲起来，”他说。“于是我想：艾莎会逃到最远的地方是哪儿呢？

paras.en: And I looked up and saw it: the North Mountain.” Maybe Hans knew her better than she’d thought.
paras.zh: 我抬头一看，就是北山。”也许汉斯比她以为的更了解她。

paras.en: His eyes crinkled with worry. “Are you all right?” No, she wanted to say.
paras.zh: 他的眼里满是担忧的皱纹。“你还好吗？”不，她想说。

paras.en: I have a sister.
paras.zh: 我有一个妹妹。

paras.en: She’s alive.
paras.zh: 她还活着。

paras.en: I desperately want to find her, but a curse is keeping us apart.
paras.zh: 我拼命想找到她，可一道诅咒将我们分开。

paras.en: But she didn’t.
paras.zh: 可她没有说出口。

paras.en: Hans looked around in wonder. “You built this?” “Yes,” Elsa said, feeling humbled again by her creation.
paras.zh: 汉斯惊奇地环顾四周。“这是你造的？”“是的，”艾莎说，面对自己的造物，再次感到敬畏。

paras.en: This wasn’t some little igloo she had imagined.
paras.zh: 这可不是她想象中那种小冰屋。

paras.en: It had the architecture of her family castle, with snowflake designs and intricate patterns covering every wall and archway.
paras.zh: 它有着和她家族城堡一样的建筑结构，每面墙、每道拱门上都布满雪花纹样与繁复的花饰。

paras.en: Every pillar sparkled and glowed with a blue hue that bathed the whole palace in light. “This place is incredible, and so are you,” Hans said. “Everything about you feels different somehow.” She blushed. “Hans…” “Is it your hair?
paras.zh: 每根柱子都泛着蓝光，熠熠生辉，把整座宫殿照得通明。“这地方太不可思议了，你也是，”汉斯说。“你身上的一切，都让人觉得有些不一样。”她脸红了。“汉斯……” “是你的头发吗？

paras.en: You don’t usually wear it down.
paras.zh: 你平时不披散头发的。

paras.en: I like your dress, too.
paras.zh: 我也喜欢你的裙子。

paras.en: This place suits you.” Hans’s eyes flickered to the room behind her. “You’re here alone?” She exhaled slowly. “I’m always alone.” Hans moved closer. “You’re not alone, Elsa.
paras.zh: 这地方很衬你。”汉斯的目光扫过她身后的房间。“你一个人在这儿？”她缓缓吐了口气。“我一直都是一个人。”汉斯凑近了些。“你不是一个人，艾莎。

paras.en: I’m here for you.
paras.zh: 我在这里陪你。

paras.en: I always have been.” Elsa wasn’t sure if it was the tone of his voice or the fact that he had journeyed so far to find her, but something inside her gave way.
paras.zh: 我一直都在。”艾莎说不清，是他话语的语气，还是他不远千里来找她这件事，让她心里的某道防线垮了下来。

paras.en: Her eyes filled with tears. “I’m sorry I revealed my powers the way I did.
paras.zh: 她的眼眶蓄满了泪水。“对不起，我那样暴露自己的魔力。

paras.en: I didn’t mean to scare you.
paras.zh: 我不是想吓你。

paras.en: I don’t want to hurt anyone.” “I know that.” He took her hand. “The Duke was pressuring me, the coronation was starting, and I had just learned—” She stopped herself. “Learned what?” Hans pressed.
paras.zh: 我不想伤害任何人。”“我知道。”他握住她的手。“公爵在逼我，加冕典礼就要开始，而我刚得知——”她住了口。“得知什么？”汉斯追问。

paras.en: Elsa pulled away. “Nothing.” How could she explain Anna? “I can’t help you if you don’t let me in,” Hans said.
paras.zh: 艾莎抽回手。“没什么。”她该怎么解释安娜？“你不让我进去，我就帮不了你，”汉斯说。

paras.en: She was quiet. “I think what you can do is breathtaking.” She looked at him. “You do?” Hans smiled. “You’ve been given an incredible gift.
paras.zh: 她沉默了。“我觉得你能做到的事，美得惊心动魄。”她看着他。“你真这么想？”汉斯笑了。“你被赐予了一份惊人的礼物。

paras.en: Think of all you could do for Arendelle with your powers.
paras.zh: 想想看，凭你的魔力，你能为阿伦黛尔做多少事。

paras.en: The people are only scared because they don’t understand your magic.
paras.zh: 百姓只是因为不懂你的魔法才害怕。

paras.en: If you show them how you can stop this winter and how your magic can protect the kingdom, they’ll fall in line.
paras.zh: 只要你让他们看到，你如何结束这场寒冬、你的魔法如何守护王国，他们就会乖乖顺从。

paras.en: You’ll see.” “Fall in line?” Elsa repeated.
paras.zh: 你等着瞧。”“乖乖顺从？”艾莎重复道。

paras.en: She wasn’t sure she liked the sound of that.
paras.zh: 她不太确定自己是否喜欢这话里的意味。

paras.en: Hans appeared flustered. “You know what I mean.
paras.zh: 汉斯显得有些慌乱。“你明白我的意思。

paras.en: They’ll respect your power the way they respect me for coming after you.” He reached for her hand again. “Think of all we could do for the kingdom together.” Together.
paras.zh: 他们会敬重你的力量，就像他们敬重我、因为我追你来了一样。”他再次伸手去握她的手。“想想看，我们俩一起能为王国做多少事。”一起。

paras.en: Elsa flinched.
paras.zh: 艾莎瑟缩了一下。

paras.en: So that was it, wasn’t it?
paras.zh: 原来如此，不是吗？

paras.en: Why hadn’t she realized it before?
paras.zh: 她之前怎么就没看出来？

paras.en: Hans wasn’t there for her; he was there for himself. “You still want to get married?” He got down on one knee. “Yes, even with these powers, I want to marry you!
paras.zh: 汉斯来这里不是为了她，而是为了他自己。“你还想结婚？”他单膝跪下。“想，哪怕你有这些魔力，我也想娶你！

paras.en: Come back and accept your crown, and we can rule Arendelle together.
paras.zh: 回来接受你的王冠，我们就能一起统治阿伦黛尔。

paras.en: You’ll never have to be alone again.
paras.zh: 你再也不必孤身一人。

paras.en: I promise you.” There it was again: We can rule Arendelle together.
paras.zh: 我向你保证。”又是这句话：我们能一起统治阿伦黛尔。

paras.en: Hans coveted the throne.
paras.zh: 汉斯觊觎王位。

paras.en: He didn’t want her—he wanted power. “I’m sorry, but I can’t marry you.
paras.zh: 他要的不是她——他要的是权力。“对不起，可我不能嫁给你。

paras.en: And I am not going back with you, either.” She started to ascend the staircase. “I’m sorry you came all this way for nothing.” “What?” Hans’s face fell. “You have to come back!” His voice had a sharp edge to it. “Only a monster would refuse!” He caught himself, and his eyes widened. “I mean—” “Please leave,” she cut him off.
paras.zh: 我也不会跟你回去。”她迈步走上台阶。“很遗憾你白跑这一趟。”“什么？”汉斯脸色一沉。“你必须回来！”他的声音里带着刺。“只有怪物才会拒绝！”他猛然住口，瞪大了眼睛。“我是说——” “请你离开，”她打断了他。

paras.en: Monster.
paras.zh: 怪物。

paras.en: Despite his pleas, Hans saw her the same way the Duke did. “Come back with me.
paras.zh: 尽管他苦苦哀求，汉斯看她的眼神，和公爵如出一辙。“跟我回去吧。

paras.en: If you would just stop the winter…Bring back summer.” He sounded frustrated. “Please?” “Don’t you see?
paras.zh: 只要你肯结束寒冬……把夏天带回来。”他听起来很懊恼。“求你了？”“你还不明白吗？

paras.en: I can’t,” Elsa told him. “I don’t know how, so I’m staying here, where I can’t hurt anyone.
paras.zh: 我做不到，”艾莎告诉他。“我不知道怎么做，所以我要留在这里，在这里我不会伤害任何人。

paras.en: I’m sorry.” Hans’s face was calm. “I see,” he said softly. “If you can’t fix things, maybe Anna can.” The wind whistling around the palace was the only sound.
paras.zh: 对不起。”汉斯的神色平静下来。“我明白了，”他轻声说。“如果你解决不了，也许安娜可以。”宫殿四周只有风在呼啸。

paras.en: Elsa stumbled in shock. “What did you say?” Hans pulled a piece of parchment from his pocket and held it up. “I said, maybe Anna can bring back summer.
paras.zh: 艾莎震惊得踉跄了一下。“你说什么？”汉斯从口袋里掏出一张羊皮纸，举了起来。“我说，也许安娜能把夏天带回来。

paras.en: That’s why you’re up here, isn’t it?
paras.zh: 你上这儿来，不就是这个原因吗？

paras.en: You’re looking for your sister.
paras.zh: 你在找你的妹妹。

paras.en: I read everything in the queen’s letter.” Elsa froze. “How did you get that?” “You dropped it in your haste to get away from the castle,” Hans said as he read it over again. “I guess you found it the day of your coronation.
paras.zh: 女王信里的内容我全读了。”艾莎僵住了。“你从哪儿弄到的？”“你匆忙逃离城堡时掉下的，”汉斯一边重读一边说。“我猜你是在加冕那天发现的。

paras.en: Why else would you have had a magic ice meltdown?” He smiled smugly. “I can’t say I blame you.
paras.zh: 不然你怎会魔力失控、冰雪爆发？”他得意地笑了。“我倒不怪你。

paras.en: If I learned I had a sister who had been hidden from me for years, I’d go a little mad, too.” “Who did you tell about that letter?” Elsa whispered. “No one—for now,” Hans said. “I was hoping you’d come back, marry me, and make this arrangement easy, but if you won’t, at least I have another option.” Elsa grasped the ice railing in panic. “You wouldn’t.” “As thirteenth in line in my own kingdom, I didn’t stand a chance.” Hans paced the floor. “I knew I’d have to marry into the throne somewhere, so when the Duke of Weselton told me about you and Arendelle, I was intrigued.
paras.zh: 要是我发现自己有个藏了多年的妹妹，我也会发点疯。”“那封信你告诉谁了？”艾莎低声问。“目前——谁也没告诉，”汉斯说。“我本指望你回来嫁给我，让这事好办些，可你不肯，至少我还有另一个选择。”艾莎惊恐地抓住冰栏。“你不敢。”“在我的王国里排第十三位，本就毫无机会，”汉斯在地板上踱步。“我早知道得靠联姻登上某个王位，所以当韦塞尔顿公爵跟我提起你和阿伦黛尔，我动了心。

paras.en: But I could never get anywhere with you.
paras.zh: 可我一直没能从你这儿得到半点进展。

paras.en: You were always closed off, and now you’ve doomed yourself.
paras.zh: 你总是拒人于千里之外，如今你已自取灭亡。

paras.en: Once I tell the people that you wouldn’t return or bring back summer, they really will think you’re a monster.” “No!” Elsa rushed down the staircase at him, and Hans drew his crossbow and brandished it at her.
paras.zh: 一旦我告诉百姓，你既不肯回来，也不肯带回夏天，他们就真会把你当怪物。”“不！”艾莎冲下台阶扑向他，汉斯却抽出弩，对准她比划。

paras.en: Elsa stopped short in surprise.
paras.zh: 艾莎惊得猛地停住。

paras.en: She didn’t recognize the man standing in front of her.
paras.zh: 她认不出眼前这个男人了。

paras.en: This wasn’t the man who had courted her for a year, sent her flowers weekly, and patiently waited for her to decide on their future.
paras.zh: 这不再是那个追求她一整年、每星期送花、耐心等她决定未来的人。

paras.en: In truth, Hans was the monster.
paras.zh: 说到底，怪物是汉斯。

paras.en: How could she have been such a fool? “Thankfully, we now know Arendelle has another heir to the throne,” Hans said. “Once I show the people this letter and find Anna, they will be indebted to me for saving their lost princess.
paras.zh: 她怎会傻成这样？“幸好，我们现在知道阿伦黛尔还有另一位王位继承人，”汉斯说。“等我向百姓出示这封信、找到安娜，他们便会感念我救回了走失的公主。

paras.en: I am charming, so unlike you, Anna will probably want to marry me in an instant.
paras.zh: 我很有魅力，所以不像你，安娜大概会立刻想嫁给我。

paras.en: Then all that will be left to do is kill you and bring back summer.” “You’re no match for me,” Elsa told him.
paras.zh: 到时只剩一件事——杀了你，把夏天带回来。”“你不是我的对手，”艾莎告诉他。

paras.en: She felt a familiar tingle in her fingers as she prepared to aim at him. “Maybe not, but I’m the hero who will save Arendelle from destruction.” Hans ran to the castle doors and opened them. “Guards!
paras.zh: 准备瞄准他时，她的指尖传来熟悉的刺痛感。“也许不是，但我可是要把阿伦黛尔从毁灭中救出的英雄。”汉斯跑向宫门，把它们打开。“卫兵！

paras.en: Guards!
paras.zh: 卫兵！

paras.en: I’ve found the princess!
paras.zh: 我找到公主了！

paras.en: She’s armed!” He grinned at her. “Help me!” Hans had tricked her.
paras.zh: 她有武器！”他朝她咧嘴一笑。“帮帮我！”汉斯骗了她。

paras.en: Anger bubbled up inside her as she raised her hands, a bright blue glow hovering above her fingers. “You won’t get away with this!” “I already have.” Hans pointed the crossbow at the ceiling and fired.
paras.zh: 她举起双手，怒火在胸中翻涌，指尖上方悬浮着幽蓝的光芒。“你不会有好下场的！”“我已经得手了。”汉斯把弩对准天花板，扣动了扳机。

paras.en: The bolt hit the enormous snowflake chandelier.
paras.zh: 弩箭射中了巨大的雪花吊灯。

paras.en: Elsa watched in horror as it shattered and fell toward her.
paras.zh: 艾莎惊恐地看着它碎裂、朝自己坠落。

paras.en: She tried to dive out of the way but wasn’t quick enough.
paras.zh: 她想扑向一旁躲开，却慢了一步。

paras.en: The crystals rained down on her, knocking her to the ground.
paras.zh: 水晶碎片如雨落下，砸得她跌在地上。

paras.en: By the time she got back up, she was face to face with Arendelle guards.
paras.zh: 等她再爬起来，已面对面撞上了阿伦黛尔的卫兵。

paras.en: Men who had dedicated their lives to protecting the crown were now holding swords aimed at their princess.
paras.zh: 这些曾誓死护卫王冠的人，此刻却举剑指向自己的公主。

paras.en: Two larger men in red overcoats ran into the room behind them.
paras.zh: 两个穿着红大衣、身材魁梧的男人从他们身后冲进房间。

paras.en: Elsa recognized them immediately.
paras.zh: 艾莎立刻认出了他们。

paras.en: They were the Duke of Weselton’s men. “We’ve got her!” one shouted. “Come quietly if you don’t want to be hurt.” How dare they threaten her?
paras.zh: 他们是韦塞尔顿公爵的手下。“抓住她了！”一人喊道。“不想受伤就乖乖跟我们走。”他们竟敢威胁她？

paras.en: They had no authority in this kingdom.
paras.zh: 在这个王国，他们根本没有执法权。

paras.en: Elsa’s fingertips began to glow, and the two men raised their crossbows in unison. “I’m not coming with you,” Elsa told them. “Just stay back!” She heard the crossbows before she saw them coming for her.
paras.zh: 艾莎的指尖开始发光，那两人齐刷刷举起了弩。“我不会跟你们走，”艾莎对他们说。“退后！”她先听见弩声，才看见箭朝自己射来。

paras.en: She put up her hands, creating a wall of ice as a shield.
paras.zh: 她举起双手，造出一堵冰墙作盾。

paras.en: Their bolts pierced the frozen surface, and it started to crack.
paras.zh: 弩箭穿透冰面，冰墙开始出现裂痕。

paras.en: Elsa ran around the wall, trying to find a way out of the palace.
paras.zh: 艾莎绕过冰墙，想找一条逃出宫殿的路。

paras.en: She needed to find Hans and keep him from getting away, but the men kept coming.
paras.zh: 她得找到汉斯，别让他溜掉，可那些人源源不断地涌来。

paras.en: Elsa fired again and again, building icy barriers around her. “Go around!” one of the Duke’s men shouted as he fought his way around daggers that sprung up from the floor.
paras.zh: 艾莎连连发射，在自己四周筑起冰障。“绕过去！”公爵的一名手下喊道，一边在从地板冒出的冰刃间左躲右闪。

paras.en: They came at her from opposite directions.
paras.zh: 他们从相反的方向朝她逼近。

paras.en: Elsa flung out her hands to protect herself. “I don’t want to hurt you!
paras.zh: 艾莎挥出双手护住自己。“我不想伤害你们！

paras.en: Stay back!” “Fire!” One of the men threw his crossbow to the other one.
paras.zh: 退后！”“放箭！”其中一人把弩抛给另一人。

paras.en: Elsa shot a steady stream of snow until it froze like an icicle, pinning one man to the wall and holding him there.
paras.zh: 艾莎射出一道稳定的雪流，直到它冻成冰柱，把一人钉在墙上动弹不得。

paras.en: With her other hand, she shot another stream across the room, creating a wall of ice that pushed the Duke’s other henchman into the next chamber, hiding him from her sight.
paras.zh: 她另一只手向房间另一侧射出一道雪流，筑起冰墙，把公爵的另一个爪牙推入隔壁房间，挡出了她的视线。

paras.en: Still, she kept pushing, thinking of Hans’s betrayal and her sister, who was unknowingly the prince’s target.
paras.zh: 即便如此，她仍不停手，脑海里是汉斯的背叛，还有妹妹——她正不知不觉地成了王子瞄准的目标。

paras.en: Her own guards ran into the room again. “Princess Elsa!” one cried. “Don’t be the monster they fear you are!” At the word monster, she dropped her arms in defeat.
paras.zh: 她自己的卫兵又冲进房间。“艾莎公主！”一人喊道。“别成为他们恐惧中那个怪物！”听到“怪物”二字，她颓然垂下双臂。

paras.en: One of the Duke’s men took advantage of her hesitation and fired his crossbow again in her direction.
paras.zh: 公爵的一名手下趁她迟疑，又朝她射了一箭。

paras.en: Angry, Elsa swirled her arms, and the walls around her crackled as new ice formed over old.
paras.zh: 艾莎怒火中烧，双臂一旋，四周的墙噼啪作响，新冰覆上了旧冰。

paras.en: Elsa imagined a great protector, and the ground began to shake.
