paras.zh: 艾莎想象出一个伟大的守护者，地面开始震动。

paras.en: Ice flew around her fingers, spiraling like a cyclone until it formed a snow beast several stories tall.
paras.zh: 冰在她的指尖飞舞，如旋风般盘旋，直至凝成一只数层楼高的雪兽。

paras.en: The beast’s eyes glowed blue as it let out a ferocious growl. “Go away!” it seemed to bark, although even Elsa couldn’t be certain.
paras.zh: 雪兽双眼泛着蓝光，发出一声凶猛的咆哮。它似乎在吼“走开！”，尽管连艾莎也不能确定。

paras.en: It could have been the sound of the rumbling walls starting to fall around them.
paras.zh: 那也可能是四周开始崩塌的墙壁轰隆作响。

paras.en: The guards raised their swords again and prepared to fight the beast.
paras.zh: 卫兵们再次举剑，准备与雪兽搏斗。

paras.en: Elsa took that moment to run for it.
paras.zh: 艾莎趁此机会夺路而逃。

paras.en: She burst through the palace doors into the snow and came face to face with more guards.
paras.zh: 她冲出宫门，冲进雪中，却迎面撞上更多卫兵。

paras.en: Fear entered their eyes as soon as they saw the giant snow beast.
paras.zh: 他们一看到那巨大的雪兽，眼里便露出惧色。

paras.en: All of them raised their crossbows and aimed at her heart. “Please.” Elsa’s voice was barely audible over the wind. “Let me explain.” They didn’t listen. “Fire!” Crossbow bolts flew toward her at the same moment the snow monster tumbled backward out of the palace, his icy left leg cut off.
paras.zh: 他们全都举起弩，瞄准她的心脏。“求求你们。”风声中，艾莎的声音几乎听不清。“让我解释。”他们不听。“放箭！”弩箭朝她飞来的同一刻，雪怪的左腿被斩断，向后跌出宫殿。

paras.en: He lost his balance and crashed into the staircase, breaking through it and falling straight into the gorge.
paras.zh: 它失去平衡，撞上台阶，撞穿后直坠深谷。

paras.en: The remaining steps started to shake and tumble.
paras.zh: 剩下的台阶开始震动、垮塌。

paras.en: Elsa tried to outrun the collapse, jumping before the steps fell into the gorge below.
paras.zh: 艾莎想抢在崩塌前逃开，在台阶坠入下方深谷前纵身一跃。

paras.en: She fell down hard on the other side, ice crashing around her.
paras.zh: 她重重摔落在另一侧，碎冰在身边四散飞溅。

paras.en: Then the world faded to black.
paras.zh: 然后，世界陷入一片漆黑。

paras.en: The sun didn’t come up the next morning.
paras.zh: 第二天早晨，太阳没有升起。

paras.en: The kingdom was shrouded in darkness thanks to the swirling blizzard that continued to drop snow onto Arendelle at an alarming rate.
paras.zh: 王国被笼罩在黑暗之中，那场盘旋的暴风雪仍在以惊人的速度不停向阿伦黛尔落下大雪。

paras.en: With the poor conditions, it apparently took Kristoff much longer than it normally would to reach the Valley of the Living Rock. “I don’t understand,” Kristoff muttered to himself. “We’ve been traveling for hours.
paras.zh: 路况恶劣，克里斯托夫显然比平时花了更长的时间才接近活石谷。“我搞不懂，”克里斯托夫喃喃自语，“我们已经走了好几个小时了。

paras.en: We should be there by now.” Kristoff pulled the sleigh to a halt. “Are you lost?” Anna asked. “You look lost!” Olaf commented.
paras.zh: 现在早该到了。”克里斯托夫把雪橇停了下来。“你迷路了吗？”安娜问。“你看起来迷路啦！”雪宝插嘴道。

paras.en: Anna wouldn’t blame him if he was.
paras.zh: 就算他真的迷路，安娜也不会怪他。

paras.en: It was snowing so hard she couldn’t see her hand in front of her face. “Shhh!” Kristoff lifted the lantern off its hook and waved it into the darkness.
paras.zh: 雪下得太大，她连眼前自己的手都看不见。“嘘！”克里斯托夫从钩子上取下提灯，朝黑暗中挥了挥。

paras.en: Sven pawed the snow uneasily as Kristoff peered into the distance.
paras.zh: 斯文不安地扒着雪，克里斯托夫则凝视着远方。

paras.en: Anna saw it at the same time Kristoff did: several pairs of yellow eyes were looking back at them.
paras.zh: 安娜和克里斯托夫同时看到了——好几对黄色的眼睛正回望着他们。

paras.en: Wolves.
paras.zh: 是狼。

paras.en: A distinct growl sounded in the distance and the pack of wolves emerged from the trees.
paras.zh: 远处传来一声清晰的低吼，狼群从树林中现身。

paras.en: Anna couldn’t believe how sharp their fangs looked.
paras.zh: 安娜不敢相信它们的獠牙竟那么尖利。

paras.en: Kristoff placed the lantern back on the hook and grabbed the reins. “Sven!
paras.zh: 克里斯托夫把提灯挂回钩上，抓住了缰绳。“斯文！

paras.en: Go!” The sled lurched and Sven took off at top speed. “Aww, look!
paras.zh: 快走！”雪橇猛地一颤，斯文全速冲了出去。“哎呀，看呀！

paras.en: Doggies!
paras.zh: 小狗！

paras.en: Aren’t they cute?” Olaf said. “They’re not dogs, Olaf!
paras.zh: 它们是不是很可爱？”雪宝说。“它们不是狗，雪宝！

paras.en: What do we do?” Anna asked as Kristoff tried to stay ahead of the pack racing after the sleigh.
paras.zh: 我们该怎么办？”安娜问，这时克里斯托夫正努力甩开紧追雪橇的狼群。

paras.en: He reached behind their seat, grabbed a stick, and lit it from the lantern.
paras.zh: 他把手伸到座位后面，抓起一根木棍，从提灯上点燃了它。

paras.en: It immediately flamed. “I can handle a few wolves,” he said, waving the fire in the air. “I want to help!” Anna shouted. “No!” Kristoff cracked the reins harder. “Why not?” They were moving so fast the falling snow felt like daggers hitting Anna’s face. “Because I don’t trust your judgment,” Kristoff snapped.
paras.zh: 木棍立刻燃起火焰。“几只狼我还能对付，”他挥舞着火把说。“我想帮忙！”安娜喊道。“不行！”克里斯托夫更用力地甩响缰绳。“为什么不行？”他们跑得太快，落下的雪像匕首般打在安娜脸上。“因为我不信任你的判断力，”克里斯托夫厉声说。

paras.en: Anna set her shoulders. “Excuse me?” “You’re not thinking straight!
paras.zh: 安娜挺直了肩膀。“你说什么？”“你脑子不清楚！

paras.en: Who keeps insisting on going out in this weather when they’re clearly getting sick?” He kicked a wolf and it flew backward.
paras.zh: 明明都快病倒了，是谁还坚持要这种天气出门？”他踢了一脚狼，那狼向后飞了出去。

paras.en: Anna hadn’t even seen the wolf coming.
paras.zh: 安娜根本没看见那狼扑过来。

paras.en: She reached for something in the sleigh to use as a weapon.
paras.zh: 她在雪橇里摸索着找件东西当武器。

paras.en: Olaf handed her Kristoff’s lute. “I am not getting sick!” “You keep passing out and mumbling to yourself,” he reminded her. “That’s because I’m seeing things!” She swung the lute.
paras.zh: 雪宝把克里斯托夫的鲁特琴递给她。“我才没生病！”“你一直在昏倒，还自言自语，”他提醒她。“那是因为我看见了幻象！”她挥起鲁特琴。

paras.en: It connected with a wolf, and the animal ran away. “Whoa!” Kristoff actually looked impressed. “What kinds of things?” Anna stopped swinging the lute and looked at him. “I know it sounds crazy, but I keep seeing myself with the princess when I was a little girl.” Kristoff held the torch over the side to keep the wolves at bay. “I mean, I guess it’s not entirely crazy.
paras.zh: 琴打中了一只狼，那动物逃开了。“哇！”克里斯托夫居然露出佩服的神色。“看见什么？”安娜停下挥琴，看着他。“我知道这听起来很疯，但我总看见自己还是小女孩时和公主在一起。”克里斯托夫把火把举在雪橇一侧，挡开狼群。“我是说，我想这也不算完全疯狂。

paras.en: I’m pretty sure I was kissed by a troll once, but I don’t remember it happening.” “You weren’t kidding about that?” Kristoff’s eyes widened. “Do you actually know Grand Pabbie?” “Who is Grand Pabbie?” Anna asked as Kristoff singed a wolf about to land in the sleigh.
paras.zh: 我很确定自己曾被地精亲过一次，但不记得那件事了。”“你之前没开玩笑？”克里斯托夫睁大了眼睛。“你真认识皮比？”“皮比是谁？”安娜问，此时克里斯托夫正烧焦一只正要扑进雪橇的狼。

paras.en: A second wolf snatched Kristoff’s overcoat.
paras.zh: 又一只狼叼走了克里斯托夫的外套。

paras.en: Kristoff tumbled out of the sled before he could answer her question. “Kristoff!” Anna screamed, grabbing the torch before it fell.
paras.zh: 还没来得及回答，克里斯托夫就从雪橇里翻了出去。“克里斯托夫！”安娜尖叫，在火把掉落前一把抓住了它。

paras.en: There was no time to signal to Sven to stop, and if he did, they’d be done for. “Here!” she heard Kristoff shout.
paras.zh: 根本没时间示意斯文停下，就算停了，他们也完蛋了。“接着！”她听见克里斯托夫喊道。

paras.en: He was holding on to a rope that was dragging him behind the sleigh.
paras.zh: 他抓着一根绳子，那绳子正拖着他跟在雪橇后面。

paras.en: The wolves were gaining on him.
paras.zh: 狼群正一点点逼近他。

paras.en: Anna lit the first thing she saw—Kristoff’s sleeping sack. “Ooh!” Olaf said as the fire ignited the bedding.
paras.zh: 安娜点燃了手边第一样东西——克里斯托夫的睡袋。“哦！”火点燃了铺盖，雪宝叫道。

paras.en: Anna picked it up and tossed it out the back of the sled.
paras.zh: 安娜抓起睡袋，从雪橇后方扔了出去。

paras.en: Kristoff screamed as the flames shot toward him, narrowly missing his head.
paras.zh: 火苗朝克里斯托夫蹿去，擦着他的脑袋飞过，他尖叫起来。

paras.en: The wolves retreated, then came racing back again.
paras.zh: 狼群退开了，紧接着又冲了回来。

paras.en: Anna rushed to the back of the sleigh to help him up.
paras.zh: 安娜冲到雪橇后面想把他拉上来。

paras.en: Kristoff was already pulling himself in. “You almost set me on fire!” “Guys?” Anna heard Olaf say, but she ignored him.
paras.zh: 克里斯托夫已经自己爬进来了。“你差点把我点着！”“喂？”安娜听见雪宝说话，但她没理他。

paras.en: She pulled Kristoff the rest of the way in. “But I didn’t!” “Guys?” Olaf tried again. “We’ve reached the end of the path!” Kristoff and Anna both did a double take.
paras.zh: 她把克里斯托夫剩下的身子也拽了进来。“可我没有啊！”“喂？”雪宝又试了一次。“路到头了！”克里斯托夫和安娜都猛地一愣。

paras.en: A ravine was a half a mile in front of them and Sven was barreling toward it, spurred on by the sound of the wolves.
paras.zh: 前方半英里处是一道峡谷，斯文听到狼群的声响，正不顾一切地朝它冲去。

paras.en: Anna and Kristoff hurried to the front of the sleigh. “Get ready to jump, Sven!” Anna shouted.
paras.zh: 安娜和克里斯托夫急忙赶到雪橇前头。“准备好起跳，斯文！”安娜喊道。

paras.en: Kristoff picked up Olaf and threw him into Anna’s lap, then lifted them both his arms. “Hey!” Anna protested.
paras.zh: 克里斯托夫抱起雪宝，扔进安娜怀里，然后双臂把两人一起托起。“嘿！”安娜抗议。

paras.en: Kristoff tossed her forward, and she landed on Sven’s back with Olaf in her arms. “You don’t tell him what to do!
paras.zh: 克里斯托夫把她向前一抛，她抱着雪宝落在了斯文背上。“你才不是指挥他的人！

paras.en: I do!” Kristoff cut the line from the sled just as they reached the ravine. “Jump, Sven!” Sven leapt into the air.
paras.zh: 我是！”就在他们到达峡谷时，克里斯托夫割断了雪橇的牵引绳。“跳，斯文！”斯文腾空跃起。

paras.en: Anna looked back in a panic for Kristoff.
paras.zh: 安娜慌乱地回头找克里斯托夫。

paras.en: He and his sled were already airborne.
paras.zh: 他和雪橇已经飞在空中。

paras.en: Sven landed on the other side of the ravine, almost pitching Anna and Olaf off him as he came to a grinding halt.
paras.zh: 斯文落在峡谷另一侧，猛地刹住时差点把安娜和雪宝甩下去。

paras.en: Anna jumped off and raced back to the edge of the cliff.
paras.zh: 安娜跳下来，跑回悬崖边。

paras.en: Kristoff leapt off the sled as it plummeted into the ravine.
paras.zh: 雪橇坠入峡谷时，克里斯托夫从上面跳了下来。

paras.en: She watched in horror as he attempted to reach the other side, instead hitting the edge of the cliff and sliding backward. “Hang on!” she shouted. “Rope!
paras.zh: 她惊恐地看着他试图够到对岸，却撞上悬崖边缘又往下滑。“撑住！”她喊道。“绳子！

paras.en: I need rope!” Anna called in a panic to Olaf, but she knew everything they needed was in that sleigh.
paras.zh: 我要绳子！”安娜慌乱地朝雪宝喊，可她知道所需的一切都在那雪橇里。

paras.en: Please don’t let anything happen to Kristoff, she silently begged.
paras.zh: 求求你别让克里斯托夫出事，她在心里默求。

paras.en: Suddenly, a pickax with rope attached to it flew through the air above her head.
paras.zh: 突然，一把系着绳子的冰镐从她头顶飞过。

paras.en: The ax hit the ground in front of Kristoff. “Grab on!” someone yelled.
paras.zh: 冰镐扎在克里斯托夫面前的地上。“抓住！”有人喊道。

paras.en: Anna looked up.
paras.zh: 安娜抬起头。

paras.en: A man with red hair and a blue overcoat was holding the other end of the rope. “Help me pull him up!” he told her.
paras.zh: 一个红头发、穿蓝外套的男人抓着绳子的另一端。“帮我把他拉上来！”他对她说。

paras.en: Anna grabbed the rope, dug in her heels, and helped pull Kristoff to safety.
paras.zh: 安娜抓住绳子，脚跟蹬地，帮忙把克里斯托夫拉到安全的地方。

paras.en: He collapsed on his back, breathing heavily.
paras.zh: 他仰面倒下，喘着粗气。

paras.en: She was so relieved she thought about hugging him, but she stopped herself and gave Kristoff a moment to catch his breath.
paras.zh: 她松了口气，本想拥抱他，却又忍住，让克里斯托夫先喘口气。

paras.en: Now probably wasn’t the time to bring up how his newly paid-off sleigh had gone up in flames.
paras.zh: 现在大概不是提起他那刚还清贷款的雪橇已化为灰烬的时候。

paras.en: Anna looked up at their rescuer, who stood next to a pale golden horse. “Thank you.
paras.zh: 安娜抬头看着救命恩人，他站在一匹淡金色马儿身旁。“谢谢你。

paras.en: If you hadn’t come along when you did—” He cut her off. “Of course.” They both knew what would have happened if he hadn’t arrived. “What are you all doing out here in the middle of this storm?
paras.zh: 要不是你及时出现——”他打断了她。“应该的。”两人都清楚，如果他没赶到会发生什么。“这么大的暴风雪，你们在这里做什么？

paras.en: It’s dangerous with the wolves and the weather.” “My thoughts exactly,” Kristoff said, breathing heavily, “but once this one has an idea in her head, she has to go with it.
paras.zh: 又有狼又有坏天气，很危险。”“正是我想说的，”克里斯托夫喘着气说，“可她一旦心里有了主意，就非得照着做不可。

paras.en: I am the fool who listened.” Anna held out her hand to shake the strangers. “I’m Anna, and the one you helped rescue is Kristoff.” “I wouldn’t exactly say ‘rescue,’” Kristoff mumbled.
paras.zh: 我就是那个听了她的傻瓜。”安娜伸出手要和陌生人握手。“我是安娜，你帮着救上来的是克里斯托夫。”“我可不敢说'救'字，”克里斯托夫嘟囔。

paras.en: The man blinked his hazel eyes several times before he spoke. “Did you say you’re Anna ?” “Yes, we saw the deep freeze happen in Harmon and headed down to Arendelle to see what was going on,” she explained, talking a mile a minute. “But then the wolves caught up with our sleigh and we reached a ravine and had to jump and Kristoff threw me onto Sven—that’s his reindeer—and then he jumped, but his sled didn’t make it.
paras.zh: 那男人眨了几下淡褐色的眼睛，才开口。“你说你是安娜？”“对，我们在哈蒙亲眼看见大地封冻，就往阿伦黛尔赶，看看出了什么事，”她语速飞快地说。“可后来狼追上了我们的雪橇，我们到了一道峡谷，只好起跳，克里斯托夫把我甩到斯文——那是他的驯鹿——背上，然后他自己也跳了，但他的雪橇没过去。

paras.en: He almost didn’t, either, but then you came along.” She smiled brightly.
paras.zh: 他差点也过不来，不过你来了。”她灿烂地笑了。

paras.en: The man still looked incredibly bewildered. “But we’re all safe now.
paras.zh: 那男人仍一脸茫然。“但我们现在都安全了。

paras.en: I’m Anna.
paras.zh: 我是安娜。

paras.en: Did I say that already?” He squeezed her hand and smiled. “You did, but that’s okay.” He had a great smile. “It’s a pleasure to meet you, Anna.
paras.zh: 我说过了吗？”他握紧她的手，笑了笑。“说过了，不过没关系。”他的笑容很好看。“很高兴认识你，安娜。

paras.en: I’m Hans of the Southern Isles.” Anna gripped his hand tight. “You’re Hans?
paras.zh: 我是南方群岛的汉斯。”安娜紧紧握住他的手。“你是汉斯？

paras.en: The Prince Hans?” He laughed. “Yes.
paras.zh: 汉斯王子？”他笑了。“是的。

paras.en: I think so.
paras.zh: 我想是吧。

paras.en: And you’re the Anna.
paras.zh: 而你就是那位安娜。

paras.en: Am I right?” “Uhh…yes!” He was funny.
paras.zh: 我没说错吧？”“嗯……对！”他很风趣。

paras.en: Anna laughed at the absurdness of it all.
paras.zh: 安娜为这一切的荒唐笑了起来。

paras.en: The wolves were on the other side of the ravine, Kristoff was safe, and they had somehow found Elsa’s Prince Hans.
paras.zh: 狼在峡谷另一边，克里斯托夫安然无恙，而他们竟然找到了艾莎的汉斯王子。

paras.en: It had to be fate! “Prince Hans!” Olaf ran out of the woods, where he’d been gathering some of Kristoff’s things that had flown through the air. “It’s you!
paras.zh: 一定是命中注定！“汉斯王子！”雪宝从树林里跑出来，他刚才一直在捡那些被甩到空中的克里斯托夫的物件。“真的是你！

paras.en: It’s really you!” Hans lost his footing in the snow. “Oh, it’s all right,” Anna said, over the shock of a talking snowman by then. “Princess Elsa made him.
paras.zh: 真的是你！”汉斯在雪里脚下一滑。“哦，没事，”安娜说，此时她已被会说话的雪人吓过，不再那么惊讶了。“他是艾莎公主造的。

paras.en: His name is Olaf, and he’s trying to help us find Elsa so we can stop this winter.” “We’re looking for her now!” Olaf added. “You are?” Hans looked surprised when she and Olaf nodded.
paras.zh: 他叫雪宝，正帮我们找艾莎，好结束这场冬天。”“我们正找她呢！”雪宝补充。“是吗？”她和雪宝一齐点头，汉斯显得有些惊讶。

paras.en: Kristoff sat up and Anna dropped Hans’s hand. “Great,” Kristoff said. “Now that we’re all clear on who’s who, we should get moving before the wolves come back.
paras.zh: 克里斯托夫坐起来，安娜松开了汉斯的手。“好极了，”克里斯托夫说。“既然大家都认清楚了，趁狼还没回来，我们该赶路了。

paras.en: Thanks for your help, Prince Hans.” Anna blushed at Kristoff’s sarcasm.
paras.zh: 谢谢你的帮忙，汉斯王子。”安娜被克里斯托夫的讽刺弄得脸红了。

paras.en: She was used to it, but Hans was a prince. “Sorry, it’s been a long few days.
paras.zh: 她习惯了，可汉斯是位王子啊。“抱歉，这几天太漫长了。

paras.en: We haven’t had any luck finding Princess Elsa so far.
paras.zh: 我们到现在还没能找到艾莎公主。

paras.en: Have you seen any sign of her?” Hans’s face fell. “No, I haven’t.
paras.zh: 你见过她的踪影吗？”汉斯的脸沉了下来。“不，我没见过。

paras.en: Have you?” Anna shook her head. “No.
paras.zh: 你呢？”安娜摇摇头。“没。

paras.en: We believe she may be in the Valley of the Living Rock, but with all this snow, we can’t seem to find it.” “Really?” Prince Hans ran a hand through his hair. “I thought she was headed to the North Mountain—that’s why I came this way—but I’ve seen no sign of her.
paras.zh: 我们相信她可能在活石谷，可雪这么大，我们好像怎么也找不到。”“真的吗？”汉斯王子用手理了理头发。“我以为她去了北山——所以我才走这条路——可我一直没见她的踪影。

paras.en: I doubt she made it up there, anyway.” “Why do you say that?” Kristoff asked.
paras.zh: 总之我怀疑她没爬上去。”“为什么这么说？”克里斯托夫问。

paras.en: Hans gave him a look. “She’s a princess.
paras.zh: 汉斯看了他一眼。“她是位公主。

paras.en: Do you really think she made it up the North Mountain with no supplies?” Anna hesitated.
paras.zh: 你真以为她没带补给就爬上了北山？”安娜犹豫了。

paras.en: She hadn’t thought of it that way before, but she wasn’t convinced.
paras.zh: 她以前没这么想过，却也没被说服。

paras.en: After all, she and Olaf had come this far, and she’d never left Harmon a day in her life.
paras.zh: 毕竟，她和雪宝都走了这么远，而她这一辈子还从没离开过哈蒙。

paras.en: Wouldn’t Elsa be able to make it up a mountain with the aid of her powers? “It’s not impossible.” Kristoff seemed to hear her thoughts.
paras.zh: 艾莎有魔力相助，难道还爬不上山吗？“不是不可能。”克里斯托夫似乎听到了她的心声。

paras.en: He stood between her and Hans. “She can make snow, so we know she likes cold places.” So now Kristoff is on Elsa’s side?
paras.zh: 他站在她和汉斯之间。“她能造雪，所以我们知道她喜欢寒冷的地方。”所以克里斯托夫现在站到艾莎那边了？

paras.en: Anna wondered.
paras.zh: 安娜暗想。

paras.en: Didn’t he just call her ice crazy last night? “Olaf?
paras.zh: 他昨晚不是还叫她冰雪疯子吗？“雪宝？

paras.en: You mean the talking snowman.” Hans seemed perturbed as he gave Olaf a small wave. “Hello there.” “Prince Hans!
paras.zh: 你说的是那个会说话的雪人。”汉斯略显不安，朝雪宝小挥了下手。“你好呀。”“汉斯王子！

paras.en: It’s so good to finally meet you!” Olaf said, clapping his twigs. “I love your flowers!” Hans looked confused. “Olaf told us how you sent the princess purple heather every week,” Anna said. “He said you were one of the only people who could convince her to leave her room.” Hans blushed.
paras.zh: 终于见到你太好了！”雪宝拍着他的树枝手说。“我喜欢你送的花！”汉斯一脸困惑。“雪宝跟我们说过，你每周都给公主送紫石楠，”安娜说。“他说你是少数几个能劝她走出房间的人。”汉斯脸红了。

paras.en: Or maybe it was just windburn. “It was her favorite flower.
paras.zh: 或许那只是风吹的。“那是她最喜欢的花。

paras.en: They always seemed to cheer her up.” His face clouded over. “Princess Elsa didn’t trust many people.
paras.zh: 它们好像总能让她的情绪好起来。”他的表情阴沉下来。“艾莎公主不怎么相信别人。

paras.en: I knew she was unhappy, but I never thought she’d plunge Arendelle into an eternal winter.” “It had to be an accident,” Anna said as a gust of wind sent snow swirling their way. “She wouldn’t have done something like this to her kingdom on purpose.” “Have you ever met the princess?” Hans asked.
paras.zh: 我知道她不开心，却从没想过她会把阿伦黛尔推入永恒的冬天。”“一定是场意外，”安娜说，一阵风把雪卷向他们。“她绝不会故意这样对待自己的王国。”“你见过公主吗？”汉斯问。

paras.en: Anna and Kristoff shook their heads. “I knew her well,” he said softly. “She was conflicted, and sometimes very angry.
paras.zh: 安娜和克里斯托夫摇了摇头。“我和她很熟，”他轻声说。“她内心矛盾，有时非常愤怒。

paras.en: She was having a tough time with this coronation.” “It’s true,” Olaf chimed in. “Elsa wasn’t happy about her hair.
paras.zh: 她对这次加冕礼很头疼。”“真的，”雪宝插嘴，“艾莎对她头发的事不开心。

paras.en: They wanted her to wear it up, and she said, ‘Olaf, should I wear it down?’ And I said, ‘I don’t have any hair.’” He pointed to the twigs on his head. “She was upset about the crown.” Hans corrected him. “She kept telling me she wasn’t ready to be a queen.
paras.zh: 他们要她把头发盘起来，她说：'雪宝，我该披下来吗？'我说：'我根本没头发。'”他指了指头上的树枝。“她是为王冠心烦。”汉斯纠正他。“她一直跟我说，她还没准备好当女王。

paras.en: I thought she was just having pre-coronation jitters, but she was insistent.
paras.zh: 我以为她只是加冕前的紧张，可她很坚持。

paras.en: She told me she didn’t want to be responsible for the whole kingdom.
paras.zh: 她告诉我，她不想对整个王国负责。

paras.en: I tried to reassure her that she’d be a good ruler, and that I’d be there for her, but…” Anna touched his arm. “It sounds like you tried to help her.” “I hated seeing her so upset.” He looked away. “The morning of her coronation, I tried to calm her down, but she got angry with me and some of the castle staff.
paras.zh: 我想安慰她，说她会是个好君主，我也会陪着她，可是……”安娜碰了碰他的胳膊。“听起来你尽力帮过她。”“我受不了看她那么难过。”他移开目光。“加冕那天早上，我想让她平静下来，她却对我还有几个城堡仆人生了气。

paras.en: The Duke of Weselton, too.
paras.zh: 还有韦斯特顿公爵。

paras.en: She kept telling us to stay back.
paras.zh: 她一直叫我们退后。

paras.en: That’s when…” Hans shut his eyes tight. “We barely made it out of that hallway alive.” “She tried to hurt you?” Anna was shocked.
paras.zh: 就在那时……”汉斯紧紧闭上眼。“我们几乎是活着逃出那条走廊的。”“她想伤害你？”安娜震惊了。

paras.en: Would the princess really try to hurt the man she loved? “Ice can be dangerous,” Kristoff said. “I should know.
paras.zh: 公主真的会伤害她所爱的人吗？“冰雪很危险，”克里斯托夫说。“我该知道的。

paras.en: I deliver ice for a living.
paras.zh: 我是卖冰为生的。

paras.en: It’s beautiful, but it’s also powerful and has a magic that can’t always be controlled.” “Exactly.
paras.zh: 它很美，却也很有力量，带着一种不总能受控的魔力。”“正是。

paras.en: And like I said, she was angry,” Hans said. “She shot ice straight at us, trying to pierce our hearts.” He looked directly at Anna. “The Duke barely got away.” “I wouldn’t be surprised if that guy provoked her,” Kristoff said with a chuckle. “He seemed real friendly when we met him.” “The Duke was almost killed,” Hans said sharply. “How friendly would you be?
paras.zh: 就像我说的，她当时很愤怒，”汉斯说。“她直冲我们射出冰，想刺穿我们的心。”他直直看着安娜。“公爵勉强逃掉。”“那家伙要是挑衅了她，我一点都不奇怪，”克里斯托夫轻声笑道。“我们见到他时，他可热情了。”“公爵差点被杀，”汉斯厉声说。“你还能对他多友好？

paras.en: I’m sorry, but the princess we thought we knew is gone.
paras.zh: 抱歉，可我们以为认识的那个公主已经不在了。

paras.en: The one I saw that day is a…monster.” Elsa wouldn’t abandon her people, would she?
paras.zh: 那天我见到的那个是……怪物。”艾莎不会抛弃她的人民，对吧？

paras.en: Anna felt a sharp pang and held her head.
paras.zh: 安娜感到一阵刺痛，抱住了头。

paras.en: She was getting another flash.
paras.zh: 她又感到一阵闪光。

paras.en: But this time it wasn’t a forgotten memory.
paras.zh: 但这次不是被遗忘的记忆。

paras.en: Instead, she felt pain.
paras.zh: 而是痛苦。

paras.en: Help me! she heard someone cry out.
paras.zh: 救我！她听见有人在呼喊。

paras.en: Anna!
paras.zh: 安娜！

paras.en: Help me! “Elsa?” Anna whispered, and crumbled to the ground.
paras.zh: 救我！“艾莎？”安娜轻声说，瘫倒在地。

paras.en: Kristoff reached for her, but Hans caught her first.
paras.zh: 克里斯托夫伸手去扶，汉斯却先一步接住了她。

paras.en: Her eyes fluttered open and closed, his face going into and out of focus. “The princess is in trouble,” Anna said. “I can feel it.” Kristoff pulled Anna out of Hans’s grasp. “You are going home.
paras.zh: 她的眼睛忽睁忽闭，他的脸在视线里模糊又清晰。“公主有危险，”安娜说。“我能感觉到。”克里斯托夫把安娜从汉斯手里拉出来。“你要回家。

paras.en: Now.” He looked at Hans. “She fell ill yesterday but tried to push on.
paras.zh: 现在。”他看着汉斯。“她昨天病倒了，却硬撑着赶路。

paras.en: She’s too stubborn for her own good.
paras.zh: 她倔得都害了自己。

paras.en: She needs to get inside and rest.” The pain subsided as quickly as it had come, and Anna shrugged away. “It’s just a headache.
paras.zh: 她需要进屋休息。”痛楚来得快去得也快，安娜甩开了他。“只是头痛。

paras.en: I can keep going.
paras.zh: 我还能走。

paras.en: I have to get to the valley.
paras.zh: 我必须赶到山谷。

paras.en: I don’t know why, but I feel like Elsa could be in danger.” “Danger?” Olaf looked frightened. “Valley?” Hans questioned. “Olaf thought she was on the North Mountain, but now he seems to think she’s in the Valley of the Living Rock,” Kristoff explained.
paras.zh: 我不知道为什么，但我觉得艾莎可能有危险。”“危险？”雪宝吓了一跳。“山谷？”汉斯疑惑道。“雪宝本来以为她去了北山，现在好像觉得她在活石谷，”克里斯托夫解释。

paras.en: He looked at Hans sharply. “Ever hear her mention it?” Hans thought for a moment. “No, I’m afraid not.” He looked at Anna. “But if you think she’s there and she’s in trouble, we have to find her.
paras.zh: 他锐利地看向汉斯。“听她提起过吗？”汉斯想了想。“不，恐怕没有。”他看着安娜。“但如果你觉得她在那里、又有麻烦，那我们得找到她。

paras.en: I only have my horse, Sitron, but I have money and things to barter.
paras.zh: 我只有我的马西特龙，但有钱和可以交换的东西。

paras.en: We can get you a horse, too, and then we’ll locate this valley together.” “And convince her to come back with us and help her people,” Anna added.
paras.zh: 我们也能给你搞匹马，然后一起找到这个山谷。”“还要说服她跟我们回去，帮她的人民，”安娜补充。

paras.en: She took a deep breath and tried to steady herself.
paras.zh: 她深吸一口气，努力稳住自己。

paras.en: The pain was gone, but the memory of Elsa’s voice lingered.
paras.zh: 痛楚消失了，艾莎的声音却仍在脑中回响。

paras.en: What was happening to her? “Yes,” Hans agreed. “And if she doesn’t want the crown, she can abdicate, but she must bring back summer.” “Whoa!” Kristoff interrupted and appealed to Anna. “You cannot go to the valley in this condition.” He touched her arm. “Anna, something is going on with you.
paras.zh: 她这是怎么了？“是的，”汉斯同意。“如果她不想要王冠，可以退位，但她必须让夏天回来。”“哇！”克里斯托夫打断，转向安娜。“你这状态不能去山谷。”他碰了碰她的胳膊。“安娜，你身上有点不对劲。

paras.en: I don’t know what it is, but you need rest.” Anna set her jaw. “Someone has to stop this winter, and I feel like…it’s me .” “But you don’t even know her,” Kristoff reminded her. “What if the prince is right?
paras.zh: 我不知道是什么，但你需要休息。”安娜绷紧了下巴。“总得有人阻止这场冬天，而我觉得……那个人是我。”“可你连她都不认识，”克里斯托夫提醒她。“万一王子说的是对的呢？

paras.en: If she’s that angry, she might hurt you.” “She won’t,” Anna insisted.
paras.zh: 如果她那么愤怒，她可能会伤了你。”“她不会的，”安娜坚持。

paras.en: The wind was whipping hard in the open clearing, and she felt her balance falter.
paras.zh: 风在空地上猛烈抽打，她感觉自己站不稳。

paras.en: Hans offered her his elbow to help her stay upright. “Kristoff, I can’t go home now.
paras.zh: 汉斯伸出胳膊肘扶她站稳。“克里斯托夫，我现在不能回家。

paras.en: Arendelle needs help.
paras.zh: 阿伦黛尔需要帮助。

paras.en: I have to try to do something.” “I agree,” Hans said. “Who asked you?” Kristoff said, and Sven snorted.
paras.zh: 我得试着做点什么。”“我同意，”汉斯说。“谁问你了？”克里斯托夫说，斯文喷了下鼻息。

paras.en: Kristoff looked at Anna. “This is crazy!
paras.zh: 克里斯托夫看着安娜。“这太疯了！

paras.en: You can’t just go off with this guy you just met!” “I went with you, didn’t I?” Anna reminded him.
paras.zh: 你不能就这么跟你刚认识的男人走！”“我不是跟你走了吗？”安娜提醒他。

paras.en: Kristoff was quiet. “Excuse me, but I don’t think you should be yelling at the lady,” Hans said. “Anna seems smart and knowledgeable.
paras.zh: 克里斯托夫不说话了。“不好意思，我觉得你不该对这位小姐大吼大叫，”汉斯说。“安娜看起来聪明又博学。

paras.en: She’s trying to help save the kingdom.” “Thank you,” Anna said.
paras.zh: 她在努力拯救王国。”“谢谢你，”安娜说。

paras.en: Hans wasn’t brooding or indecisive.
paras.zh: 汉斯既不忧郁也不优柔寡断。

paras.en: He might have been worried Elsa wouldn’t return with him, but he was still willing to go after her.
paras.zh: 他也许担心艾莎不会跟他回来，却仍愿意去追她。

paras.en: Maybe he’d be able to talk sense into her.
paras.zh: 也许他能说服她明白道理。

paras.en: Something told her she needed to be with Hans when he found her. “Anna, see reason!
paras.zh: 有种感觉告诉她，汉斯找到艾莎时，她得陪在身边。“安娜，理智点！

paras.en: We’ve lost all our supplies, my sleigh is in pieces, and this weather is making everyone a little crazy.” Kristoff was growing agitated now. “You can’t possibly want to keep going when we don’t even know for sure where Elsa is!
paras.zh: 我们的补给全没了，雪橇也碎了，这天气让谁都有点疯。”克里斯托夫越来越焦躁。“我们连艾莎到底在哪都不确定，你不可能还想继续走！

paras.en: We’re going with a snowman’s hunch!” “We do know!
paras.zh: 我们这是跟着雪人的直觉走！”“我们知道！

paras.en: When the letter was read aloud, I heard someone say ‘the Valley of the Living Rock’,” Olaf reminded them. “You heard me read the letter?” Hans said slowly. “It was you!” Olaf said happily. “I should’ve known.
paras.zh: 信被大声念出来的时候，我听见有人说'活石谷'，”雪宝提醒他们。“你听见我读信了？”汉斯缓缓地说。“就是你！”雪宝高兴地说。“我早该想到。

paras.en: You’re so good to Elsa.” “Anna,” Kristoff tried again. “Don’t do this.” Why couldn’t he see how important this was?
paras.zh: 你对艾莎真好。”“安娜，”克里斯托夫又劝，“别这样。”他怎么就看不出这事有多重要？

paras.en: She couldn’t show up back home and tell her parents she had failed.
paras.zh: 她不能回家，然后告诉父母自己失败了。

paras.en: Harmon would never survive this eternal winter.
paras.zh: 哈蒙绝熬不过这个永恒的冬天。

paras.en: But that was the problem, wasn’t it?
paras.zh: 可问题就在这，不是吗？

paras.en: Harmon wasn’t Kristoff’s village; it was hers.
paras.zh: 哈蒙不是克里斯托夫的村子，是她的。

paras.en: Kristoff just passed through with ice deliveries.
paras.zh: 克里斯托夫只是送货经过。

paras.en: He didn’t care about the people the way she did.
paras.zh: 他不像她那样在乎那些人。

paras.en: The only one he cared about was Sven. “I’m going,” she said firmly. “And I have no problem going the rest of the way with Hans.
paras.zh: 他只在乎斯文。“我要去，”她坚定地说。“我完全愿意和汉斯走完剩下的路。

paras.en: So…are you going to come with us?” Kristoff threw up his hands. “Look, I know the valley well, and even I can’t find it in this weather—and I’m not getting sick.
paras.zh: 那么……你要和我们一起走吗？”克里斯托夫摊开双手。“听着，我很熟悉那个山谷，可这种天气连我都找不到——而且我没生病。

paras.en: We should all turn back.” “I’m still going,” she said firmly. “Hans is, too.
paras.zh: 我们都该回头。”“我还是要去，”她坚定地说。“汉斯也是。

paras.en: We can all go.” “No.
paras.zh: 我们可以一起走。”“不。

paras.en: I think you three have it covered on your own.
paras.zh: 我觉得你们三个自己就够了。

paras.en: I’m going to salvage what’s left of my sleigh.
paras.zh: 我要去把我雪橇的残骸捡回来。

paras.en: Come on, Sven.” He turned his back and stalked off.
paras.zh: 走吧，斯文。”他转过身，大步走了。

paras.en: Sven grunted mournfully as he looked from Anna to Kristoff. “It’s okay, Sven,” Anna said, surprised she couldn’t change Kristoff’s mind. “You look after him.
paras.zh: 斯文从安娜看到克里斯托夫，哀怨地哼了一声。“没事的，斯文，”安娜说，惊讶自己竟劝不动克里斯托夫。“你照顾好他。

paras.en: I’ll be okay.” She watched the reindeer follow Kristoff into the woods. “I’m going to miss them,” Olaf said sadly.
paras.zh: 我不会有事的。”她看着驯鹿跟着克里斯托夫走进树林。“我会想他们的，”雪宝难过地说。

paras.en: Me too, Anna thought.
paras.zh: 安娜也这么想。

paras.en: Hans shook his head. “I can’t believe he’d leave you out here.” “I’ll be fine,” Anna said firmly. “I don’t doubt it.
paras.zh: 汉斯摇摇头。“真不敢相信他会把你丢在这里。”“我不会有事的，”安娜坚定地说。“我不怀疑。

paras.en: You seem like a natural leader.” Hans was looking at her so intently Anna started to blush.
paras.zh: 你像个天生的领导者。”汉斯那样专注地看着她，安娜不由脸红了。

paras.en: He pointed at smoke in the distance. “There has to be a cabin that way.
paras.zh: 他指着远处的炊烟。“那边准有小屋。

paras.en: Let’s find shelter for the night.” He held out his hand to help her onto his horse.
paras.zh: 我们去那里过夜。”“他伸手扶她上马。

paras.en: Anna climbed on and Hans placed Olaf in front of her.
paras.zh: 安娜爬上马，汉斯把雪宝放在她身前。

paras.en: Then he mounted the horse behind them. “We’re going to make a good team, Anna.
paras.zh: 然后他骑到他们身后。”我们会是个好搭档的，安娜。

paras.en: I can feel it.” “So can I,” Anna said with a soft smile.
paras.zh: 我能感觉到。“”我也是，“安娜温柔地笑了笑。

paras.en: Team.
paras.zh: 搭档。

paras.en: She liked the idea of that.
paras.zh: 她喜欢这个想法。

paras.en: Elsa felt her head pounding before she opened her eyes.
paras.zh: 艾莎睁开眼之前，就感到头在突突地疼。

paras.en: Why did her head hurt?
paras.zh: 她的头为什么疼？

paras.en: Then she remembered: Hans revealing his sinister nature, her desperate attempt to get away before Hans could find Anna on his own, the ice chandelier crashing and almost impaling her, and the ambush outside her fortress.
paras.zh: 接着她想起来了：汉斯暴露出邪恶的本性，她拼命想在汉斯独自找到安娜前逃走，冰吊灯砸落差点刺穿她，还有她城堡外的伏击。

paras.en: If only she’d known they were planning to take her back to Arendelle Castle and lock her away.
paras.zh: 要是早知道他们计划把她带回阿伦黛尔城堡关押起来就好了。

paras.en: She sat up and the blanket that had been lying over her fell, revealing chains.
paras.zh: 她坐起来，盖在身上的毯子滑落，露出了锁链。

paras.en: Elsa wore metal gloves, meant to keep her from using her hands—or, more specifically, her magic.
paras.zh: 艾莎戴着手套般的金属镣铐，为的是不让她用手——更准确地说，不让她用魔法。

paras.en: The chains were anchored to a large boulder on the floor that prevented her from moving more than a few feet.
paras.zh: 锁链固定在地上的一块大圆石上，让她最多只能移动几英尺。

paras.en: She pulled on the chains, hoping to yank them free, but it was no use.
paras.zh: 她拉扯锁链，想把它们拽脱，却毫无用处。

paras.en: Once again, she was a prisoner in her own castle.
paras.zh: 她又一次成了自己城堡里的囚徒。

paras.en: The chains were only long enough to allow her to walk to the castle window.
paras.zh: 锁链的长度只够她走到城堡的窗边。

paras.en: Outside, Arendelle wasn’t just covered in snow; it was buried.
paras.zh: 窗外，阿伦黛尔不只是被雪覆盖，而是被埋住了。

paras.en: Layers of snow were piled so high past rooftops that houses were no longer visible.
paras.zh: 一层层积雪堆得高过屋顶，房屋都看不见了。

paras.en: She heard a crash and wondered what had fallen: A house?
paras.zh: 她听见一声巨响，猜想是什么塌了：房子？

paras.en: A statue?
paras.zh: 雕像？

paras.en: A ship?
paras.zh: 船？

paras.en: She could see the boats out in the harbor, frozen where they were anchored, and she could do nothing to change it.
paras.zh: 她能看见港口里那些船，在原地抛锚处冻住了，而她束手无策。

paras.en: It seemed the more she panicked, the bigger the storm got.
paras.zh: 似乎她越恐慌，风暴就越大。

paras.en: As she felt her fingertips tingle, icicles grew like weeds in the dungeon, causing the walls to groan with misery.
paras.zh: 当她指尖发麻时，地牢里的冰柱像野草般疯长，墙壁痛苦地呻吟。

paras.en: Where were all the people?
paras.zh: 人们都去哪了？

paras.en: How were they staying warm?
paras.zh: 他们怎么取暖？

paras.en: She thought again of the mother and baby she had frightened in the castle courtyard on coronation day.
paras.zh: 她又想起加冕那天在城堡庭院里被她吓到的母亲和婴儿。

paras.en: Were they safe?
paras.zh: 他们安全吗？

paras.en: Was Anna?
paras.zh: 安娜呢？

paras.en: Elsa closed her eyes, overcome with worry. “What have I done?” she whispered.
paras.zh: 艾莎闭上眼，满心忧虑。“我做了什么？”她轻声说。

paras.en: Mama, Papa, please help me break this curse, she pleaded.
paras.zh: 妈妈、爸爸，求你们帮我解开这个诅咒，她哀求。

paras.en: The kingdom can’t survive much longer.
paras.zh: 王国撑不了多久了。

paras.en: Help Anna remember who she really is!
paras.zh: 帮安娜想起她真正的身份！

paras.en: As she suspected, no answers came.
paras.zh: 正如她所料，没有回应。

paras.en: She would have to figure this out on her own.
paras.zh: 她只能靠自己想明白。

paras.en: The only way she could do that was escape.
paras.zh: 而唯一的办法就是逃出去。

paras.en: Maybe if she could get word to Anna without actually going near her, she could jog her memory.
paras.zh: 也许她能在不靠近安娜的情况下送个信，唤起她的记忆。

paras.en: If only she had that letter as proof of the truth.
paras.zh: 要是她有那封信作为真相的证据就好了。

paras.en: Elsa concentrated on her cuffs and they started to glow.
paras.zh: 艾莎集中精神盯着镣铐，它们开始发光。

paras.en: Break, she willed them.
paras.zh: 碎掉，她默念。

paras.en: Break!
paras.zh: 碎掉！

paras.en: Instead, the cuffs started to freeze up, making it almost impossible to move.
paras.zh: 可相反，镣铐开始冻结，让她几乎动弹不得。

paras.en: The situation seemed hopeless. “Princess Elsa?” Elsa looked up.
paras.zh: 情形似乎毫无希望。“艾莎公主？”艾莎抬起头。

paras.en: Lord Peterssen was peering at her through a barred window in the dungeon door. “Lord Peterssen!” she cried.
paras.zh: 彼得森大人正透过地牢门上的铁窗望着她。“彼得森大人！”她喊道。

paras.en: The ice on her cuffs stopped forming immediately.
paras.zh: 她镣铐上的冰立刻停止了生成。

paras.en: She rushed to the door but was yanked back by her chains. “Are you all right?” he asked, holding tightly to the bars.
paras.zh: 她冲向门，却被锁链拽了回来。“你还好吗？”他紧紧抓着铁栏问。

paras.en: Aside from Olaf, Lord Peterssen was the only other person in her life who treated her like family.
paras.zh: 除了雪宝，彼得森大人是她生命中唯一把她当家人对待的人。

paras.en: Her father had trusted him with his life.
paras.zh: 她父亲曾把性命托付给他。

paras.en: Maybe she could do the same. “No.
paras.zh: 也许她也能信他。“不。

paras.en: I need to find someone.
paras.zh: 我得找到一个人。

paras.en: Desperately.
paras.zh: 急切地。

paras.en: Lord Peterssen, did my parents ever talk about having another child?
paras.zh: 彼得森大人，我父母可曾提起过还有另一个孩子？

paras.en: A girl?
paras.zh: 一个女孩？

paras.en: Younger than me, with red hair?
paras.zh: 比我小，红头发？

paras.en: Her name is Anna?” For the briefest of seconds, she thought she saw Lord Peterssen’s brown eyes flicker. “I…the name does sound familiar.” “Yes!” Elsa tried harder to yank the chains out of the wall so she could get closer to him. “Do you remember her?” “I’m sorry.
paras.zh: 她叫安娜？”在极短的一瞬，她仿佛看见彼得森大人褐色的眼睛闪烁了一下。“我……这名字确实有点耳熟。”“对！”艾莎更用力地想从墙里拽出锁链，好离他近一些。“你记得她吗？”“抱歉。

paras.en: I don’t know who you’re talking about,” he said as the wind howled fiercely. “You are the only heir to this kingdom.” “But I’m not,” Elsa stressed. “Lord Peterssen, please!
paras.zh: 我不知道你在说谁，”狂风呼啸，他说。“你是这个王国唯一的继承人。”“可我不是，”艾莎强调。“彼得森大人，求你了！

paras.en: I must find this girl.
paras.zh: 我必须找到这女孩。

paras.en: She’d be a few years younger than me.
paras.zh: 她应该比我小几岁。

paras.en: We need to start a search!
paras.zh: 我们得开始搜寻！

paras.en: I must find her before Prince Hans does.” “Prince Hans?” Lord Peterssen appeared puzzled. “Yes.
paras.zh: 我必须在汉斯王子之前找到她。”“汉斯王子？”彼得森大人显得困惑。“是的。

paras.en: You cannot trust him!
paras.zh: 你绝不能相信他！

paras.en: He does not have the best interests of the kingdom at heart.” She longed to say more, but didn’t want to scare him off. “I know my word doesn’t hold much weight at the moment, but you must believe me.” “No one can search for anyone in this weather,” he said. “We are running out of firewood, and food is growing scarce.
paras.zh: 他心里想的不是王国的最大利益。”她很想多说，却又不想把他吓跑。“我知道我现在的话分量不重，但你必须相信我。”“这种天气谁也搜不了任何人，”他说。“我们的木柴快烧完了，食物也越来越少。

paras.en: The people are freezing!
paras.zh: 人们在挨冻！

paras.en: They’re getting desperate.
paras.zh: 他们越来越绝望。

paras.en: Prince Hans went after you, but he has not returned.” “Where is he?” Elsa’s cuffs started to glow again. “No one knows, and we can’t send anyone out to look for him.
paras.zh: 汉斯王子去追你了，但一直没回来。”“他在哪？”艾莎的镣铐又开始发光。“没人知道，我们也派不出人去找他。

paras.en: This cold isn’t even safe for our livestock,” Lord Peterssen told her. “The men who brought you here are the only ones who have made it back.
paras.zh: 这严寒连牲口都撑不住，”彼得森大人告诉她。“把你带到这里的人，是唯一回来的一批。

paras.en: Unfortunately, the Duke met them before I did, and he convinced them to lock you in this dungeon.” She saw his eyes flash angrily. “The men were scared after what happened at your ice palace.
paras.zh: 不幸的是，公爵比我先见到他们，说服他们把你锁进这地牢。”她看见他眼里闪过怒火。“那些人在你冰宫殿的事之后吓坏了。

paras.en: I only just learned you were down here.
paras.zh: 我也是刚刚才知道你在这里。

paras.en: The Duke will pay for claiming authority in a land where he has none.” “Then you will set me free?” Elsa asked, yanking harder to pull off her cuffs.
paras.zh: 公爵在没有权力的地方擅作主张，他会付出代价的。”“那么你会放我走？”艾莎问，更用力地想扯掉镣铐。

paras.en: They glowed brighter. “I can help.” “I’ve searched everywhere for the key to this room but cannot find it,” Lord Peterssen told her.
paras.zh: 它们发光更亮了。“我能帮忙。”“我找遍了这间房的钥匙，却找不到，”彼得森大人告诉她。

paras.en: Elsa tried not to be disappointed. “I know you will find it.
paras.zh: 艾莎尽量不让自己失望。“我知道你会找到的。

paras.en: You have always been there for me.” “I’ve always thought you’d make a fine leader.
paras.zh: 你一直都在我身边。”“我一直觉得你会是个好君主。

paras.en: We need you to lead us now,” Lord Peterssen said. “Will you bring back summer?
paras.zh: 我们现在需要你来领导我们，”彼得森大人说。“你会让夏天回来吗？

paras.en: We can’t hold on much longer.” Elsa’s arms drooped to her sides. “I truly don’t know how.” “You are your father’s daughter,” Lord Peterssen said with resolve.
paras.zh: 我们撑不了多久了。”艾莎的手臂垂在身侧。“我真的不知道怎么做。”“你是你父亲的女儿，”彼得森大人坚定地说。

paras.en: His eyes searched hers. “I know you can dig deep inside yourself and figure out a way to stop this storm.
paras.zh: 他的目光探寻着她的眼睛。“我知道你能深深挖掘自己的内心，找到停止风暴的办法。

paras.en: We’ve been patient, but we need you now more than ever.” Be patient.
paras.zh: 我们一直很有耐心，但现在比以往任何时候都更需要你。”要耐心。

paras.en: She heard Grand Pabbie in her head.
paras.zh: 她脑中响起皮比的声音。

paras.en: A storm was raging outside and growing fiercer.
paras.zh: 外面的风暴正肆虐，且越来越猛。

paras.en: The time for patience had passed.
paras.zh: 耐心的时候已经过去了。

paras.en: She needed Anna’s memories to return and the curse to end.
paras.zh: 她需要安娜的记忆恢复，诅咒解除。

paras.en: That might be the only way they could save Arendelle and the kingdom: they needed to do it together. “I know,” Elsa told him. “I want to stop this winter badly, but I can’t do it alone.
paras.zh: 那也许是他们拯救阿伦黛尔和王国唯一的办法：他们必须一起。“我知道，”艾莎告诉他。“我极其想结束这场冬天，可我一个人做不到。

paras.en: I need to find someone who can help me.” “Princess, we can’t—” “Stop right there!” There was a commotion in the hallway and then shouting.
paras.zh: 我得找个能帮我的人。”“公主，我们没法——”“站住！”走廊里一阵骚动，接着是叫喊声。

paras.en: Lord Peterssen was ripped away from the bars.
paras.zh: 彼得森大人被人从铁栏边拽开了。

paras.en: Elsa couldn’t see anything from her vantage point.
paras.zh: 从她的位置，艾莎什么也看不见。

paras.en: Suddenly, she glimpsed the top of someone’s head.
paras.zh: 突然，她瞥见某人的头顶。

paras.en: A white toupee flapped in the wind. “Lift me up!” she heard someone cry.
paras.zh: 一顶白色假发在风中飘动。“把我举起来！”她听见有人喊。

paras.en: His face appeared in the bars on her window. “Princess Elsa,” the Duke of Weselton announced, “you are a threat to Arendelle.
paras.zh: 他的脸出现在她窗户的铁栏前。“艾莎公主，”韦斯特顿公爵宣布，“你对阿伦黛尔是个威胁。

paras.en: You are going nowhere.”
paras.zh: 你哪儿也去不了。”

paras.en: Hans collected fresh supplies and borrowed a second horse for Anna from the people in the cabin they found.
paras.zh: 汉斯补充了新补给，还从他们找到的小屋主人那里借了一匹马给安娜。

paras.en: The couple insisted they stay overnight before continuing on their journey.
paras.zh: 那对夫妇坚持要他们过一夜再继续赶路。

paras.en: After all they had seen with the summer snowstorm, the appearance of Olaf didn’t frighten them at all.
paras.zh: 既然他们见过夏天的暴风雪，雪宝的出现一点也没吓到他们。

paras.en: By morning, they were begging them not to press on. “These mountain trails are treacherous even in the most optimal conditions,” the man told them. “And this weather will make it impossible.” “It’s hailing now, too,” the wife added. “Please, Prince Hans, if you are who you say you are, go back to Arendelle.” “Maybe they’re right,” Hans said, looking out their cabin windows.
paras.zh: 到了早上，他们恳求他们别再前进。“这些山路就算天气最好也险象环生，”那男人说。“这种天气根本走不了。”“现在还下冰雹了，”妻子补充。“求你了，汉斯王子，如果你真是你说的那人，就回阿伦黛尔吧。”“也许他们说得对，”汉斯看着小屋窗外说。

paras.en: All they could see was white. “The storm is getting worse.
paras.zh: 他们眼里只有白茫茫一片。“风暴越来越糟了。

paras.en: Soon we won’t be able to get back to Arendelle at all.” “We have to keep going,” Anna insisted. “You know as well as I do the only way to stop this winter is to find Princess Elsa.” I want to bake my own cookie for Papa! she heard a child’s voice say in her head.
paras.zh: 很快我们连回阿伦黛尔都不行了。”“我们必须继续走，”安娜坚持。“你和我一样清楚，结束这场冬天的唯一办法就是找到艾莎公主。”我想亲手给爸爸烤一块饼干！她听见一个孩子的声音在脑中说。

paras.en: Wait for Miss Olina, another person said.
paras.zh: 等奥丽娜小姐，另一个人说。

paras.en: Who was “Miss Olina”? “And what if she doesn’t want to be found?” Hans asked as the couple added the last of their wood to the fireplace. “You don’t want to hear this, but Elsa is only thinking of herself.
paras.zh: “奥丽娜小姐”是谁？“那如果她不想被找到呢？”汉斯问，这时夫妇俩把最后一点木柴添进壁炉。“你不想听这个，但艾莎只想着她自己。

paras.en: She probably wants to hold the kingdom prisoner.” Prisoner.
paras.zh: 她大概想把整个王国当囚徒。”“囚徒。

paras.en: Anna’s head seared with pain and she saw a blond woman chained to a wall, snow falling all around.
paras.zh: 安娜的头一阵灼痛，她看见一个金发女人被锁在墙上，四周落满雪。

paras.en: She was hurting.
paras.zh: 她在受苦。

paras.en: Elsa? “What’s the matter?” Hans asked. “Nothing.” She held back from telling Hans what she was seeing. “I’ve just got a slight headache.” “Maybe that friend of yours was right—this weather is too much on you.” Hans sounded slightly annoyed. “We should turn back to Arendelle before it’s impossible to travel.
paras.zh: 艾莎？”怎么了？“汉斯问。”没什么。“她忍住没告诉汉斯自己看见的。”只是有点头痛。“”也许你那朋友说得对——这天气对你太过了。“汉斯听起来有点不耐烦。”我们该在没法赶路前回阿伦黛尔。

paras.en: You can shelter at the castle with me till the storm passes.” “It’s not going to pass,” Anna reminded him.
paras.zh: 你可以和我待在城堡里，等风暴过去。“”风暴不会过去的，“安娜提醒他。

paras.en: Not until I help her stop the storm.
paras.zh: 除非我帮她停止风暴。

paras.en: She held her breath.
paras.zh: 她屏住了呼吸。

paras.en: What had made her think that?
paras.zh: 是什么让她这么想的？

paras.en: There was another flash, and she saw herself as a little girl sledding across a room full of ice.
paras.zh: 又是一阵闪光，她看见自己还是个小女孩，在满是冰的房间里滑雪橇。

paras.en: Why was she seeing memories of moments she couldn’t recall?
paras.zh: 为什么她会看见自己记不起的瞬间的记忆？

paras.en: Hans frowned. “You’re probably right.
paras.zh: 汉斯皱起眉。”你大概是对的。

paras.en: I think Elsa wants Arendelle to suffer.” “No!
paras.zh: 我想艾莎是想让阿伦黛尔受苦。“”不！

paras.en: The princess wouldn’t do that, would she?” the wife asked.
paras.zh: 公主不会那么做的，对吧？“妻子问。

paras.en: For a man who was supposedly in love with Elsa, Hans had a funny way of showing it.
paras.zh: 对一个据称深爱艾莎的男人来说，汉斯表达爱意的方式可真够怪的。

paras.en: And as charming as he could be, he really did like to rehash the same point over and over. “No,” Anna said, getting aggravated. “I think the princess is frightened.
paras.zh: 而且尽管他能讨人喜欢，他确实喜欢把同一个意思翻来覆去地说。”不，“安娜有些恼火地说。”我觉得公主是吓坏了。

paras.en: If we could just talk to her, I’m sure we could work this out before the situation worsens.
paras.zh: 只要我们能和她谈谈，我肯定在情况恶化前就能解决。

paras.en: That’s why we need to find her quickly and keep going,” Anna stressed.
paras.zh: 所以我们得快点找到她，继续走，“安娜强调。

paras.en: Hans sighed. “I don’t want to see you get hurt.” “Elsa would never hurt Anna,” Olaf interrupted. “She loves her more than anything.” Anna and Hans looked at the snowman.
paras.zh: 汉斯叹气。”我不想看你受伤。“”艾莎绝不会伤害安娜，“雪宝打断。”她爱安娜胜过一切。“安娜和汉斯看向雪人。

paras.en: A gust of wind blew the door open, knocking Olaf’s head off.
paras.zh: 一阵风把门吹开，把雪宝的头吹掉了。

paras.en: The husband and wife rushed to bolt it shut again. “Hey, do me a favor and grab my butt,” Olaf’s head said to Hans.
paras.zh: 丈夫和妻子急忙把门重新闩上。”嘿，帮我个忙，抓住我的屁股，“雪宝的头对汉斯说。

paras.en: Anna was lost in her own thoughts.
paras.zh: 安娜沉浸在自己的思绪中。

paras.en: Olaf.
paras.zh: 雪宝。

paras.en: Her new memories.
paras.zh: 她新的记忆。

paras.en: The voices.
paras.zh: 那些声音。

paras.en: All those things felt like a tiny itch between her shoulders that she couldn’t reach.
paras.zh: 所有这些东西，就像她两肩之间够不到的一处小痒。

paras.en: Why had she always dreamed of snow?
paras.zh: 为什么她总梦见雪？

paras.en: Why did she make snowman cookies?
paras.zh: 为什么她会做雪人饼干？

paras.en: Why did she feel such a pull to Arendelle?
paras.zh: 为什么她感到对阿伦黛尔有那么强的牵引？

paras.en: Maybe because she was always supposed to be there at that exact moment to help Elsa.
paras.zh: 也许是因为她本就该在那个时刻出现在那里，去帮艾莎。

paras.en: She and Elsa seemed to have a connection Anna didn’t understand.
paras.zh: 她和艾莎之间，似乎有种安娜无法理解的联系。

paras.en: She needed to find the princess and find out why.
paras.zh: 她得找到公主，弄清原因。

paras.en: There was a sudden pounding on the door.
paras.zh: 突然，门上传来一阵猛烈的敲门声。

paras.en: Everyone looked at one another.
paras.zh: 大家面面相觑。

paras.en: Hans reached for his sheath. “Open it,” he instructed the man.
paras.zh: 汉斯伸手去摸剑鞘。”开门，“他吩咐那男人。

paras.en: A guard in a green uniform fell through the door. “My goodness!” the wife cried as she and Anna rushed forward to help him up.
paras.zh: 一个穿绿制服的卫兵摔进门来。”天哪！“妻子惊呼，她和安娜冲上前扶他起来。

paras.en: The husband struggled to close the door again against the wind.
paras.zh: 丈夫费力地顶着风把门重新关上。

paras.en: The guard saw Hans and his eyes widened. “Prince Hans!
paras.zh: 卫兵看到汉斯，瞪大了眼睛。”汉斯王子！

paras.en: We’ve been looking for you everywhere.” His voice was hoarse and his face was red with windburn. “When we didn’t see you after the battle, we thought we’d lost you.
paras.zh: 我们到处在找你。“他声音沙哑，脸被风吹得通红。”战斗后没见你，我们以为失去你了。

paras.en: I planned to keep looking, but my horse is struggling in this cold.
paras.zh: 我本打算继续找，但我的马在这严寒里撑不住了。

paras.en: I saw the cabin and—” The husband started putting on layers of clothing. “I’ll get your horse in the barn,” he said, and pulled on his boots before going to the door. “What battle?” Anna asked.
paras.zh: 我看见这小屋，就——“丈夫开始一层层加衣服。”我去把你的马牵进棚里，“他说，穿上靴子走向门口。”什么战斗？“安娜问。

paras.en: Hans ignored her and helped the man to the fire. “What’s happened?
paras.zh: 汉斯没理她，扶着那人到火边。”出了什么事？

paras.en: Is everything all right in Arendelle?” The wife wrapped the guard in a blanket.
paras.zh: 阿伦黛尔一切都好吗？“妻子用毯子裹住卫兵。

paras.en: He took it gratefully as he shivered.
paras.zh: 他颤抖着，感激地接过来。

paras.en: He looked at the people around him, then back at Hans. “May we speak in private?” “Of course,” the wife said, and put her arm around Anna. “Come, dear.
paras.zh: 他看了看身边的人，又看回汉斯。”我们能私下谈谈吗？“”当然，“妻子说，搂住安娜的肩膀。”来，亲爱的。

paras.en: We should see if we can find you some warmer clothes.” But Anna didn’t want to go.
paras.zh: 我们看看能不能给你找点更暖和的衣服。“可安娜不想走。

paras.en: Now wasn’t the time for secrets. “Is everything all right?” Anna asked the men. “What aren’t you telling us?” Hans hesitated. “The North Mountain has suffered an avalanche.
paras.zh: 现在不是保密的时候。”一切都好吗？“安娜问男人们。”有什么没告诉我们？“汉斯犹豫了。”北山发生了雪崩。

paras.en: I don’t want to upset you when you’ve given up so much to be here, but I don’t know if we can continue toward the valley with the situation outside so precarious.” The guard looked at him.
paras.zh: 你为到这儿放弃了那么多，我不想让你难过，但外面情况这么危险，我不知道我们还能不能继续朝山谷走。“卫兵看着他。

paras.en: Hans was charming, but there was something about him she wasn’t sure she trusted.
paras.zh: 汉斯很有魅力，可他身上有某种让她拿不准该不该信任的东西。

paras.en: Anna was about to argue, but she suddenly felt it in her aching bones—the castle was calling to her.
paras.zh: 安娜正要争辩，却突然在酸痛的骨头里感觉到了——城堡在召唤她。

paras.en: Elsa wasn’t in the valley anymore, and she’d long ago left the North Mountain.
paras.zh: 艾莎已不在山谷，而且她早就离开了北山。

paras.en: She wasn’t sure how she knew this, but she wasn’t about to share her feeling. “Let’s go back to Arendelle,” she agreed. “We can wait out the storm in the castle.
paras.zh: 她不确定自己怎么知道的，却不愿说出这种感觉。”我们回阿伦黛尔吧，“她同意了。”我们可以在城堡里等风暴过去。

paras.en: Maybe when we’re there, we’ll find a clue we’re missing.” “Yay!
paras.zh: 也许到了那儿，我们会找到遗漏的线索。“”耶！

paras.en: Elsa will be so excited to see you!” Olaf said, and Hans looked at him. “She’s been looking for you forever.” Anna didn’t flinch.
paras.zh: 艾莎见到你一定超开心！“雪宝说，汉斯看了他一眼。”她找你找了好久了。“安娜没有退缩。

paras.en: Hans smiled. “I meant what I said before—you’d be a great leader.” “I don’t know about that,” Anna said.
paras.zh: 汉斯微笑。”我之前说的都是真心话——你会是个出色的领袖。“”我可说不好，“安娜说。

paras.en: Hans didn’t break his stare. “I do.
paras.zh: 汉斯目光不移。”我清楚。

paras.en: Let’s get you to Arendelle so you can see that for yourself.”
paras.zh: 我们送你回阿伦黛尔，让你亲眼看看。“

paras.en: “It’s official!
paras.zh: “这下可算定了！

paras.en: I’ve decided something, Sven,” Kristoff told his friend as they trudged down the ravine to find what was left of his sleigh. “Who needs people when I have a reindeer?” Sven grunted.
paras.zh: 我决定了件事，斯文，”克里斯托夫一边和好友沿着峡谷往下走、去找雪橇的残骸，一边说。“我有头驯鹿就够了，谁还需要人？”斯文哼了一声。

paras.en: The reindeer was too busy watching the darkening tree line for signs of another wolf attack.
paras.zh: 驯鹿正忙着盯着渐暗的林线，提防狼群再来袭击。

paras.en: Fortunately, between the light of the rising moon and the bright snow, Kristoff and Sven could see pretty far into the distance.
paras.zh: 幸好有初升的月光和雪地的亮光，克里斯托夫和斯文能看清挺远的地方。

paras.en: There was no reason to look back.
paras.zh: 没有理由回头看。

paras.en: So he’d let Anna go off with some smooth-talking prince and a snowman to find a princess who didn’t want finding.
paras.zh: 所以他由着安娜跟着一个油嘴滑舌的王子和雪人走了，去找一个根本不想被找到的公主。

paras.en: He wasn’t about to get himself and Sven killed over it.
paras.zh: 他可不想为了这事把自己和斯文的命搭上。

paras.en: Yes, he wanted to bring back summer—all this available ice made selling it for a living kind of hard—but he was used to the weather.
paras.zh: 没错，他是想让夏天回来——到处都是冰，靠卖冰为生的日子可不好过——但他早就习惯了这天气。

paras.en: He spent most days up in the mountains, being covered in snow, wool clothing, and heavy boots that smelled of sweat.
paras.zh: 他多数日子都在山上，满身是雪、羊毛衣，还有那双带着汗味的笨重靴子。

paras.en: And it didn’t matter what he smelled like, because who was around to smell him?
paras.zh: 他身上什么味也不打紧，反正谁会在身边闻他？

paras.en: Only Sven.
paras.zh: 只有斯文。

paras.en: Well, reindeer didn’t smell that great, either.
paras.zh: 嗯，驯鹿身上的味儿也不怎么好闻。

paras.en: So bring on an eternal winter.
paras.zh: 所以来吧，永恒的冬天。

paras.en: He could handle it.
paras.zh: 他扛得住。

paras.en: But Anna…the cold was clearly getting to her.
paras.zh: 可安娜……寒冷显然已经影响到她了。

paras.en: He’d chalked it up to hypothermia or possibly frostbite, but deep down he knew that wasn’t it.
paras.zh: 他本以为是体温过低，或者可能冻伤了，但心底里他知道不是那么回事。

paras.en: It was almost as if the closer she got to finding Princess Elsa, the more connected she was to her.
paras.zh: 仿佛她越接近找到艾莎公主，就和她的联系越紧密。

paras.en: Like magic.
paras.zh: 就像魔法一样。

paras.en: Let people make fun of magic all they wanted.
paras.zh: 随别人怎么拿魔法取笑好了。

paras.en: He knew it was real.
paras.zh: 他知道魔法是真的。

paras.en: He’d been raised around magic his whole life.
paras.zh: 他从小就是围着魔法长大的。

paras.en: Not that he’d tell Anna that.
paras.zh: 不过他可不会告诉安娜。

paras.en: Why would he when she was so infuriating?
paras.zh: 她那么气人，他凭什么说？

paras.en: She talked on and on and on , not just to him and Sven—to everyone she met!
paras.zh: 她说个没完没了，不只对他和斯文——对每一个遇见的人都是！

paras.en: She was also impulsive and strong-minded, which was how he’d allowed himself to be talked into taking her to Arendelle in the first place.
paras.zh: 她还冲动、有主见，他当初就是这么被她说服、带她去阿伦黛尔的。

paras.en: Feisty-pants thought she could stop an eternal winter even though she had no idea how to find Elsa or what she’d say to make her end the madness.
paras.zh: 这个急性子丫头以为自己能阻止永恒的冬天，尽管她根本不知道怎么找艾莎，也不知道该说什么让她停下这场疯狂。

paras.en: Kristoff could see the wreck of his sleigh as they approached the bottom of the ravine.
paras.zh: 他们接近峡谷底部时，克里斯托夫看见了雪橇的残骸。

paras.en: He was almost afraid to see how bad the damage was.
paras.zh: 他几乎害怕看清损坏有多严重。

paras.en: Instead, he concentrated on Sven. “I’ve decided all people want to do is use you and cheat you.” He used his reindeer voice again: “You’re right.
paras.zh: 于是他把注意力放在斯文身上。“我决定了，所有人只想利用你、骗你。”他又用驯鹿的腔调说：“你说得对。

paras.en: They’re all bad!
paras.zh: 他们全都不是好东西！

paras.en: Except you.” He rubbed Sven’s snout. “Aww, thanks, buddy.
paras.zh: 除了你。”他揉了揉斯文的鼻子。“哎，谢了，老伙计。

paras.en: Let’s see what we can salvage here.” He looked at the sled and sighed.
paras.zh: 看看这儿还能抢救点什么。”他望着雪橇，叹了口气。

paras.en: His beloved ride was in a million pieces.
paras.zh: 他心爱的座驾碎成了无数片。

paras.en: His lute was destroyed.
paras.zh: 他的鲁特琴毁了。

paras.en: His ice ax must have gone flying, because it wasn’t among the wreckage.
paras.zh: 他的冰镐准是飞出去了，因为残骸里没有它。

paras.en: The little food they’d had had already been scavenged by critters.
paras.zh: 他们仅剩的一点食物已经被小动物翻吃光了。

paras.en: There wasn’t much to salvage, but Kristoff examined every item to make sure.
paras.zh: 没多少可抢救的，但克里斯托夫还是逐件检查，确认了一遍。

paras.en: Finally, he climbed onto Sven. “Now what do we do, Sven?
paras.zh: 最后，他爬上斯文。“现在我们怎么办，斯文？

paras.en: I didn’t think I could find the valley, but we don’t really have a choice.
paras.zh: 我本来以为找不到山谷了，可我们实在没有别的选择。

paras.en: We have to get you out of this weather too, buddy.” He looked around at the landscape. “We’ve got to be close.
paras.zh: 也得让你躲开这天气，老伙计。”他环顾四周的景色。“我们肯定离得很近了。

paras.en: We’ll find it.” Sven wouldn’t budge.
paras.zh: 我们会找到的。”斯文却不肯动。

paras.en: He snorted loudly. “Yes, I’m sure she’s fine.
paras.zh: 他大声喷着鼻息。“是啊，我肯定她没事。

paras.en: They probably made their way to a cabin.
paras.zh: 他们大概已经到小屋去了。

paras.en: I saw smoke in the distance,” Kristoff told him. “We are not joining them there.
paras.zh: 我看见远处有炊烟，”克里斯托夫告诉他。“我们不去那儿跟他们会合。

paras.en: Let’s go.
paras.zh: 走吧。

paras.en: Stop worrying.” Sven gave him a withering look. “You don’t want to help her anymore?” Kristoff said in his Sven voice. “Of course I don’t want to help her anymore!” Kristoff pulled on Sven’s reins and they started their ascent up the ravine. “In fact, this whole thing has ruined me for helping anyone ever again.” As they climbed, an angry snow squall descended, causing almost whiteout conditions.
paras.zh: 别担心了。”斯文给了他一个鄙夷的眼神。“你不想再帮她了？”克里斯托夫用斯文的腔调说。“我当然不想再帮她了！”克里斯托夫拉起斯文的缰绳，他们开始爬上峡谷。“说真的，这整件事让我以后谁都不想帮了。”攀爬时，一阵愤怒的雪飑袭来，几乎让人什么都看不见。

paras.en: Going home was the wise choice.
paras.zh: 回家是明智的选择。

paras.en: But that meant he was going to the same place Anna was headed.
paras.zh: 但那意味着他要去的地方，正是安娜前往的方向。

paras.en: Sven snorted again. “Yes, I know that’s where she’s headed.” Sven gave him a look. “Okay, so maybe I do look like a jerk showing up there now when we could have all gone together.” Sven snorted louder. “He wasn’t a total stranger—he’s Elsa’s prince.” Kristoff rolled his eyes. “So of course he did the right thing and agreed to go with her.” He thought for a moment. “Okay, yeah.
paras.zh: 斯文又喷了下鼻息。“是，我知道她去的就是那儿。”斯文看了他一眼。“好吧，本来大家能一起去的，现在我才出现，我看起来确实像个混蛋。”斯文喷得更响了。“他也不是完全陌生——他是艾莎的王子。”克里斯托夫翻了个白眼。“所以他当然做了正确的事，答应陪她去。”他想了想。“好吧，没错。

paras.en: I was a jerk.” Sven pranced around while Kristoff stood there feeling guilty. “So now what?
paras.zh: 我是个混蛋。”斯文绕着圈蹦跳，克里斯托夫站在那儿满心愧疚。“那现在怎么办？

paras.en: We go find her?
paras.zh: 我们去找她？

paras.en: Or we get to the valley and apologize?” Sven looked at him. “Yeah, we won’t find her again in this.
paras.zh: 还是先到山谷再道歉？”斯文看着他。“对，这种天气我们找不着她了。

paras.en: We’ll go to the valley and then I’ll apologize when she arrives, okay?
paras.zh: 我们去山谷，等她到了我再道歉，行吗？

paras.en: I get it.
paras.zh: 我明白了。

paras.en: I screwed up.” Kristoff spent the entire journey to the valley consumed with self-hatred.
paras.zh: 是我搞砸了。”去山谷的整段路上，克里斯托夫都沉浸在自我厌恶中。

paras.en: Anna was out there in this weather with a total stranger.
paras.zh: 安娜在这种天气里，跟一个完全陌生的人在外面。

paras.en: He’d abandoned her when she’d needed him.
paras.zh: 她在需要他的时候，他却抛下了她。

paras.en: No wonder Bulda thought he’d never find a girl.
paras.zh: 难怪布尔达觉得他永远找不到姑娘。

paras.en: The snow was falling heavier and wetter than it had earlier, but at least the journey was quiet.
paras.zh: 雪比先前下得更大更湿，但至少路上很安静。

paras.en: Without Anna, there was no one to tell him what to do, or talk incessantly about her favorite food (hers was sandwiches), or almost set him on fire.
paras.zh: 没有安娜，再没人指挥他该做什么，没人喋喋不休地说她最爱的食物（她喜欢三明治），也没人差点把他点着。

paras.en: Maybe he did miss having company.
paras.zh: 也许他确实想念有人作伴。

paras.en: Even Olaf.
paras.zh: 连雪宝也是。

paras.en: Not that he’d tell Sven that.
paras.zh: 不过他可不会告诉斯文。

paras.en: It took several hours to get to the Valley of the Living Rock, but Kristoff knew the route like the back of his callused hands.
paras.zh: 去活石谷花了好几个小时，但克里斯托夫对这条路熟得像自己长满老茧的手背。

paras.en: Even under all that snow, he was able to spot the peculiar rock formations that marked the location of his home.
paras.zh: 即便在厚厚的雪下，他也能认出那些标志他家园所在地的奇特岩层。

paras.en: When they got closer, Kristoff jumped off Sven and they walked up the path of boulders until they arrived at the valley.
paras.zh: 走近后，克里斯托夫跳下斯文，沿着圆石铺成的小路走到山谷。

paras.en: The second they were inside the valley, the snow stopped.
paras.zh: 他们一进山谷，雪就停了。

paras.en: The air warmed.
paras.zh: 空气暖了起来。

paras.en: The ground smelled like fresh dew and was covered with grassy moss.
paras.zh: 地面带着新鲜露水的气味，覆着青苔。

paras.en: Kristoff descended the path into the fog and watched the rocks start to roll at the sight of him.
paras.zh: 克里斯托夫顺着小路走进雾里，看着岩石一看见他就滚动起来。

paras.en: Sven pranced eagerly, his tongue sticking out of his mouth.
paras.zh: 斯文急切地蹦跳着，舌头伸在嘴外。

paras.en: Kristoff tapped his knees, beckoning the rocks closer.
paras.zh: 克里斯托夫拍了拍膝盖，招呼岩石靠近些。

paras.en: A large number of them started to roll in his direction.
paras.zh: 许多岩石开始朝他滚来。

paras.en: They came to a stop and began to unfurl. “Kristoff’s home!” shouted Bulda, a female troll who was front and center.
paras.zh: 它们停下，开始舒展身形。“克里斯托夫回家了！”站在最前头的雌性地精布尔达喊道。

paras.en: His adoptive mother held her arms out for a hug.
paras.zh: 他的养母张开双臂要抱他。

paras.en: Kristoff stepped closer and she wrapped herself around his legs.
paras.zh: 克里斯托夫走近，她整个缠抱住他的腿。

paras.en: The red gems around her neck seemed to have grown since the last time he visited.
paras.zh: 她脖子上的红宝石，似乎比上次他来时又长大了些。

paras.en: Several of them glowed, making her mossy-green dress look almost orange.
paras.zh: 其中几颗发着光，让她苔绿色的裙子看上去近乎橙色。

paras.en: Dozens of other trolls unfurled from their rocky slumber and cheered.
paras.zh: 几十个其他地精从石眠中舒展身形，欢呼起来。

paras.en: They clambered over one another to see him. “Yay!
paras.zh: 它们互相攀爬着要看他。“耶！

paras.en: Kristoff’s home!” they shouted.
paras.zh: 克里斯托夫回家了！”它们喊道。

paras.en: The trolls had been his family ever since he was a small child.
paras.zh: 自从他还是小孩起，地精们就是他的家人。

paras.en: Life in an orphanage was no place for a free spirit like him.
paras.zh: 孤儿院的生活容不下一个像他这样向往自由的孩子。

paras.en: Whenever he could, he’d snuck out and followed the Arendelle ice harvesters up the mountain to see how they worked.
paras.zh: 一有机会，他就溜出去，跟着阿伦黛尔的采冰人上山，看他们怎么干活。

paras.en: On one such trip, he found Sven, and they became inseparable.
paras.zh: 在一次这样的出行中，他找到了斯文，从此形影不离。

paras.en: After that, he didn’t want to go back to the orphanage.
paras.zh: 从那以后，他再不想回孤儿院。

paras.en: Sven and ice were his new life.
paras.zh: 斯文和冰成了他的新生活。

paras.en: He was even earning a living!
paras.zh: 他甚至能以此谋生了！

paras.en: But one summer night, he was working with Sven when they saw a different kind of ice.
paras.zh: 可有个夏夜，他和斯文正在干活，看见了另一种冰。

paras.en: It was crackling and glowing on the grassy mountainside.
paras.zh: 它在长草的山坡上噼啪作响、闪闪发光。

paras.en: He and Sven were curious, so they followed the strange path up the mountain.
paras.zh: 他和斯文很好奇，便沿着那条奇怪的路往山上走。

paras.en: It led them straight to the Valley of the Living Rock.
paras.zh: 它把他们直接带到了活石谷。

paras.en: Bulda spotted him and adopted him and Sven on the spot.
paras.zh: 布尔达一眼看见他，当场就收养了他和斯文。

paras.en: Come to think of it, he never had asked her why that ice had appeared in the middle of the summer like that. “Let me look at you!” Bulda said, beckoning him to stoop down to her level.
paras.zh: 回想起来，他从未问过她，为什么那种冰会在盛夏里那样出现。“让我看看你！”布尔达说，招手让他弯下腰、降到她的高度。

paras.en: Kristoff took a knee. “Are you hungry?” she asked. “I just made a stone soup.
paras.zh: 克里斯托夫单膝跪下。“你饿吗？”她问。“我刚煮了石头汤。

paras.en: I’ll fetch you a cup.” “No,” Kristoff said quickly.
paras.zh: 我去给你盛一杯。”“不用，”克里斯托夫连忙说。

paras.en: He hated stone soup.
paras.zh: 他讨厌石头汤。

paras.en: Impossible to swallow. “I just ate.
paras.zh: 根本咽不下去。“我刚吃过。

paras.en: It’s great to see you all.
paras.zh: 能见到你们大家都真好。

paras.en: Have you had any visitors?” He looked around for Anna. “No one but you!” Bulda said. “Why, are you expecting someone?” If he told her he was expecting a girl to be there, he’d never hear the end of it. “No, but…where is Grand Pabbie?” “He’s napping,” said one of Kristoff’s little cousins. “But look!
paras.zh: 你们有客人来过吗？”他四下找安娜。“除了你没别人！”布尔达说。“怎么，你在等谁？”要是告诉她自己等的是个姑娘，他可就别想消停了。“没有，不过……皮比在哪儿？”“他在打盹，”克里斯托夫的一个小表亲说。“可你看！

paras.en: I grew a mushroom!” He showed off the mushroom growing on his mossy back. “I earned my fire crystal,” said another, holding up a glowing red stone. “I passed a kidney stone,” said one of his uncles, holding up the rock as proof. “If you aren’t hungry for my cooking, what brings you home?” Bulda asked.
paras.zh: 我长出蘑菇了！”他炫耀着长在苔背上的一颗蘑菇。“我挣到火晶了，”另一个举起发光的红石说。“我排出了肾结石，”一个叔辈举起石头当证据说。“既然你不想吃我做的饭，那是什么让你回家的？”布尔达问。

paras.en: Nothing got past her. “I just wanted to see you, that’s all,” Kristoff lied.
paras.zh: 什么都瞒不过她。“我只是想看看你们，就这样，”克里斯托夫撒谎道。

paras.en: Bulda studied him carefully, then looked at the others. “This is about a girl!” The others cheered in agreement. “No, no, no!
paras.zh: 布尔达仔细打量他，又看看别人。“这是为了一个姑娘！”其他地精齐声欢呼赞同。“不，不，不！

paras.en: You’ve got this all wrong!” Kristoff said even as his face grew red.
paras.zh: 你们全搞错了！”克里斯托夫说着，脸却红了。

paras.en: Sven snorted loudly, and several trolls gathered round as he pawed at the dirt and made noises. “It is about a girl!” Bulda exclaimed, and the others chimed in again.
paras.zh: 斯文大声喷着鼻息，好几只地精围拢来，它扒着土发出声响。“就是为了一个姑娘！”布尔达喊道，其他人又跟着附和。

paras.en: Kristoff rolled his eyes. “Guys, please!
paras.zh: 克里斯托夫翻了个白眼。“各位，拜托！

paras.en: I’ve got bigger problems than finding a girl.
paras.zh: 我的问题比找姑娘大多了。

paras.en: The whole kingdom is covered in—” “Snow?” Bulda said. “We know.
paras.zh: 整个王国都被——”“雪？”布尔达说。“我们知道。

paras.en: But we want to hear about you!” Kristoff gaped. “How do you know about the snow?” Bulda ignored his question. “If you like this girl, why didn’t she come home with you?
paras.zh: 但我们想听听你的事！”克里斯托夫目瞪口呆。“你们怎么知道下雪的？”布尔达没理他的问题。“你要是喜欢这姑娘，她怎么没跟你一起回家？

paras.en: Did your grumpiness scare her off?” “No,” he argued. “This isn’t about me.
paras.zh: 是你那坏脾气把她吓跑了？”“不是，”他争辩，“这不关我的事。

paras.en: I—” “You tell this girl that she’ll never met a fellow as sensitive and as sweet as my Kristoff!” Now he felt even worse. “This is not about me and this girl!
paras.zh: 我——”“你告诉那姑娘，她再也遇不到像我家克里斯托夫这么体贴、这么温柔的人了！”这下他更难受了。“这跟我跟那姑娘没关系！

paras.en: It’s about Arendelle!
paras.zh: 这是关于阿伦黛尔！

paras.en: I know you can’t see it from inside your cocoon here, but it’s not just the land outside the valley covered in snow.
paras.zh: 我知道你们待在茧里看不见，但不只有山谷外的土地盖着雪。

paras.en: It’s the whole kingdom!
paras.zh: 是整个王国！

paras.en: And it’s the middle of the summer!” His family stood there, blinking. “If you know how to stop it, tell me!” One of his little cousins pulled on Bulda’s dress. “I thought Grand Pabbie said we couldn’t tell anyone that she was here.” Bulda made a face. “What?
paras.zh: 而且现在还是盛夏！”他的家人们站在那儿，眨着眼。“你要是知道怎么停，就告诉我！”一个小表亲拽了拽布尔达的裙子。“我记得皮比说过，不能告诉任何人她来过这儿。”布尔达做了个鬼脸。“什么？

paras.en: Didn’t he say it was a secret?” “Anna?
paras.zh: 他没说要保密吗？”“安娜？

paras.en: She was here?
paras.zh: 她来过这儿？

paras.en: With the prince?
paras.zh: 和王子一起？

paras.en: When did they leave?” he said hurriedly.
paras.zh: 他们什么时候走的？”他急忙问。

paras.en: A large rock rolled forward, and Grand Pabbie unfurled from his slumber.
paras.zh: 一块大岩石滚上前，皮比从沉睡中舒展开身形。

paras.en: He reached out for Kristoff and took his hands. “Kristoff, you came!
paras.zh: 他伸手拉住克里斯托夫的手。“克里斯托夫，你来了！

paras.en: And just in time, I fear,” he said, his voice gravelly. “Where is Anna now?
paras.zh: 而且恐怕来得正是时候，”他声音沙哑地说。“安娜现在在哪儿？

paras.en: Is she okay?
paras.zh: 她还好吧？

paras.en: Was she mad at me?” he asked sheepishly and looked at Bulda. “I know I shouldn’t have left her, okay?
paras.zh: 她生我气了吗？”他不好意思地问，看了看布尔达。“我知道我不该丢下她，行了吧？

paras.en: We’re having a blizzard in the middle of the summer.
paras.zh: 我们大夏天里刮起了暴风雪。

paras.en: It’s not normal.” Sure, he’d acted like the snow was no big deal, but even an ice expert like him could see it was getting too cold to survive.
paras.zh: 这不正常。”当然，他之前表现得好像雪没什么大不了，可连他这样的冰专家都看得出，天冷得要活不下去了。

paras.en: When he’d last looked at the fjord, he’d seen the ships leaning and cracking.
paras.zh: 他最后一次看峡湾时，看见船只倾斜、发出裂响。

paras.en: Soon buildings would do the same.
paras.zh: 很快房屋也会如此。

paras.en: There would be nowhere safe to shelter.
paras.zh: 将无处可安全避难。

paras.en: What would happen to Anna? “So where is she now?
paras.zh: 安娜会怎样？“那她现在在哪儿？

paras.en: What did you tell Anna?” Grand Pabbie’s brow furrowed. “Anna?
paras.zh: 你跟安娜说了什么？”皮比皱起眉头。“安娜？

paras.en: You mean Princess Elsa.
paras.zh: 你是说艾莎公主。

paras.en: She’s the one that came to see me.” “Not Anna?” Kristoff asked, feeling weak. “No.
paras.zh: 是她来见我的。”“不是安娜？”克里斯托夫虚弱地问。“不是。

paras.en: Princess Elsa.
paras.zh: 是艾莎公主。

paras.en: I tried to help her—in what little way I can, given the curse.” “Curse?” Kristoff repeated.
paras.zh: 我想帮她——在诅咒之下，我能做的很有限。”“诅咒？”克里斯托夫重复道。

paras.en: This was a lot to take in. “She’s in grave danger,” Grand Pabbie said. “You must find her, Kristoff.” “Princess Elsa?” he asked.
paras.zh: 这信息量太大了。“她处境极危险，”皮比说。“你必须找到她，克里斯托夫。”“艾莎公主？”他问。

paras.en: Grand Pabbie was confusing him. “I tried!
paras.zh: 皮比把他搞糊涂了。“我试过了！

paras.en: No one knows where she is—although I met this talking snowman who knows the princess.
paras.zh: 没人知道她在哪——不过我遇见了那个认识公主的会说话的雪人。

paras.en: And Anna and Prince Hans—Elsa’s prince—were headed here.” He looked at the valley opening again. “I thought they’d be here when I arrived.” “Anna isn’t coming,” Grand Pabbie said. “She’s on her way back to Arendelle.” Kristoff stepped back in surprise. “You know who Anna is?” “Anna’s heart must be protected,” Grand Pabbie said. “This is a precarious time for her.” “I know,” Kristoff agreed. “I’m worried she’s getting sick, but she’s determined to keep going and find Princess Elsa.” “Kristoff, you must listen to me,” he said. “There is a reason Anna feels drawn to Elsa and is fighting so hard to find her.
paras.zh: 安娜和汉斯王子——艾莎的王子——是往这儿来的。”他又望向山谷入口。“我以为我到的时候他们会在。”“安娜不会来了，”皮比说。“她在回阿伦黛尔的路上。”克里斯托夫吃惊地退了一步。“你知道安娜是谁？”“安娜的心必须被保护，”皮比说。“对她来说现在是很危险的时刻。”“我知道，”克里斯托夫同意，“我担心她生病，可她铁了心要继续走、找到艾莎公主。”“克里斯托夫，你必须听我说，”他说。“安娜之所以被艾莎吸引、这么拼命找她，是有原因的。

paras.en: Their connection is stronger than you think.” “I’ve sensed that,” Kristoff admitted. “Ever since we journeyed to Arendelle, Anna’s been feeling things…having strange headaches, and this talking snowman of Princess Elsa’s knows her.
paras.zh: 她们的联系比你想象的更强。”“我感觉到过，”克里斯托夫承认。“自从我们去阿伦黛尔，安娜就一直有感觉……奇怪的头痛，而且艾莎公主的这个会说话的雪人认识她。

paras.en: None of it makes sense.” “Is she?” Grand Pabbie scratched his chin. “This is good.
paras.zh: 这些全都说不通。”“是吗？”皮比挠了挠下巴。“这是好事。

paras.en: She’s starting to remember a past that has been hidden from her and Elsa for far too long.” “Past?” Kristoff asked, a new recollection dawning on him.
paras.zh: 她开始记起一段被她和艾莎隐瞒太久的过去了。”“过去？”克里斯托夫问，一种新的记忆在他心头浮现。

paras.en: It was as if he were awakening from a slumber himself, one that had kept him from knowing exactly how Anna and Elsa were connected. “Wait a minute.…” Grand Pabbie patted his hand. “Yes.
paras.zh: 仿佛他自己也从一场沉睡中醒来，那场沉睡让他一直不清楚安娜和艾莎究竟怎么相连。“等一下……”皮比拍了拍他的手。“是的。

paras.en: Anna and Elsa are sisters.” “Anna is a princess?” “The curse that has prevented the sisters from being together is fading!
paras.zh: 安娜和艾莎是姐妹。”“安娜是位公主？”“阻止姐妹团聚的诅咒正在消退！

paras.en: Elsa already remembers who Anna is, but Anna’s path has not been so simple.
paras.zh: 艾莎已经记起安娜是谁，但安娜的路没那么简单。

paras.en: Love can thaw any curse,” he insisted, “but until she regains her memories, Anna and Elsa cannot be near each other.
paras.zh: 爱能融化任何诅咒，”他坚持说，“但在安娜恢复记忆之前，她和艾莎不能靠近彼此。

paras.en: This is very important!
paras.zh: 这非常重要！

paras.en: She must remember Elsa before they ever come face to face.” Kristoff felt his heart practically stop.
paras.zh: 她们面对面之前，安娜必须记起艾莎。”克里斯托夫的心几乎停跳。

paras.en: Anna wouldn’t quit till she found Elsa. “Why?” “We don’t have much time together, so I won’t waste it trying to explain the past, but it has to do with the curse,” Grand Pabbie explained. “If Anna gets near Elsa before she remembers their connection, Elsa’s powers will turn her to ice.” “What?” Kristoff’s voice sounded hollow to him. “Their love for each other is so strong this curse is already fading.
paras.zh: 安娜不找到艾莎不会罢休。“为什么？”“我们相处的时间不多，所以我不浪费口舌解释过去，但那和诅咒有关，”皮比解释。“如果安娜还没记起她们的联系就靠近艾莎，艾莎的力量会把她冻成冰。”“什么？”克里斯托夫觉得自己的声音很空洞。“她们对彼此的爱如此强烈，这诅咒已经在消退了。

paras.en: Elsa remembers her past, but Anna is not there yet.
paras.zh: 艾莎记起了过去，但安娜还没到那一步。

paras.en: Until the spell is broken, Anna must be kept away.” Grand Pabbie frowned. “Elsa knows this.
paras.zh: 在咒语解除前，必须让安娜远离。”“皮比皱起眉。”艾莎知道这一点。

paras.en: It is why she has kept her distance.
paras.zh: 所以她一直保持距离。

paras.en: But I fear someone else knows the truth, and is leading Anna into danger.
paras.zh: 但我怕另有其人知道真相，正把安娜引向危险。

paras.en: Kristoff, Anna is headed to Arendelle, and Elsa is there too.” Kristoff paled. “Which means…I have to stop her!” Sven started to snort wildly and jump around. “Sven!” Kristoff shouted, climbing the steps double-time as he started running toward the valley’s hidden exit.
paras.zh: 克里斯托夫，安娜正往阿伦黛尔去，艾莎也在那儿。“”克里斯托夫脸色发白。“也就是说……我得拦住她！”斯文开始疯狂喷鼻息、乱跳。“斯文！”克里斯托夫喊着，两步并作一步冲上台阶，朝山谷的秘密出口跑去。

paras.en: Sven galloped to meet him.
paras.zh: 斯文飞奔着迎向他。

paras.en: He didn’t even think to say goodbye to Grand Pabbie, Bulda, or the others.
paras.zh: 他甚至没想到跟皮比、布尔达或其他人道别。

paras.en: Only one thing mattered now—saving Anna at all costs.
paras.zh: 此刻只有一件事要紧——不惜一切代价救出安娜。

paras.en: When Anna, Hans, and the guard arrived back in Arendelle, the kingdom was almost unrecognizable.
paras.zh: 当安娜、汉斯和卫兵回到阿伦黛尔时，整个王国几乎认不出来了。

paras.en: In just two days, snow had drifted to the second story of the castle.
paras.zh: 仅仅两天，积雪就已经堆到了城堡的二层。

paras.en: The fire in the castle courtyard was long gone, and the fountain with the statue of the royal family was completely buried.
paras.zh: 城堡庭院里的火堆早就熄灭了，那座立着王室一家雕像的喷泉也被完全掩埋。

paras.en: They had to fight the wind to reach the castle doors, which were frozen over with ice.
paras.zh: 他们得顶着狂风才能走到城堡大门前，而门已经被冰封得死死的。

paras.en: The guard had to pry them open with a pickax to get them inside.
paras.zh: 卫兵不得不用一把镐才把门撬开，让他们进了城堡。

paras.en: A group was gathered in front of the fireplace, trying to keep warm, but it was clear they were shivering.
paras.zh: 一群人围在壁炉前想取暖，但明显都在瑟瑟发抖。

paras.en: The fire was almost out.
paras.zh: 火苗都快灭了。

paras.en: Hans and the guard rushed to a group of guards and started talking while members of the castle staff busied themselves getting them blankets and warm clothes.
paras.zh: 汉斯和卫兵冲向一队卫兵，急切地交谈起来，而城堡的侍从们则忙着给他们拿毯子和暖和的衣服。

paras.en: Anna couldn’t move.
paras.zh: 安娜动弹不得。

paras.en: Being inside the castle made the strange memories inside her head come on at full force.
paras.zh: 一走进城堡，她脑海里那些奇怪的记忆便排山倒海般涌了上来。

paras.en: A woman in an apron touched her arm. “Miss, are you all right?” Anna gasped as a memory of herself with this woman flooded her mind.
paras.zh: 一位系着围裙的妇人碰了碰她的胳膊。“小姐，你还好吗？”安娜倒吸一口气，脑海里顿时涌出自己和这个妇人在一起的画面。

paras.en: They were baking cookies in a large kitchen, and someone else was with them…a girl.
paras.zh: 那是在一间大厨房里烤饼干，当时还有另一个人在——是个女孩。

paras.en: Anna remembered burning her finger on the stove, and the girl freezing a pot of water so she could cool it down.
paras.zh: 安娜记得自己在炉子上烫到了手指，而那个女孩冻住了一壶水，好让她敷一敷降温。

paras.en: Elsa?
paras.zh: 艾莎？

paras.en: Anna clutched her heart and started to hyperventilate.
paras.zh: 安娜捂住心口，呼吸急促起来。

paras.en: Was this Miss Olina? “Anna!
paras.zh: 这难道是奥丽娜女士？“安娜！

paras.en: Anna!
paras.zh: 安娜！

paras.en: Are you all right?” Hans rushed to her. “Yes.” Anna slowed her breathing. “I…just feel so strange.
paras.zh: 你还好吗？”汉斯冲到她身边。“还好。”安娜放缓呼吸，“我……只是觉得好怪。”

paras.en: I…” The sudden memories didn’t seem like dreams.
paras.zh: 我……”这些突然冒出的记忆不像是梦。

paras.en: They seemed like missing pieces of her life that she had somehow forgotten.
paras.zh: 它们更像是她人生中不知为何被遗忘了的碎片。

paras.en: She was desperate to figure out what was happening, but she was in a room of total strangers.
paras.zh: 她急切地想弄清发生了什么，可眼前全是一张张陌生的脸。

paras.en: If only Kristoff were with them.
paras.zh: 要是克里斯托夫在他们身边就好了。

paras.en: He’d help her make sense of it all. “Where is Prince Hans?” someone cried. “Is he really here?” The Duke of Weselton pushed his way through the crowd.
paras.zh: 他一定能帮她理清这一切。“汉斯王子在哪？”有人喊道，“他真的回来了？”威斯特顿公爵从人群里挤了过来。

paras.en: He was bundled up in a hat and several scarves. “Prince!
paras.zh: 他裹着帽子和好几条围巾。“殿下！

paras.en: Thank goodness you’re alright.
paras.zh: 谢天谢地您平安无事。

paras.en: I was worried when my men said they couldn’t find you after the battle.” “Where was this battle?” Anna asked.
paras.zh: 我的手下说战后找不到您，可把我急坏了。”“这场仗在哪儿打的？”安娜问。

paras.en: Her teeth were chattering.
paras.zh: 她牙齿直打颤。

paras.en: She felt so cold.
paras.zh: 她觉得好冷。

paras.en: Hans didn’t answer her. “I’m fine,” he told the Duke. “I got turned around in the snow.” The Duke noticed Anna and did a double take. “You!” “We meet again.” Anna rubbed her arms to keep warm. “Hello.” “You two know each other?” Hans asked, confused. “Well, not exactly,” Anna was saying when Olaf stepped forward and the Duke shrieked. “Hi!
paras.zh: 汉斯没有回答她。“我没事，”他对公爵说，“在雪里迷了路。”公爵这才注意到安娜，愣了一下。“是你！”“我们又见面了。”安娜搓着胳膊取暖，“你好。”“你们俩认识？”汉斯困惑地问。“算不上吧，”安娜正说着，雪宝走上前来，公爵尖叫起来。“嗨！

paras.en: I’m Olaf, and I like warm hugs,” the snowman said. “I’ve brought Anna home!
paras.zh: 我是雪宝，我喜欢温暖的拥抱，”雪人说，“我把安娜带回家了！

paras.en: Wait till I tell Elsa!
paras.zh: 等我去告诉艾莎！

paras.en: Is she here?” Home?
paras.zh: 她在这儿吗？”回家？

paras.en: Anna thought. “No one is permitted to see Princess Elsa!” the Duke declared. “She remains in the dungeons!” “She’s here?” Anna asked, but she felt her body fading.
paras.zh: 安娜心想。“谁也不许见艾莎公主！”公爵宣布，“她还在地牢里！”“她在这儿？”安娜问，却觉得身子越来越虚。

paras.en: She was so tired.
paras.zh: 她太累了。

paras.en: A woman in a green uniform pushed her way to the front. “Prince Hans!
paras.zh: 一位穿绿色制服的女子挤到前面。“汉斯王子！

paras.en: You must do something!
paras.zh: 您必须做点什么！

paras.en: The Duke has the princess, and now he’s taken away Lord Peterssen, too!” “We demand Lord Peterssen be let out of his chambers!” a man in uniform cried.
paras.zh: 公爵关着公主，现在又把彼得森大人也带走了！”“我们要求释放彼得森大人！”一个穿制服的男人大喊。

paras.en: They both started yelling at the Duke, but their voices were drowned out by the memories flooding Anna’s mind.
paras.zh: 两人都冲着公爵喊起来，但他们的声音被安娜脑海里翻涌的记忆淹没了。

paras.en: A different woman in green, with a cap on her head, placed her hand on Anna’s shoulder. “Are you all right?” “Gerda?” Anna whispered, the name all of a sudden popping into her head.
paras.zh: 另一位戴帽子的绿衣女子把手搭在安娜肩上。“你还好吗？”“格尔达？”安娜轻声问，这个名字忽然蹦进了她的脑海。

paras.en: The woman blinked in surprise. “Why, yes.
paras.zh: 那女子惊讶地眨了眨眼。“哎呀，是啊。

paras.en: How did you…” A portly man with thinning hair appeared beside her.
paras.zh: 你怎么……”一个头发稀疏的胖男人出现在她身边。

paras.en: Anna pointed shakily in his direction. “And you’re Kai.” “Why, yes, miss,” he said, looking at Gerda in confusion. “Can we get you warm clothes or glogg, perhaps?
paras.zh: 安娜颤抖地指向他。“你是凯。”“是啊，小姐，”他困惑地看看格尔达，“要不要给您拿件暖和的衣服，或者来点热饮？

paras.en: Olina doesn’t have supplies to cook much else, I’m afraid.” “Olina,” Anna repeated, seeing herself as a small girl in the kitchen with the palace cook again.
paras.zh: 奥丽娜那儿怕是没多少材料能煮别的了。”“奥丽娜，”安娜重复着，眼前又浮现出自己还是小女孩时和宫殿厨师在厨房里的样子。

paras.en: It was all too much for her to bear.
paras.zh: 这一切让她承受不住。

paras.en: She started to back away from the crowd and the people shouting for Lord Peterssen’s release, looking for an escape. “Miss?” Kai stepped forward, but Anna rushed through an open door.
paras.zh: 她开始从人群和那些高喊释放彼得森大人的人中间退开，想找个出口。“小姐？”凯走上前，可安娜从一扇敞开的门冲了出去。

paras.en: She wandered into what appeared to be a portrait gallery.
paras.zh: 她走进了一间像是肖像画廊的屋子。

paras.en: The large room had a slanted ceiling with blue panels and wooden beams.
paras.zh: 这间大屋子天花板是斜的，上面有蓝色镶板和木梁。

paras.en: There was not much furniture—just a few benches and tables—and there were lots of paintings.
paras.zh: 家具不多——只有几条长椅和几张桌子——墙上却挂满了画。

paras.en: Anna looked up at a portrait of a female knight in battle.
paras.zh: 安娜抬头望着一幅女骑士征战中的画像。

paras.en: For some reason, she could swear her name was Joan.
paras.zh: 不知为何，她敢发誓那骑士叫琼。

paras.en: As a matter of fact, all the portraits seemed familiar.
paras.zh: 事实上，所有的画像都让她觉得眼熟。

paras.en: Anna clutched her stomach in agony.
paras.zh: 安娜痛苦地捂住肚子。

paras.en: Her hands were cold and she felt too weak to stand.
paras.zh: 她的手冰凉，虚弱得几乎站不住。

paras.en: She didn’t hear the door open behind her. “Anna!” Hans caught her as she started to collapse.
paras.zh: 她没听见身后的门开了。“安娜！”她开始瘫倒时，汉斯接住了她。

paras.en: He placed her on one of the benches, cradling her head as she sank into the velvet cushion.
paras.zh: 他把她放到一条长椅上，轻轻托着她的头，让她靠进天鹅绒坐垫里。

paras.en: Anna couldn’t breathe. “What is happening to me?” she said in a panic. “You’re freezing!
paras.zh: 安娜喘不上气。“我这是怎么了？”她慌乱地问。“你快冻僵了！

paras.en: Hang on!” Hans stepped away to light a fire in the fireplace.
paras.zh: 撑住！”汉斯退开去壁炉里生火。

paras.en: Anna kept talking. “I keep seeing things, hearing voices.…I know names of people I’ve never met before!
paras.zh: 安娜还在说。“我总看见东西，听见声音……我认识的那些人，我以前根本没见过！

paras.en: Olaf remembers me, but I don’t remember him…although I feel like I might.” She looked up at Hans, her eyes full of tears. “I feel like I’m losing my mind.” He smiled gently. “It’s all right.
paras.zh: 雪宝认得我，可我不记得他……虽然我觉得自己也许认得。”她抬头望着汉斯，眼里满是泪水。“我觉得自己要疯了。”他温柔地笑了笑。“没事的。

paras.en: You’re not losing your mind.” “I’m not?” Anna asked.
paras.zh: 你没疯。”“我没有？”安娜问。

paras.en: Her teeth were chattering. “No,” he said, and put his hand on top of hers. “I think you’re remembering your old life.
paras.zh: 她牙齿打着颤。“没有，”他说着，把手覆在她的手上，“我想你是在记起从前的生活。

paras.en: The one you had before you were adopted.” He looked at her intently. “I know this will be hard to understand, but the castle is your home.” “What?” Anna heard a whooshing sound in her ears.
paras.zh: 就是你被收养之前的生活。”他专注地看着她。“我知道这很难接受，但这座城堡就是你的家。”“什么？”安娜耳中一阵嗡鸣。

paras.en: I have to find Elsa.
paras.zh: 我得找到艾莎。

paras.en: Hans continued. “You’re an heir to this kingdom.
paras.zh: 汉斯继续说。“你是这个王国的继承人。

paras.en: Your parents gave you up because Elsa struck you with her magic and almost killed you.” “No, I’m…no…Elsa wouldn’t…she didn’t…” Anna couldn’t find the words to express what she was feeling.
paras.zh: 你的父母之所以放弃你，是因为艾莎用魔法伤了你，差点要了你的命。”“不，我……不……艾莎不会……她没有……”安娜找不到词来表达自己的感受。

paras.en: Something inside her was starting to crack.
paras.zh: 她的内心开始崩裂。

paras.en: Hans wasn’t making sense, and yet she knew he was telling the truth.
paras.zh: 汉斯说的似乎不合常理，可她却知道他说的是真话。

paras.en: Do the magic!
paras.zh: 施展魔法！

paras.en: Do the magic! she heard a child say again with glee.
paras.zh: 施展魔法！她又听见一个孩童欢快地喊。

paras.en: That child was her. “It’s true,” Hans insisted. “You don’t remember, but I have the proof right here.” He knelt down by her side and pulled a piece of parchment out of his jacket pocket. “This is a letter from the queen to Elsa telling her everything.” Anna’s heart drummed faster.
paras.zh: 那孩子就是她自己。“这是真的，”汉斯坚持道，“你不记得，可证据就在这儿。”他在她身边跪下，从外套口袋掏出一张羊皮纸。“这是王后写给艾莎的信，把一切都告诉她了。”安娜的心怦怦跳得更快了。

paras.en: She reached for the letter.
paras.zh: 她伸手去拿那封信。

paras.en: Hans held it away from her. “Elsa is a threat to this kingdom and must be punished for her crimes, but your family legacy remains intact.
paras.zh: 汉斯把信拿开了。“艾莎是这个王国的威胁，必须为她的罪行受罚，但你们家族的传承还在。

paras.en: You’re the next in line for the throne!
paras.zh: 你才是王位的下一任继承人！

paras.en: Don’t you see?” Hans smiled eagerly. “With Elsa gone, summer will have to be restored!
paras.zh: 你还不明白吗？”汉斯急切地笑着。“艾莎一走，夏天就一定会回来！

paras.en: Then you and I can rule Arendelle together.” Anna tried to sit up.
paras.zh: 到时你和我就能一起统治阿伦黛尔了。”安娜想撑起身来。

paras.en: Her body was shaking, and such varied emotions were swirling that she thought she might implode.
paras.zh: 她的身体在发抖，种种情绪翻涌交织，她觉得自己快要炸开了。

paras.en: What was Hans saying? “I thought you loved Elsa…don’t you?” Hans’s face fell as he rose to his full height. “As heir, she was preferable, of course.
paras.zh: 汉斯在说什么？“我以为你爱艾莎……难道不是吗？”汉斯站直身子，脸色沉了下来。“作为继承人，她当然更合适。

paras.en: But after what happened on her coronation day, there was no saving her.
paras.zh: 但加冕日那天出了那样的事，她已经没救了。

paras.en: You, though…the long-lost princess of Arendelle—the people will adore you once they see their beloved queen’s letter and realize who you are.
paras.zh: 但你不同……你是阿伦黛尔失踪已久的公主——只要人们看到他们敬爱的王后的信、知道你是谁，就会爱戴你。

paras.en: Don’t you see?
paras.zh: 你还不明白吗？

paras.en: My finding you before Elsa was fate.” “Elsa was looking for me?
paras.zh: 我在艾莎之前找到你，这是命中注定。”“艾莎在找我？
