paras.en: She’s seen this letter?” Anna pulled herself up to stand and staggered toward him. “She knows she has a”—Anna played around with the word in her head before saying it aloud—“sister?” Her heart started beating even faster. “Yes,” Hans said. “I didn’t tell you earlier because I was trying to protect you.” Anna heard the wind howling outside the large window, rattling the frame.
paras.zh: 她看过这封信了？”安娜撑着站起来，踉跄着朝他走去。“她知道自己有个——”安娜在心里掂量着这个词，才说出声来——“妹妹？”她的心跳得更快了。“是的，”汉斯说，“我之前没告诉你，是想保护你。”安娜听见大窗外的风在呼啸，吹得窗框咯咯作响。

paras.en: The glass was iced over and she could see nothing but white outside.
paras.zh: 玻璃上结满了冰，窗外白茫茫一片，什么也看不见。

paras.en: She and Elsa were sisters?
paras.zh: 她和艾莎是姐妹？

paras.en: If it was true, why couldn’t she remember her life as a princess of Arendelle?
paras.zh: 如果这是真的，她为何记不起自己作为阿伦黛尔公主的生活？

paras.en: Why would her family have sent her away unless Hans was right that Elsa’s magic almost killed her?
paras.zh: 除非汉斯说得对——是艾莎的魔法差点害死她——否则家人怎么会送走她？

paras.en: Anna closed her eyes tight, begging herself to remember, but nothing new came to her.
paras.zh: 安娜紧紧闭上眼，求自己想起来，可什么新画面也没出现。

paras.en: Frustrated, she took it out on Hans. “So you learned Elsa tried to kill me and you were willing to lead me right toward her?” Hans’s eyes flickered in surprise. “I…The queen’s letter said it was an accident, but…” There was something he wasn’t telling her. “Let me read the letter for myself, then.” Hans put the letter back in his pocket. “You’re upset.
paras.zh: 挫败之下，她把气撒在汉斯身上。“所以你知道艾莎差点杀了我，还愿意把我直接领到她面前？”汉斯眼里闪过一丝惊讶。“我……王后的信说那是意外，可是……”他有什么瞒着她。“那让我自己看看信。”汉斯把信塞回口袋。“你情绪不太好。

paras.en: Why don’t you calm down first?
paras.zh: 你先冷静一下不好吗？

paras.en: I’ll hold the letter for safekeeping.” She felt a flash of anger. “So instead of making things right with Elsa, you’ve been trying to sweet-talk me?” Hans’s face reddened. “What is this battle everyone keeps talking about?” Hans shifted slightly. “And where is Elsa?
paras.zh: 我先替你保管。”她心头火起。“所以你不是去和艾莎把事情说清，而是一直在哄骗我？”汉斯脸红了。“大家老说的这场仗到底是怎么回事？”汉斯微微挪了挪脚。“艾莎在哪儿？

paras.en: If you know, why don’t you let me talk to her so she can see for herself that the past is in the past?
paras.zh: 你既然知道，为什么不让我去跟她谈，让她亲眼看到过去的事已经过去了？

paras.en: Maybe she’ll stop this storm.” Hans’s face was grim. “She’s had her chance.
paras.zh: 也许她就会停下这场暴风雪。”汉斯脸色阴沉。“她已经错过机会了。

paras.en: I’ve tried talking to her—in her ice palace on the North Mountain, in fact.
paras.zh: 我试过跟她谈——其实就在北山她的冰宫里。

paras.en: She isn’t willing to negotiate, which means she’s sentencing Arendelle and the rest of her kingdom to its doom.
paras.zh: 她根本不愿协商，等于判了阿伦黛尔和她的王国其他地方的死刑。

paras.en: She knows all about you, but instead of helping you, she’s cast you aside, just like she did Arendelle.” “She wouldn’t do that,” Anna argued.
paras.zh: 她什么都知道，却不是帮你，而是把你抛在一边，就像她抛弃阿伦黛尔一样。”“她不会那样的，”安娜争辩道。

paras.en: Hans gestured to the frozen window, which was still rattling. “But she has.
paras.zh: 汉斯指了指那扇仍在震动的冰封窗户。“可她已经做了。

paras.en: Look outside!
paras.zh: 看看外面！

paras.en: We can’t last much longer.
paras.zh: 我们撑不了多久了。

paras.en: The people are looking to me now for rescuing.” “How are you going to save them?” Anna scoffed.
paras.zh: 现在大家都指望我来救。”“你打算怎么救他们？”安娜冷笑。

paras.en: Hans didn’t say anything. “Wait.
paras.zh: 汉斯没说话。“等等。

paras.en: You’re going to kill her?” Hans was still silent. “You c-can’t!” she stuttered. “You have no right to decide her fate!” Hans didn’t flinch. “I’m the one saving this kingdom, and the people will thank me for it.
paras.zh: 你要杀了她？”汉斯依旧沉默。“你……你不能！”她结巴了，“你没权利决定她的命运！”汉斯不为所动。“是我拯救了这个王国，人民会为此感谢我。

paras.en: I’m just sorry you won’t be at my side when I do.” “You’re no match for Elsa,” Anna hissed as the rattling from the window grew louder. “No, you’re no match for Elsa,” Hans countered. “I thought you might be preferable, but clearly I was wrong.
paras.zh: 我只遗憾，我做这件事时你不在我身边。”“你根本不是艾莎的对手，”安娜低吼，窗子的震动更响了。“不，你才不是艾莎的对手，”汉斯回击，“我本以为你或许更合适，但显然我错了。

paras.en: The queen’s secrets will die with her now.” He held the letter over the fire.
paras.zh: 王后的秘密现在要随她一起埋葬了。”他把信举到火上。

paras.en: Anna staggered forward in alarm. “No!” “Stop!” Hans and Anna turned around.
paras.zh: 安娜惊慌地踉跄上前。“不！”“住手！”汉斯和安娜转过身。

paras.en: Lord Peterssen was standing in the open door with two guards by his sides. “Take the prince away!” Lord Peterssen demanded. “I…Lord…” Hans looked around for an escape. “Sir, you don’t understand.
paras.zh: 彼得森大人站在敞开的门口，两侧各有一名卫兵。“把这个王子带走！”彼得森大人命令道。“我……大人……”汉斯四下张望想找退路。“大人，您不明白。

paras.en: If you knew the truth, you’d see that this is the only way.” “I’ve heard everything I need to.” Lord Peterssen’s eyes flickered to Anna’s. “And Princess Elsa tried to tell me the rest.” He smiled softly. “Hello again, Anna.” Anna stepped toward him.
paras.zh: 您若知道真相，就会明白这是唯一的办法。”“该听的我都听到了。”彼得森大人的目光扫向安娜，“艾莎公主也试图把余下的告诉我。”他温和地笑了笑。“又见面了，安娜。”安娜朝他走去。

paras.en: He looked familiar too.
paras.zh: 他也让安娜觉得眼熟。

paras.en: She opened her mouth to speak and heard the window’s rattling increase.
paras.zh: 她张口想说话，却听见窗子的震动加剧了。

paras.en: She turned to look, and suddenly the window shattered.
paras.zh: 她转头一看，窗户突然碎了。

paras.en: The glass flew through the room, a piece slamming into Lord Peterssen and knocking him to the ground.
paras.zh: 玻璃碎片飞过屋子，一块击中彼得森大人，把他撞倒在地。

paras.en: Hans protected his head but was hit by a piece of the window frame.
paras.zh: 汉斯护住头，却被一块窗框击中。

paras.en: The guards rushed to help the lord up as wind howled through the room, knocking portraits off the wall and sending snow everywhere.
paras.zh: 卫兵们冲过去扶大人起身，狂风呼啸着灌进屋里，把墙上的画像刮落，雪四处飞扬。

paras.en: That was when Anna saw it.… The letter had fallen out of Hans’s hand.
paras.zh: 就在这时安娜看见了……那封信从汉斯手中掉了出来。

paras.en: Anna snatched it before it blew away and staggered out of the room, determined to find her way to the dungeons below.
paras.zh: 安娜在信被吹走前一把夺过，踉跄着冲出房间，下定决心要去下面的地牢。

paras.en: Kristoff had barely ridden Sven out of the Valley of the Living Rock when he saw what was happening in the distance: the storm appeared to be directly over the castle.
paras.zh: 克里斯托夫刚骑着斯文离开活石山谷，就望见远处发生了什么：风暴仿佛正盘旋在城堡正上方。

paras.en: A swirl of white smoke rose like a cyclone before it shot out like a blast, causing a fierce wind to roar through the countryside and send birch trees sideways.
paras.zh: 一股白色的烟柱像旋风一样升起，又像爆炸般喷射而出，激起一阵猛风咆哮着席卷乡野，把白桦树吹得横倒。

paras.en: Kristoff and Sven braced for impact, feeling the storm wash over them.
paras.zh: 克里斯托夫和斯文稳住身形准备承受冲击，任凭风暴从身上掠过。

paras.en: His gut told him these new weather conditions weren’t natural.
paras.zh: 他的直觉告诉他，这新起的天气绝非自然。

paras.en: They involved magic.
paras.zh: 其中藏着魔法。

paras.en: And curses.
paras.zh: 还有诅咒。

paras.en: Getting to Arendelle fast became even more important. “Come on, boy!” Kristoff kicked his legs into Sven’s hide.
paras.zh: 尽快赶到阿伦黛尔变得更加重要了。“快，老伙计！”克里斯托夫用腿夹了夹斯文的皮。

paras.en: He and Sven rode faster than they ever had before, racing into the wind down the mountainside.
paras.zh: 他和斯文从没跑得这么快，逆着风冲下山去。

paras.en: His hat was lost halfway down, and he could hardly see what was in front of him due to the blinding snow.
paras.zh: 他的帽子在半山腰就丢了，刺眼的飞雪让他几乎看不清前面的路。

paras.en: The journey felt like it took forever.
paras.zh: 这趟路程仿佛永远走不到头。

paras.en: When Sven finally hit the bottom of the mountain, he skidded out onto what should have been the fjord.
paras.zh: 斯文终于冲到山脚，在原本该是峡湾的地方滑了出去。

paras.en: Up close, the cyclone of snow and ice looked even more menacing.
paras.zh: 近看，那由雪和冰构成的旋风显得更加狰狞。

paras.en: It swirled toward them, and Kristoff and Sven raced right into it, bracing themselves for whatever would come.
paras.zh: 它朝他们卷来，克里斯托夫和斯文径直冲了进去，不管会迎来什么，都咬牙顶住。

paras.en: All that mattered was reaching Anna.
paras.zh: 此刻唯一要紧的，就是找到安娜。

paras.en: Anna, with her bright smile, bubbly enthusiasm, big eyes, and need to fill every moment with chatter.
paras.zh: 安娜，带着她灿烂的笑容、活泼的热忱、大大的眼睛，还有把每分每秒都填满话匣子的劲头。

paras.en: Anna, with her feisty nature and strong will that had saved him from the wolves…and cost him his sleigh.
paras.zh: 安娜，带着她那泼辣的性子和倔强的意志——那性子把他从狼群嘴里救了出来……也赔上了他的雪橇。

paras.en: Anna, who was willing to risk her life to save her village and help a princess she didn’t think she knew.
paras.zh: 安娜，那个情愿冒生命危险去救自己的村庄、去帮一位她以为自己并不认识的公主的人。

paras.en: Leave it to him to wait till now to realize he was falling for her.
paras.zh: 偏偏等到现在，他才发觉自己已经爱上她了。

paras.en: And he might be too late. “Come on, buddy!
paras.zh: 而他可能已经太迟了。“快，老友！

paras.en: Faster!” Kristoff encouraged Sven as they sped across the fjord.
paras.zh: 再快点！”克里斯托夫催促着斯文，两人飞驰过峡湾。

paras.en: He did a double take.
paras.zh: 他猛地愣了一下。

paras.en: They were riding past what appeared to be the bow of a large ship submerged in ice.
paras.zh: 他们正从一艘似乎陷在冰里的大船船首旁驶过。

paras.en: Through the driving snow, several more ships appeared like ghosts, their masts cracking in the extreme cold.
paras.zh: 在狂暴的飞雪中，又浮现出好几艘船，像幽灵一般，桅杆在极寒中咔咔断裂。

paras.en: Kristoff heard the snap before he knew what was happening.
paras.zh: 克里斯托夫还没反应过来，就先听见了断裂声。

paras.en: By the time he looked up, a massive ship was starting to fall right toward them.
paras.zh: 等他抬头，一艘巨大的船正朝他们直直砸下来。

paras.en: It was too late to get out of the way.
paras.zh: 想躲已经来不及了。

paras.en: All Kristoff could do was lead Sven straight through, ducking as debris rained down on their heads.
paras.zh: 克里斯托夫能做的，只有领着斯文笔直穿过去，低头躲开如雨点般落下的碎片。

paras.en: They cleared the ship right before it crashed, but the force still caused the ice around them to splinter.
paras.zh: 他们在船砸落前一刻险险掠过，但冲击仍让周围的冰面裂开了。

paras.en: Kristoff saw the crack spreading beneath them till there was nothing but water in front of them.
paras.zh: 克里斯托夫看见脚下的裂缝不断蔓延，直到面前只剩一片水。

paras.en: Sven pitched forward, sending Kristoff flying onto a sheet of ice.
paras.zh: 斯文猛地向前一倾，把克里斯托夫甩到了一块冰面上。

paras.en: Sven plunged into the water. “Sven!” Kristoff shouted, searching frantically for his best friend.
paras.zh: 斯文栽进了水里。“斯文！”克里斯托夫大喊，拼命搜寻他最好的朋友。

paras.en: Sven broke through the icy water, clambering to pull himself up onto a nearby piece of drift ice.
paras.zh: 斯文冲破冰冷水面，挣扎着爬上附近一块浮冰。

paras.en: Kristoff exhaled with relief. “Good boy,” he shouted. “Stay there!” He struggled to stand in the fierce wind and looked around to get his bearings.
paras.zh: 克里斯托夫松了口气。“好孩子，”他喊道，“待在那儿别动！”他挣扎着在狂风中站起，环顾四周辨明方向。

paras.en: Spotting the castle in the distance, Kristoff braced himself against the wind and headed toward it, hoping Anna was okay.
paras.zh: 望见远处的城堡，克里斯托夫顶着风稳住身子朝它走去，只盼安娜平安。

paras.en: “Lord Peterssen!” Elsa cried. “Kai?
paras.zh: “彼得森大人！”艾莎喊道。“凯？

paras.en: Gerda?
paras.zh: 格尔达？

paras.en: Someone let me out!
paras.zh: 谁来放我出去！

paras.en: Please!” No one answered.
paras.zh: 求求你们！”没有人回答。

paras.en: Through the bars of the small dungeon window she noticed torches flickering in the hallway.
paras.zh: 透过小牢窗的铁栏，她看见走廊里的火把在闪烁。

paras.en: The wind howled between the bricks, nearly blowing the flames out.
paras.zh: 风在砖缝间呼啸，差点把火苗吹灭。

paras.en: Even her chains were starting to freeze, making it hard to move.
paras.zh: 连她的锁链都开始结冰，让她难以动弹。

paras.en: She was trapped.
paras.zh: 她被囚住了。

paras.en: Elsa sat down on the bench and stared at the metal shackles on her hands.
paras.zh: 艾莎在长椅上坐下，盯着腕上的金属镣铐。

paras.en: She couldn’t just watch as her entire kingdom became a frozen tundra.
paras.zh: 她不能眼睁睁看着整个王国变成冰封的荒原。

paras.en: She needed someone to find Anna and tell her the truth about her past.
paras.zh: 她需要有人找到安娜，告诉她关于自己过去的真相。

paras.en: Maybe, just maybe, it would help her remember who she really was.
paras.zh: 也许，只是也许，这能帮她记起自己真正的身份。

paras.en: Then the curse would break and…what did that mean for the weather?
paras.zh: 那样诅咒就会解除，而……这对天气意味着什么？

paras.en: Even if Anna knew who she was, Grand Pabbie had said nothing about her sister being able to stop this winter.
paras.zh: 就算安娜知道她是谁，皮比也从未说过她妹妹能停下这场寒冬。

paras.en: Elsa had created it.
paras.zh: 是艾莎制造了它。

paras.en: Only she could end it.
paras.zh: 也只有她能结束它。

paras.en: Elsa flung her head back against the wall and heard the ice crack.
paras.zh: 艾莎把头往后靠在墙上，听见冰裂开的声音。

paras.en: Why didn’t she know how to reverse the spell she had created?
paras.zh: 她为何不懂如何逆转自己施下的咒语？

paras.en: I know what fear is doing to your magic, she heard Grand Pabbie say.
paras.zh: “我知道恐惧正在如何影响你的魔法，”她仿佛听见皮比说。

paras.en: You must concentrate on controlling your powers.
paras.zh: “你必须专心掌控自己的力量。

paras.en: What did he mean by fear?
paras.zh: 他说的恐惧是什么意思？

paras.en: She wasn’t afraid of her powers, was she?
paras.zh: 她并不怕自己的力量，不是吗？

paras.en: What she was afraid of was not having her sister in her life.
paras.zh: 她怕的，是生命里没有妹妹的陪伴。

paras.en: If she let Anna go, would the storm stop?
paras.zh: 如果她放安娜走，风暴会停下吗？

paras.en: She wasn’t sure, and she didn’t know whom to ask.
paras.zh: 她不确定，也不知道该去问谁。

paras.en: She had lost Mama and Papa, alienated her people, and abandoned Olaf in her quest to escape her chains.
paras.zh: 她已经失去了爸爸妈妈，疏远了臣民，又在挣脱锁链的途中丢下了雪宝。

paras.en: There was no one left to help her.
paras.zh: 再没有人能帮她了。

paras.en: Elsa hung her head and wept. “Mama, Papa, please help me.” The only voice she heard was the wind’s. “Princess Elsa!” Elsa opened her eyes and stood up, straining against her chains.
paras.zh: 艾莎低下头哭了。“妈妈，爸爸，请帮帮我。”她唯一听见的声音，是风声。“艾莎公主！”艾莎睁开眼站起身，用力挣着锁链。

paras.en: Someone was calling for her.
paras.zh: 有人在唤她。

paras.en: It was a girl.
paras.zh: 是个女孩。

paras.en: But she she didn’t recognize the voice. “Princess Elsa, where are you?” “I’m here!” Elsa cried.
paras.zh: 可她听不出那声音。“艾莎公主，你在哪儿？”“我在这儿！”艾莎喊道。

paras.en: It didn’t sound like Gerda or Olina, but it didn’t matter who it was.
paras.zh: 那声音听起来不像格尔达，也不像奥丽娜，但来的是谁已经不重要。

paras.en: Someone was coming for her. “Follow my voice!” “Found you!” The girl stuck her face in the bars and looked into the dungeon.
paras.zh: 有人正朝她走来。”“循着我的声音！”“找到你了！”女孩把脸贴在铁栏上，朝牢里张望。

paras.en: Elsa couldn’t believe what she was seeing.
paras.zh: 艾莎简直不敢相信眼前所见。

paras.en: The girl in front of her had red hair and blue eyes.
paras.zh: 面前的女孩一头红发、一双蓝眼。

paras.en: They locked gazes, and Elsa’s cuffs began to glow.
paras.zh: 两人目光交汇，艾莎的手铐开始发光。

paras.en: Strangely, they didn’t freeze up.
paras.zh: 奇怪的是，它们并没有冻住。

paras.en: The ice melted away. “Anna?” Elsa whispered, momentarily forgetting everything else. “Yes.” She grasped the bars. “I’m Anna.…Hi.” Anna wasn’t a figment of her imagination.
paras.zh: 冰融化了。“安娜？”艾莎轻声唤，一时把其余一切都忘了。“是我。”她握住铁栏。“我是安娜……你好。”安娜不是她凭空想象出来的幻影。

paras.en: She wasn’t a ghost.
paras.zh: 她不是鬼魂。

paras.en: She was real and on the other side of the dungeon door.
paras.zh: 她是真实的，就在牢门的另一侧。

paras.en: Elsa’s younger sister was here.
paras.zh: 艾莎的妹妹就在这里。

paras.en: The curse was broken!
paras.zh: 诅咒解除了！

paras.en: She started to cry. “You know who I am?” Anna paused. “Yes.” “You remember?” Elsa’s tears came faster. “You remembered and you found me.” “I…This place…” Anna trailed off.
paras.zh: 她哭了起来。“你知道我是谁？”安娜顿了顿。“知道。”“你想起来了？”艾莎的泪流得更急了。“你想起来了，还找到了我。”“我……这地方……”安娜说不下去了。

paras.en: She held up a piece of parchment. “I have the queen’s letter.” Elsa’s cuffs glowed brighter. “You have the letter?
paras.zh: 她举起一张羊皮纸。“我有王后的信。”艾莎的手铐亮得更盛。“你有信？

paras.en: How?” Now they could read Mama’s letter together! “It doesn’t matter.
paras.zh: 怎么拿到的？”现在她们可以一起读妈妈的信了！“这不要紧。

paras.en: All that matters is you’re back!
paras.zh: 要紧的是你回来了！

paras.en: You’re…real.” “So are you,” Anna whispered.
paras.zh: 你是……真的。”“你也是，”安娜轻声说。

paras.en: They continued to stare at each other, the only sounds coming from the storm raging outside.
paras.zh: 两人继续对望着，耳边只有外面肆虐的风暴声。

paras.en: Then came the sound of someone giggling. “And so am I!” Anna picked something up and held it in front of the bars.
paras.zh: 接着传来一阵咯咯的笑声。“我也是真的呀！”安娜捡起什么，举到铁栏前。

paras.en: It was a snowman’s head.
paras.zh: 是雪人的脑袋。

paras.en: The head grinned toothily. “Olaf!” Elsa exclaimed. “You’re all right!” “Yes!” Olaf frowned. “But I left your room.
paras.zh: 那脑袋咧嘴露出牙齿笑了。“雪宝！”艾莎惊呼。“你没事！”“是啊！”雪宝皱起眉。“可我离开了你的房间。

paras.en: I know I’m not supposed to.” “It’s all right.” Elsa laughed through her tears. “And I found Anna!” Olaf said happily. “We came to find you with Kristoff and Sven, but then Kristoff and Sven left and we went off with Prince Hans.” “Hans?” Elsa’s smile faded. “Where is he?” she demanded. “Anna, you can’t listen to him!” Anna opened her mouth to respond, and someone pulled her and Olaf from view. “Anna!” Elsa cried. “Get away from me!” she heard Anna yell. “I can’t see!
paras.zh: 我知道我不该这样。”“没事的。”艾莎含泪而笑。“而且我找到安娜了！”雪宝开心地说。“我们本来和克里斯托夫、斯文一起去找你，后来克里斯托夫和斯文走了，我们就跟着汉斯王子走了。”“汉斯？”艾莎的笑容消失了。“他在哪儿？”她急切地问。“安娜，你不能听他的！”安娜张口想答，却有人把她和雪宝拽离了视线。“安娜！”艾莎喊道。“离我远点！”她听见安娜在喊。“我看不见了！

paras.en: I can’t see!” Olaf shouted. “Put me back together!” Elsa heard a key turn and watched the dungeon door open.
paras.zh: 我看不见了！”雪宝叫道。“把我拼回去！”艾莎听见钥匙转动，看着牢门被打开。

paras.en: Olaf’s head rolled into the room without his body.
paras.zh: 雪宝的脑袋滚进屋里，身子却没跟着来。

paras.en: Hans walked in behind it, holding Anna like his prisoner.
paras.zh: 汉斯跟在后面走进来，像押犯人一样抓着安娜。

paras.en: There was a fresh cut above his right eye. “Well, isn’t this refreshing?” he said. “A reunion between two sisters.” “Let her go!
paras.zh: 他右眼上方有一道新伤。“哟，这可真让人耳目一新，”他说，“两姐妹团聚。”“放开她！

paras.en: You can’t hurt us,” Elsa shouted as her cuffs glowed bright blue. “She remembers everything!” Hans smiled. “Does she now?
paras.zh: 你伤不了我们，”艾莎喊道，手铐泛起亮蓝的光。“她全都想起来了！”汉斯笑了。“是吗？

paras.en: Let’s see about that.” He pushed Anna forward.
paras.zh: 那我们瞧瞧。”他一把将安娜推上前。

paras.en: She crashed into Elsa, then fell backward, gasping for air.
paras.zh: 安娜撞在艾莎身上，又向后倒去，喘不过气。

paras.en: Ice formed on her feet and began to creep up her legs.
paras.zh: 冰在她脚上凝结，并开始顺着双腿往上爬。

paras.en: The curse—it wasn’t broken.
paras.zh: 那诅咒——它并没有解除。

paras.en: Hans watched, unfazed, as the ice started to travel up Anna’s body and her hair turned completely white.
paras.zh: 汉斯无动于衷地看着冰爬上安娜的身体，她的头发也全变白了。

paras.en: Anna was freezing from the inside out.
paras.zh: 安娜正由内而外冻僵。

paras.en: Elsa strained against her chains to get away, but she couldn’t go far enough. “Anna!” Olaf panicked, his head rolling toward her. “You’ll kill her!” Elsa screamed.
paras.zh: 艾莎拼命挣着锁链想躲开，却挪不了多远。“安娜！”雪宝慌了，脑袋滚向她。“你会害死她的！”艾莎尖叫。

paras.en: Hans didn’t move. “Exactly.” He looked at Elsa as Anna writhed on the floor in pain. “You doomed yourself, but she was dumb enough to go after you.
paras.zh: 汉斯一动不动。“正是。”他看着在地上痛苦扭动的安娜，对艾莎说。“你毁了自己，可她蠢到偏要追着你跑。

paras.en: Now you’ll both be out of the picture and I’ll rule Arendelle on my own.” “No!” Elsa cried out in agony.
paras.zh: 现在你们两个都出局了，阿伦黛尔就归我独霸。”“不！”艾莎痛苦地喊。

paras.en: Her cuffs began to glow again.
paras.zh: 她的手铐又开始发光。

paras.en: Snowflakes spread across them, the chains, and soon the walls.
paras.zh: 雪花蔓延过手铐、锁链，很快又爬上墙壁。

paras.en: Hans looked up in surprise as the room filled with ice.
paras.zh: 汉斯惊讶地抬头，只见屋子被冰填满。

paras.en: Elsa yanked once, twice, and then a third time as icicles formed on the ceiling and fell on top of them.
paras.zh: 艾莎猛拽一下，两下，又第三下，冰柱在天花板上结成，落向他们。

paras.en: Olaf clambered onto Anna just as the ice began to fall.
paras.zh: 冰开始坠落时，雪宝爬到安娜身上护住她。

paras.en: Hans covered his head with his hands.
paras.zh: 汉斯用双手护住头。

paras.en: Elsa concentrated on the window in the dungeon, and willed her magic to create a hole.
paras.zh: 艾莎凝神盯着牢里的窗户，用意念驱动魔法破出一个洞。

paras.en: Finally, the stones burst, taking half the wall and her chains along with it.
paras.zh: 终于，石块爆裂，连带半面墙和她的锁链一起崩开。

paras.en: Each cuff on her hands broke in two, freeing her from her binds.
paras.zh: 腕上的每只手铐都断成两截，把她从束缚中解放出来。

paras.en: Elsa climbed through the opening in the wall and looked back at Anna.
paras.zh: 艾莎从墙上的破洞钻出去，回头望了望安娜。

paras.en: The ice on her body was starting to recede as Elsa ran into the tempest and disappeared.
paras.zh: 她身上的冰正开始消退，而艾莎已冲进风暴，消失不见。

paras.en: There was a loud blast and shouting, then the sound of men running. “The princess has escaped!” someone yelled, but his voice sounded far away.
paras.zh: 一声巨响和喊叫过后，是男人们奔跑的脚步声。“公主逃走了！”有人喊，可那声音听起来很遥远。

paras.en: A moment earlier, Anna had felt like she was freezing from the inside out.
paras.zh: 片刻之前，安娜还觉得自己由内而外冻透了。

paras.en: The second Elsa was gone, the nausea subsided and she started to warm up again.
paras.zh: 艾莎一消失，那股恶心感就消退了，她又开始暖和起来。

paras.en: How strange, she thought.
paras.zh: 真奇怪，她想。

paras.en: Do the magic! the small voice inside her head said again, causing an instant headache.
paras.zh: 施展魔法！她脑海里那个细小的声音又响起来，惹得她立刻头疼。

paras.en: She tried to block the memory out.
paras.zh: 她想把这个记忆挡在门外。

paras.en: You remember?
paras.zh: 你想起来了？

paras.en: Elsa had asked.
paras.zh: 艾莎曾这样问。

paras.en: Anna had been so surprised by the question she hadn’t known how to answer her.
paras.zh: 安娜被这问题惊到，不知该如何回答她。

paras.en: Elsa clearly did, but Anna was still figuring out these new memories and the information Hans had fed her.
paras.zh: 艾莎显然想起来了，可安娜还在梳理这些新记忆，以及汉斯灌给她的那些话。

paras.en: She couldn’t believe it was all true: she was the lost princess of Arendelle and King Agnarr and Queen Iduna’s child.
paras.zh: 她不敢相信这一切都是真的：她是阿伦黛尔失踪的公主，是安格瑞国王和伊杜娜王后的孩子。

paras.en: She thought of the portrait she had seen of the royal family in the castle.
paras.zh: 她想起在城堡里见过的那幅王室全家画像。

paras.en: Anna heard her heart pounding as she started to put together the pieces: the way Freya had perished, the infrequent visits under the cloak of darkness, the carriage that waited for her outside the bakery.
paras.zh: 安娜听见自己的心怦怦直跳，开始把碎片拼起来：弗雷娅离世的方式、在夜色掩护下难得一次的探视、面包店外等她的马车。

paras.en: The portrait of the queen in the castle that looked remarkably like the woman who had been her aunt and her mother’s best friend.
paras.zh: 城堡里那幅王后的画像，和那个既是她姨母、又是她母亲最好朋友的女人惊人地相似。

paras.en: Could Freya and the queen be the same person?
paras.zh: 弗雷娅和王后会是同一个人吗？

paras.en: And was that person her birth mother?
paras.zh: 而那个人，会是她的亲生母亲吗？

paras.en: She watched through the fuzz in her vision as Olaf’s head rolled by and connected with his body.
paras.zh: 她透过模糊的视线，看见雪宝的脑袋滚过，和身子接在了一起。

paras.en: Suddenly it became clear: Freya was Queen Iduna.
paras.zh: 忽然间一切都清楚了：弗雷娅就是伊杜娜王后。

paras.en: The snowman poked her with his carrot nose. “Anna?
paras.zh: 雪人用胡萝卜鼻子戳了戳她。“安娜？

paras.en: Are you all right?” Anna struggled to sit up and answer him.
paras.zh: 你还好吗？”安娜挣扎着坐起来回答他。

paras.en: Then she heard someone else talking. “Prince Hans!” A guard was leaning over a figure on the ground a few feet away. “The princess,” Hans choked out. “I tried to stop her from making the storm worse, but she struck me with her magic.
paras.zh: 接着她听见另一个人在说话。“汉斯王子！”一名卫兵俯身看着几步外地上的一具身影。“公主，”汉斯哽咽着说，“我想拦住她，不让风暴更糟，她却用魔法打了我。

paras.en: She’s…getting…away.” “Liar!” Anna said, but her voice was weak.
paras.zh: 她……要……逃走了。”“骗子！”安娜说，可声音虚弱。

paras.en: The room slowly began to come into focus.
paras.zh: 屋子慢慢清晰起来。

paras.en: Snow was streaming into the dungeon through a large hole in the wall.
paras.zh: 雪从墙上的大洞灌进地牢。

paras.en: Hans pointed to Anna. “Elsa struck Anna, too.
paras.zh: 汉斯指向安娜。“艾莎也打了安娜。

paras.en: Her whole body started to freeze.” Elsa hadn’t struck her.
paras.zh: 她整个人都开始结冰。”艾莎并没有打她。

paras.en: She had been happy to see Anna.
paras.zh: 她见到安娜明明很高兴。

paras.en: But why had she run away?
paras.zh: 可她为什么逃走了？

paras.en: Elsa, wake up!
paras.zh: 艾莎，醒醒！

paras.en: Wake up!
paras.zh: 醒醒！

paras.en: Wake up! a voice inside her head said.
paras.zh: 醒醒！她脑海里一个声音喊。

paras.en: Do you want to build a snowman?
paras.zh: 你想堆个雪人吗？

paras.en: It was her own voice from long ago.
paras.zh: 那是久远的从前她自己的声音。

paras.en: The memories were coming to the surface faster now.
paras.zh: 记忆现在浮得更快了。

paras.en: I need to find Elsa. “Men, aid Anna while I go after the princess,” she heard Hans say. “No!” Anna shouted out as the guards descended on her.
paras.zh: “我去追公主，你们照应安娜，”她听见汉斯说。“不！”安娜在卫兵围上来时大喊。

paras.en: She watched as Hans turned his shoulder into the wind and disappeared through the hole.
paras.zh: 她看着汉斯侧身迎着风，从破洞消失了。

paras.en: His sword was raised, ready to attack.
paras.zh: 他举着剑，准备出击。

paras.en: He’s going to kill her, Anna thought.
paras.zh: 他要去杀她，安娜想。

paras.en: I have to stop him. “I’m fine,” she told the guards. “Someone needs to stop Prince Hans!
paras.zh: 我得拦住他。“我没事，”她对卫兵说，“得有人去拦住汉斯王子！

paras.en: He’s going to hurt the princess!” The guards looked at her in confusion. “After the princess!” one of the guards shouted and headed through the hole.
paras.zh: 他要伤害公主！”卫兵困惑地看着她。“追公主！”一名卫兵喊着，从破洞冲了出去。

paras.en: The others followed.
paras.zh: 其余的也跟了上去。

paras.en: Anna struggled to stand up, but she felt like she had been hit by something hard.
paras.zh: 安娜挣扎着站起来，却觉得自己像被什么重物撞过。

paras.en: Slowly, she moved toward the opening in the wall. “We have to find Elsa before Hans and the others do,” Anna told Olaf, but the words sounded strange. “Hey!
paras.zh: 她慢慢挪向墙上的破洞。“我们得赶在汉斯和那些人之前找到艾莎，”安娜对雪宝说，可这话听着很怪。“嘿！

paras.en: Your lips are blue!” Olaf commented. “Olaf?
paras.zh: 你的嘴唇发紫了！”雪宝说。“雪宝？

paras.en: You have to help me get to Elsa fast.
paras.zh: 你得帮我快点赶到艾莎身边。

paras.en: It’s important!” Olaf beamed. “Okay!
paras.zh: 这很重要！”雪宝眉开眼笑。“好啊！

paras.en: I’m ready.
paras.zh: 我准备好了。

paras.en: Let’s go!” He wandered off ahead of her through the wall.
paras.zh: 走吧！”他先她一步穿过墙洞。

paras.en: Anna struggled to find her footing as she made her way through the wall and into the snow.
paras.zh: 安娜穿过墙洞走进雪里，好不容易才站稳脚步。

paras.en: The wind was howling.
paras.zh: 风在呼啸。

paras.en: She couldn’t see Olaf even though he was walking right in front of her.
paras.zh: 她看不见雪宝，尽管他就走在前头。

paras.en: Around her, she could hear things creaking and falling.
paras.zh: 四周传来吱嘎崩塌的声响。

paras.en: A sudden gust blew her backward.
paras.zh: 一阵突如其来的狂风把她向后吹去。

paras.en: Olaf was lifted into the air, the three pieces of his body separating. “Keep going!” he shouted as his parts blew away.
paras.zh: 雪宝被卷到空中，三截身子散了开。“继续走！”他的部件被吹散时还喊着。

paras.en: Anna held her arm in front of her face and turned into the wind.
paras.zh: 安娜把胳膊挡在脸前，迎风转过身。

paras.en: She needed to find Elsa before it was too late.
paras.zh: 她得赶在一切都太迟之前找到艾莎。

paras.en: Elsa spun around, unsure of her direction.
paras.zh: 艾莎转过身，辨不清方向。

paras.en: Her cape blew in front of her face and she pushed it away.
paras.zh: 斗篷被风掀到她面前，她伸手拨开。

paras.en: The storm was so fierce there was nowhere left to shelter.
paras.zh: 风暴如此猛烈，已无处可以躲避。

paras.en: She couldn’t go back to the castle.
paras.zh: 她回不了城堡了。

paras.en: She was an enemy to her people and to Anna now.
paras.zh: 如今她成了臣民和安娜的敌人。

paras.en: The curse still ruled Anna’s life.
paras.zh: 诅咒仍掌控着安娜的命运。

paras.en: Elsa’s life was in ruins.
paras.zh: 艾莎的人生已是一片废墟。

paras.en: She couldn’t save her people from her madness.
paras.zh: 她无力将臣民从自己的疯狂中拯救出来。

paras.en: She didn’t know how to save her sister.
paras.zh: 她不知道该如何拯救妹妹。

paras.en: She was at a loss on how to stop the storm, no matter how desperately she wanted to.
paras.zh: 无论她多么渴望停下风暴，却一筹莫展。

paras.en: She’d never been more frightened or alone.
paras.zh: 她从未如此恐惧，如此孤独。

paras.en: Elsa wandered around in the swirling darkness, barely making out the ship frozen in front of her.
paras.zh: 艾莎在旋转翻涌的黑暗中徘徊，勉强辨认出前方冻住的船只。

paras.en: Let them come for me, she thought.
paras.zh: 让他们来抓我吧，她想。

paras.en: Without Anna, I’ve got nothing left to fight for.
paras.zh: 没了安娜，我已无物可守。

paras.en: She’d lost Olaf, she couldn’t see where she was going, a ship had just appeared before her like a mirage, and Elsa was nowhere to be seen.
paras.zh: 她弄丢了雪宝，看不清去路，一艘船如海市蜃楼般出现在眼前，而艾莎却不见踪影。

paras.en: She heard a bang and watched in horror as the ship’s mast tumbled into the ice and shattered, sending large chunks of ice flying.
paras.zh: 她听见一声巨响，惊恐地看着船桅砸进冰里摔得粉碎，大块坚冰四散飞溅。

paras.en: She raised her hands to her face to protect herself.
paras.zh: 她抬手护住脸庞。

paras.en: It felt like the world was ending, but she refused to let it.
paras.zh: 世界仿佛正在终结，但她绝不允许。

paras.en: There was so much to live for.
paras.zh: 她还有太多活下去的理由。

paras.en: She had a past to remember and a sister to get to know.
paras.zh: 她有往事需要记起，有妹妹需要重新认识。

paras.en: Arendelle needed both its princesses.
paras.zh: 阿伦黛尔需要两位公主都在。

paras.en: Maybe together they could bring back the sun.
paras.zh: 也许她们合力，就能唤回太阳。

paras.en: Anna pulled her cape tightly around her for warmth, but it did nothing.
paras.zh: 安娜把斗篷紧紧裹在身上取暖，却毫无作用。

paras.en: The cold felt like it was inside her bones, just like it had when she’d been in the room with Elsa.
paras.zh: 寒意仿佛沁入骨髓，就像之前和艾莎同处一室时那样。

paras.en: Something was causing this new condition, and it wasn’t just the weather.
paras.zh: 这新出现的状况另有原因，绝不只是天气。

paras.en: Her pale hands were starting to freeze, small ice crystals forming on her wrists and fingertips.
paras.zh: 她苍白的双手开始冻结，手腕和指尖结出细小的冰晶。

paras.en: Cursed .
paras.zh: 被诅咒了。

paras.en: Was that what was happening to her and Elsa?
paras.zh: 她和艾莎遭遇的，就是这个吗？

paras.en: Had she been cursed to be kept apart from her sister?
paras.zh: 难道她被诅咒，注定要与妹妹分离？

paras.en: Was that why her birth parents had separated them?
paras.zh: 父母当初将她们分开，是因为这个吗？

paras.en: Maybe the queen’s letter explained what had happened.
paras.zh: 也许王后的信能解释这一切。

paras.en: The letter!
paras.zh: 那封信！

paras.en: Anna felt her dress pockets, but the letter was gone.
paras.zh: 安娜摸了摸裙子的口袋，信却不见了。

paras.en: During the explosion and Elsa’s escape, it must have fallen out of her pocket.
paras.zh: 在爆炸与艾莎逃离时，信一定从她口袋里掉了出去。

paras.en: Now she had nothing that proved who she really was.
paras.zh: 如今她手边没有任何能证明自己身份的东西。

paras.en: Elsa was the only one who could help her, and she had run off.
paras.zh: 唯一能帮她的艾莎，已经跑掉了。

paras.en: What if Hans found her before Anna could?
paras.zh: 万一汉斯比安娜先找到她呢？

paras.en: Anna slipped on the ice.
paras.zh: 安娜在冰上滑了一跤。

paras.en: There was so much of it, and slowly, she was becoming a part of it.
paras.zh: 四周全是冰，慢慢地，她正变成冰的一部分。

paras.en: Please, she begged, calling on Freya’s memory—her mother’s memory—to guide her.
paras.zh: 求求你，她恳求着，唤起弗雷娅的记忆——也就是母亲的记忆——来指引她。

paras.en: Let me find Elsa.
paras.zh: 让我找到艾莎。

paras.en: She felt an irresistible urge to turn around.
paras.zh: 她感到一阵无法抗拒的冲动，想要转身。

paras.en: Elsa was huddled on the ground, feet from where Anna stood, with her head in her hands.
paras.zh: 艾莎蜷缩在地上，离安娜所站之处仅几步之遥，双手抱着头。

paras.en: Hans was standing over her.
paras.zh: 汉斯正站在她上方。

paras.en: Did Elsa even know he was there?
paras.zh: 艾莎知道他在那儿吗？

paras.en: Or had she given up?
paras.zh: 还是她已经放弃了？

paras.en: No, Elsa! she wanted to cry out.
paras.zh: 不，艾莎！她想喊出声。

paras.en: I…I remember, she realized.
paras.zh: 我……我想起来了，她猛然意识到。

paras.en: A feeling came over her, so strong that for the smallest of moments, it warmed her soul.
paras.zh: 一种强烈的情感涌上心头，在最短的一瞬，温暖了她的灵魂。

paras.en: Pictures flew through her mind: She and Elsa talking in their bedroom, baking with their mother in the kitchen, running down the central staircase.
paras.zh: 画面在脑海中飞掠：她和艾莎在卧室里聊天，和母亲在厨房烤点心，沿着中央楼梯奔跑而下。

paras.en: Do the magic! she heard a voice say, and now she realized it was her younger self begging Elsa to create more snow.
paras.zh: 施展魔法吧！她听见一个声音说，此刻才意识到那是小时候的自己，在央求艾莎变出更多雪。

paras.en: Together they had skated around the Great Hall and made snow angels.
paras.zh: 她们曾一起在大礼堂里滑冰，堆出雪天使。

paras.en: They had built Olaf!
paras.zh: 雪宝就是她们一起堆出来的！

paras.en: She used to marvel at Elsa’s magic and always wanted her sister to use it.
paras.zh: 她曾那样惊叹于艾莎的魔法，总想着让姐姐施展出来。

paras.en: Do the magic! she heard herself beg again, and then she saw the moment when everything changed.
paras.zh: 施展魔法吧！她又听见自己恳求，接着看见了那个一切改变的瞬间。

paras.en: In her haste to stop Anna from falling off a snow mound, Elsa had accidentally struck her.
paras.zh: 艾莎急着阻止安娜从雪堆上摔下，却不小心击中了她。

paras.en: That was when she and Elsa had been ripped apart.
paras.zh: 就在那一刻，她和艾莎被硬生生分开了。

paras.en: She remembered everything!
paras.zh: 她全都想起来了！

paras.en: She— She looked up.
paras.zh: 她——她抬起头。

paras.en: Hans had his sword high over his head and was about to plunge it straight into Elsa’s heart.
paras.zh: 汉斯将剑高高举过头顶，正要直直刺入艾莎的心脏。

paras.en: Her sister’s heart.
paras.zh: 她妹妹的心脏。

paras.en: With what little strength she had left, Anna lunged forward. “No!” Anna shouted, sliding in front of Elsa as the blade began to fall.
paras.zh: 用尽残存的力气，安娜猛地向前扑去。不！安娜喊道，在剑刃落下时滑到艾莎身前。

paras.en: She raised her hand to stop him and felt the ice spread from her chest to her extremities.
paras.zh: 她抬手去挡，感到冰从胸口蔓延到四肢末梢。

paras.en: Her fingertips connected with the sword just as they froze, shattering the blade into pieces.
paras.zh: 她的指尖在冻结的刹那碰到剑身，将剑刃击得粉碎。

paras.en: A shock wave seemed to emanate from her frozen body, sending Hans flying backward.
paras.zh: 一股冲击波似乎从她冻结的身躯迸发，将汉斯震得向后飞出。

paras.en: Anna exhaled a last breath that evaporated into thin air.
paras.zh: 安娜吐出最后一口气，消散在空气里。

paras.en: The vibrations rocked the ground, startling Elsa, who had been lost in her own thoughts of despair.
paras.zh: 震动撼动了大地，惊醒了陷入绝望思绪的艾莎。

paras.en: The storm had suddenly ceased, along with the snow.
paras.zh: 风暴连同飞雪，骤然停息。

paras.en: Flakes were suspended in the air as if time had stopped.
paras.zh: 雪花悬在半空，仿佛时间静止。

paras.en: It took Elsa a moment to realize why. “Anna!” she screamed, jumping up.
paras.zh: 艾莎过了片刻才明白缘由。安娜！她惊叫着跳起身。

paras.en: Her sister had turned to ice.
paras.zh: 妹妹变成了冰。

paras.en: Anna looked like a statue, forever preserved with one hand outstretched to the sky.
paras.zh: 安娜宛如一座雕像，永远定格在一只手伸向天空的姿势。

paras.en: Her cape was frozen in motion, like she had run to Elsa’s side to protect her.
paras.zh: 她的斗篷凝在动作里，仿佛是奔到艾莎身边护着她。

paras.en: Hans lay a few feet away, his sword near his side.
paras.zh: 汉斯躺在几步之外，剑落在身侧。

paras.en: Realization struck her: Anna had stopped Hans from hurting her.
paras.zh: 她恍然大悟：安娜挡下了汉斯，没让他伤到自己。

paras.en: She had given her life to save Elsa’s.
paras.zh: 她献出自己的生命，救了艾莎的命。

paras.en: Elsa gingerly reached out to touch Anna’s frozen face. “Oh, Anna.
paras.zh: 艾莎小心翼翼地伸手，去触碰安娜冰冷的脸颊。哦，安娜。

paras.en: No.
paras.zh: 不。

paras.en: No.
paras.zh: 不。

paras.en: Please, no.” Her hands caressed Anna’s icy cheeks.
paras.zh: 求求你，不要。她的双手轻抚着安娜冰冷的脸颊。

paras.en: The curse had lifted a second too late.
paras.zh: 诅咒解除，却迟了一秒。

paras.en: How could magic be so cruel?
paras.zh: 魔法怎么会如此残忍？

paras.en: Anna.
paras.zh: 安娜。

paras.en: Sweet, beautiful Anna, she thought.
paras.zh: 甜美、美丽的安娜，她心想。

paras.en: It’s not fair.
paras.zh: 这不公平。

paras.en: Don’t leave me.
paras.zh: 别丢下我。

paras.en: Elsa threw herself at Anna’s frozen sculpture, crying with abandon.
paras.zh: 艾莎扑向安娜冰封的雕像，尽情地哭着。

paras.en: She didn’t hear Olaf walk up beside her.
paras.zh: 她没听见雪宝走到身旁。

paras.en: She barely noticed the devastated blond man who had just arrived with a reindeer.
paras.zh: 她几乎没注意到那个刚和驯鹿一起赶来的、失魂落魄的金发青年。

paras.en: Through the haze of the unearthly stillness, she thought she saw Lord Peterssen, a bandage around his right arm, and Gerda, Kai, and Olina on a castle balcony, watching from above.
paras.zh: 在超凡寂静的朦胧中，她仿佛看见彼得森勋爵右臂缠着绷带，还有歌尔达、凯和奥丽娜站在城堡阳台上，从高处望下来。

paras.en: But what did any of it matter?
paras.zh: 可这些又有什么要紧？

paras.en: Perhaps the entire kingdom had just woken up from a dreamlike state and remembered: Arendelle did not have one princess.
paras.zh: 也许整个王国刚刚从梦境般的状态中醒来，记起：阿伦黛尔不该只有一位公主。

paras.en: It had two.
paras.zh: 它有两位。

paras.en: They’d found their lost princess only to lose her all over again.
paras.zh: 他们找回了失踪的公主，却又再次失去她。

paras.en: I’m so sorry, Anna, Elsa thought as she clung to her sister and tears streamed down her cheeks.
paras.zh: 对不起，安娜，艾莎紧抱着妹妹，泪流满面地想。

paras.en: I love you more than anything in this world, and I always will.
paras.zh: 我爱你胜过世间一切，永远如此。

paras.en: Suddenly Elsa heard a gasp and felt Anna collapse in her arms.
paras.zh: 忽然，艾莎听见一声喘息，感到安娜瘫软在怀里。

paras.en: She was alive!
paras.zh: 她还活着！

paras.en: Her body had thawed completely.
paras.zh: 她的身体完全解冻了。

paras.en: Even the white stripe in her hair had disappeared. “Anna!” Elsa cried in surprise, looking into her sister’s eyes.
paras.zh: 连她头发里的那道白发也消失了。安娜！艾莎望着妹妹的眼睛，惊喜地喊道。

paras.en: Anna gripped her. “I remember you .
paras.zh: 安娜紧紧抓住她。我想起你了。

paras.en: I remember everything,” she said, and finally they were able to embrace.
paras.zh: 我想起了一切，她说，两人终于得以相拥。

paras.en: When Elsa finally pulled away, she looked at Anna with fresh eyes. “You sacrificed yourself for me,” she said softly. “I love you,” Anna said, holding Elsa’s hand tightly in her own.
paras.zh: 艾莎终于松开，用全新的目光看着安娜。你为我牺牲了自己，她轻声说。我爱你，安娜说，紧紧握住艾莎的手。

paras.en: She noticed Elsa staring at something and turned around. “Kristoff!” “Princess,” he said. “There was a Princess Anna, and you’re her.
paras.zh: 她发现艾莎盯着什么，转过身去。克里斯托夫！公主，他说，这世上本有一位安娜公主，而您就是她。

paras.en: I can’t believe it.
paras.zh: 我简直不敢相信。

paras.en: I mean, I can, but…you’re actually a princess!
paras.zh: 我是说，我信，可是……您真的是公主！

paras.en: Am I supposed to bow?
paras.zh: 我该鞠躬吗？

paras.en: Kneel?
paras.zh: 下跪？

paras.en: I’m not sure what to do here.” “Don’t be ridiculous!
paras.zh: 我不知道该怎么做。别傻了！

paras.en: I’m still me,” Anna told Kristoff with a laugh, and hugged him.
paras.zh: 我还是我呀，安娜笑着对克里斯托夫说，并拥抱了他。

paras.en: Elsa couldn’t believe what she was hearing.
paras.zh: 艾莎不敢相信自己听到的话。

paras.en: If Kristoff knew who Anna truly was, then all of Arendelle and the kingdom did, too.
paras.zh: 既然克里斯托夫知道了安娜的真实身份，那么整个阿伦黛尔和王国也都知道了。

paras.en: Her eyes filled with tears. “Grand Pabbie was right—love can really thaw any curse,” Kristoff said. “Love can thaw…” Elsa repeated. “Of course!” All that time she had allowed herself to be wrapped up in fear—fear of being alone, fear of never finding Anna, fear of destroying the kingdom with her powers.
paras.zh: 她热泪盈眶。皮比说得对——爱真的能融化任何诅咒，克里斯托夫说。爱能融化……艾莎重复道。当然！一直以来，她任由自己被恐惧裹挟——害怕孤独，害怕永远找不到安娜，害怕用自己的力量毁掉王国。

paras.en: That fear had held her prisoner since she had learned she had magic inside her.
paras.zh: 自从得知体内有魔法起，这份恐惧就囚禁了她。

paras.en: It was just as Grand Pabbie had said: she needed to learn to control her magic.
paras.zh: 正如皮比所说：她需要学会掌控自己的魔法。

paras.en: If only she embraced the beauty in her life and the magic she’d been gifted—gifted, not cursed with!—then she could move mountains.
paras.zh: 只要她拥抱生命中的美好，以及被赋予（是赋予，不是诅咒！）的魔法，她就能移山倒海。

paras.en: Or at least thaw out the countryside.
paras.zh: 至少也能融化乡野的冰雪。

paras.en: Elsa stared at her hands in wonder.
paras.zh: 艾莎惊奇地盯着自己的双手。

paras.en: The answer had been right in front of her all that time. “Love!” “Elsa?” Anna questioned.
paras.zh: 答案一直就在眼前。爱！艾莎？安娜疑惑道。

paras.en: Elsa thought hard about what she was feeling; it was pure joy mixed with the greatest love she had ever known.
paras.zh: 艾莎认真体会着内心的感受：那是纯粹的喜悦，混合着她所知晓的最深沉的爱。

paras.en: She had a sister she loved fiercely.
paras.zh: 她有一个被自己深爱着的妹妹。

paras.en: Focusing on that love and the love she had for her parents and her people calmed her once-frightened soul.
paras.zh: 将心思凝聚于这份爱，以及她对父母和臣民的爱，安抚了她曾经受惊的灵魂。

paras.en: It was her job to protect her kingdom, and she could do that now.
paras.zh: 守护王国是她的职责，而如今她能做到。

paras.en: Her loving thoughts made her fingers tingle like they always did when she used her magic, but this time her body felt different.
paras.zh: 充满爱意的念头让她的指尖如施法时那般发麻，但这一次，她的身体感觉不同了。

paras.en: Her fingers began to warm.
paras.zh: 她的指尖开始变暖。

paras.en: Elsa lifted her hands to the sky, and snowflakes began to rise from the ice beneath their feet.
paras.zh: 艾莎双手举向天空，雪花开始从脚下的冰面上升起。

paras.en: The flakes turned into water and rose like a geyser.
paras.zh: 雪花化作水，如间歇泉般喷涌上升。

paras.en: Everywhere she could see, all the way to the horizon, the ice was rising into the sky and evaporating.
paras.zh: 目之所及，直到地平线，冰层都在升向天空，蒸发消散。

paras.en: The fjord was thawing, allowing ships to be free to sail once more.
paras.zh: 峡湾正在解冻，船只终于又能自由航行。

paras.en: Elsa hadn’t even noticed that she was standing on the bow of a ship herself till it began to rise out of the ice with Anna, Kristoff, Olaf, the reindeer, and her on it.
paras.zh: 直到船随着安娜、克里斯托夫、雪宝、驯鹿和她一起从冰里浮起，艾莎才发现自己正站在船首。

paras.en: The blue glow from her fingers continued to travel, reaching across the water into the village.
paras.zh: 她指尖的蓝光继续延伸，越过水面，抵达村庄。

paras.en: Slowly, houses that had been almost buried in snow came back to life.
paras.zh: 慢慢地，几乎被雪掩埋的房屋重新焕发生机。

paras.en: Flowers bloomed again, and the countryside and mountains returned to their green selves.
paras.zh: 花朵再次绽放，乡野与群山恢复了青翠。

paras.en: People stepped outside in wonder as the world turned from winter to summer once more.
paras.zh: 人们惊奇地走出门外，看世界再次由冬转夏。

paras.en: When the thaw was finally complete, the remaining water that had lifted into the sky swirled and spinned into a giant snowflake.
paras.zh: 当解冻终于完成，升上天空的残水盘旋汇聚，化作一片巨大的雪花。

paras.en: Elsa gave a final wave of her hands, and the snowflake exploded in a ball of light.
paras.zh: 艾莎双手最后一挥，那片雪花在一团光球中炸开。

paras.en: The sky was blue, and the sun finally showed its face again.
paras.zh: 天空湛蓝，太阳终于再次露出面容。

paras.en: Anna looked at Elsa with pride. “I knew you could do it.” “Hands down, the best day of my life,” Olaf agreed, his personal flurry the only remaining precipitation to be found.
paras.zh: 安娜骄傲地看着艾莎。我就知道你做得到。毫无疑问，这是我这辈子最棒的一天，雪宝附和道，他身边那团专属飞雪成了仅存的降水。

paras.en: Elsa heard moaning and noticed Hans clutching his jaw.
paras.zh: 艾莎听见呻吟，注意到汉斯捂着下巴。

paras.en: She immediately started marching over.
paras.zh: 她立刻大步走了过去。

paras.en: Anna reached out to stop her. “He’s not worth your time,” Anna said as she approached the prince herself.
paras.zh: 安娜伸手拦住她。他不值得你费心，安娜说罢，自己走向了那位王子。

paras.en: Hans saw her and gasped in surprise. “Anna?” He stood up straight. “But the curse—I saw you turn to ice!” Anna’s expression hardened. “You’re the one who’s cold as ice!” She turned to walk away, then apparently thought better of it and punched him in the jaw.
paras.zh: 汉斯看见她，惊讶地倒吸一口气。安娜？他直起身。可那诅咒——我亲眼见你变成了冰！安娜神色一凛。冷得像冰的人是你才对！她转身要走，显然又改了主意，一拳打在他下巴上。

paras.en: Hans fell backward, flipping over the side of the ship and landing in the water.
paras.zh: 汉斯向后倒去，翻过船舷，掉进了水里。

paras.en: They heard a cheer in the distance.
paras.zh: 远处传来一阵欢呼。

paras.en: Elsa looked toward the castle and saw Kai, Gerda, and several others standing on the balcony.
paras.zh: 艾莎望向城堡，看见凯、歌尔达和另外几人站在阳台上。

paras.en: The sight of them applauding Hans’s comeuppance made her hopeful that they knew the truth about the prince.
paras.zh: 看见他们为汉斯自食其果而鼓掌，她有了希望：他们已知道这位王子的真面目。

paras.en: He couldn’t be trusted, but she’d make sure the people of Arendelle knew they could put their faith in her once more. “Princess Elsa!” Elsa rushed to the side of the ship to see who was calling to her.
paras.zh: 他不可信任，但她要让阿伦黛尔的子民重新确信，可以再次信赖她。艾莎公主！艾莎冲到船边，看是谁在喊她。

paras.en: A small boat was headed toward them, manned by two guards and Lord Peterssen.
paras.zh: 一艘小艇朝他们驶来，上面有两名卫兵和彼得森勋爵。

paras.en: The boat bumped against the side of the ship, and Lord Peterssen climbed up while the guards stayed back to fish Hans out of the water.
paras.zh: 小艇撞上船身，彼得森勋爵爬上船，卫兵们则留在后面把汉斯从水里捞起来。

paras.en: Lord Peterssen looked from Anna to Elsa before rushing forward to embrace them both.
paras.zh: 彼得森勋爵看看安娜，又看看艾莎，然后冲上前将两人一起拥抱。

paras.en: His eyes were red, as if he’d been crying. “To see both princesses of Arendelle together…The kingdom will rejoice!
paras.zh: 他眼睛通红，像是哭过。能看见阿伦黛尔的两位公主团聚……王国将会欢腾！

paras.en: People are flooding the castle—the kingdom has thawed from its deep freeze!
paras.zh: 人们正涌向城堡——王国已从严寒中解冻！

paras.en: Summer has returned thanks to you.” He wiped his eyes and touched Anna’s arm. “Our lost princess has been returned to us.
paras.zh: 多亏你们，夏天回来了。他擦了擦眼睛，碰了碰安娜的手臂。我们失踪的公主回到了我们身边。

paras.en: It’s as if I’ve lived two lives—one where I’ve been asleep and forgotten you and one where you’re here with us again.
paras.zh: 我仿佛过了两世——一世昏睡着将你遗忘，一世你又回到我们身边。

paras.en: The curse has been lifted.” “How do you know about the curse?” Elsa asked in surprise.
paras.zh: 诅咒已经解除。你怎么知道诅咒的事？艾莎惊讶地问。

paras.en: Lord Peterssen pulled a piece of parchment out of his jacket pocket. “I read about it in your mother’s letter, which I found in the dungeons after you both ran off.” He handed it to Elsa. “I wanted to make sure you got it back.
paras.zh: 彼得森勋爵从外套口袋掏出一页羊皮纸。我是在你们俩跑掉后，在地牢里找到的王后信中读到的。他递给艾莎。我想确保物归原主。

paras.en: Words of wisdom from the queen should not be forgotten.” “Thank you.” Elsa stared at the letter she had thought she would never see again. “I never even got a chance to read it before…” “You froze the kingdom?” Olaf asked, and they laughed. “Why don’t we read it together?” Anna asked, touching the parchment in wonder.
paras.zh: 王后的箴言不该被遗忘。谢谢你。艾莎盯着那封以为再也见不到的信。我之前连读它的机会都没有……是你冻住了王国？雪宝问，众人大笑。不如我们一起读吧？安娜轻触羊皮纸，满心惊奇地说。

paras.en: The others stepped away to give the sisters space.
paras.zh: 其他人退开，给姐妹俩留出空间。

paras.en: Elsa and Anna sat side by side on the deck and read the words their mother had written long before.
paras.zh: 艾莎和安娜并肩坐在甲板上，读着母亲许久之前写下的字句。

paras.en: Our darling Elsa, If you’re reading this, we’re gone.
paras.zh: 我最亲爱的艾莎，如果你读到了这封信，我们已不在人世。

paras.en: Otherwise, our dear girl, you would already know about the curse that separated our family long ago.
paras.zh: 否则，亲爱的孩子，你早该知道那个很久以前拆散我们家的诅咒。

paras.en: We have always wanted to tell you the truth about what happened that night, but Grand Pabbie—the leader of the trolls whose wisdom we sought for help—told us the curse would someday lift and you would remember everything on your own.
paras.zh: 我们一直想告诉你那晚发生的真相，但皮比——我们曾求助其智慧的地精首领——说诅咒终有一天会解除，你会自己想起一切。

paras.en: As I write this, that day has not come.
paras.zh: 写这封信时，那一天还没到来。

paras.en: This is a secret we’ve hidden for years, and now it is hidden away here in your new lockbox, to make sure you know the truth if we are not around to give it.
paras.zh: 这是我们藏了多年的秘密，如今它被收进你的新保险箱，好确保若我们不在了，你仍能得知真相。

paras.en: You have a younger sister, Anna, who, like you, has lived in the dark far too long.
paras.zh: 你有一个妹妹，安娜，她和你一样，在黑暗中活了太久。

paras.en: We love you and your sister very much, but circumstance forced us to keep you apart.
paras.zh: 我们深爱着你和妹妹，但情势所迫，只得将你们分开。

paras.en: This will be hard to hear, but you were given the gift of magic that allows you to create ice and snow.
paras.zh: 这话或许难以接受，但你被赋予了创造冰雪的魔法天赋。

paras.en: When you were young, your magic accidentally struck Anna.
paras.zh: 你年幼时，魔法不小心击中了安娜。

paras.en: To save her life, we sought out the wisdom of the trolls, traveling to the Valley of the Living Rock.
paras.zh: 为救她一命，我们前往活石谷，求教于地精的智慧。

paras.en: Their leader, Grand Pabbie, was able to help Anna, but when he tried to erase her memories of your magic for her own safety, you got upset and interfered.
paras.zh: 他们的首领皮比救下了安娜，可当他为保安娜安全，试图抹去她对魔法的记忆时，你焦急之下出手阻拦。

paras.en: When your magic combined with Grand Pabbie’s, it cursed you and Anna differently.
paras.zh: 你的魔法与皮比的力量交织，给了你和安娜不同的诅咒。

paras.en: For you, your magic became dormant.
paras.zh: 对你而言，魔法陷入了沉寂。

paras.en: Grand Pabbie said it would appear again when you needed your sister more than you ever had before.
paras.zh: 皮比说，当你比以往任何时候都更需要妹妹时，它便会重新苏醒。

paras.en: But for Anna, the curse meant she could not be near you, or she would turn to ice.
paras.zh: 而对安娜，诅咒意味着她不能靠近你，否则就会变成冰。

paras.en: Until the curse lifts, you and Anna must not meet.
paras.zh: 在诅咒解除前，你和安娜绝不能相见。

paras.en: I know you will have many questions.
paras.zh: 我知道你会有许多疑问。

paras.en: Too many, I fear, for us to answer in one letter, but know you weren’t separated from each other out of fear.
paras.zh: 我怕是太多，一封信答不完，但请记住，你们分开并非出于恐惧。

paras.en: We did what we did because we had no choice.
paras.zh: 我们那样做，是因为别无选择。

paras.en: We loved you both too much to see you hurt, and Grand Pabbie gave us a way to protect you both.
paras.zh: 我们太爱你们，不忍见你们受伤，而皮比给了我们保护你们俩的办法。

paras.en: Please understand, when I say curse, I don’t mean your powers.
paras.zh: 请理解，我说诅咒时，指的不是你的力量。

paras.en: Your powers are a gift that I hope by now your father and I have helped you learn how to control.
paras.zh: 你的力量是一份天赋，但愿到如今，你父亲和我已帮你学会掌控它。

paras.en: So why tell you now?
paras.zh: 那么为何现在才告诉你？

paras.en: This letter serves to give you hope.
paras.zh: 这封信是为了给你希望。

paras.en: You are not alone in the world!
paras.zh: 你在这世上并不孤单！

paras.en: You are a smart, resourceful girl, Elsa, and I know you can find a way to reach your sister even when she is out of sight.
paras.zh: 艾莎，你是个聪明又机敏的姑娘，我知道即便妹妹不在眼前，你也能找到办法与她相认。

paras.en: And Anna, with her warm heart and kind soul, will find her way back to you.
paras.zh: 而安娜，凭着她温暖的心与善良的灵魂，终会找回回到你身边的路。

paras.en: Other than your father and I, the family caring for Anna are the only ones who know you are sisters.
paras.zh: 除你父亲和我之外，只有照顾安娜的那户人家知道你们是姐妹。

paras.en: The rest of Arendelle does not remember their lost princess.
paras.zh: 阿伦黛尔的其他人都已不记得失踪的公主。

paras.en: Grand Pabbie also hid both of your memories of each other to ease the pain of separating you.
paras.zh: 皮比也藏起了你们彼此的记忆，以减轻分离之苦。

paras.en: Once the magic fades, your memories will return.
paras.zh: 一旦魔法消退，你们的记忆便会归来。

paras.en: If only you could have seen yourselves as children!
paras.zh: 真希望你能看见儿时的你们！

paras.en: Thick as thieves, and so inseparable that most mornings we would find Anna had crawled from her bed into yours.
paras.zh: 你们亲密无间，形影不离，大多清晨我们都会发现安娜从自己床上爬进了你的被窝。

paras.en: You were a wonderful big sister, and you will be again.
paras.zh: 你曾是一位出色的好姐姐，将来也会是。

paras.en: You two will find your way back to each other, I’m sure of it.
paras.zh: 你们俩一定会有重逢之日，我对此深信不疑。

paras.en: You are, and always have been, each other’s light in the darkness.
paras.zh: 你们是，也一直是，彼此在黑暗中的光。

paras.en: Mama and Papa Elsa looked at Anna.
paras.zh: 妈妈和爸爸 艾莎望向安娜。

paras.en: They both had tears in their eyes.
paras.zh: 两人眼中都噙着泪水。

paras.en: They embraced again and didn’t let go.
paras.zh: 她们再次相拥，久久不放。

paras.en: It took a few days for things in Arendelle to get back to normal.
paras.zh: 阿伦黛尔过了几天才恢复常态。

paras.en: Make that a new normal.
paras.zh: 不如说是恢复了新常态。

paras.en: The people welcomed both of their lost princesses back with open arms.
paras.zh: 人们张开双臂，热烈欢迎两位失而复得的公主归来。

paras.en: Elsa, contrite for what had accidentally happened to the kingdom, worked tirelessly to make things right.
paras.zh: 艾莎对王国遭遇的意外深感愧疚，不辞辛劳地弥补一切。

paras.en: For her first order of business, she sent Prince Hans packing. “We shall return this scoundrel to his country,” a ship captain told Elsa as they stood at the docks. “We will see what his twelve big brothers think of his behavior.” “Elsa, please let me make things right between us,” Hans begged as they lead him onto the ship.
paras.zh: 她的第一件事，就是把汉斯王子遣送走。我们会把这个恶棍送回他的国家，码头上，一位船长对艾莎说，且看他那十二个哥哥如何看待他的行径。艾莎，请让我弥补我们之间的事，汉斯被押上船时恳求道。

paras.en: He smiled apologetically. “Can’t we talk?” “Oh, I think we’ve done enough talking,” Elsa told him. “Your brothers might hear you out, though, after they read my letter.” She held a note in her hand and handed it to the captain of the ship. “I told them everything that happened here.
paras.zh: 他歉疚地笑了笑。我们就不能谈谈吗？哦，我想我们该说的话都说尽了，艾莎对他说，不过你哥哥们读完我的信，或许会听你分辩。她手里捏着一张字条，递给船长。我把这里发生的一切都告诉他们了。

paras.en: Maybe you can convince them not to toss you into the dungeons.” His face froze. “Enjoy the Southern Isles, Prince Hans.” The captain pushed Hans onto the ship.
paras.zh: 也许你能说服他们别把你扔进地牢。他的脸僵住了。好好享受南方群岛吧，汉斯王子。船长把汉斯推上船。

paras.en: She hoped they’d never see the likes of him again.
paras.zh: 她但愿再也不要见到他这种人。

paras.en: The Duke of Weselton, however, put up more of a fight. “This is unacceptable!” Elsa heard the Duke shouting as he was led onto a ship along with his men. “I have been a victim of fear!” the Duke argued. “I have been traumatized and— aaah!
paras.zh: 然而韦塞尔顿公爵反抗得更激烈。艾莎听见公爵在被卫兵连同手下押上船时大喊：这不可接受！我才是恐惧的受害者！公爵争辩道，我受了创伤，而且——啊！

paras.en: My neck hurts.
paras.zh: 我的脖子好痛。

paras.en: Is there a doctor I could see?” “You can see one when you arrive at home,” Elsa told him, feeling satisfied. “Arendelle will henceforth and forever no longer do business of any sort with Weaseltown .” “It’s Weselton!” the Duke cried as he was taken away. “Weselton!”
paras.zh: 有医生能给我看看吗？等你到家就能看了，艾莎满意地说，从今往后，阿伦黛尔永不再与貂鼠镇有任何往来。是韦塞尔顿！公爵被带走时喊道，韦塞尔顿！

paras.en: While Elsa prepared for a new coronation and worked on fixing things in the kingdom, Anna took a few days to travel home to her village and see her parents.
paras.zh: 当艾莎筹备新的加冕礼、着手修复王国事务时，安娜抽了几天时间，回乡探望养父母。

paras.en: Kristoff escorted her and was surprised that the villagers were as excited to see him as they were Anna.
paras.zh: 克里斯托夫护送她，惊讶地发现村民见到他和见到安娜一样兴奋。

paras.en: The two of them spent a long night in front of the fire, telling everyone about their journey and about the curse that had separated the princesses.
paras.zh: 两人在炉火前聊了整整一夜，向众人讲述他们的旅程，以及拆散两位公主的诅咒。

paras.en: But mostly, they marveled at Tomally and Johan for so faithfully keeping the king and queen’s secret.
paras.zh: 但最让他们惊叹的，是托玛丽和约翰如此忠实地守护着国王与王后的秘密。

paras.en: When the fire died down, people retired to their homes, and Kristoff and Sven headed to the barn.
paras.zh: 火苗渐弱，人们各自回家，克里斯托夫和斯文朝谷仓走去。

paras.en: (Kristoff said he was most comfortable there.) Then Anna sat with her adoptive parents in their living room and heard the story of how she had arrived on their doorstep.
paras.zh: 克里斯托夫说他待在那儿最自在。随后安娜和养父母坐在客厅，听他们讲述自己当年被送到门前的经过。

paras.en: Her parents weren’t sure if she’d ever been kissed by a troll, but they knew trolls had played a part in her journey. “Leaving you with me was the hardest thing your mother and father ever did, but they did it out of love,” Ma told her. “We were entrusted with keeping you safe till the time came for you all to be reunited.” “She started to think that day would never come,” Papa added. “I always held out hope you’d be reunited.
paras.zh: 养父母不确定她是否曾被地精亲吻过，但他们知道地精曾在她的旅途中扮演过角色。把你交给我，是你父母做过最艰难的事，可那是出于爱，妈妈对她说，我们受托在你与父母重聚之前护你平安。她一度以为那一天永远不会到来，爸爸补充道，可我一直抱着你们团聚的希望。

paras.en: But then…” “The king and queen perished at sea,” Anna finished.
paras.zh: 可后来……国王和王后葬身大海，安娜替他说完。

paras.en: Accepting what had happened to her parents would take time.
paras.zh: 接受父母遭遇的一切，需要时间。

paras.en: Knowing she’d lost so many years with them was painful, but she reminded herself that she’d had her mother in her life without even realizing it. “Freya” had loved her fiercely, and so had Tomally and Johan.
paras.zh: 想到与他们错过的那些年令人心痛，但她提醒自己：母亲其实一直活在她生命里，而她浑然不知。弗雷娅曾那样深爱她，托玛丽和约翰也是如此。

paras.en: Her life had been blessed in so many ways.
paras.zh: 她的人生在许多方面都蒙受恩泽。

paras.en: Finding the joy in their shared stories kept the tears at bay. “So you mean to tell me that in all the years ‘Freya’ visited, no one noticed she was actually the queen?” Anna asked her parents.
paras.zh: 在共同的故事里寻得欢乐，让她忍住了眼泪。那么你是说，在弗雷娅来访的那些年里，竟没人发现她其实就是王后？安娜问养父母。

paras.en: Ma laughed. “One time, Mr.
paras.zh: 妈妈笑了。有一次，拉森先生

paras.en: Larson came into the shop while she was here, and he actually bowed because he was so certain she was the queen, but your father convinced him otherwise.” “I said she was a distant cousin with terrible breath,” Papa told her. “That made him leave!” The three of them roared with laughter, and Anna knew without a shadow of a doubt that they truly were her parents in every sense of the word.
paras.zh: 当时她正在店里，拉森先生进来，因为认定她是王后，竟然鞠了躬，可你爸爸说服了他不是。我说她是个有口臭的远房表亲，爸爸告诉她，这话把他打发走了！三人放声大笑，安娜毫不怀疑：他们在任何意义上都是自己真正的父母。

paras.en: How fortunate she was to have had two sets of parents who loved her enough to set her free.
paras.zh: 她何其有幸，拥有两对甘愿放手、深爱她的父母。

paras.en: Anna left the village with promises to return and talk of Ma and Papa visiting her at the castle. “We wouldn’t miss your sister’s coronation for the world,” Ma said, hugging her tightly before letting her go to Kristoff, who was waiting to take her home.
paras.zh: 安娜离开村庄时承诺会回来，还说妈妈和爸爸要来城堡看她。你妹妹的加冕礼我们死也不会错过，妈妈紧紧抱住她，才把她交给等候带她回家的克里斯托夫。

paras.en: It was nice to see him out of his snow clothes, which he’d traded for a teal shirt and black vest.
paras.zh: 看到他脱下雪地装、换上蓝绿色衬衫和黑色马甲，感觉真不错。

paras.en: His blond hair shone bright in the sunlight.
paras.zh: 他的金发在阳光下闪闪发亮。

paras.en: Home.
paras.zh: 家。

paras.en: It felt strange to use that word about a place she hadn’t lived in since she was a child, but the castle felt more familiar than she had expected.
paras.zh: 把家用在自儿时就未住过的地方，感觉陌生，可城堡却比她预想的更熟悉。

paras.en: She quickly became reacquainted with the layout, her bedroom, and all the other rooms, even visiting her old friend Joan in the portrait gallery.
paras.zh: 她很快重新熟悉了布局和自己的卧室，还有各个房间，甚至去肖像廊探望了老朋友琼。

paras.en: The truth was, home was anywhere Elsa was.
paras.zh: 其实，有艾莎的地方就是家。

paras.en: She just hoped someone else would be comfortable staying nearby, too. “Okay, here we are!” Anna said. “ Now can you unblindfold me?” Kristoff grumbled.
paras.zh: 她只盼另一个人也能安心住在附近。好啦，我们到了！安娜说，现在能把我眼罩摘了吗？克里斯托夫嘟囔着。

paras.en: He’d spent the last half hour of their journey back to the kingdom unable to see.
paras.zh: 回王国的路上，最后一半小时他都看不见。

paras.en: Anna didn’t want to ruin the surprise, so she had insisted he let her lead the way.
paras.zh: 安娜不想破坏惊喜，坚持由她带路。

paras.en: Now they were standing on the waterfront. “Yes!” She pulled the blindfold off. “Ta-da!
paras.zh: 此刻他们站在水岸边。对啦！她扯下眼罩。哒哒！

paras.en: I got you a new sled to replace the one that got destroyed.” Kristoff’s jaw dropped. “Are you serious?” Anna squealed excitedly. “Yes!
paras.zh: 我给你买了辆新雪橇，替掉那辆坏的。克里斯托夫惊得合不拢嘴。你是认真的？安娜兴奋地尖叫，是啊！

paras.en: And it’s the latest model.” It wasn’t just a sled.
paras.zh: 而且是最新款。这可不只是辆雪橇。

paras.en: It was a state-of-the-art custom-built sleigh that had so much varnish Kristoff would never have to polish it with spit.
paras.zh: 这是一辆最先进的定制雪橇，上了厚厚的清漆，克里斯托夫再也不用唾沫去擦它。

paras.en: Sven marched in front of it, almost as if the sled had been his doing.
paras.zh: 斯文在车前阔步而行，仿佛这雪橇是他的杰作。

paras.en: She’d wrapped the sleigh with a ribbon and placed a new lute on the seat.
paras.zh: 她用丝带装饰了雪橇，还在座位上放了一把新鲁特琴。

paras.en: There was also a sack in the back of the sled filled with an ice ax, rope, and everything she could think of that he’d lost. “I can’t accept this,” Kristoff said, blushing. “You have to!” Anna insisted. “No returns!
paras.zh: 雪橇后头还放着一袋东西，装了冰镐、绳索，以及她能想到的他丢过的一切。这个我受不起，克里斯托夫红着脸说。你必须收下！安娜坚持，概不退换！

paras.en: No exchanges.
paras.zh: 概不调换。

paras.en: Future queen Elsa’s orders.
paras.zh: 这是未来女王艾莎的命令。

paras.en: She’s named you the official Arendelle ice master and deliverer.” She pointed to a shiny silver medal hanging from Sven’s neck.
paras.zh: 她封你为阿伦黛尔官方御用采冰师兼配送员。她指向挂在斯文脖子上的闪亮银牌。

paras.en: Kristoff scoffed. “That’s not a thing.” “Sure it is!” Anna said.
paras.zh: 克里斯托夫嗤之以鼻。哪有这种职务。当然有！安娜说。

paras.en: Call it a sisterly bond, but even without Anna’s saying so, Elsa seemed to know how much Anna wanted Kristoff around. “And,” she said, hoping to sweeten the deal, “it even has a cup holder.
paras.zh: 这就叫姐妹情吧，可即便安娜不说，艾莎似乎也知道她多希望克里斯托夫留在身边。而且，她想让这份礼物更诱人，说道，它还有个杯架呢。

paras.en: Do you like it?” “Like it?” Kristoff swung Anna high in the air. “I love it!
paras.zh: 你喜欢吗？喜欢？克里斯托夫把安娜高高举起。我太爱了！

paras.en: I could kiss you.” He quickly put her down and ran a hand through his hair. “I mean, I could.
paras.zh: 我真想亲你。他赶紧把她放下，伸手捋了捋头发。我是说，我可以。

paras.en: I’d like to.
paras.zh: 我愿意。

paras.en: May I?
paras.zh: 可以吗？

paras.en: We me?
paras.zh: 我们……我？

paras.en: I mean, may we?
paras.zh: 我是说，我们可以吗？

paras.en: Wait.
paras.zh: 等等。

paras.en: What?” Anna leaned in and kissed Kristoff on the cheek. “We may.” Kristoff didn’t hesitate.
paras.zh: 什么？安娜倾身，在克里斯托夫脸颊上亲了一下。我们可以。克里斯托夫没有迟疑。

paras.en: He pulled Anna into his arms and kissed her the way Anna had always imagined he would.
paras.zh: 他将安娜揽入怀中，以安娜一直想象的方式吻了她。

paras.en: Anna threw her arms around his neck and kissed him right back.
paras.zh: 安娜双臂环住他的脖颈，回吻了他。

paras.en: After a storm comes the sun.
paras.zh: 风暴过后，便是阳光。

paras.en: Arendelle truly had a new beginning, and people couldn’t wait to celebrate the kingdom’s rebirth.
paras.zh: 阿伦黛尔真正迎来了新的开端，人们迫不及待要庆祝王国的重生。

paras.en: Villagers flooded the castle to celebrate not only Elsa’s coronation but their lost princess.
paras.zh: 村民涌进城堡，既庆祝艾莎的加冕，也庆祝他们失踪的公主归来。

paras.en: Anna had been returned to them.
paras.zh: 安娜回到了他们身边。

paras.en: After so much sadness, Arendelle was basking in joy.
paras.zh: 在长久的悲伤之后，阿伦黛尔沐浴在喜悦之中。

paras.en: The sisters’ silhouettes appeared on new banners hanging from every flag post in the kingdom.
paras.zh: 姐妹俩的剪影出现在王国每根旗杆上新挂的旗帜上。

paras.en: And when it was finally time for Elsa to stand in front of the bishop and accept her crown, Anna was exactly where she was always meant to be: right by Elsa’s side. “Queen Elsa of Arendelle!” the bishop declared as he presented her to the people in the chapel.
paras.zh: 终于，到了艾莎站到主教面前接受王冠的时刻，安娜正站在她命定所在之处：艾莎的身旁。阿伦黛尔的艾莎女王！主教在教堂里向众人宣告。

paras.en: Elsa beamed with pride as she held the scepter and orb in her hands.
paras.zh: 艾莎手持权杖与宝球，自豪地绽开笑容。

paras.en: Her fingers didn’t tingle and she felt no fear.
paras.zh: 她的指尖不再发麻，心中也无恐惧。

paras.en: She knew now her purpose was to serve her people, and she’d do it with every fiber of her being.
paras.zh: 她如今明白，自己的使命是服务子民，她将倾尽全部去履行。

paras.en: After the ceremony, there was a banquet in the Great Hall with a large chocolate fountain and a beautiful cake.
paras.zh: 典礼之后，大礼堂里举行了宴会，有巨大的巧克力喷泉和精美的蛋糕。

paras.en: There was dancing, laughter, and merriment.
paras.zh: 人们载歌载舞，欢笑连连。

paras.en: The castle itself seemed to sigh with contentment.
paras.zh: 连城堡本身似乎都满足地舒了口气。

paras.en: For so long, the castle had lived in sorrow.
paras.zh: 长久以来，城堡都活在忧伤里。

paras.en: Now it truly was a happy place.
paras.zh: 如今它真正成了欢乐之地。

paras.en: While people enjoyed one another’s company, Elsa and Anna slipped away to the entrance hall and studied their family’s newly restored royal portrait.
paras.zh: 当人们正其乐融融时，艾莎和安娜悄悄溜到门厅，端详家中新修复的皇室画像。

paras.en: The one with the king, the queen, Elsa, and Anna had been returned to its rightful place of honor.
paras.zh: 那幅有国王、王后、艾莎和安娜的画像，已被归还原本的尊荣之位。

paras.en: Mr.
paras.zh: 卢登堡先生

paras.en: Ludenburg had already declared that he would complete a new sculpture for the castle courtyard fountain that reflected the family of four. “Tell me something about them I don’t know,” Anna said as she slipped her arm through Elsa’s.
paras.zh: 卢登堡已宣布，要为城堡庭院的喷泉完成一座新的雕塑，呈现一家四口。跟我说点我不知道的关于他们的事，安娜挽着艾莎的手臂说。

paras.en: Anna asked her questions like that daily, and Elsa loved to answer them.
paras.zh: 安娜天天这样问，而艾莎乐于回答。

paras.en: The two stayed up late into the night, sitting on each other’s beds, talking about anything and everything they could imagine. “They loved sweets almost as much as you and I do,” Elsa said as they turned to walk back toward the party. “Especially krumkaker.” Anna grinned. “I remember baking those!
paras.zh: 两人熬夜到深夜，坐在彼此床上，聊着能想到的一切。他们和我们一样爱甜食，转身走向宴会时，艾莎说，尤其爱krumkaker（挪威脆饼）。安娜咧嘴一笑。我记得烤过那些！

paras.en: You always ate half the batter before Miss Olina could cook them.” “That was you!” Elsa said accusingly, laughing. “Maybe it was Mama,” Anna said, but she was laughing, too.
paras.zh: 你总在奥丽娜小姐下锅前吃掉一半面糊。那是你！艾莎笑着，假装责怪。也许是妈妈，安娜说，但她也笑了。

paras.en: Kristoff and Olaf watched the sisters from the doorway with smiles.
paras.zh: 克里斯托夫和雪宝在门口含笑望着姐妹俩。

paras.en: No one seemed to want the party to end, so it didn’t.
paras.zh: 似乎没人想让宴会结束，于是它就没有结束。

paras.en: Not for a long while.
paras.zh: 很久都没有。

paras.en: But when the banquet hall grew warm and people needed air, Elsa knew exactly what to do to help them cool off.
paras.zh: 可当宴会厅变热、人们需要透气时，艾莎很清楚该怎么做让大家凉快。

paras.en: She gathered everyone outside. “Are you ready?” Elsa asked the crowd.
paras.zh: 她把大家聚到室外。准备好了吗？艾莎问众人。

paras.en: Their cheers and applause told her all she needed to know.
paras.zh: 他们的欢呼与掌声，已说明一切。

paras.en: Her magic no longer felt like a shackle.
paras.zh: 她的魔法不再像枷锁。

paras.en: It was truly a gift, as her mother had always told her, and now she used it with joy instead of fear.
paras.zh: 它真是一份天赋，正如母亲一直所说，如今她带着喜悦而非恐惧来使用它。

paras.en: Elsa tapped her foot on the courtyard ground.
paras.zh: 艾莎用脚轻点庭院地面。

paras.en: A sheet of ice slowly spread throughout the plaza.
paras.zh: 一层冰面缓缓铺满广场。

paras.en: Next Elsa lifted her hands to the sky and made the lightest of snowflakes fall.
paras.zh: 接着艾莎双手举向天空，让最轻盈的雪花飘落。

paras.en: On a hot summer night like that, an impromptu ice-skating party was the perfect gift.
paras.zh: 在那样一个炎热的夏夜，一场即兴的溜冰派对是最完美的礼物。

paras.en: People skidded around the square, enjoying the magic she had long kept to herself.
paras.zh: 人们在广场上滑行，享受着她长久独藏的魔法。

paras.en: Anna slid into place beside her. “This is so much fun!” Anna smiled. “I’m so happy I’m here with you.” Elsa held her arm tight. “We will never be apart again,” she promised.
paras.zh: 安娜滑到她身旁。太好玩了！安娜微笑着说，真高兴能和你在这里。我们再也不分开了，艾莎紧紧挽着她的手臂，许诺道。

paras.en: Then she transformed Anna’s shoes into an elegant pair of ice skates. “Oh, Elsa, they’re beautiful, but you know I don’t skate,” Anna said.
paras.zh: 接着她把安娜的鞋变成了优雅的冰刀鞋。哦，艾莎，它们真美，可你知道我不会滑冰，安娜说。

paras.en: Elsa grabbed her arms and swung her around the ice. “Come on!” she said, shouting encouragement to her little sister. “You can do it!” The two of them laughed as they spun around the fountain in the courtyard. “I got it!
paras.zh: 艾莎抓住她的手臂，带着她在冰上旋转。来嘛！她朝小妹妹喊着加油，你行的！两人绕着庭院喷泉打转，笑作一团。我学会了！

paras.en: I got it!
paras.zh: 我学会了！

paras.en: I don’t got it!” Anna laughed as she kept slipping. “Look out!
paras.zh: 我还没学会！安娜一边不断打滑一边笑。小心！

paras.en: Reindeer coming through!” said Kristoff as he and Sven slid by. “Hey, guys!” Olaf joined them on the ice. “Glide and pivot!
paras.zh: 驯鹿来啦！克里斯托夫和斯文滑过时说。嘿，伙伴们！雪宝也上了冰。滑行，再转身！

paras.en: Glide and pivot!” he advised as he grabbed hold of Elsa’s cape and went for a spin around the square.
paras.zh: 滑行，再转身！他抓着艾莎的斗篷，绕着广场转了一圈，这样建议道。

paras.en: Elsa smiled, her heart full and her head in a good place.
paras.zh: 艾莎微笑着，心中盈满温暖，思绪安好。

paras.en: Her people were happy.
paras.zh: 她的子民很快乐。

paras.en: She was content.
paras.zh: 她很满足。

paras.en: And she was very, very loved by a sister who had finally been returned to her.
paras.zh: 而她被一位终于回到身边的妹妹，深深地、深深地爱着。

paras.en: Things were exactly as they should be.
paras.zh: 一切恰如应有的模样。
